name: main_theorem
statement:
theorem main_theorem (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ →
      (∀ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ → ε₁ < 1 → 0 < ε₂ → ε₂ < 1 →
        SVW.phi ε₁ ε₂ ≤ SVW.theta d κ ε₁ ε₂) ∧
      (∀ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ → ε₁ < 1 → 0 < ε₂ → ε₂ < 1 → 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂ →
        SVW.theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ = 1 ∧ SVW.RadialOddConcentration d κ ε₁ ε₂) ∧
      SVW.criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2) ∧
    (∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ 1/8 →
        1/2-C*κ^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ SVW.criticalDensity d κ ∧ SVW.criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2) ∧
      Tendsto (SVW.criticalDensity d) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (1/2)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun κ hκ => SVW.svw_half_density_obstruction d hd κ hκ, SVW.svw_half_density_limit d hd⟩

name: SVW.memLp_indicator_null
statement:
theorem memLp_indicator_null (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ)
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : MemLp (E.indicator f) 2 μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).indicator₀ hE,
    lt_of_le_of_lt (eLpNorm_indicator_le f) (Lp.memLp f).2⟩

name: SVW.cut_coe
statement:
theorem cut_coe (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    cut μ E hE f =ᵐ[μ] E.indicator f
proof:
:=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.norm_cut_le
statement:
theorem norm_cut_le (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ‖cut μ E hE f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [cut, Lp.norm_toLp, Lp.norm_def]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (Lp.memLp f).2.ne (eLpNorm_indicator_le f)

name: SVW.cut_add
statement:
theorem cut_add (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    cut μ E hE (f + g) = cut μ E hE f + cut μ E hE g
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE (f + g), cut_coe μ E hE f,
    cut_coe μ E hE g, Lp.coeFn_add f g,
    Lp.coeFn_add (cut μ E hE f) (cut μ E hE g)] with x h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅
  rw [h₁, h₅]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [h₂, h₃]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E
  · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Pi.add_apply] using h₄
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_add]

name: SVW.cut_smul
statement:
theorem cut_smul (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (c : ℂ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    cut μ E hE (c • f) = c • cut μ E hE f
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE (c • f), cut_coe μ E hE f,
    Lp.coeFn_smul c f, Lp.coeFn_smul c (cut μ E hE f)] with x h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  rw [h₁, h₄]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [h₂]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E <;> simp [hx, h₃]

name: SVW.positionProjection_apply
statement:
theorem positionProjection_apply (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ)
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : positionProjection μ E hE f = cut μ E hE f
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.norm_positionProjection_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_positionProjection_le_one (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) :
    ‖positionProjection μ E hE‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro f
  simpa [positionProjection_apply] using norm_cut_le μ E hE f

name: SVW.cut_idempotent
statement:
theorem cut_idempotent (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    cut μ E hE (cut μ E hE f) = cut μ E hE f
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE (cut μ E hE f), cut_coe μ E hE f] with x h₁ h₂
  rw [h₁]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E
  · simp [hx]
  · simp [hx, h₂]

name: SVW.cut_compl
statement:
theorem cut_compl (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    cut μ Eᶜ hE.compl f = f - cut μ E hE f
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ Eᶜ hE.compl f, cut_coe μ E hE f,
    Lp.coeFn_sub f (cut μ E hE f)] with x h₁ h₂ h₃
  rw [h₁, h₃]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [h₂]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E <;> simp [hx]

name: SVW.cut_inner
statement:
theorem cut_inner (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ⟪cut μ E hE f, g⟫ = ⟪f, cut μ E hE g⟫
proof:
:= by
  simp only [L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE f, cut_coe μ E hE g] with x hf hg
  rw [hf, hg]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E <;> simp [hx]

name: SVW.positionProjection_isStarProjection
statement:
theorem positionProjection_isStarProjection (E : Set α)
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) : IsStarProjection (positionProjection μ E hE)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    exact cut_idempotent μ E hE f
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
    intro f g
    exact cut_inner μ E hE f g

name: SVW.positionProjection_compl
statement:
theorem positionProjection_compl (E : Set α) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) :
    positionProjection μ Eᶜ hE.compl = 1 - positionProjection μ E hE
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  exact cut_compl μ E hE f

name: SVW.frequencyProjection_apply
statement:
theorem frequencyProjection_apply (d : ℕ) (F : Set (Space d))
    (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) (f : Hilbert d) :
    frequencyProjection d F hF f = (fourier d).symm (cut volume F hF (fourier d f))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.norm_frequencyProjection_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_frequencyProjection_apply_le (d : ℕ) (F : Set (Space d))
    (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖frequencyProjection d F hF f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [frequencyProjection_apply, (fourier d).symm.norm_map]
  exact (norm_cut_le volume F hF (fourier d f)).trans_eq ((fourier d).norm_map f)

name: SVW.norm_frequencyProjection_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_frequencyProjection_le_one (d : ℕ) (F : Set (Space d))
    (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) : ‖frequencyProjection d F hF‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro f
  simpa using norm_frequencyProjection_apply_le d F hF f

name: SVW.frequency_residual_norm
statement:
theorem frequency_residual_norm (d : ℕ) (F : Set (Space d))
    (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖f - frequencyProjection d F hF f‖ = ‖cut volume Fᶜ hF.compl (fourier d f)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [cut_compl, ← (fourier d).norm_map (f - frequencyProjection d F hF f)]
  rw [(fourier d).map_sub, frequencyProjection_apply, (fourier d).apply_symm_apply]

name: SVW.frequencyProjection_isStarProjection
statement:
theorem frequencyProjection_isStarProjection (d : ℕ) (F : Set (Space d))
    (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) : IsStarProjection (frequencyProjection d F hF)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    change frequencyProjection d F hF (frequencyProjection d F hF f) = _
    simp only [frequencyProjection_apply, (fourier d).apply_symm_apply, cut_idempotent]
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
    intro f g
    change ⟪frequencyProjection d F hF f, g⟫ = ⟪f, frequencyProjection d F hF g⟫
    rw [← (fourier d).inner_map_map (frequencyProjection d F hF f) g,
      ← (fourier d).inner_map_map f (frequencyProjection d F hF g)]
    simp only [frequencyProjection_apply, (fourier d).apply_symm_apply]
    exact cut_inner volume F hF (fourier d f) (fourier d g)

name: SVW.concentration_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem concentration_norm_le_one (d : ℕ) (E F : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) :
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE * frequencyProjection d F hF‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE * frequencyProjection d F hF‖ ≤
        ‖positionProjection volume E hE‖ * ‖frequencyProjection d F hF‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (norm_positionProjection_le_one volume E hE)
      (norm_frequencyProjection_le_one d F hF) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    _ = 1 := mul_one 1

name: SVW.phi_symm
statement: theorem phi_symm (a b : ℝ) : phi a b = phi b a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phi, add_comm]

name: SVW.phiRadical_nonneg
statement: theorem phiRadical_nonneg (a b : ℝ) : 0 ≤ phiRadical a b
proof:
:=
  add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: SVW.phi_nonneg
statement: theorem phi_nonneg (a b : ℝ) : 0 ≤ phi a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold phi
  split_ifs
  · exact phiRadical_nonneg a b
  · norm_num

name: SVW.phi_square_identity
statement:
theorem phi_square_identity (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    phiRadical a b ^ 2 + phiGap a b ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ a * (1 - b) := mul_nonneg ha.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2)
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ b * (1 - a) := mul_nonneg hb.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2)
  have h₃ : 0 ≤ (1 - a) * (1 - b) :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2)
  have h₄ : 0 ≤ a * b := mul_nonneg ha.1 hb.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (a * (1 - b)) * Real.sqrt (b * (1 - a)) =
      Real.sqrt ((1 - a) * (1 - b)) * Real.sqrt (a * b) := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul h₁, ← Real.sqrt_mul h₃]
    congr 1
    ring
  unfold phiRadical phiGap
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h₁, Real.sq_sqrt h₂, Real.sq_sqrt h₃, Real.sq_sqrt h₄]

name: SVW.phiRadical_le_one
statement:
theorem phiRadical_le_one (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : phiRadical a b ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hi := phi_square_identity a b ha hb
  have hn := phiRadical_nonneg a b
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (phiGap a b)]

name: SVW.phi_le_one
statement:
theorem phi_le_one (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : phi a b ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold phi
  split_ifs
  · exact phiRadical_le_one a b ha hb
  · exact le_rfl

name: SVW.phiRadical_eq_one_of_add_eq_one
statement:
theorem phiRadical_eq_one_of_add_eq_one (a b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) : phiRadical a b = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : 1 - b = a := by linarith
  have h₂ : 1 - a = b := by linarith
  simp only [phiRadical, h₁, h₂, Real.sqrt_mul_self ha, Real.sqrt_mul_self hb]
  exact hab

name: SVW.phi_eq_one_of_one_le_add
statement:
theorem phi_eq_one_of_one_le_add (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hab : 1 ≤ a + b) : phi a b = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold phi
  split_ifs with h
  · exact phiRadical_eq_one_of_add_eq_one a b ha hb (le_antisymm h hab)
  · rfl

name: SVW.phiGap_nonneg
statement: theorem phiGap_nonneg (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + b ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ phiGap a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold phiGap
  apply sub_nonneg.mpr
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  nlinarith

name: SVW.phiGap_pos
statement:
theorem phiGap_pos (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hab : a + b < 1) : 0 < phiGap a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold phiGap
  apply sub_pos.mpr
  apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (mul_nonneg ha hb)
  nlinarith

name: SVW.phi_lt_one_of_add_lt_one
statement:
theorem phi_lt_one_of_add_lt_one (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hab : a + b < 1) : phi a b < 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨ha, by linarith⟩
  have hb' : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hb, by linarith⟩
  rw [phi, if_pos hab.le]
  change phiRadical a b < 1
  have hi := phi_square_identity a b ha' hb'
  have hn := phiRadical_nonneg a b
  have hp := phiGap_pos a b ha hb hab
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hp]

name: SVW.phi_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem phi_eq_one_iff (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    phi a b = 1 ↔ 1 ≤ a + b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    have hl := phi_lt_one_of_add_lt_one a b ha hb (lt_of_not_ge hc)
    linarith
  · exact phi_eq_one_of_one_le_add a b ha hb

name: SVW.continuousOn_phi
statement:
theorem continuousOn_phi :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => phi p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  change ContinuousOn
    (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => if p.1 + p.2 ≤ 1 then phiRadical p.1 p.2 else 1) _
  apply ContinuousOn.if
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨⟨ha, hb⟩, hfrontier⟩
    have hab : a + b = 1 :=
      frontier_le_subset_eq (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd) continuous_const hfrontier
    exact phiRadical_eq_one_of_add_eq_one a b ha.1 hb.1 hab
  · have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => phiRadical p.1 p.2) := by
      unfold phiRadical
      fun_prop
    exact hcont.continuousOn
  · exact continuous_const.continuousOn

name: SVW.phiGap_antitone_left
statement:
theorem phiGap_antitone_left (a a' b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (haa' : a ≤ a') : phiGap a' b ≤ phiGap a b
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (1 - a') * (1 - b) ≤ (1 - a) * (1 - b) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2)
  have h₂ : a * b ≤ a' * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haa' hb.1
  unfold phiGap
  linarith [Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h₁, Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h₂]

name: SVW.phiRadical_mono_left
statement:
theorem phiRadical_mono_left (a a' b : ℝ)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ha' : a' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (haa' : a ≤ a') (htriangle : a' + b ≤ 1) :
    phiRadical a b ≤ phiRadical a' b
proof:
:= by
  have hi := phi_square_identity a b ha hb
  have hi' := phi_square_identity a' b ha' hb
  have hg := phiGap_nonneg a b (by linarith)
  have hg' := phiGap_nonneg a' b htriangle
  have hgg := phiGap_antitone_left a a' b hb haa'
  have hn := phiRadical_nonneg a b
  have hn' := phiRadical_nonneg a' b
  have hsq : phiGap a' b ^ 2 ≤ phiGap a b ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hg' hg).mpr hgg
  nlinarith

name: SVW.phi_mono_left
statement:
theorem phi_mono_left (a a' b : ℝ)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ha' : a' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (haa' : a ≤ a') : phi a b ≤ phi a' b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htriangle : a' + b ≤ 1
  · have htriangle' : a + b ≤ 1 := by linarith
    simpa only [phi, if_pos htriangle, if_pos htriangle', phiRadical] using
      phiRadical_mono_left a a' b ha ha' hb haa' htriangle
  · have hlarge : phi a' b = 1 := by simp only [phi, if_neg htriangle]
    rw [hlarge]
    exact phi_le_one a b ha hb

name: SVW.phi_mono_right
statement:
theorem phi_mono_right (a b b' : ℝ)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb' : b' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hbb' : b ≤ b') : phi a b ≤ phi a b'
proof:
:= by
  rw [phi_symm a b, phi_symm a b']
  exact phi_mono_left b b' a hb hb' ha hbb'

name: SVW.phi_mono
statement:
theorem phi_mono (a b a' b' : ℝ)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ha' : a' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hb' : b' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (haa' : a ≤ a') (hbb' : b ≤ b') : phi a b ≤ phi a' b'
proof:
:= by
  exact (phi_mono_left a a' b ha ha' hb haa').trans
    (phi_mono_right a' b b' ha' hb hb' hbb')

name: SVW.monotoneOn_phi_left
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_phi_left (b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun a : ℝ => phi a b) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha a' ha' haa'
  exact phi_mono_left a a' b ha ha' hb haa'

name: SVW.monotoneOn_phi_right
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_phi_right (a : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun b : ℝ => phi a b) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb b' hb' hbb'
  exact phi_mono_right a b b' ha hb hb' hbb'

name: SVW.phiRadical_symm
statement: theorem phiRadical_symm (a b : ℝ) : phiRadical a b = phiRadical b a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phiRadical, add_comm]

name: SVW.phiRadical_mono_right
statement:
theorem phiRadical_mono_right (a b b' : ℝ)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb' : b' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hbb' : b ≤ b') (htriangle : a + b' ≤ 1) :
    phiRadical a b ≤ phiRadical a b'
proof:
:= by
  rw [phiRadical_symm a b, phiRadical_symm a b']
  exact phiRadical_mono_left b b' a hb hb' ha hbb' (by linarith)

name: SVW.phiRadical_mono_of_le
statement:
theorem phiRadical_mono_of_le (u v a b : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hua : u ≤ a) (hvb : v ≤ b) (hab : a + b ≤ 1) :
    phiRadical u v ≤ phiRadical a b
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hu, by linarith⟩
  have hv' : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv, by linarith⟩
  have ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  exact (phiRadical_mono_left u a v hu' ha hv' hua (by linarith)).trans
    (phiRadical_mono_right a v b ha hv' hb hvb hab)

name: SVW.reciprocalRadius_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalRadius_zero (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ : ℝ) : reciprocalRadius κ (0 : E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [reciprocalRadius]

name: SVW.reciprocalRadius_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalRadius_pos (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (x : E) : 0 < reciprocalRadius κ x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [reciprocalRadius, hx]
  · simp only [reciprocalRadius, if_neg hx, lt_min_iff]
    exact ⟨zero_lt_one, div_pos hκ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)⟩

name: SVW.reciprocalRadius_le_one
statement:
theorem reciprocalRadius_le_one (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ : ℝ) (x : E) : reciprocalRadius κ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [reciprocalRadius, hx]
  · simp only [reciprocalRadius, if_neg hx]
    exact min_le_left _ _

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_pos
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_pos (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (x : E) :
    0 < truncatedRadius κ δ x
proof:
:= by
  exact div_pos hκ (lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (le_max_right _ _))

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_le_div
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_le_div (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (x : E) :
    truncatedRadius κ δ x ≤ κ / δ
proof:
:= by
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hκ hδ (le_max_right _ _)

name: SVW.max_norm_lipschitz
statement:
theorem max_norm_lipschitz (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] (δ : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun x : E => max ‖x‖ δ)
proof:
:=
  lipschitzWith_one_norm.max_const δ

name: SVW.reciprocal_difference_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocal_difference_bound (κ δ a b : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (ha : δ ≤ a) (hb : δ ≤ b) :
    |κ / a - κ / b| ≤ (κ / δ ^ 2) * |a - b|
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ ha
  have hb0 : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ hb
  have hab0 : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha0 hb0
  have hden : δ ^ 2 ≤ a * b := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul ha hb hδ.le ha0.le
  have hfrac : κ / (a * b) ≤ κ / δ ^ 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hκ (sq_pos_of_pos hδ) hden
  have hid : κ / a - κ / b = κ * (b - a) / (a * b) := by
    field_simp
  calc
    |κ / a - κ / b| = (κ / (a * b)) * |a - b| := by
      rw [hid, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hκ, abs_of_pos hab0, abs_sub_comm]
      ring
    _ ≤ (κ / δ ^ 2) * |a - b| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfrac (abs_nonneg _)

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_lipschitz
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_lipschitz (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (κ / δ ^ 2))
      (truncatedRadius (E := E) κ δ)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ κ / δ ^ 2 := div_nonneg hκ (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hfactor, Real.dist_eq]
  have hmax : |max ‖x‖ δ - max ‖y‖ δ| ≤ dist x y := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using
      (max_norm_lipschitz E δ).dist_le_mul x y
  exact (reciprocal_difference_bound κ δ (max ‖x‖ δ) (max ‖y‖ δ)
    hκ hδ (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax hfactor)

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_sub_le
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_sub_le (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (x y : E) :
    |truncatedRadius κ δ x - truncatedRadius κ δ y| ≤
      (κ / δ ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.coe_toNNReal _
    (div_nonneg hκ (sq_nonneg δ))] using
      (truncatedRadius_lipschitz E κ δ hκ hδ).dist_le_mul x y

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_eq_reciprocalRadius
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_eq_reciprocalRadius (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hκδ : κ ≤ δ) (x : E) (hx : δ ≤ ‖x‖) :
    truncatedRadius κ δ x = reciprocalRadius κ x
proof:
:= by
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ hx
  have hxzero : x ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hxpos
  have hdiv : κ / ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hxpos).mpr (hκδ.trans hx)
  simp only [truncatedRadius, max_eq_left hx, reciprocalRadius, if_neg hxzero,
    min_eq_right hdiv]

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_le_sq_of_cube
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_le_sq_of_cube (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) (x : E) :
    truncatedRadius κ δ x ≤ δ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hκ : 0 ≤ κ := by rw [← hcube]; positivity
  have hid : κ / δ = δ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hcube]
    field_simp
  exact (truncatedRadius_le_div E κ δ hκ hδ x).trans_eq hid

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_lipschitz_of_cube
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_lipschitz_of_cube (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal δ) (truncatedRadius (E := E) κ δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hκ : 0 ≤ κ := by rw [← hcube]; positivity
  have hid : κ / δ ^ 2 = δ := by
    rw [← hcube]
    field_simp
  simpa only [hid] using truncatedRadius_lipschitz E κ δ hκ hδ

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_eq_reciprocalRadius_of_cube
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_eq_reciprocalRadius_of_cube
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] (κ δ : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ)
    (x : E) (hx : δ ≤ ‖x‖) :
    truncatedRadius κ δ x = reciprocalRadius κ x
proof:
:= by
  have hδsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hκδ : κ ≤ δ := by
    rw [← hcube]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδsq hδ.le]
  exact truncatedRadius_eq_reciprocalRadius E κ δ hδ hκδ x hx

name: SVW.wolffThin_mono
statement:
theorem wolffThin_mono (d : ℕ) (κ ε η : ℝ) (E : Set (Space d))
    (hE : WolffThin d κ ε E) (hεη : ε ≤ η) : WolffThin d κ η E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hE.1, fun x => (hE.2 x).trans ?_⟩
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hεη measureReal_nonneg

name: SVW.wolffThin_empty
statement:
theorem wolffThin_empty (d : ℕ) (κ ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    WolffThin d κ ε ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nullMeasurableSet_empty, fun x => ?_⟩
  simp only [empty_inter, measureReal_empty]
  exact mul_nonneg hε measureReal_nonneg

name: SVW.testingBall_volume_pos
statement:
theorem testingBall_volume_pos (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (x : Space d) :
    0 < volume (testingBall d κ x)
proof:
:= by
  exact Metric.measure_ball_pos volume x (reciprocalRadius_pos (Space d) κ hκ x)

name: SVW.testingBall_volume_ne_top
statement:
theorem testingBall_volume_ne_top (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    volume (testingBall d κ x) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  exact measure_ball_lt_top.ne

name: SVW.concentrationValues_bddAbove
statement:
theorem concentrationValues_bddAbove (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ) :
    BddAbove (concentrationValues d κ ε₁ ε₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rintro t ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
  exact concentration_norm_le_one d E F hE.1 hF.1

name: SVW.concentrationValues_nonempty
statement:
theorem concentrationValues_nonempty (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hε₁ : 0 ≤ ε₁) (hε₂ : 0 ≤ ε₂) :
    (concentrationValues d κ ε₁ ε₂).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let hE := wolffThin_empty d κ ε₁ hε₁
  let hF := wolffThin_empty d κ ε₂ hε₂
  exact ⟨_, ∅, ∅, hE, hF, rfl⟩

name: SVW.theta_nonneg
statement: theorem theta_nonneg (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ theta d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sSup_nonneg
  rintro t ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
  exact norm_nonneg _

name: SVW.theta_le_one
statement:
theorem theta_le_one (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hε₁ : 0 ≤ ε₁) (hε₂ : 0 ≤ ε₂) : theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le (concentrationValues_nonempty d κ ε₁ ε₂ hε₁ hε₂)
  rintro t ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
  exact concentration_norm_le_one d E F hE.1 hF.1

name: SVW.concentration_norm_le_theta
statement:
theorem concentration_norm_le_theta (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (E F : Set (Space d)) (hE : WolffThin d κ ε₁ E) (hF : WolffThin d κ ε₂ F) :
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE.1 * frequencyProjection d F hF.1‖ ≤
      theta d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:=
  le_csSup (concentrationValues_bddAbove d κ ε₁ ε₂) ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩

name: SVW.theta_mono
statement:
theorem theta_mono (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ η₁ η₂ : ℝ)
    (hε₁ : 0 ≤ ε₁) (hε₂ : 0 ≤ ε₂) (h₁ : ε₁ ≤ η₁) (h₂ : ε₂ ≤ η₂) :
    theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ ≤ theta d κ η₁ η₂
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le (concentrationValues_nonempty d κ ε₁ ε₂ hε₁ hε₂)
  rintro t ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
  exact concentration_norm_le_theta d κ η₁ η₂ E F
    (wolffThin_mono d κ ε₁ η₁ E hE h₁) (wolffThin_mono d κ ε₂ η₂ F hF h₂)

name: SVW.criticalDensity_nonneg
statement: theorem criticalDensity_nonneg (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ criticalDensity d κ
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sSup_nonneg
  intro ε hε
  exact hε.1.le

name: SVW.criticalDensity_le_one
statement: theorem criticalDensity_le_one (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) : criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ({ε : ℝ | 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ theta d κ ε ε < 1}).Nonempty
  · exact csSup_le h (fun ε hε => hε.2.1.le)
  · rw [criticalDensity, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h, Real.sSup_empty]
    exact zero_le_one

name: SVW.density_cube_root
statement:
theorem density_cube_root (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    0 < κ^((1:ℝ)/3) ∧ (κ^((1:ℝ)/3))^3 = κ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rpow_pos_of_pos hκ _, ?_⟩
  simpa only [one_div, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    (rpow_inv_natCast_pow hκ.le (by decide : (3:ℕ) ≠ 0))

name: SVW.density_cube_root_le_half
statement:
theorem density_cube_root_le_half (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8) :
    κ^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ 1/2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by decide : (3:ℕ) ≠ 0) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2)
  rw [(density_cube_root κ hκ).2]
  norm_num
  exact hκsmall

name: SVW.criticalDensity_lower_of_initial_gap
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_lower_of_initial_gap
    (d : ℕ) (κ a : ℝ) (ha : a ≤ 1)
    (hgap : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < a → theta d κ ε ε < 1) :
    a ≤ criticalDensity d κ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hca : criticalDensity d κ < a := lt_of_not_ge hn
  obtain ⟨ε, hcε, hεa⟩ := exists_between hca
  have hε : 0 < ε := (criticalDensity_nonneg d κ).trans_lt hcε
  have hb : BddAbove {e : ℝ | 0 < e ∧ e < 1 ∧ theta d κ e e < 1} :=
    ⟨1, fun e he => he.2.1.le⟩
  have hs : ε ≤ criticalDensity d κ :=
    le_csSup hb ⟨hε, hεa.trans_le ha, hgap ε hε hεa⟩
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hs) hcε

name: SVW.criticalDensity_upper_of_saturation
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_upper_of_saturation
    (d : ℕ) (κ a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hsat : theta d κ a a = 1) :
    criticalDensity d κ ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hne : ({ε : ℝ | 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ theta d κ ε ε < 1}).Nonempty
  · apply csSup_le hne
    intro ε hε
    by_contra hn
    have haε : a ≤ ε := (lt_of_not_ge hn).le
    have hm := theta_mono d κ a a ε ε ha ha haε haε
    rw [hsat] at hm
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hm) hε.2.2
  · rw [criticalDensity, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Real.sSup_empty]
    exact ha

name: SVW.density_cube_root_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem density_cube_root_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun κ : ℝ => κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds
    (tendsto_id.rpow_const_nhds_zero (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/3))

name: SVW.shiftedGaussian_pos
statement:
theorem shiftedGaussian_pos (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (v x : Space d) :
    0 < shiftedGaussian d a v x
proof: := exp_pos _

name: SVW.continuous_shiftedGaussian
statement:
theorem continuous_shiftedGaussian (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (v : Space d) :
    Continuous (shiftedGaussian d a v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedGaussian
  fun_prop

name: SVW.integrable_shiftedGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_shiftedGaussian (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (v : Space d) :
    Integrable (shiftedGaussian d a v) volume
proof:
:= by
  have h := (GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
    (V := Space d) (b := (a : ℂ)) (by simpa using ha) 1 v).re
  refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  simp [shiftedGaussian, Complex.exp_re, neg_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_pow]

name: SVW.integral_shiftedGaussian
statement:
theorem integral_shiftedGaussian (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (v : Space d) :
    (∫ x, shiftedGaussian d a v x) =
      (π / a) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_inj]
  have hc := GaussianFourier.integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
    (V := Space d) (b := (a : ℂ)) (show 0 < (a : ℂ).re from ha) 1 v
  have hleft : (∫ x : Space d,
      Complex.exp (-(a : ℂ) * (‖x‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 + (1 : ℂ) * (⟪v, x⟫_ℝ : ℂ))) =
      ((∫ x, shiftedGaussian d a v x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      simp [shiftedGaussian, Complex.ofReal_exp]
  rw [hleft] at hc
  rw [hc]
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (Space d) = d := by simp [Space]
  rw [hdim]
  have hp : (π / (a : ℂ)) ^ ((d : ℂ) / 2) =
      (((π / a) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow (div_nonneg pi_pos.le ha.le)]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hp, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  congr 1
  simp [Complex.ofReal_exp]

name: SVW.gaussian_polynomial_exp_bound
statement:
theorem gaussian_polynomial_exp_bound (c q : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    q * exp (-c * q) ≤ 1 / c
proof:
:= by
  have hq : c * q ≤ exp (c * q) := by linarith [add_one_le_exp (c * q)]
  calc
    q * exp (-c * q) = (1 / c) * ((c * q) * exp (-c * q)) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ (1 / c) * (exp (c * q) * exp (-c * q)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq (exp_pos _).le) (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / c := by rw [← exp_add]; simp

name: SVW.shiftedGaussian_secondMoment_le
statement:
theorem shiftedGaussian_secondMoment_le (d : ℕ) (b c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hcb : 2 * c ≤ b) (v x : Space d) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d b v x ≤ (1 / c) * shiftedGaussian d c v x
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hexp : exp (-(b - c) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ) ≤
      exp (-c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ) := by
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith
  calc
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d b v x =
        (‖x‖ ^ 2 * exp (-c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) *
          exp (-(b - c) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← exp_add]
      congr 1
      unfold shiftedGaussian
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ (1 / c) * exp (-(b - c) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussian_polynomial_exp_bound c (‖x‖ ^ 2) hc) (exp_pos _).le
    _ ≤ (1 / c) * shiftedGaussian d c v x :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity)

name: SVW.integrable_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment
statement:
theorem integrable_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (v : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d a v x) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_shiftedGaussian d (a / 2) (by positivity) v).const_mul (1 / (a / 2))).mono'
  · exact (continuous_norm.pow 2 |>.mul (continuous_shiftedGaussian d a v)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (shiftedGaussian_pos d a v x).le)]
      exact shiftedGaussian_secondMoment_le d a (a / 2) (by positivity) (by linarith) v x

name: SVW.hasDerivAt_shiftedGaussian_parameter
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_shiftedGaussian_parameter (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (v x : Space d) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => shiftedGaussian d b v x)
      (-(‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d a v x)) a
proof:
:= by
  convert! ((((hasDerivAt_id a).neg.mul_const (‖x‖ ^ 2)).add_const ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ).exp) using 1
  simp only [shiftedGaussian, Pi.neg_apply, id_eq]
  ring

name: SVW.hasDerivAt_integral_shiftedGaussian
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_shiftedGaussian (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (v : Space d) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => ∫ x, shiftedGaussian d b v x)
      (-(∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d a v x)) a
proof:
:= by
  let F' : ℝ → Space d → ℝ := fun b x => -(‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d b v x)
  let bound : Space d → ℝ := fun x => (1 / (a / 4)) * shiftedGaussian d (a / 4) v x
  have hbint : Integrable bound volume :=
    (integrable_shiftedGaussian d (a / 4) (by positivity) v).const_mul _
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ b in nhds a, AEStronglyMeasurable (shiftedGaussian d b v) volume :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun b => (continuous_shiftedGaussian d b v).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hdmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (F' a) volume :=
    ((continuous_norm.pow 2 |>.mul (continuous_shiftedGaussian d a v)).neg).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball a (a / 2), ‖F' b x‖ ≤ bound x := by
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x b hb => by
      have hb' : a / 2 ≤ b := by
        have hdist : |b - a| < a / 2 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hb
        have := (abs_lt.mp hdist).1
        linarith
      dsimp only [F', bound]
      rw [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (shiftedGaussian_pos d b v x).le)]
      exact shiftedGaussian_secondMoment_le d b (a / 4) (by positivity) (by linarith) v x
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball a (a / 2),
      HasDerivAt (fun b => shiftedGaussian d b v x) (F' b x) b :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x b _hb => hasDerivAt_shiftedGaussian_parameter d b v x
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds a (by positivity : 0 < a / 2)) hmeas
    (integrable_shiftedGaussian d a ha v) hdmeas hbound hbint hdiff).2
  simpa only [F', integral_neg] using hd

name: SVW.hasDerivAt_shiftedGaussian_mass_formula
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_shiftedGaussian_mass_formula (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (v : Space d) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => (π / b) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * b)))
      (-(((d : ℝ) / (2 * a) + ‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * a ^ 2)) *
        ((π / a) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * a))))) a
proof:
:= by
  have hp : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => π / b) (-π / a ^ 2) a := by
    convert! (hasDerivAt_const a π).div (hasDerivAt_id a) ha.ne' using 1
    simp
  have hpow := hp.rpow_const (p := (d : ℝ) / 2) (Or.inl (div_pos pi_pos ha).ne')
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => ‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * b))
      (-‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * a ^ 2)) a := by
    convert! (hasDerivAt_const a (‖v‖ ^ 2)).div
      ((hasDerivAt_id a).const_mul 4) (by positivity : 4 * a ≠ 0) using 1
    simp only [id_eq]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hExp := hinner.exp
  convert! hpow.mul hExp using 1
  rw [rpow_sub_one (div_pos pi_pos ha).ne']
  field_simp
  ring

name: SVW.integral_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment
statement:
theorem integral_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (v : Space d) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d a v x) =
      ((d : ℝ) / (2 * a) + ‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * a ^ 2)) *
        (π / a) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * a))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun b : ℝ => ∫ x, shiftedGaussian d b v x) =ᶠ[nhds a]
      (fun b : ℝ => (π / b) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (‖v‖ ^ 2 / (4 * b))) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ha] with b hb
    exact integral_shiftedGaussian d b hb v
  have hD := (hasDerivAt_shiftedGaussian_mass_formula d a ha v).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  have hdEq := (hasDerivAt_integral_shiftedGaussian d a ha v).unique hD
  have hresult := neg_inj.mp hdEq
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using hresult

name: SVW.norm_sum_sq_of_pairwise_orthogonal
statement:
theorem norm_sum_sq_of_pairwise_orthogonal
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → H)
    (hv : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → inner ℂ (v i) (v j) = 0) :
    ‖∑ i : Fin n, v i‖^2 = ∑ i : Fin n, ‖v i‖^2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi : inner ℂ (∑ i : Fin n, v i) (∑ i : Fin n, v i) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, inner ℂ (v i) (v i) := by
    rw [sum_inner]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    rw [inner_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
    · intro j _hj hji
      exact hv i j (Ne.symm hji)
    · simp
  calc
    ‖∑ i : Fin n, v i‖^2 = (inner ℂ (∑ i : Fin n, v i) (∑ i : Fin n, v i)).re :=
      InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) _
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, ‖v i‖^2 := by
      rw [hi, Complex.re_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _hi
      exact (InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (v i)).symm

name: SVW.norm_sum_orthogonal_operators_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_orthogonal_operators_le
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hA : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖A i‖ ≤ C)
    (horth : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ x : H, inner ℂ (A i x) (A j x) = 0) :
    ‖∑ i : Fin n, A i‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) * C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro x
  have hn : ‖∑ i : Fin n, A i x‖^2 = ∑ i : Fin n, ‖A i x‖^2 :=
    norm_sum_sq_of_pairwise_orthogonal H n (fun i => A i x) (fun i j hij => horth i j hij x)
  have hb : (∑ i : Fin n, ‖A i x‖^2) ≤ (n:ℝ)*(C*‖x‖)^2 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, ‖A i x‖^2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, (C*‖x‖)^2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _hi
        have ha := (A i).le_opNorm x
        have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA i) (norm_nonneg x)
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ha.trans hc) 2
      _ = (n:ℝ)*(C*‖x‖)^2 := by simp
  have hr : (Real.sqrt (n:ℝ))^2 = (n:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hp : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)*C*‖x‖ := by positivity
  have ht : ‖∑ i : Fin n, A i x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)*C*‖x‖ := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (∑ i : Fin n, A i x)]
  simpa only [sum_apply] using ht

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.toLinf_coe
statement: theorem toLinf_coe (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) : m.toLinf =ᵐ[μ] m
proof: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_coe
statement:
theorem operator_coe (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    m.operator f =ᵐ[μ] fun x => m x * f x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).coeFn_holder (r := 2) m.toLinf f,
    m.toLinf_coe] with x h₁ h₂
  simpa only [operator, ContinuousLinearMap.holderL_apply_apply, h₂,
    ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using h₁

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.norm_operator_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_operator_apply_le (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ‖m.operator f‖ ≤ (m.bound : ℝ) * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
  filter_upwards [m.operator_coe f, m.norm_le] with x hx hm
  rw [hx, norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (norm_nonneg _)

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.norm_operator_le
statement: theorem norm_operator_le (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) : ‖m.operator‖ ≤ (m.bound : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ m.bound.coe_nonneg
  exact m.norm_operator_apply_le

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_one
statement: theorem operator_one : (one (α := α) (μ := μ)).operator = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(one (α := α) (μ := μ)).operator_coe f] with x hx
  simpa only [one, one_mul, one_apply_eq_self] using hx

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_mul
statement:
theorem operator_mul (m n : BoundedSymbol α μ) :
    (m.mul n).operator = m.operator * n.operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(m.mul n).operator_coe f, m.operator_coe (n.operator f),
    n.operator_coe f] with x h₁ h₂ h₃
  change (m.mul n).operator f x = m.operator (n.operator f) x
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  exact mul_assoc _ _ _

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_conj_inner
statement:
theorem operator_conj_inner (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) (f g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    inner ℂ (m.conj.operator f) g = inner ℂ f (m.operator g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [m.conj.operator_coe f, m.operator_coe g] with x hf hg
  rw [hf, hg]
  change inner ℂ (star (m x) * f x) (g x) = inner ℂ (f x) (m x * g x)
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, map_mul, Complex.star_def, starRingEnd_self_apply]
  ring

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_conj
statement: theorem operator_conj (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) : m.conj.operator = star m.operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext_inner_right ℂ
  intro g
  rw [operator_conj_inner, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.norm_operator_apply_eq_of_unimodular
statement:
theorem norm_operator_apply_eq_of_unimodular (m : BoundedSymbol α μ)
    (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖m x‖ = 1) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : ‖m.operator f‖ = ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lp.norm_def]
  congr 1
  apply eLpNorm_congr_norm_ae
  filter_upwards [m.operator_coe f, hm] with x hx hmx
  rw [hx, norm_mul, hmx, one_mul]

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_conj_apply_cancel
statement:
theorem operator_conj_apply_cancel (m : BoundedSymbol α μ)
    (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖m x‖ = 1) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    m.operator (m.conj.operator f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [m.operator_coe (m.conj.operator f), m.conj.operator_coe f, hm]
    with x hx hy hmx
  rw [hx, hy]
  change m x * (star (m x) * f x) = f x
  rw [← mul_assoc, Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_conj]
  have hn : Complex.normSq (m x) = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hmx, one_pow]
  rw [hn, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.unitary_apply
statement:
theorem unitary_apply (m : BoundedSymbol α μ) (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖m x‖ = 1)
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : m.unitary hm f = m.operator f
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.radial_gaussian_first_moment_bound
statement:
theorem radial_gaussian_first_moment_bound (a r : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    r * exp (-a * r ^ 2) ≤ (1 + 2/a) * exp (-(a/2) * r ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have he0 : 1 ≤ exp (a*r^2/2) := one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity)
  have he1 : a*r^2/2 ≤ exp (a*r^2/2) := by
    linarith [add_one_le_exp (a*r^2/2)]
  have hc : 0 ≤ 2/a := by positivity
  have hs : r^2 ≤ (2/a) * exp (a*r^2/2) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he1 hc
    have hh' : (2/a) * (a*r^2/2) = r^2 := by field_simp
    rwa [hh'] at hh
  have hr' : r ≤ (1+2/a) * exp (a*r^2/2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r-1/2)]
  calc
    r * exp (-a*r^2) ≤ ((1+2/a) * exp (a*r^2/2)) * exp (-a*r^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr' (exp_pos _).le
    _ = (1+2/a) * exp (-(a/2)*r^2) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.gaussian_le_one
statement:
theorem gaussian_le_one (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (x : Space d) :
    gaussian d b x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply exp_le_one_iff.mpr
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]

name: SVW.norm_mul_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem norm_mul_gaussian_le (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (x : Space d) :
    ‖x‖ * gaussian d b x ≤ (1+2/b) * gaussian d (b/2) x
proof:
:=
  radial_gaussian_first_moment_bound b ‖x‖ hb

name: SVW.integrable_norm_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_mul_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖ * gaussian d b x) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_gaussian d (b/2) (by positivity)).const_mul (1+2/b)).mono'
  · unfold gaussian
    fun_prop
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (gaussian_pos d b x).le)]
      exact norm_mul_gaussian_le d b hb x)

name: SVW.weighted_gaussian_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_gaussian_bound (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (x : Space d) :
    (1+‖x‖) * gaussian d b x ≤ 2+2/b
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (norm_mul_gaussian_le d b hb x).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussian_le_one d (b/2) (by positivity) x)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+2/b))
  have hg := gaussian_le_one d b hb.le x
  nlinarith

name: SVW.hasFDerivAt_gaussian
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    HasFDerivAt (gaussian d b) ((gaussian d b x * (-2*b)) • innerSL ℝ x) x
proof:
:= by
  convert! (((hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (-b)).exp) using 1
  ext y
  simp only [gaussian, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.norm_fderiv_gaussian
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (x : Space d) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (gaussian d b) x‖ = 2*b*‖x‖*gaussian d b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_gaussian d b x).fderiv, norm_smul, innerSL_apply_norm,
    norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (gaussian_pos d b x)]
  simp only [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_ofNat, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
  ring

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_weighted_bound
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_weighted_bound (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) :
    (1+‖x‖) * gaussianWindow d x ≤ (2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/4) * (2+2/π)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianWindow
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (1+‖x‖), mul_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (weighted_gaussian_bound d π pi_pos x) (by positivity)

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_derivative_bound (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (gaussianWindow d) x‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/4) * (2*π) * (1+2/π)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (hasFDerivAt_gaussian d π x).const_mul ((2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/4))
  change ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/4) * gaussian d π y) x‖ ≤ _
  rw [hd.fderiv, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [← (hasFDerivAt_gaussian d π x).fderiv, norm_fderiv_gaussian d π pi_pos.le]
  have hn := (norm_mul_gaussian_le d π pi_pos x).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussian_le_one d (π/2) (by positivity) x)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+2/π))
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/4)*(2*π))
  nlinarith

name: SVW.gaussian_pos
statement: theorem gaussian_pos (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (x : Space d) : 0 < gaussian d b x
proof:
:=
  exp_pos _

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (gaussian d b) volume
proof:
:= by
  have h := (GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
    (V := Space d) (b := (b : ℂ)) (by simpa using hb) 0 0).re
  refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
  simp [gaussian, neg_mul, Complex.exp_re, ← Complex.ofReal_pow]

name: SVW.integral_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ x : Space d, gaussian d b x = (π / b) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [gaussian] using
    (GaussianFourier.integral_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm (V := Space d) hb)

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_pos
statement: theorem gaussianWindow_pos (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) : 0 < gaussianWindow d x
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _) (gaussian_pos d π x)

name: SVW.integrable_gaussianWindow
statement: theorem integrable_gaussianWindow (d : ℕ) : Integrable (gaussianWindow d) volume
proof:
:=
  (integrable_gaussian d π pi_pos).const_mul _

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_sq
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_sq (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) :
    gaussianWindow d x ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * gaussian d (2 * π) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianWindow gaussian
  rw [mul_pow]
  have hp : ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) := by
    rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    congr 1
    ring
  have he : exp (-π * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 = exp (-(2 * π) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hp, he]

name: SVW.integrable_gaussianWindow_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianWindow_sq (d : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => gaussianWindow d x ^ 2) volume
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianWindow_sq]
  exact (integrable_gaussian d (2 * π) (by positivity)).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_gaussianWindow_sq
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianWindow_sq (d : ℕ) :
    ∫ x : Space d, gaussianWindow d x ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianWindow_sq]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussian d (2 * π) (by positivity)]
  have hpi : π / (2 * π) = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by field_simp
  rw [hpi, ← mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
  norm_num

name: SVW.heatDensity_pos
statement:
theorem heatDensity_pos (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (x : Space d) :
    0 < heatDensity d t x
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos pi_pos ht) _) (gaussian_pos d (π ^ 2 / t) x)

name: SVW.integrable_heatDensity
statement:
theorem integrable_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (heatDensity d t) volume
proof:
:=
  (integrable_gaussian d (π ^ 2 / t) (by positivity)).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_heatDensity
statement:
theorem integral_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫ x : Space d, heatDensity d t x = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatDensity
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussian d (π ^ 2 / t) (by positivity)]
  rw [← mul_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / t)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (π ^ 2 / t))]
  have h : π / t * (π / (π ^ 2 / t)) = 1 := by
    field_simp
  rw [h, one_rpow]

name: SVW.separatorSymbol_nonneg
statement:
theorem separatorSymbol_nonneg (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    0 ≤ separatorSymbol d q p
proof:
:= by
  unfold separatorSymbol
  positivity

name: SVW.separatorSymbol_le_one
statement:
theorem separatorSymbol_le_one (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    separatorSymbol d q p ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold separatorSymbol
  by_cases h : ‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2 = 0
  · rw [h, div_zero]
    exact zero_le_one
  · apply (div_le_one (lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm h))).mpr
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)

name: SVW.separatorSymbol_complement
statement:
theorem separatorSymbol_complement (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (h : q ≠ 0 ∨ p ≠ 0) :
    separatorSymbol d p (-q) = 1 - separatorSymbol d q p
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    rcases h with hq | hp
    · have : 0 < ‖q‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hq
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖p‖]
    · have : 0 < ‖p‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hp
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖q‖]
  simp only [separatorSymbol, norm_neg]
  rw [add_comm (‖p‖ ^ 2)]
  field_simp
  ring

name: SVW.measurable_separatorSymbol
statement:
theorem measurable_separatorSymbol (d : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun z : Space d × Space d => separatorSymbol d z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold separatorSymbol
  fun_prop

name: SVW.ennreal_two_mul_le_add_sq
statement:
theorem ennreal_two_mul_le_add_sq (u v : ℝ≥0∞) :
    2 * (u * v) ≤ u ^ 2 + v ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.young_inequality u v Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
  have h' : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (u * v) ≤ 2 * (u ^ (2 : ℝ) / ENNReal.ofReal 2 + v ^ (2 : ℝ) / ENNReal.ofReal 2) := by gcongr
  norm_num only [ENNReal.rpow_two, ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] at h'
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * 2⁻¹ = 1 := ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  calc
    2 * (u * v) ≤ 2 * (u ^ 2 / 2 + v ^ 2 / 2) := h'
    _ = (2 * 2⁻¹) * u ^ 2 + (2 * 2⁻¹) * v ^ 2 := by
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_add]
      ac_rfl
    _ = u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 := by rw [htwo, one_mul, one_mul]

name: SVW.kernel_row_square_bound
statement:
theorem kernel_row_square_bound
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ]
    (K : X × X → ℝ≥0∞) (hK : Measurable K)
    (u : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hu : Measurable u) (s : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫⁻ y, K (x, y) ∂μ ≤ s) :
    ∫⁻ w, K w * u w.1 ^ 2 ∂μ.prod μ ≤ s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_prod (fun w : X × X => K w * u w.1 ^ 2) (by fun_prop)]
  calc
    ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, K (x, y) * u x ^ 2 ∂μ ∂μ =
        ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, K (x, y) ∂μ) * u x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact lintegral_mul_const (u x ^ 2)
        (hK.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, s * u x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [hrow] with x hx
      gcongr
    _ = s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ := lintegral_const_mul s (hu.pow_const 2)

name: SVW.kernel_schur_lintegral
statement:
theorem kernel_schur_lintegral
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ]
    (K : X × X → ℝ≥0∞) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hsym : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, K w = K w.swap)
    (u : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hu : Measurable u) (s : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫⁻ y, K (x, y) ∂μ ≤ s) :
    ∫⁻ w, K w * (u w.1 * u w.2) ∂μ.prod μ ≤ s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : (∫⁻ w, K w * u w.2 ^ 2 ∂μ.prod μ) =
      ∫⁻ w, K w * u w.1 ^ 2 ∂μ.prod μ := by
    rw [← lintegral_prod_swap (fun w : X × X => K w * u w.2 ^ 2)]
    apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hsym] with w hw
    simp only [Prod.snd_swap]
    rw [← hw]
  have hrowbound := kernel_row_square_bound X μ K hK u hu s hrow
  apply (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_right (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
    (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞)).mp
  calc
    2 * ∫⁻ w, K w * (u w.1 * u w.2) ∂μ.prod μ =
        ∫⁻ w, 2 * (K w * (u w.1 * u w.2)) ∂μ.prod μ := by
      exact (lintegral_const_mul 2 (show Measurable (fun w : X × X => K w * (u w.1 * u w.2)) by fun_prop)).symm
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ w, K w * u w.1 ^ 2 + K w * u w.2 ^ 2 ∂μ.prod μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro w
      simpa only [mul_add, mul_comm (2 : ℝ≥0∞), mul_assoc] using
        (show K w * (2 * (u w.1 * u w.2)) ≤ K w * (u w.1 ^ 2 + u w.2 ^ 2) by
          gcongr
          exact ennreal_two_mul_le_add_sq (u w.1) (u w.2))
    _ = (∫⁻ w, K w * u w.1 ^ 2 ∂μ.prod μ) +
        ∫⁻ w, K w * u w.2 ^ 2 ∂μ.prod μ :=
      lintegral_add_left (hK.mul ((hu.comp measurable_fst).pow_const 2)) _
    _ ≤ (s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ) + (s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
      rw [hswap]
      exact add_le_add hrowbound hrowbound
    _ = 2 * (s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ) := by rw [two_mul]

name: SVW.kernel_schur_lintegral_ae
statement:
theorem kernel_schur_lintegral_ae
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ]
    (K : X × X → ℝ≥0∞) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hsym : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, K w = K w.swap)
    (u : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hu : AEMeasurable u μ) (s : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫⁻ y, K (x, y) ∂μ ≤ s) :
    ∫⁻ w, K w * (u w.1 * u w.2) ∂μ.prod μ ≤ s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hfst := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).ae_eq hu.ae_eq_mk
  have hsnd := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).ae_eq hu.ae_eq_mk
  calc
    ∫⁻ w, K w * (u w.1 * u w.2) ∂μ.prod μ =
        ∫⁻ w, K w * (hu.mk u w.1 * hu.mk u w.2) ∂μ.prod μ := by
      apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hfst, hsnd] with w hw1 hw2
      simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hw1 hw2
      rw [hw1, hw2]
    _ ≤ s * ∫⁻ x, hu.mk u x ^ 2 ∂μ :=
      kernel_schur_lintegral X μ K hK hsym (hu.mk u) hu.measurable_mk s hrow
    _ = s * ∫⁻ x, u x ^ 2 ∂μ := by
      congr 1
      apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hu.ae_eq_mk] with x hx
      rw [hx]

name: SVW.kernel_schur_real_integral
statement:
theorem kernel_schur_real_integral
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ]
    (K : X × X → ℝ) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hK0 : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, 0 ≤ K w)
    (hsym : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, K w = K w.swap)
    (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) μ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (K (x, y)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) :
    Integrable (fun w => K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖)) (μ.prod μ) ∧
      (∫ w, K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖) ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
        s * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hfst : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : X × X => f w.1) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst
  have hsnd : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : X × X => f w.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd
  have hg : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : X × X => K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖))
      (μ.prod μ) := hK.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hfst.norm.mul hsnd.norm)
  have hg0 : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, 0 ≤ K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖) := by
    filter_upwards [hK0] with w hw
    positivity
  have hsym' : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, ENNReal.ofReal (K w) = ENNReal.ofReal (K w.swap) := by
    filter_upwards [hsym] with w hw
    rw [hw]
  have hbound := kernel_schur_lintegral_ae X μ (fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (K w))
    (by fun_prop) hsym' (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ‖f x‖) (by fun_prop)
    (ENNReal.ofReal s) hrow
  have hsq : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _))]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg (f x)) 2).symm
  have hbound' : (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖)) ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (s * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖)) ∂μ.prod μ) =
          ∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (K w) *
            (ENNReal.ofReal ‖f w.1‖ * ENNReal.ofReal ‖f w.2‖) ∂μ.prod μ := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hK0] with w hw
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hw, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := hbound
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (s * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) := by rw [hsq, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hs]
  have hfinite : Integrable (fun w => K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖)) (μ.prod μ) := by
    refine ⟨hg, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hg0).mpr ?_⟩
    exact hbound'.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hg0 hg]
  have hright : 0 ≤ s * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ :=
    mul_nonneg hs (integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _))
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hright] using
    ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hbound'

name: SVW.kernel_schur_complex_integral
statement:
theorem kernel_schur_complex_integral
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ]
    (K : X × X → ℝ) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hK0 : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, 0 ≤ K w)
    (hsym : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ, K w = K w.swap)
    (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) μ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (K (x, y)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) :
    Integrable (fun w => (K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2)) (μ.prod μ) ∧
      (∫ w, (K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2) ∂μ.prod μ).re ≤
        s * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hg := kernel_schur_real_integral X μ K hK hK0 hsym f hf hf2 s hs hrow
  have hfst : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : X × X => f w.1) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst
  have hsnd : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : X × X => f w.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd
  have hgc : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun w => (K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hK.complex_ofReal.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hfst.inner hsnd)
  have hnorm : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.prod μ,
      ‖(K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2)‖ ≤ K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖) := by
    filter_upwards [hK0] with w hw
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hw]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_inner_le_norm _ _) hw
  have hfinite := hg.1.mono' hgc hnorm
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ w, (K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2) ∂μ.prod μ).re ≤
        ‖∫ w, (K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2) ∂μ.prod μ‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ w, ‖(K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2)‖ ∂μ.prod μ :=
      norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ w, K w * (‖f w.1‖ * ‖f w.2‖) ∂μ.prod μ :=
      integral_mono_ae hfinite.norm hg.1 hnorm
    _ ≤ s * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := hg.2

name: SVW.lp_integral_norm_sq
statement:
theorem lp_integral_norm_sq
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ‖f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_re (𝕜 := ℂ) (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) f f)
  simpa only [inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← L2.inner_def] using h

name: SVW.cut_norm_sq_eq_setIntegral
statement:
theorem cut_norm_sq_eq_setIntegral
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)
    (E : Set X) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ‖cut μ E hE f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x in E, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq X μ (cut μ E hE f)]
  calc
    (∫ x, ‖cut μ E hE f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∫ x, E.indicator (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) x ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE f] with x hx
      rw [hx]
      by_cases hxE : x ∈ E <;> simp [hxE]
    _ = ∫ x in E, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_indicator₀ hE

name: SVW.kernel_schur_compression
statement:
theorem kernel_schur_compression
    (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [SigmaFinite μ]
    (E : Set X) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ)
    (K : X × X → ℝ) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hK0 : ∀ᵐ w ∂(μ.restrict E).prod (μ.restrict E), 0 ≤ K w)
    (hsym : ∀ᵐ w ∂(μ.restrict E).prod (μ.restrict E), K w = K w.swap)
    (R : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) (hR : IsSelfAdjoint R)
    (hrep : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 μ, inner ℂ (cut μ E hE f) (R (cut μ E hE f)) =
      ∫ w, (K w : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f w.1) (f w.2) ∂(μ.restrict E).prod (μ.restrict E))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict E,
      ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (K (x, y)) ∂μ.restrict E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) :
    positionProjection μ E hE * R * positionProjection μ E hE ≤
      s • positionProjection μ E hE
proof:
:= by
  let P : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ := positionProjection μ E hE
  have hP := positionProjection_isStarProjection μ E hE
  change P * R * P ≤ s • P
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.le_def _ _ |>.mpr
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_def'.mpr
  have hsPeq : s • P = (s : ℂ) • P := (algebraMap_smul ℂ s P).symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsPeq]
    exact ((show IsSelfAdjoint (s : ℂ) by simp [isSelfAdjoint_iff]).smul
      hP.isSelfAdjoint).sub (hR.conjugate_self hP.isSelfAdjoint)
  intro f
  have hf2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).mp (Lp.memLp f)
  have hbound := (kernel_schur_complex_integral X (μ.restrict E) K hK hK0 hsym
    f (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).restrict hf2.restrict s hs hrow).2
  rw [← cut_norm_sq_eq_setIntegral X μ E hE f, ← hrep f] at hbound
  have hPP : (inner ℂ f (P f)).re = ‖cut μ E hE f‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hc := cut_inner μ E hE f (cut μ E hE f)
    rw [cut_idempotent] at hc
    change (inner ℂ f (cut μ E hE f)).re = _
    rw [← hc]
    exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) _
  have hPRP : inner ℂ f ((P * R * P) f) =
      inner ℂ (cut μ E hE f) (R (cut μ E hE f)) := by
    change inner ℂ f (cut μ E hE (R (cut μ E hE f))) = _
    exact (cut_inner μ E hE f (R (cut μ E hE f))).symm
  have hsP : (inner ℂ f ((s • P) f)).re = s * ‖cut μ E hE f‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsPeq, smul_apply, inner_smul_right]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    rw [hPP]
  change 0 ≤ (inner ℂ ((s • P - P * R * P) f) f).re
  have hswapre : (inner ℂ ((s • P - P * R * P) f) f).re =
      (inner ℂ f ((s • P - P * R * P) f)).re :=
    inner_re_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) _ _
  rw [hswapre]
  simp only [sub_apply, inner_sub_right, Complex.sub_re]
  rw [hsP, hPRP]
  linarith

name: SVW.gram_linearCombination_inner
statement:
theorem gram_linearCombination_inner (I H K : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (e : I → H) (f : I → K)
    (hgram : ∀ i j : I, inner ℂ (e i) (e j) = inner ℂ (f i) (f j))
    (c d : I →₀ ℂ) :
    inner ℂ (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e c) (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e d) =
      inner ℂ (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ f c) (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ f d)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, sum_inner, inner_sum,
    inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, hgram]

name: SVW.gram_linearCombination_norm
statement:
theorem gram_linearCombination_norm (I H K : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (e : I → H) (f : I → K)
    (hgram : ∀ i j : I, inner ℂ (e i) (e j) = inner ℂ (f i) (f j))
    (c : I →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e c‖ = ‖Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ f c‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ), norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ),
    gram_linearCombination_inner I H K e f hgram]

name: SVW.gramExtension_linearCombination
statement:
theorem gramExtension_linearCombination (I H K : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (e : I → H) (f : I → K)
    (hdense : DenseRange (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e))
    (hgram : ∀ i j : I, inner ℂ (e i) (e j) = inner ℂ (f i) (f j))
    (c : I →₀ ℂ) :
    gramExtension I H K e f (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e c) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ f c
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq hdense
  refine ⟨1, fun d => ?_⟩
  rw [one_mul, gram_linearCombination_norm I H K e f hgram]

name: SVW.gramExtension_generator
statement:
theorem gramExtension_generator (I H K : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (e : I → H) (f : I → K)
    (hdense : DenseRange (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e))
    (hgram : ∀ i j : I, inner ℂ (e i) (e j) = inner ℂ (f i) (f j))
    (i : I) : gramExtension I H K e f (e i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa using gramExtension_linearCombination I H K e f hdense hgram (Finsupp.single i 1)

name: SVW.gramExtension_norm
statement:
theorem gramExtension_norm (I H K : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (e : I → H) (f : I → K)
    (hdense : DenseRange (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ e))
    (hgram : ∀ i j : I, inner ℂ (e i) (e j) = inner ℂ (f i) (f j))
    (x : H) : ‖gramExtension I H K e f x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  refine hdense.induction_on (p := fun y : H => ‖gramExtension I H K e f y‖ = ‖y‖) x ?_ ?_
  · exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_norm
  · intro c
    rw [gramExtension_linearCombination I H K e f hdense hgram]
    exact (gram_linearCombination_norm I H K e f hgram c).symm

name: SVW.orthonormal_partial_norm_sub_sq
statement:
theorem orthonormal_partial_norm_sub_sq (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (v : ℕ → H) (hv : Orthonormal ℂ v) (x : H) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    ‖x-∑ i ∈ s, inner ℂ (v i) x • v i‖^2 = ‖x‖^2-∑ i ∈ s, ‖inner ℂ (v i) x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ : (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, inner ℂ (v i) x * inner ℂ x (v j) * inner ℂ (v j) (v i)) =
      (∑ k ∈ s, inner ℂ (v k) x * inner ℂ x (v k) : ℂ) := hv.inner_left_right_finset
  have h₃ (z : ℂ) : RCLike.re (z * conj z) = ‖z‖^2 := by
    change (z * conj z).re = ‖z‖^2
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [@norm_sub_sq ℂ, sub_add]
  simp only [@InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ H, inner_sum, sum_inner]
  simp only [inner_smul_right, two_mul, inner_smul_left, inner_conj_symm, ← mul_assoc, h₂,
    add_sub_cancel_right, sub_right_inj]
  simp only [map_sum, ← inner_conj_symm x, ← h₃]

name: SVW.mem_closed_span_of_orthonormal_norm_saturation
statement:
theorem mem_closed_span_of_orthonormal_norm_saturation (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (v : ℕ → H) (hv : Orthonormal ℂ v) (x : H)
    (hs : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ‖inner ℂ (v n) x‖^2) (‖x‖^2)) :
    x ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range v)).topologicalClosure
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ‖x‖^2)).sub hs.tendsto_sum_nat
  have he (n : ℕ) : ‖x‖^2-∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖inner ℂ (v k) x‖^2 =
      ‖x-∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, inner ℂ (v k) x • v k‖^2 :=
    (orthonormal_partial_norm_sub_sq H v hv x (Finset.range n)).symm
  simp only [he, sub_self] at ht
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖(∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, inner ℂ (v k) x • v k)-x‖)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero, norm_sub_rev] using ht.sqrt
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, inner ℂ (v k) x • v k)
      atTop (nhds x) := tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr hnorm
  apply (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range v)).isClosed_topologicalClosure.mem_of_tendsto hlim
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro n
  apply (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range v)).le_topologicalClosure
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k,rfl⟩))

name: SVW.cyclicNormalFormToFree_left_inverse
statement:
theorem cyclicNormalFormToFree_left_inverse :
    cyclicNormalFormToFree.comp freeToCyclicNormalForm = MonoidHom.id (FreeGroup Bool)
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp [cyclicNormalFormToFree, freeToCyclicNormalForm]

name: SVW.cyclicNormalFormToFree_right_inverse
statement:
theorem cyclicNormalFormToFree_right_inverse :
    freeToCyclicNormalForm.comp cyclicNormalFormToFree = MonoidHom.id CyclicProduct
proof:
:= by
  apply Monoid.CoprodI.ext_hom
  intro i
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  change freeToCyclicNormalForm (FreeGroup.of i ^ Multiplicative.toAdd z) =
    Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ) (i := i) z
  rw [freeToCyclicNormalForm_zpow, ofAdd_toAdd]

name: SVW.freeCyclicCoordinates_left_multiply
statement:
theorem freeCyclicCoordinates_left_multiply (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    freeCyclicCoordinates i (FreeGroup.of i ^ k * g) =
      (k + (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).1, (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).2)
proof:
:= by
  change cyclicPairCoordinates i (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equivPair i
    (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ)
      (freeToCyclicNormalForm (FreeGroup.of i ^ k * g)))) = _
  rw [map_mul, freeToCyclicNormalForm_zpow]
  change cyclicPairCoordinates i (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equivPair i
    ((Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ) (i := i)
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd k) * freeToCyclicNormalForm g) • Monoid.CoprodI.Word.empty)) = _
  rw [mul_smul, Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equivPair_smul_same]
  rfl

name: SVW.lp_two_norm_sq
statement:
theorem lp_two_norm_sq (I : Type*) (E : I → Type*) [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    (f : lp E 2) : ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑' i : I, ‖f i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (p := 2) (by norm_num) f

name: SVW.lp_two_summable_sq
statement:
theorem lp_two_summable_sq (I : Type*) (E : I → Type*) [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    (f : lp E 2) : Summable (fun i : I => ‖f i‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (lp.memℓp f).summable (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)

name: SVW.l2RelabelFunction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem l2RelabelFunction_apply (I J : Type*) (e : I ≃ J) (f : GroupHilbert I) (j : J) :
    l2RelabelFunction I J e f j = f (e.symm j)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.l2RelabelFunction_norm
statement:
theorem l2RelabelFunction_norm (I J : Type*) (e : I ≃ J) (f : GroupHilbert I) :
    ‖l2RelabelFunction I J e f‖ = ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖l2RelabelFunction I J e f‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [lp_two_norm_sq, lp_two_norm_sq]
    exact e.symm.tsum_eq (fun i => ‖f i‖ ^ 2)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg f, norm_nonneg (l2RelabelFunction I J e f)]

name: SVW.l2Fiber_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem l2Fiber_apply (J : Type*) (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) (j : J) (n : ℤ) :
    l2Fiber J f j n = f (n, j)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.l2Fiber_summable_norm_sq
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_summable_norm_sq (J : Type*) (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) :
    Summable (fun j : J => ‖l2Fiber J f j‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa +instances only [lp_two_norm_sq, l2Fiber_apply, Prod.swap] using
    ((lp_two_summable_sq (ℤ × J) (fun _ => ℂ) f).prod_symm).prod

name: SVW.l2Fiber_norm_sq_sum
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_norm_sq_sum (J : Type*) (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) :
    (∑' j : J, ‖l2Fiber J f j‖ ^ 2) = ‖f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := (lp_two_summable_sq (ℤ × J) (fun _ => ℂ) f).prod_symm
  calc
    _ = ∑' j : J, ∑' n : ℤ, ‖f (n, j)‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [lp_two_norm_sq, l2Fiber_apply]
    _ = ∑' p : J × ℤ, ‖f p.swap‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa +instances only [Prod.swap] using h.tsum_prod.symm
    _ = ∑' p : ℤ × J, ‖f p‖ ^ 2 := (Equiv.prodComm J ℤ).tsum_eq (fun p => ‖f p‖ ^ 2)
    _ = _ := (lp_two_norm_sq (ℤ × J) (fun _ => ℂ) f).symm

name: SVW.l2Fiber_add
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_add (J : Type*) (f g : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) (j : J) :
    l2Fiber J (f + g) j = l2Fiber J f j + l2Fiber J g j
proof: := by ext n; rfl

name: SVW.l2Fiber_smul
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_smul (J : Type*) (c : ℂ) (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) (j : J) :
    l2Fiber J (c • f) j = c • l2Fiber J f j
proof: := by ext n; rfl

name: SVW.l2Fiber_image_sq_le
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_image_sq_le (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) (j : J) :
    ‖S (l2Fiber J f j)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S‖ ^ 2 * ‖l2Fiber J f j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_pow] using (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr (S.le_opNorm (l2Fiber J f j))

name: SVW.l2Fiber_image_summable
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_image_summable (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) : Summable (fun j : J => ‖S (l2Fiber J f j)‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (l2Fiber_image_sq_le J S f)
    ((l2Fiber_summable_norm_sq J f).mul_left (‖S‖ ^ 2))

name: SVW.l2FiberLift_mem
statement:
theorem l2FiberLift_mem (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) : Memℓp (fun p : ℤ × J => S (l2Fiber J f p.2) p.1) 2
proof:
:= by
  apply memℓp_gen
  have hsum : Summable (fun p : J × ℤ => ‖S (l2Fiber J f p.1) p.2‖ ^ 2) := by
    apply (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)).mpr
    constructor
    · intro j
      exact lp_two_summable_sq ℤ (fun _ => ℂ) (S (l2Fiber J f j))
    · simpa only [← lp_two_norm_sq] using l2Fiber_image_summable J S f
  simpa using hsum.prod_symm

name: SVW.l2FiberLiftFunction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem l2FiberLiftFunction_apply (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) (p : ℤ × J) :
    l2FiberLiftFunction J S f p = S (l2Fiber J f p.2) p.1
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.l2Fiber_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem l2Fiber_lift (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) (j : J) :
    l2Fiber J (l2FiberLiftFunction J S f) j = S (l2Fiber J f j)
proof: := by ext n; rfl

name: SVW.l2FiberLiftFunction_norm_le
statement:
theorem l2FiberLiftFunction_norm_le (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) : ‖l2FiberLiftFunction J S f‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [mul_pow, ← l2Fiber_norm_sq_sum J (l2FiberLiftFunction J S f)]
  simp only [l2Fiber_lift]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j : J, ‖S‖ ^ 2 * ‖l2Fiber J f j‖ ^ 2 :=
      Summable.tsum_le_tsum (l2Fiber_image_sq_le J S f) (l2Fiber_image_summable J S f)
        ((l2Fiber_summable_norm_sq J f).mul_left _)
    _ = _ := by rw [tsum_mul_left, l2Fiber_norm_sq_sum]

name: SVW.l2FiberLift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem l2FiberLift_apply (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) : l2FiberLift J S f = l2FiberLiftFunction J S f
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.l2FiberLift_idempotent
statement:
theorem l2FiberLift_idempotent (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ f : GroupHilbert ℤ, S (S f) = S f) (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) :
    l2FiberLift J S (l2FiberLift J S f) = l2FiberLift J S f
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [l2FiberLift_apply, l2FiberLiftFunction_apply, l2Fiber_lift, hS]

name: SVW.l2Fiber_inner_sum
statement:
theorem l2Fiber_inner_sum (J : Type*) (f g : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) :
    (∑' j : J, ⟪l2Fiber J f j, l2Fiber J g j⟫_ℂ) = ⟪f, g⟫_ℂ
proof:
:= by
  have h := (lp.summable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) f g).prod_symm
  calc
    _ = ∑' j : J, ∑' n : ℤ, ⟪f (n, j), g (n, j)⟫_ℂ := by
      simp only [lp.inner_eq_tsum, l2Fiber_apply]
    _ = ∑' p : J × ℤ, ⟪f p.swap, g p.swap⟫_ℂ := by
      simpa +instances only [Prod.swap] using h.tsum_prod.symm
    _ = ∑' p : ℤ × J, ⟪f p, g p⟫_ℂ :=
      (Equiv.prodComm J ℤ).tsum_eq (fun p => ⟪f p, g p⟫_ℂ)
    _ = _ := (lp.inner_eq_tsum f g).symm

name: SVW.l2FiberLift_symmetric
statement:
theorem l2FiberLift_symmetric (J : Type*) (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ f g : GroupHilbert ℤ, ⟪S f, g⟫_ℂ = ⟪f, S g⟫_ℂ)
    (f g : GroupHilbert (ℤ × J)) :
    ⟪l2FiberLift J S f, g⟫_ℂ = ⟪f, l2FiberLift J S g⟫_ℂ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← l2Fiber_inner_sum J, ← l2Fiber_inner_sum J]
  simp only [l2FiberLift_apply, l2Fiber_lift, hS]

name: SVW.circleSequenceProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleSequenceProjection_apply (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f : GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    circleSequenceProjection A hA f = circleFourierUnitary
      (cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet (circleFourierUnitary.symm f))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.circleSequenceProjection_idempotent
statement:
theorem circleSequenceProjection_idempotent (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f : GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    circleSequenceProjection A hA (circleSequenceProjection A hA f) =
      circleSequenceProjection A hA f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [circleSequenceProjection_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    cut_idempotent]

name: SVW.circleSequenceProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem circleSequenceProjection_symmetric (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f g : GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    ⟪circleSequenceProjection A hA f, g⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪f, circleSequenceProjection A hA g⟫_ℂ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← circleFourierUnitary.symm.inner_map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← circleFourierUnitary.symm.inner_map_map]
  simp only [circleSequenceProjection_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact cut_inner AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet _ _

name: SVW.circleSequenceProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem circleSequenceProjection_norm_le (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f : GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    ‖circleSequenceProjection A hA f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [circleSequenceProjection_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using
    norm_cut_le AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeCyclicOperator_apply (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) (f : FreeHilbert) :
    freeCyclicOperator i S f = (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i).symm
      (l2FiberLift (CyclicTail i) S (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i f))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_idempotent
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_idempotent (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ f : GroupHilbert ℤ, S (S f) = S f) (f : FreeHilbert) :
    freeCyclicOperator i S (freeCyclicOperator i S f) = freeCyclicOperator i S f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [freeCyclicOperator_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    l2FiberLift_idempotent (CyclicTail i) S hS]

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_symmetric
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_symmetric (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ f g : GroupHilbert ℤ, ⟪S f, g⟫_ℂ = ⟪f, S g⟫_ℂ) (f g : FreeHilbert) :
    ⟪freeCyclicOperator i S f, g⟫_ℂ = ⟪f, freeCyclicOperator i S g⟫_ℂ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i).inner_map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i).inner_map_map]
  simp only [freeCyclicOperator_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact l2FiberLift_symmetric (CyclicTail i) S hS _ _

name: SVW.freeArcProjection_idempotent
statement:
theorem freeArcProjection_idempotent (i : Bool) (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f : FreeHilbert) :
    freeArcProjection i A hA (freeArcProjection i A hA f) = freeArcProjection i A hA f
proof:
:=
  freeCyclicOperator_idempotent i _ (circleSequenceProjection_idempotent A hA) f

name: SVW.freeArcProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem freeArcProjection_symmetric (i : Bool) (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f g : FreeHilbert) :
    ⟪freeArcProjection i A hA f, g⟫_ℂ = ⟪f, freeArcProjection i A hA g⟫_ℂ
proof:
:=
  freeCyclicOperator_symmetric i _ (circleSequenceProjection_symmetric A hA) f g

name: SVW.circleFourierUnitary_symm_delta_zero
statement:
theorem circleFourierUnitary_symm_delta_zero :
    circleFourierUnitary.symm (groupDelta ℤ 0) =ᵐ[AddCircle.haarAddCircle]
      (fun _ : AddCircle (1 : ℝ) => (1 : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  change (fourierBasis (T := (1 : ℝ))).repr.symm (groupDelta ℤ 0) =ᵐ[AddCircle.haarAddCircle] _
  have hδ : groupDelta ℤ 0 = lp.single 2 0 (1 : ℂ) := by
    ext k
    by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [groupDelta_apply, lp.single_apply, hk]
  rw [hδ, HilbertBasis.repr_symm_single, coe_fourierBasis]
  filter_upwards [coeFn_fourierLp (T := (1 : ℝ)) 2 0] with z hz
  simpa using hz

name: SVW.circleSequenceProjection_diagonal
statement:
theorem circleSequenceProjection_diagonal (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
