    circleSequenceProjection A hA (groupDelta ℤ 0) 0 =
      ((AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  change (fourierBasis (T := (1 : ℝ))).repr
    (cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet
      (circleFourierUnitary.symm (groupDelta ℤ 0))) 0 = _
  rw [fourierBasis_repr, fourierCoeff]
  have hae : (fun z : AddCircle (1 : ℝ) => _root_.fourier (0 : ℤ) z •
      cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet
        (circleFourierUnitary.symm (groupDelta ℤ 0)) z) =ᵐ[AddCircle.haarAddCircle]
      A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) := by
    filter_upwards [cut_coe AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet
      (circleFourierUnitary.symm (groupDelta ℤ 0)), circleFourierUnitary_symm_delta_zero]
      with z hz hz0
    simp only [fourier_zero, one_smul, hz]
    by_cases hzA : z ∈ A <;> simp [hzA, hz0]
  simpa only [neg_zero, integral_indicator hA, setIntegral_const,
    Measure.real, smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul, mul_one] using integral_congr_ae hae

name: SVW.cyclicPair_fstIdx_ne_iff
statement:
theorem cyclicPair_fstIdx_ne_iff (i : Bool)
    (p : Monoid.CoprodI.Word.Pair (fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ) i) :
    (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.rcons p).fstIdx ≠ some i ↔ p.head = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.head = 1
  · simp only [Monoid.CoprodI.Word.rcons, dif_pos hp]
    exact iff_of_true p.fstIdx_ne hp
  · simp only [Monoid.CoprodI.Word.rcons, dif_neg hp, Monoid.CoprodI.Word.fstIdx_cons]
    simp [hp]

name: SVW.freeCyclicCoordinates_zero_iff
statement:
theorem freeCyclicCoordinates_zero_iff (i : Bool) (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).1 = 0 ↔ freeFirstLetter g ≠ some i
proof:
:= by
  change Multiplicative.toAdd (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equivPair i
    (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equiv (freeCyclicEquiv g))).head = 0 ↔ _
  rw [toAdd_eq_zero, ← cyclicPair_fstIdx_ne_iff]
  change ((Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equivPair i).symm
    (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equivPair i (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equiv (freeCyclicEquiv g)))).fstIdx ≠
      some i ↔ _
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: SVW.freeCyclicCoordinates_nonzero_first
statement:
theorem freeCyclicCoordinates_nonzero_first (i : Bool) (g : FreeGroup Bool)
    (hg : (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).1 ≠ 0) : freeFirstLetter g = some i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hg ((freeCyclicCoordinates_zero_iff i g).mpr h)

name: SVW.freeCyclicCoordinates_other_zero
statement:
theorem freeCyclicCoordinates_other_zero (i j : Bool) (hij : i ≠ j) (g : FreeGroup Bool)
    (hg : (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).1 ≠ 0) : (freeCyclicCoordinates j g).1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeCyclicCoordinates_zero_iff j g).mpr
  rw [freeCyclicCoordinates_nonzero_first i g hg]
  exact fun h => hij (Option.some.inj h)

name: SVW.freeFirstLetter_one
statement: @[simp] theorem freeFirstLetter_one : freeFirstLetter (1 : FreeGroup Bool) = none
proof:
:= by
  change (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equiv (freeToCyclicNormalForm 1)).fstIdx = none
  rw [map_one]
  rfl

name: SVW.freeCyclicCoordinates_one_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeCyclicCoordinates_one_fst (i : Bool) :
    (freeCyclicCoordinates i 1).1 = 0
proof:
:=
  (freeCyclicCoordinates_zero_iff i 1).mpr (by simp)

name: SVW.cyclicHeadSupported_other_base
statement:
theorem cyclicHeadSupported_other_base (i j : Bool) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : FreeHilbert)
    (hf : CyclicHeadSupported j f) : CyclicBaseSupported i f
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  exact hf g (freeCyclicCoordinates_other_zero i j hij g hg)

name: SVW.freeVacuum_cyclicBaseSupported
statement: theorem freeVacuum_cyclicBaseSupported (i : Bool) : CyclicBaseSupported i freeVacuum
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  have hg1 : g ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; exact hg (freeCyclicCoordinates_one_fst i)
  simp only [freeVacuum, groupVacuum, groupDelta_apply, if_neg hg1]

name: SVW.cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_apply (i : Bool) (f : FreeHilbert)
    (p : ℤ × CyclicTail i) :
    cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i f p = f ((freeCyclicCoordinates i).symm p)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_symm_apply (i : Bool)
    (f : GroupHilbert (ℤ × CyclicTail i)) (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i).symm f g = f (freeCyclicCoordinates i g)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.cyclicBaseSupported_fiber
statement:
theorem cyclicBaseSupported_fiber (i : Bool) (f : FreeHilbert)
    (hf : CyclicBaseSupported i f) (t : CyclicTail i) :
    l2Fiber (CyclicTail i) (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i f) t =
      f ((freeCyclicCoordinates i).symm (0, t)) • groupDelta ℤ 0
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [l2Fiber_apply, cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_apply, lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
    groupDelta_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk]
  · rw [if_neg hk, mul_zero]
    exact hf _ (by simpa using hk)

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_centered_support
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_centered_support (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) (a : ℂ)
    (ha : S (groupDelta ℤ 0) 0 = a) (f : FreeHilbert) (hf : CyclicBaseSupported i f) :
    CyclicHeadSupported i (freeCyclicOperator i S f - a • f)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  change (freeCyclicOperator i S f) g - a * f g = 0
  simp only [freeCyclicOperator_apply, cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_symm_apply,
    l2FiberLift_apply, l2FiberLiftFunction_apply, cyclicBaseSupported_fiber i f hf,
    map_smul, lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hg, ha]
  have hpoint : (freeCyclicCoordinates i).symm (0, (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).2) = g := by
    apply (freeCyclicCoordinates i).injective
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Prod.ext hg.symm rfl
  rw [hpoint, mul_comm, sub_self]

name: SVW.cyclicHeadSupported_vacuum_inner
statement:
theorem cyclicHeadSupported_vacuum_inner (i : Bool) (f : FreeHilbert)
    (hf : CyclicHeadSupported i f) : ⟪freeVacuum, f⟫_ℂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [freeVacuum, groupVacuum, groupDelta, lp.inner_single_left,
    RCLike.inner_apply, map_one, mul_one] using hf 1 (freeCyclicCoordinates_one_fst i)

name: SVW.regularTrace_coefficient
statement:
theorem regularTrace_coefficient (T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) T = T freeVacuum 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [regularTrace, freeVacuum, groupVacuum, groupDelta, lp.inner_single_left]

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_trace
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_trace (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) (a : ℂ)
    (ha : S (groupDelta ℤ 0) 0 = a) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (freeCyclicOperator i S) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularTrace_coefficient]
  have h := freeCyclicOperator_centered_support i S a ha freeVacuum
    (freeVacuum_cyclicBaseSupported i) 1 (freeCyclicCoordinates_one_fst i)
  change (freeCyclicOperator i S freeVacuum) 1 - a * freeVacuum 1 = 0 at h
  simpa [freeVacuum, groupVacuum, groupDelta_apply, sub_eq_zero] using h

name: SVW.freeArcProjection_trace
statement:
theorem freeArcProjection_trace (i : Bool) (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (freeArcProjection i A hA) =
      ((AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:=
  freeCyclicOperator_trace i _ _ (circleSequenceProjection_diagonal A hA)

name: SVW.normalizedCyclicGenerator_support
statement:
theorem normalizedCyclicGenerator_support
    (S : Bool → GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) (a : Bool → ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ i : Bool, S i (groupDelta ℤ 0) 0 = ((a i : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (i : Bool) (f : FreeHilbert) (hf : CyclicBaseSupported i f) :
    CyclicHeadSupported i (normalizedCyclicGenerators S a i f)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  have h := freeCyclicOperator_centered_support i (S i) (a i) (hdiag i) f hf g hg
  change (freeCyclicOperator i (S i) f) g - (a i : ℂ) * f g = 0 at h
  change (Real.sqrt (a i * (1 - a i)))⁻¹ •
    ((freeCyclicOperator i (S i) f) g - (a i : ℂ) * f g) = 0
  rw [h, smul_zero]

name: SVW.normalizedCyclicWord_headSupported
statement:
theorem normalizedCyclicWord_headSupported
    (S : Bool → GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) (a : Bool → ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ i : Bool, S i (groupDelta ℤ 0) 0 = ((a i : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (w : List Bool) : ∀ i : Bool, (i :: w).IsChain (· ≠ ·) →
      CyclicHeadSupported i
        (centeredWord FreeHilbert (normalizedCyclicGenerators S a) (i :: w) freeVacuum)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro i _
    exact normalizedCyclicGenerator_support S a hdiag i freeVacuum
      (freeVacuum_cyclicBaseSupported i)
  | cons j w ih =>
    intro i hiw
    exact normalizedCyclicGenerator_support S a hdiag i _
      (cyclicHeadSupported_other_base i j (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hiw).1 _
        (ih j (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hiw).2))

name: SVW.normalizedCyclicGenerators_freeness
statement:
theorem normalizedCyclicGenerators_freeness
    (S : Bool → GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) (a : Bool → ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ i : Bool, S i (groupDelta ℤ 0) 0 = ((a i : ℝ) : ℂ)) :
    CenteredWordFreeness FreeHilbert (normalizedCyclicGenerators S a) freeVacuum
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw hchain
  cases w with
  | nil => exact (hw rfl).elim
  | cons i w =>
    have hc := cyclicHeadSupported_vacuum_inner i _
      (normalizedCyclicWord_headSupported S a hdiag w i hchain)
    change (⟪freeVacuum,
      centeredWord FreeHilbert (normalizedCyclicGenerators S a) (i :: w) freeVacuum⟫_ℂ).re = 0
    rw [hc, Complex.zero_re]

name: SVW.freeArcProjections_freeness
statement:
theorem freeArcProjections_freeness (A B : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    CenteredWordFreeness FreeHilbert
      (projectionGenerators FreeHilbert
        ((freeArcProjection false A hA).restrictScalars ℝ)
        ((freeArcProjection true B hB).restrictScalars ℝ)
        (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A) (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B)) freeVacuum
proof:
:= by
  let S : Bool → GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ := fun i =>
    if i then circleSequenceProjection B hB else circleSequenceProjection A hA
  let a : Bool → ℝ := fun i =>
    if i then AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B else AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A
  have hg : projectionGenerators FreeHilbert
      ((freeArcProjection false A hA).restrictScalars ℝ)
      ((freeArcProjection true B hB).restrictScalars ℝ)
      (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A) (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B) =
      normalizedCyclicGenerators S a := by
    funext i
    cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hg]
  apply normalizedCyclicGenerators_freeness S a
  intro i
  cases i
  · exact circleSequenceProjection_diagonal A hA
  · exact circleSequenceProjection_diagonal B hB

name: SVW.freeArcProjections_radical_lower
statement:
theorem freeArcProjections_radical_lower (A B : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (ha0 : 0 < AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A) (ha1 : AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A < 1)
    (hb0 : 0 < AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B) (hb1 : AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B < 1) :
    phiRadical (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A) (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B) ≤
      ‖(freeArcProjection true B hB).comp (freeArcProjection false A hA)‖
proof:
:= by
  let P := freeArcProjection false A hA
  let Q := freeArcProjection true B hB
  have hPsym : ∀ x y : FreeHilbert,
      ⟪P.restrictScalars ℝ x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, P.restrictScalars ℝ y⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x y
    exact congrArg Complex.re (freeArcProjection_symmetric false A hA x y)
  have hQsym : ∀ x y : FreeHilbert,
      ⟪Q.restrictScalars ℝ x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, Q.restrictScalars ℝ y⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x y
    exact congrArg Complex.re (freeArcProjection_symmetric true B hB x y)
  have h := free_projection_radical_lower FreeHilbert (P.restrictScalars ℝ)
    (Q.restrictScalars ℝ) freeVacuum _ _ ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1 freeVacuum_norm hPsym hQsym
    (freeArcProjection_idempotent false A hA) (freeArcProjection_idempotent true B hB)
    (freeArcProjections_freeness A B hA hB)
  change phiRadical _ _ ≤ ‖(Q.comp P).restrictScalars ℝ‖ at h
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_restrictScalars] using h

name: SVW.centeredWord_inner_different
statement:
theorem centeredWord_inner_different (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (T : Bool → H →L[ℝ] H) (Ω : H)
    (hsym : ∀ (i : Bool) (x y : H), ⟪T i x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, T i y⟫_ℝ)
    (hfree : CenteredWordFreeness H T Ω)
    (u : List Bool) : ∀ (i j : Bool) (v : List Bool), i ≠ j →
      (i :: u).IsChain (· ≠ ·) → (j :: v).IsChain (· ≠ ·) →
      ⟪centeredWord H T (i :: u) Ω, centeredWord H T (j :: v) Ω⟫_ℝ = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil =>
    intro i j v hij _ hv
    change ⟪T i Ω, centeredWord H T (j :: v) Ω⟫_ℝ = 0
    rw [hsym i]
    exact hfree (i :: j :: v) (by simp) (by simpa only [List.isChain_cons_cons] using And.intro hij hv)
  | cons k u ih =>
    intro i j v hij hu hv
    have hik : i ≠ k := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hu).1
    have hku : (k :: u).IsChain (· ≠ ·) := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hu).2
    change ⟪T i (centeredWord H T (k :: u) Ω), centeredWord H T (j :: v) Ω⟫_ℝ = 0
    rw [hsym i]
    exact ih k i (j :: v) (Ne.symm hik) hku (List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨hij, hv⟩)

name: SVW.centeredWord_inner
statement:
theorem centeredWord_inner (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (T : Bool → H →L[ℝ] H) (Ω : H) (ℓ : Bool → ℝ)
    (hΩ : ‖Ω‖ = 1) (hsym : ∀ (i : Bool) (x y : H), ⟪T i x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, T i y⟫_ℝ)
    (hquad : ∀ (i : Bool) (x : H), T i (T i x) = x + ℓ i • T i x)
    (hfree : CenteredWordFreeness H T Ω)
    (u v : List Bool) (hu : u.IsChain (· ≠ ·)) (hv : v.IsChain (· ≠ ·)) :
    ⟪centeredWord H T u Ω, centeredWord H T v Ω⟫_ℝ = if u = v then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing v with
  | nil =>
    cases v with
    | nil => simp [centeredWord, hΩ]
    | cons j v => exact (hfree (j :: v) (by simp) hv).trans (by simp)
  | cons i u ih =>
    cases v with
    | nil =>
      rw [real_inner_comm]
      exact (hfree (i :: u) (by simp) hu).trans (by simp)
    | cons j v =>
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        have hu' : u.IsChain (· ≠ ·) := hu.tail
        have hv' : v.IsChain (· ≠ ·) := hv.tail
        have hzero : ⟪centeredWord H T u Ω, centeredWord H T (i :: v) Ω⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
          cases u with
          | nil => exact hfree (i :: v) (by simp) hv
          | cons k u =>
            exact centeredWord_inner_different H T Ω hsym hfree u k i v
              (Ne.symm (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hu).1) hu' hv
        change ⟪T i (centeredWord H T u Ω), T i (centeredWord H T v Ω)⟫_ℝ = _
        rw [hsym i, hquad i, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right]
        change ⟪centeredWord H T u Ω, centeredWord H T v Ω⟫_ℝ +
          ℓ i * ⟪centeredWord H T u Ω, centeredWord H T (i :: v) Ω⟫_ℝ = _
        rw [hzero, mul_zero, add_zero, ih v hu' hv']
        simp only [List.cons.injEq, true_and]
      · rw [centeredWord_inner_different H T Ω hsym hfree u i j v hij hu hv]
        simp only [List.cons.injEq, hij, false_and, ↓reduceIte]

name: SVW.jacobiEvenWord_length
statement: @[simp] theorem jacobiEvenWord_length (n : ℕ) : (jacobiEvenWord n).length = 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [jacobiEvenWord, List.length_cons, ih]; omega

name: SVW.jacobiWord_chain
statement:
theorem jacobiWord_chain (n : ℕ) : (jacobiEvenWord n).IsChain (· ≠ ·) ∧
    (false :: jacobiEvenWord n).IsChain (· ≠ ·)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [jacobiEvenWord]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [jacobiEvenWord, List.isChain_cons_cons]
    exact ⟨⟨by decide, ih.2⟩, by decide, by decide, ih.2⟩

name: SVW.normalizedProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem normalizedProjection_symmetric (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (P : H →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (hP : ∀ x y : H, ⟪P x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, P y⟫_ℝ) :
    ∀ x y : H, ⟪normalizedProjection H P a x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, normalizedProjection H P a y⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  change ⟪(Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a)))⁻¹ • (P x - a • x), y⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪x, (Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a)))⁻¹ • (P y - a • y)⟫_ℝ
  simp only [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right,
    hP x y, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]

name: SVW.normalizedProjection_recover
statement:
theorem normalizedProjection_recover (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (P : H →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (x : H) :
    P x = a • x + Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a)) • normalizedProjection H P a x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a)) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos ha0 (sub_pos.mpr ha1))).ne'
  change P x = a • x + Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a)) •
    ((Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a)))⁻¹ • (P x - a • x))
  rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hs, one_smul]
  module

name: SVW.normalizedProjection_quadratic
statement:
theorem normalizedProjection_quadratic (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (P : H →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hP : ∀ x : H, P (P x) = P x) (x : H) :
    normalizedProjection H P a (normalizedProjection H P a x) =
      x + ((1 - 2 * a) / Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a))) • normalizedProjection H P a x
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a))
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos ha0 (sub_pos.mpr ha1))).ne'
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = a * (1 - a) := Real.sq_sqrt (mul_pos ha0 (sub_pos.mpr ha1)).le
  have he : s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * a ^ 2 = 1 - (1 - 2 * a) * s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * a := by
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hs2]
  change s⁻¹ • (P (s⁻¹ • (P x - a • x)) - a • (s⁻¹ • (P x - a • x))) =
    x + ((1 - 2 * a) / s) • (s⁻¹ • (P x - a • x))
  rw [map_smul, map_sub, map_smul, hP x]
  calc
    _ = (s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * (1 - 2 * a)) • P x + (s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * a ^ 2) • x := by module
    _ = (s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * (1 - 2 * a)) • P x +
        (1 - (1 - 2 * a) * s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * a) • x := by rw [he]
    _ = _ := by simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]; module

name: SVW.jacobiEvenWord_injective
statement: theorem jacobiEvenWord_injective : Function.Injective jacobiEvenWord
proof:
:= by
  intro n m h
  have hh := congrArg List.length h
  simp only [jacobiEvenWord_length] at hh
  omega

name: SVW.jacobiEvenWord_ne_odd
statement: theorem jacobiEvenWord_ne_odd (n m : ℕ) : jacobiEvenWord n ≠ false :: jacobiEvenWord m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg List.length h
  simp only [jacobiEvenWord_length, List.length_cons] at hh
  omega

name: SVW.jacobi_word_gram
statement:
theorem jacobi_word_gram (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (T : Bool → H →L[ℝ] H) (Ω : H) (ℓ : Bool → ℝ)
    (hΩ : ‖Ω‖ = 1) (hsym : ∀ (i : Bool) (x y : H), ⟪T i x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, T i y⟫_ℝ)
    (hquad : ∀ (i : Bool) (x : H), T i (T i x) = x + ℓ i • T i x)
    (hfree : CenteredWordFreeness H T Ω) (n m : ℕ) :
    ⟪jacobiEven H T Ω n, jacobiEven H T Ω m⟫_ℝ = (if n = m then 1 else 0) ∧
    ⟪jacobiOdd H T Ω n, jacobiOdd H T Ω m⟫_ℝ = (if n = m then 1 else 0) ∧
    ⟪jacobiEven H T Ω n, jacobiOdd H T Ω m⟫_ℝ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := centeredWord_inner H T Ω ℓ hΩ hsym hquad hfree _ _
    (jacobiWord_chain n).1 (jacobiWord_chain m).1
  have ho := centeredWord_inner H T Ω ℓ hΩ hsym hquad hfree _ _
    (jacobiWord_chain n).2 (jacobiWord_chain m).2
  have heo := centeredWord_inner H T Ω ℓ hΩ hsym hquad hfree _ _
    (jacobiWord_chain n).1 (jacobiWord_chain m).2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [jacobiEven, jacobiEvenWord_injective.eq_iff] using he
  · simpa only [jacobiOdd, List.cons.injEq, true_and, jacobiEvenWord_injective.eq_iff] using ho
  · simpa only [jacobiEven, jacobiOdd, jacobiEvenWord_ne_odd, ↓reduceIte] using heo

name: SVW.jacobi_forward_edge_sum
statement:
theorem jacobi_forward_edge_sum (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (if n + 1 = m then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_range, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  simp only [lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
  calc
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))
    _ = _ := by simp

name: SVW.projection_jacobi_rayleigh_lower
statement:
theorem projection_jacobi_rayleigh_lower (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (P Q : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hQsym : ∀ x y : H, ⟪Q x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, Q y⟫_ℝ) (hQid : ∀ x : H, Q (Q x) = Q x)
    (f : ℕ → H) (D E : ℝ)
    (hgram : ∀ n m : ℕ, ⟪f n, f m⟫_ℝ = if n = m then 1 else 0)
    (hP : ∀ n : ℕ, P (f n) = f n)
    (hJac : ∀ n m : ℕ, ⟪Q (f n), f m⟫_ℝ =
      D * (if n = m then 1 else 0) + E * (if n + 1 = m then 1 else 0) +
        E * (if m + 1 = n then 1 else 0)) :
    D + 2 * E ≤ ‖Q.comp P‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let v : ℕ → H := fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n
  have hnorm (N : ℕ) : ‖v N‖ ^ 2 = N := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [v, sum_inner, inner_sum, hgram, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    calc
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => if_pos hn)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hvP (N : ℕ) : P (v N) = v N := by simp only [v, map_sum, hP]
  have hdiag (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (if n = m then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = (N : ℝ) + 1 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    calc
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (1 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => if_pos hn)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hdiagRev (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (if m = n then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = (N : ℝ) + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hdiag N
  have hback (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (if m + 1 = n then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = N := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact jacobi_forward_edge_sum N
  have hquad (N : ℕ) : ⟪Q (v (N + 1)), v (N + 1)⟫_ℝ =
      ((N : ℝ) + 1) * D + 2 * (N : ℝ) * E := by
    simp only [v, map_sum, sum_inner, inner_sum, hJac, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hdiagRev, hback, jacobi_forward_edge_sum]
    ring
  have hbound (N : ℕ) : ((N : ℝ) + 1) * D + 2 * (N : ℝ) * E ≤
      ‖Q.comp P‖ ^ 2 * ((N : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have hn := (Q.comp P).le_opNorm (v (N + 1))
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hvP] at hn
    have hn2 := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mpr hn
    rw [mul_pow, hnorm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hn2
    have hid : ⟪Q (v (N + 1)), v (N + 1)⟫_ℝ = ‖Q (v (N + 1))‖ ^ 2 := by
      calc
        _ = ⟪Q (Q (v (N + 1))), v (N + 1)⟫_ℝ := by rw [hQid]
        _ = ⟪Q (v (N + 1)), Q (v (N + 1))⟫_ℝ := hQsym _ _
        _ = _ := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
    rw [← hid, hquad] at hn2
    exact hn2
  by_contra h
  have hg : 0 < D + 2 * E - ‖Q.comp P‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * E / (D + 2 * E - ‖Q.comp P‖ ^ 2))
  have hm := (div_lt_iff₀ hg).mp hN
  have hb := hbound N
  nlinarith

name: SVW.jacobi_projection_model_lower
statement:
theorem jacobi_projection_model_lower (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (P Q : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hQsym : ∀ x y : H, ⟪Q x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, Q y⟫_ℝ)
    (hQid : ∀ x : H, Q (Q x) = Q x)
    (e o : ℕ → H) (p q r s : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hpq : p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (he : ∀ n m : ℕ, ⟪e n, e m⟫_ℝ = if n = m then 1 else 0)
    (ho : ∀ n m : ℕ, ⟪o n, o m⟫_ℝ = if n = m then 1 else 0)
    (heo : ∀ n m : ℕ, ⟪e n, o m⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hPe : ∀ n : ℕ, P (e n) = p ^ 2 • e n + (p * q) • o n)
    (hPo : ∀ n : ℕ, P (o n) = (p * q) • e n + q ^ 2 • o n)
    (hQe : ∀ n : ℕ, Q (e (n + 1)) = (r * s) • o n + s ^ 2 • e (n + 1))
    (hQo : ∀ n : ℕ, Q (o n) = r ^ 2 • o n + (r * s) • e (n + 1)) :
    p * s + q * r ≤ ‖Q.comp P‖
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → H := fun n => p • e (n + 1) + q • o (n + 1)
  have hoe (n m : ℕ) : ⟪o n, e m⟫_ℝ = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm, heo]
  have hf (n m : ℕ) : ⟪f n, f m⟫_ℝ = if n = m then 1 else 0 := by
    simp only [f, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
      starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, he, ho, heo, hoe, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero,
      Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]
    split_ifs <;> nlinarith [hpq]
  have hPf (n : ℕ) : P (f n) = f n := by
    simp only [f, map_add, map_smul, hPe, hPo]
    calc
      _ = (p * (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2)) • e (n + 1) +
          (q * (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2)) • o (n + 1) := by module
      _ = _ := by rw [hpq, mul_one, mul_one]
  have hQf (n m : ℕ) : ⟪Q (f n), f m⟫_ℝ =
      (p ^ 2 * s ^ 2 + q ^ 2 * r ^ 2) * (if n = m then 1 else 0) +
        (p * q * r * s) * (if n + 1 = m then 1 else 0) +
        (p * q * r * s) * (if m + 1 = n then 1 else 0) := by
    simp only [f, map_add, map_smul, hQe, hQo, inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
      inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial,
      he, ho, heo, hoe, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]
    have hnm : n = m + 1 ↔ m + 1 = n := eq_comm
    simp only [hnm]
    ring
  have hb := projection_jacobi_rayleigh_lower H P Q hQsym hQid f
    (p ^ 2 * s ^ 2 + q ^ 2 * r ^ 2) (p * q * r * s) hf hPf hQf
  have hpos : 0 ≤ p * s + q * r := by positivity
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Q.comp P)]

name: SVW.normalizedProjection_pair_actions
statement:
theorem normalizedProjection_pair_actions (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [NormedSpace ℝ H] (P : H →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hP : ∀ x : H, P (P x) = P x) (e o : H)
    (hTe : normalizedProjection H P a e = o) :
    P e = (Real.sqrt a) ^ 2 • e + (Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt (1 - a)) • o ∧
    P o = (Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt (1 - a)) • e + (Real.sqrt (1 - a)) ^ 2 • o
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a))
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos ha0 (sub_pos.mpr ha1))).ne'
  have hmul : Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt (1 - a) = s := (Real.sqrt_mul ha0.le _).symm
  have hp : (Real.sqrt a) ^ 2 = a := Real.sq_sqrt ha0.le
  have hq : (Real.sqrt (1 - a)) ^ 2 = 1 - a := Real.sq_sqrt (sub_pos.mpr ha1).le
  have hcoef : s * ((1 - 2 * a) / s) = 1 - 2 * a := by field_simp
  have hTo : normalizedProjection H P a o = e + ((1 - 2 * a) / s) • o := by
    rw [← hTe, normalizedProjection_quadratic H P a ha0 ha1 hP e]
  constructor
  · rw [hp, hmul, ← hTe]
    exact normalizedProjection_recover H P a ha0 ha1 e
  · rw [hmul, hq, normalizedProjection_recover H P a ha0 ha1 o, hTo]
    change a • o + s • (e + ((1 - 2 * a) / s) • o) = s • e + (1 - a) • o
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, hcoef]
    module

name: SVW.free_projection_radical_lower
statement:
theorem free_projection_radical_lower (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (P Q : H →L[ℝ] H) (Ω : H) (a b : ℝ)
    (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1)
    (hΩ : ‖Ω‖ = 1)
    (hPsym : ∀ x y : H, ⟪P x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, P y⟫_ℝ)
    (hQsym : ∀ x y : H, ⟪Q x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, Q y⟫_ℝ)
    (hPid : ∀ x : H, P (P x) = P x) (hQid : ∀ x : H, Q (Q x) = Q x)
    (hfree : CenteredWordFreeness H (projectionGenerators H P Q a b) Ω) :
    phiRadical a b ≤ ‖Q.comp P‖
proof:
:= by
  let T : Bool → H →L[ℝ] H := projectionGenerators H P Q a b
  let ℓ : Bool → ℝ := fun i => if i then (1 - 2 * b) / Real.sqrt (b * (1 - b))
    else (1 - 2 * a) / Real.sqrt (a * (1 - a))
  have hsym : ∀ (i : Bool) (x y : H), ⟪T i x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, T i y⟫_ℝ := by
    intro i
    cases i
    · exact normalizedProjection_symmetric H P a hPsym
    · exact normalizedProjection_symmetric H Q b hQsym
  have hquad : ∀ (i : Bool) (x : H), T i (T i x) = x + ℓ i • T i x := by
    intro i
    cases i
    · exact normalizedProjection_quadratic H P a ha0 ha1 hPid
    · exact normalizedProjection_quadratic H Q b hb0 hb1 hQid
  let e : ℕ → H := jacobiEven H T Ω
  let o : ℕ → H := jacobiOdd H T Ω
  have hgram := jacobi_word_gram H T Ω ℓ hΩ hsym hquad hfree
  have hPpair (n : ℕ) := normalizedProjection_pair_actions H P a ha0 ha1 hPid
    (e n) (o n) (by rfl)
  have hQpair (n : ℕ) := normalizedProjection_pair_actions H Q b hb0 hb1 hQid
    (o n) (e (n + 1)) (by rfl)
  have hpq : (Real.sqrt a) ^ 2 + (Real.sqrt (1 - a)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt ha0.le, Real.sq_sqrt (sub_pos.mpr ha1).le]
    ring
  have hmodel := jacobi_projection_model_lower H P Q hQsym hQid e o
    (Real.sqrt a) (Real.sqrt (1 - a)) (Real.sqrt b) (Real.sqrt (1 - b))
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hpq
    (fun n m => (hgram n m).1) (fun n m => (hgram n m).2.1)
    (fun n m => (hgram n m).2.2) (fun n => (hPpair n).1) (fun n => (hPpair n).2)
    (fun n => (hQpair n).2) (fun n => (hQpair n).1)
  simpa only [phiRadical, Real.sqrt_mul ha0.le, Real.sqrt_mul hb0.le, mul_comm] using hmodel

name: SVW.free_projection_phi_lower
statement:
theorem free_projection_phi_lower (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (P Q : H →L[ℝ] H) (Ω : H) (a b : ℝ)
    (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) (hab : a + b ≤ 1)
    (hΩ : ‖Ω‖ = 1)
    (hPsym : ∀ x y : H, ⟪P x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, P y⟫_ℝ)
    (hQsym : ∀ x y : H, ⟪Q x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, Q y⟫_ℝ)
    (hPid : ∀ x : H, P (P x) = P x) (hQid : ∀ x : H, Q (Q x) = Q x)
    (hfree : CenteredWordFreeness H (projectionGenerators H P Q a b) Ω) :
    phi a b ≤ ‖Q.comp P‖
proof:
:= by
  change (if a + b ≤ 1 then phiRadical a b else 1) ≤ _
  rw [if_pos hab]
  exact free_projection_radical_lower H P Q Ω a b ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1 hΩ hPsym hQsym hPid hQid hfree

name: SVW.groupL2Permute_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupL2Permute_apply (G : Type*) (e : G ≃ G) (f : GroupHilbert G) (g : G) :
    groupL2Permute G e f g = f (e.symm g)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.groupL2Permute_norm
statement:
theorem groupL2Permute_norm (G : Type*) (e : G ≃ G) (f : GroupHilbert G) :
    ‖groupL2Permute G e f‖ = ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have hi : ⟪groupL2Permute G e f, groupL2Permute G e f⟫_ℂ = ⟪f, f⟫_ℂ := by
    simp only [lp.inner_eq_tsum, groupL2Permute_apply]
    exact e.symm.tsum_eq (fun g => ⟪f g, f g⟫_ℂ)
  have hr : ‖groupL2Permute G e f‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ = (⟪groupL2Permute G e f, groupL2Permute G e f⟫_ℂ).re :=
        InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) _
      _ = (⟪f, f⟫_ℂ).re := congrArg Complex.re hi
      _ = _ := (InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) f).symm
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg f, norm_nonneg (groupL2Permute G e f)]

name: SVW.groupL2Reindex_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupL2Reindex_apply (G : Type*) (e : G ≃ G) (f : GroupHilbert G) (g : G) :
    groupL2Reindex G e f g = f (e.symm g)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.leftRegularL2_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftRegularL2_apply (G : Type*) [Group G] (g h : G) (f : GroupHilbert G) :
    leftRegularL2 G g f h = f (g⁻¹ * h)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.groupDelta_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupDelta_apply (G : Type*) (g h : G) :
    groupDelta G g h = if h = g then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [groupDelta, lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: SVW.groupDelta_norm
statement: theorem groupDelta_norm (G : Type*) (g : G) : ‖groupDelta G g‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [groupDelta, lp.norm_single]

name: SVW.groupVacuum_norm
statement: theorem groupVacuum_norm (G : Type*) [Group G] : ‖groupVacuum G‖ = 1
proof: := groupDelta_norm G 1

name: SVW.leftRegularL2_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftRegularL2_delta (G : Type*) [Group G] (g h : G) :
    leftRegularL2 G g (groupDelta G h) = groupDelta G (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext k
  simp only [leftRegularL2_apply, groupDelta_apply, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul]

name: SVW.groupDelta_inner
statement:
theorem groupDelta_inner (G : Type*) (g h : G) :
    ⟪groupDelta G g, groupDelta G h⟫_ℂ = if g = h then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [groupDelta, lp.inner_single_left, lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: SVW.leftRegularL2_vacuum_trace
statement:
theorem leftRegularL2_vacuum_trace (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) :
    ⟪groupVacuum G, leftRegularL2 G g (groupVacuum G)⟫_ℂ = if g = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [groupVacuum, leftRegularL2_delta, mul_one, groupDelta_inner, eq_comm]

name: SVW.leftRegularRepresentation_injective
statement:
theorem leftRegularRepresentation_injective (G : Type*) [Group G] :
    Function.Injective (leftRegularRepresentation G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro g h he
  have hv := congrArg (fun U : GroupHilbert G ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] GroupHilbert G => U (groupVacuum G)) he
  change leftRegularL2 G g (groupVacuum G) = leftRegularL2 G h (groupVacuum G) at hv
  simp only [groupVacuum, leftRegularL2_delta, mul_one] at hv
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : GroupHilbert G => f g) hv
  simp only [groupDelta_apply, ↓reduceIte] at hc
  by_contra hne
  simp only [if_neg hne] at hc
  exact one_ne_zero hc

name: SVW.freeVacuum_norm
statement: theorem freeVacuum_norm : ‖freeVacuum‖ = 1
proof: := groupVacuum_norm (FreeGroup Bool)

name: SVW.regularOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularOperator_apply (G : Type*) [Group G] (g h : G) (f : GroupHilbert G) :
    regularOperator G g f h = f (g⁻¹ * h)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.regularOperator_star
statement:
theorem regularOperator_star (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) :
    star (regularOperator G g) = regularOperator G g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularOperator, LinearIsometryEquiv.star_eq_symm]
  ext f h
  change f (g * h) = f ((g⁻¹)⁻¹ * h)
  rw [inv_inv]

name: SVW.regularTrace_regularOperator
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularTrace_regularOperator (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) :
    regularTrace G (regularOperator G g) = if g = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  leftRegularL2_vacuum_trace G g

name: SVW.freeToCyclicNormalForm_zpow
statement:
theorem freeToCyclicNormalForm_zpow (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    freeToCyclicNormalForm (FreeGroup.of i ^ k) =
      Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ) (i := i) (Multiplicative.ofAdd k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zpow]
  change (Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ) (i := i) (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ))) ^ k = _
  rw [← map_zpow, ← ofAdd_zsmul]
  simp

name: SVW.free_cyclic_normal_word_ne_one
statement:
theorem free_cyclic_normal_word_ne_one
    (w : Monoid.CoprodI.Word (fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ)) (hw : w.toList ≠ []) :
    (w.toList.map (fun l => FreeGroup.of l.1 ^ Multiplicative.toAdd l.2)).prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm := congrArg freeToCyclicNormalForm h
  simp only [map_list_prod, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, freeToCyclicNormalForm_zpow,
    ofAdd_toAdd, map_one] at hm
  have hp : w.prod = (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.empty : Monoid.CoprodI.Word
      (fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ)).prod := hm
  have he : w = Monoid.CoprodI.Word.empty :=
    (Monoid.CoprodI.Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ)).symm.injective hp
  exact hw (congrArg Monoid.CoprodI.Word.toList he)

name: SVW.free_cyclic_normal_word_trace_zero
statement:
theorem free_cyclic_normal_word_trace_zero
    (w : Monoid.CoprodI.Word (fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ)) (hw : w.toList ≠ []) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool)
      ((w.toList.map (fun l => FreeGroup.of l.1 ^ Multiplicative.toAdd l.2)).prod)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularTrace_regularOperator, if_neg (free_cyclic_normal_word_ne_one w hw)]

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_isClosed
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_isClosed :
    IsClosed (reducedFreeCStar : Set (FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert))
proof:
:=
  StarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _

name: SVW.regularGenerator_mem_reducedFreeCStar
statement:
theorem regularGenerator_mem_reducedFreeCStar (i : Bool) :
    regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i) ∈ reducedFreeCStar
proof:
:=
  StarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _ (StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: SVW.regularOperator_mem_reducedFreeCStar
statement:
theorem regularOperator_mem_reducedFreeCStar (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) g ∈ reducedFreeCStar
proof:
:= by
  induction g using FreeGroup.induction_on with
  | C1 =>
    change regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool) 1 ∈ _
    rw [map_one]
    exact reducedFreeCStar.one_mem
  | of i => exact regularGenerator_mem_reducedFreeCStar i
  | inv_of i hi =>
    rw [← regularOperator_star]
    exact star_mem hi
  | mul g h hg hh =>
    change regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool) (g * h) ∈ _
    rw [map_mul]
    exact reducedFreeCStar.mul_mem hg hh

name: SVW.free_alternating_powers_ne_one
statement:
theorem free_alternating_powers_ne_one (w : List (Bool × ℤ)) (hw : w ≠ [])
    (hne : ∀ l ∈ w, l.2 ≠ 0) (hchain : w.IsChain (fun l l' => l.1 ≠ l'.1)) :
    (w.map (fun l => FreeGroup.of l.1 ^ l.2)).prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  let W : Monoid.CoprodI.Word (fun _ : Bool => Multiplicative ℤ) :=
    { toList := w.map (fun l => ⟨l.1, Multiplicative.ofAdd l.2⟩)
      ne_one := by
        intro l hl
        obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
        exact hne p hp
      chain_ne := by simpa only [List.isChain_map] using hchain }
  have hW : W.toList ≠ [] := by
    exact fun h => hw (List.eq_nil_of_map_eq_nil h)
  simpa only [W, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, toAdd_ofAdd] using
    free_cyclic_normal_word_ne_one W hW

name: SVW.free_generator_zpow_ne_one
statement:
theorem free_generator_zpow_ne_one (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    FreeGroup.of i ^ k ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one] using
    free_alternating_powers_ne_one [(i, k)] (by simp)
      (by intro l hl; simpa using List.mem_singleton.mp hl ▸ hk) (by simp)

name: SVW.regularTrace_free_zpow
statement:
theorem regularTrace_free_zpow (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) =
      if k = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularTrace_regularOperator]
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk]
  · rw [if_neg hk, if_neg (free_generator_zpow_ne_one i k hk)]

name: SVW.cyclicLaurentOperator_trace
statement:
theorem cyclicLaurentOperator_trace (i : Bool) (c : ℤ →₀ ℂ) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (cyclicLaurentOperator i c) = c 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cyclicLaurentOperator, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, regularTrace_free_zpow,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp h).symm

name: SVW.laurentExpansion_zero
statement:
theorem laurentExpansion_zero (c : Bool → ℤ →₀ ℂ) (w : List Bool) (F : List ℤ → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ ks : List ℤ, List.Forall₂ (fun i k => c i k ≠ 0) w ks → F ks = 0) :
    laurentExpansion c w F = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing F with
  | nil => exact hF [] List.Forall₂.nil
  | cons i w ih =>
    unfold laurentExpansion Finsupp.sum
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    have hk' : c i k ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hk
    change c i k * laurentExpansion c w (fun ks => F (k :: ks)) = 0
    rw [ih (fun ks => F (k :: ks)) (fun ks hks => hF (k :: ks) (List.Forall₂.cons hk' hks)), mul_zero]

name: SVW.freeCyclicWord_zip
statement:
theorem freeCyclicWord_zip (w : List Bool) (ks : List ℤ) :
    freeCyclicWord w ks = ((w.zip ks).map (fun l => FreeGroup.of l.1 ^ l.2)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing ks with
  | nil => simp [freeCyclicWord]
  | cons i w ih => cases ks <;> simp [freeCyclicWord, ih]

name: SVW.freeCyclicWord_ne_one_of_support
statement:
theorem freeCyclicWord_ne_one_of_support (c : Bool → ℤ →₀ ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ i : Bool, c i 0 = 0) (w : List Bool) (hw : w ≠ [])
    (hchain : w.IsChain (· ≠ ·)) (ks : List ℤ)
    (hks : List.Forall₂ (fun i k => c i k ≠ 0) w ks) : freeCyclicWord w ks ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : w.length = ks.length := hks.length_eq
  have hnz : ∀ k ∈ ks, k ≠ 0 := by
    clear hw hchain hlen
    induction hks with
    | nil => simp
    | @cons i k w ks hik _ ih =>
      intro j hj
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
      · intro hk
        exact hik (hk ▸ hc i)
      · exact ih j hj
  have hne : w.zip ks ≠ [] := by
    intro hz
    have hmap := List.map_fst_zip hlen.le
    rw [hz, List.map_nil] at hmap
    exact hw hmap.symm
  have hzchain : (w.zip ks).IsChain (fun l l' => l.1 ≠ l'.1) := by
    have hh : ((w.zip ks).map Prod.fst).IsChain (· ≠ ·) := by
      rw [List.map_fst_zip hlen.le]
      exact hchain
    simpa only [List.isChain_map] using hh
  rw [freeCyclicWord_zip]
  exact free_alternating_powers_ne_one (w.zip ks) hne
    (fun l hl => hnz l.2 (List.of_mem_zip hl).2) hzchain

name: SVW.cyclicLaurent_trace_expansion
statement:
theorem cyclicLaurent_trace_expansion (c : Bool → ℤ →₀ ℂ) (w : List Bool)
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (A * (w.map (fun i => cyclicLaurentOperator i (c i))).prod) =
      laurentExpansion c w (fun ks => regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool)
        (A * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (freeCyclicWord w ks)))
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing A with
  | nil =>
    change regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (A * 1) =
      regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (A * regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool) 1)
    rw [map_one]
  | cons i w ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, cyclicLaurentOperator, Finsupp.sum,
      Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, map_sum,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul, laurentExpansion]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    congr 1
    calc
      _ = regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) ((A * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) *
          (w.map (fun j => cyclicLaurentOperator j (c j))).prod) := by rw [mul_assoc]; rfl
      _ = _ := ih (A * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k))
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        funext ks
        change regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) ((A * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) *
          regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (freeCyclicWord w ks)) =
            regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (A * regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool)
              (FreeGroup.of i ^ k * freeCyclicWord w ks))
        rw [(regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool)).map_mul, mul_assoc]
        rfl

name: SVW.cyclicLaurentOperator_freeness
statement:
theorem cyclicLaurentOperator_freeness (c : Bool → ℤ →₀ ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ i : Bool, c i 0 = 0) (w : List Bool) (hw : w ≠ [])
    (hchain : w.IsChain (· ≠ ·)) :
    regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) ((w.map (fun i => cyclicLaurentOperator i (c i))).prod) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hexp := cyclicLaurent_trace_expansion c w 1
  simp only [one_mul] at hexp
  rw [hexp]
  apply laurentExpansion_zero
  intro ks hks
  rw [regularTrace_regularOperator, if_neg (freeCyclicWord_ne_one_of_support c hc w hw hchain ks hks)]

name: SVW.regularTrace_norm_le
statement:
theorem regularTrace_norm_le (G : Type*) [Group G] (A : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    ‖regularTrace G A‖ ≤ ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  change ‖⟪groupVacuum G, A (groupVacuum G)⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ ‖A‖
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖groupVacuum G‖ * ‖A (groupVacuum G)‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖groupVacuum G‖ * (‖A‖ * ‖groupVacuum G‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (A.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [groupVacuum_norm, mul_one, one_mul]

name: SVW.regularTrace_positive
statement:
theorem regularTrace_positive (G : Type*) [Group G] (A : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    0 ≤ (regularTrace G (star A * A)).re
proof:
:= by
  change 0 ≤ (⟪groupVacuum G, A.adjoint (A (groupVacuum G))⟫_ℂ).re
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  exact inner_self_nonneg (𝕜 := ℂ) (x := A (groupVacuum G))

name: SVW.quadraticContinuousMultiplier_norm_le
statement:
theorem quadraticContinuousMultiplier_norm_le (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ)
    (f : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)) : ‖quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:=
  (quadraticContinuousSymbol d m f).norm_operator_le

name: SVW.quadraticContinuousMultiplier_monomial
statement:
theorem quadraticContinuousMultiplier_monomial (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (_root_.fourier k) =
      (chirpUnitary d ((k:ℝ)*m) : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(quadraticContinuousSymbol d m (_root_.fourier k)).operator_coe u,
    chirpUnitary_coe d ((k:ℝ)*m) u] with x hq hc
  change (quadraticContinuousSymbol d m (_root_.fourier k)).operator u x =
    chirpUnitary d ((k:ℝ)*m) u x
  rw [hq, hc]
  congr 1
  change _root_.fourier k (((m/2 * ‖x‖^2 : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) = chirpPhase d ((k:ℝ)*m) x
  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  unfold chirpPhase
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.chirpUnitary_zpow
statement:
theorem chirpUnitary_zpow (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    chirpUnitary d ((k:ℝ)*m) = (chirpUnitary d m)^k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [continuousChirpRepresentation, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
    toAdd_zpow, toAdd_ofAdd, zsmul_eq_mul] using
    (continuousChirpRepresentation d).map_zpow (Multiplicative.ofAdd m) k

name: SVW.quadraticFourierConjugation_norm_le
statement:
theorem quadraticFourierConjugation_norm_le (d : ℕ) (A : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d) :
    ‖quadraticFourierConjugation d A‖ ≤ ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg A)
  intro u
  change ‖(fourier d).symm (A (fourier d u))‖ ≤ ‖A‖*‖u‖
  simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using A.le_opNorm (fourier d u)

name: SVW.quadraticCyclicCalculus_norm_le
statement:
theorem quadraticCyclicCalculus_norm_le (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (i : Bool)
    (f : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)) : ‖quadraticCyclicCalculus d m i f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  cases i
  · exact quadraticContinuousMultiplier_norm_le d m f
  · exact (quadraticFourierConjugation_norm_le d _).trans
      (quadraticContinuousMultiplier_norm_le d m f)

name: SVW.quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_left
statement:
theorem quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_left (d : ℕ) (m α β : ℝ) (hαβ : α < β) :
    positionProjection volume (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β))
      (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc β) (circleArc_measurable β)).nullMeasurableSet *
      quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff α β) =
        quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply boundedSymbol_mask_left
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => circleArcCutoff_eq_zero_off α β hαβ _ hx)

name: SVW.quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_right
statement:
theorem quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_right (d : ℕ) (m α β : ℝ) (hαβ : α < β) :
    quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff α β) *
      positionProjection volume (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β))
        (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc β) (circleArc_measurable β)).nullMeasurableSet =
        quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply boundedSymbol_mask_right
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => circleArcCutoff_eq_zero_off α β hαβ _ hx)

name: SVW.integerShift_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem integerShift_apply (k : ℤ) (f : GroupHilbert ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    integerShift k f n = f (n - k)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_integerShift
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_integerShift (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    freeCyclicOperator i (integerShift k : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) =
      regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  ext f g
  simp only [freeCyclicOperator_apply, cyclicCoordinatesUnitary_symm_apply,
    l2FiberLift_apply, l2FiberLiftFunction_apply, regularOperator_apply]
  change f ((freeCyclicCoordinates i).symm
    ((freeCyclicCoordinates i g).1 - k, (freeCyclicCoordinates i g).2)) =
      f ((FreeGroup.of i ^ k)⁻¹ * g)
  apply congrArg f
  apply (freeCyclicCoordinates i).injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ← zpow_neg, freeCyclicCoordinates_left_multiply]
  exact Prod.ext (by omega) rfl

name: SVW.circleSymbolSequenceOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleSymbolSequenceOperator_apply
    (m : BoundedSymbol (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle) (f : GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    circleSymbolSequenceOperator m f = circleFourierUnitary (m.operator (circleFourierUnitary.symm f))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.circleSymbolSequenceOperator_monomial
statement:
theorem circleSymbolSequenceOperator_monomial (k : ℤ) :
    circleSymbolSequenceOperator (circleMonomialSymbol k) =
      (integerShift k : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext f n
  change circleFourierUnitary ((circleMonomialSymbol k).operator
    (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)) n = f (n - k)
  change (fourierBasis (T := (1 : ℝ))).repr
    ((circleMonomialSymbol k).operator (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)) n = _
  rw [fourierBasis_repr]
  have hc : fourierCoeff ((circleMonomialSymbol k).operator (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)) n =
      fourierCoeff (circleFourierUnitary.symm f) (n - k) := by
    simp only [fourierCoeff, smul_eq_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [(circleMonomialSymbol k).operator_coe (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)] with z hz
    rw [hz]
    change _root_.fourier (-n) z * (_root_.fourier k z * circleFourierUnitary.symm f z) = _
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← fourier_add]
    rw [show -n + k = -(n - k) by omega]
  rw [hc, ← fourierBasis_repr]
  exact congrArg (fun v : GroupHilbert ℤ => v (n - k)) (circleFourierUnitary.apply_symm_apply f)

name: SVW.freeCyclicSymbol_monomial
statement:
theorem freeCyclicSymbol_monomial (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    freeCyclicSymbol i (circleMonomialSymbol k) =
      regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeCyclicSymbol, circleSymbolSequenceOperator_monomial, freeCyclicOperator_integerShift]

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeContinuousCyclic_apply (i : Bool) (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ)) :
    freeContinuousCyclic i f = freeCyclicSymbol i (continuousCircleSymbol f)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.boundedCircleSymbol_operator_congr
statement:
theorem boundedCircleSymbol_operator_congr
    (m n : BoundedSymbol (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
    (hmn : (m : AddCircle (1 : ℝ) → ℂ) =ᵐ[AddCircle.haarAddCircle] n) : m.operator = n.operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [m.operator_coe f, n.operator_coe f, hmn] with z hm hn heq
  rw [hm, hn, heq]

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_monomial
statement:
theorem freeContinuousCyclic_monomial (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    freeContinuousCyclic i (_root_.fourier k) =
      regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeContinuousCyclic_apply]
  have heq : (continuousCircleSymbol (_root_.fourier k)).operator = (circleMonomialSymbol k).operator :=
    boundedCircleSymbol_operator_congr _ _ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))
  change freeCyclicOperator i ((circleFourierUnitary : UnitCircleHilbert →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) ∘L
    (continuousCircleSymbol (_root_.fourier k)).operator ∘L
    (circleFourierUnitary.symm : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] UnitCircleHilbert)) = _
  rw [heq]
  exact freeCyclicSymbol_monomial i k

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_mem_reducedFreeCStar
statement:
theorem freeContinuousCyclic_mem_reducedFreeCStar (i : Bool) (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ)) :
    freeContinuousCyclic i f ∈ reducedFreeCStar
proof:
:= by
  let K : Submodule ℂ C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ) :=
    reducedFreeCStar.toSubmodule.comap (freeContinuousCyclic i).toLinearMap
  have hclosed : IsClosed (K : Set C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ)) :=
    reducedFreeCStar_isClosed.preimage (freeContinuousCyclic i).continuous
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (_root_.fourier (T := (1 : ℝ)))) ≤ K := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    change freeContinuousCyclic i (_root_.fourier k) ∈ reducedFreeCStar
    rw [freeContinuousCyclic_monomial]
    exact regularOperator_mem_reducedFreeCStar _
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ)) ≤ K := by
    rw [← span_fourier_closure_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hspan hclosed
  exact htop (Submodule.mem_top)

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_norm_le
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_norm_le (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) : ‖freeCyclicOperator i S‖ ≤ ‖S‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg S)
  intro f
  simpa only [freeCyclicOperator_apply, l2FiberLift_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using
    l2FiberLiftFunction_norm_le (CyclicTail i) S (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i f)

name: SVW.circleSequenceEmbedding_norm_le
statement:
theorem circleSequenceEmbedding_norm_le (S : UnitCircleHilbert →L[ℂ] UnitCircleHilbert) :
    ‖circleSequenceEmbedding S‖ ≤ ‖S‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg S)
  intro f
  change ‖circleFourierUnitary (S (circleFourierUnitary.symm f))‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖f‖
  simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using S.le_opNorm (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_norm_le
statement:
theorem freeContinuousCyclic_norm_le (i : Bool) (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ)) :
    ‖freeContinuousCyclic i f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  exact (freeCyclicOperator_norm_le i _).trans
    ((circleSequenceEmbedding_norm_le _).trans (continuousCircleSymbol f).norm_operator_le)

name: SVW.freeArcProjection_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem freeArcProjection_norm_le_one (i : Bool) (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ‖freeArcProjection i A hA‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeCyclicOperator_norm_le i _).trans
  change ‖circleSequenceEmbedding (positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet)‖ ≤ 1
  exact (circleSequenceEmbedding_norm_le _).trans
    (norm_positionProjection_le_one AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet)

name: SVW.freeCyclicEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeCyclicEmbedding_apply (i : Bool)
    (S : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) : freeCyclicEmbedding i S = freeCyclicOperator i S
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.circleSequenceEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleSequenceEmbedding_apply (S : UnitCircleHilbert →L[ℂ] UnitCircleHilbert)
    (f : GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    circleSequenceEmbedding S f = circleFourierUnitary (S (circleFourierUnitary.symm f))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.circleSequenceEmbedding_mul
statement:
theorem circleSequenceEmbedding_mul (S T : UnitCircleHilbert →L[ℂ] UnitCircleHilbert) :
    circleSequenceEmbedding (S * T) = circleSequenceEmbedding S * circleSequenceEmbedding T
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  change circleFourierUnitary (S (T (circleFourierUnitary.symm f))) =
    circleFourierUnitary (S (circleFourierUnitary.symm
      (circleFourierUnitary (T (circleFourierUnitary.symm f)))))
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SVW.freeCyclicOperator_mul
statement:
theorem freeCyclicOperator_mul (i : Bool)
    (S T : GroupHilbert ℤ →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert ℤ) :
    freeCyclicOperator i (S * T) = freeCyclicOperator i S * freeCyclicOperator i T
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  change freeCyclicOperator i (S * T) f = freeCyclicOperator i S (freeCyclicOperator i T f)
  simp only [freeCyclicOperator_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply congrArg (cyclicCoordinatesUnitary i).symm
  ext p
  simp only [l2FiberLift_apply, l2FiberLiftFunction_apply, l2Fiber_lift]
  rfl

name: SVW.continuousCircleMultiplier_cut_right
statement:
theorem continuousCircleMultiplier_cut_right (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ))
    (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hf : ∀ z ∈ A, f z = 1) :
    continuousCircleMultiplier f * positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet =
      positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(continuousCircleSymbol f).operator_coe
    (cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet u),
    cut_coe AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet u] with z hm hc
  change ((continuousCircleSymbol f).operator
    (cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet u)) z =
      cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet u z
  rw [hm, hc]
  change f z * A.indicator u z = A.indicator u z
  by_cases hz : z ∈ A
  · simp [hz, hf z hz]
  · simp [hz]

name: SVW.continuousCircleMultiplier_cut_left
statement:
theorem continuousCircleMultiplier_cut_left (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ))
    (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hf : ∀ z ∈ A, f z = 1) :
    positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet * continuousCircleMultiplier f =
      positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(continuousCircleSymbol f).operator_coe u,
    cut_coe AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet ((continuousCircleSymbol f).operator u),
    cut_coe AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet u] with z hm hc hu
  change cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet ((continuousCircleSymbol f).operator u) z =
    cut AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet u z
  rw [hc, hu]
  by_cases hz : z ∈ A
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, hm]
    change f z * u z = u z
    rw [hf z hz, one_mul]
  · simp [hz]

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_arc_right
statement:
theorem freeContinuousCyclic_arc_right (i : Bool) (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ))
    (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hf : ∀ z ∈ A, f z = 1) :
    freeContinuousCyclic i f * freeArcProjection i A hA = freeArcProjection i A hA
proof:
:= by
  change freeCyclicOperator i (circleSequenceEmbedding (continuousCircleMultiplier f)) *
    freeCyclicOperator i (circleSequenceEmbedding
      (positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet)) = _
  rw [← freeCyclicOperator_mul, ← circleSequenceEmbedding_mul,
    continuousCircleMultiplier_cut_right f A hA hf]
  rfl

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_arc_left
statement:
theorem freeContinuousCyclic_arc_left (i : Bool) (f : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ))
    (A : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hf : ∀ z ∈ A, f z = 1) :
    freeArcProjection i A hA * freeContinuousCyclic i f = freeArcProjection i A hA
proof:
:= by
  change freeCyclicOperator i (circleSequenceEmbedding
      (positionProjection AddCircle.haarAddCircle A hA.nullMeasurableSet)) *
    freeCyclicOperator i (circleSequenceEmbedding (continuousCircleMultiplier f)) = _
  rw [← freeCyclicOperator_mul, ← circleSequenceEmbedding_mul,
    continuousCircleMultiplier_cut_left f A hA hf]
  rfl

name: SVW.product_norm_le_of_plateaus
statement:
theorem product_norm_le_of_plateaus (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    (P Q A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : ‖P‖ ≤ 1) (hQ : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1)
    (hAP : A * P = P) (hQB : Q * B = Q) : ‖Q * P‖ ≤ ‖B * A‖
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Q * (B * A) * P = Q * P := by
    calc
      _ = (Q * B) * (A * P) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hQB, hAP]
  calc
    _ = ‖Q * (B * A) * P‖ := congrArg norm heq.symm
    _ ≤ (‖Q‖ * ‖B * A‖) * ‖P‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (1 * ‖B * A‖) * 1 := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ (norm_nonneg _)) hP (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: SVW.freeContinuousCyclic_product_radical_lower
statement:
theorem freeContinuousCyclic_product_radical_lower
    (f g : C(AddCircle (1 : ℝ), ℂ)) (A B : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (hf : ∀ z ∈ A, f z = 1) (hg : ∀ z ∈ B, g z = 1)
    (ha0 : 0 < AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A) (ha1 : AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A < 1)
    (hb0 : 0 < AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B) (hb1 : AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B < 1) :
    phiRadical (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real A) (AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real B) ≤
      ‖freeContinuousCyclic true g * freeContinuousCyclic false f‖
proof:
:= by
  exact (freeArcProjections_radical_lower A B hA hB ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1).trans
    (product_norm_le_of_plateaus FreeHilbert (freeArcProjection false A hA)
      (freeArcProjection true B hB) (freeContinuousCyclic false f) (freeContinuousCyclic true g)
      (freeArcProjection_norm_le_one false A hA) (freeArcProjection_norm_le_one true B hB)
      (freeContinuousCyclic_arc_right false f A hA hf) (freeContinuousCyclic_arc_left true g B hB hg))

name: SVW.quadraticArc_pair_exists_thin
statement:
theorem quadraticArc_pair_exists_thin (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (κ ε₁ ε₂ α β : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hαε : α < ε₁)
    (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β ≤ 1) (hβε : β < ε₂) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m ∧
      WolffThin d κ ε₁ (quadraticSet d ((m:ℝ)/2) (circleArc α)) ∧
      WolffThin d κ ε₂ (quadraticSet d ((m:ℝ)/2) (circleArc β))
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
    have hE := quadraticArc_eventually_wolffThin n κ α ε₁ hκ hα0 hα1 hαε
    have hF := quadraticArc_eventually_wolffThin n κ β ε₂ hκ hβ0 hβ1 hβε
    exact (hE.and (hF.and (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (2:ℕ)))).exists.imp
      (fun m hm => ⟨hm.2.2, hm.1, hm.2.1⟩)

name: SVW.quadratic_radical_lower_of_models
statement:
theorem quadratic_radical_lower_of_models (hd : 0 < d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) :
    phiRadical ε₁ ε₂ ≤ theta d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:= by
  apply phiRadical_le_of_strict_inner_bounds ε₁ ε₂ _ hε₁0 hε₂0
  intro a b ha0 haε hb0 hbε
  obtain ⟨α, haα, hαε⟩ := exists_between haε
  obtain ⟨β, hbβ, hβε⟩ := exists_between hbε
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hE, hF⟩ := quadraticArc_pair_exists_thin d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ α β hκ
    (ha0.trans haα).le (hαε.trans hε₁1).le hαε
    (hb0.trans hbβ).le (hβε.trans hε₂1).le hβε
  exact quadratic_density_lower_from_representation d κ ε₁ ε₂ m a α b β H (π m hm) J
    (hchar m hm) ha0 (haε.trans hε₁1) hb0 (hbε.trans hε₂1) haα hbβ hE hF

name: SVW.quadratic_saturation_of_models
statement:
theorem quadratic_saturation_of_models (hd : 0 < d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (_hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) (hsum : 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂) :
    theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (theta_le_one d κ ε₁ ε₂ hε₁0.le hε₂0.le)
  have hb0 : 0 < 1-ε₁ := by linarith
  have hb1 : 1-ε₁ < 1 := by linarith
  have h := quadratic_radical_lower_of_models d H π J hchar hd κ ε₁ (1-ε₁)
    hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hb0 hb1
  rw [phiRadical_eq_one_of_add_eq_one ε₁ (1-ε₁) hε₁0.le hb0.le (by ring)] at h
  exact h.trans (theta_mono d κ ε₁ (1-ε₁) ε₁ ε₂ hε₁0.le hb0.le le_rfl (by linarith))

name: SVW.quadratic_phi_lower_of_models
statement:
theorem quadratic_phi_lower_of_models (hd : 0 < d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) :
    phi ε₁ ε₂ ≤ theta d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold phi
  split_ifs with hs
  · exact quadratic_radical_lower_of_models d H π J hchar hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1
  · rw [quadratic_saturation_of_models d H π J hchar hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ
      hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1 (le_of_not_ge hs)]

name: SVW.quadratic_odd_witness_of_models
statement:
theorem quadratic_odd_witness_of_models (hodd : ∀ x : H, OddVector d (J x))
    (hd : 0 < d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1) (_hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1)
    (hsum : 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    ∃ E F : Set (Space d), ∃ hE : WolffThin d κ ε₁ E, ∃ hF : WolffThin d κ ε₂ F,
    ∃ f : Hilbert d, Radial d E ∧ Radial d F ∧ OddVector d f ∧ ‖f‖ = 1 ∧
      cut volume Fᶜ hF.1.compl (fourier d f) = 0 ∧
      ‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.1.compl f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2)/r
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < 1-ε₁ := by linarith
  have hinner : ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ a < ε₁ ∧ 0 < b ∧ b < 1-ε₁ ∧ r < phiRadical a b := by
    by_contra! hn
    have he := phiRadical_le_of_strict_inner_bounds ε₁ (1-ε₁) r hε₁0 hb0
      (fun a b ha0 haε hb0 hbε => hn a b ha0 haε hb0 hbε)
    rw [phiRadical_eq_one_of_add_eq_one ε₁ (1-ε₁) hε₁0.le hb0.le (by ring)] at he
    linarith
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha0, haε, hb0', hbε, hrphi⟩ := hinner
  have hbε₂ : b < ε₂ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨α, haα, hαε⟩ := exists_between haε
  obtain ⟨β, hbβ, hβε⟩ := exists_between hbε₂
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hE, hF⟩ := quadraticArc_pair_exists_thin d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ α β hκ
    (ha0.trans haα).le (hαε.trans hε₁1).le hαε
    (hb0'.trans hbβ).le (hβε.trans hε₂1).le hβε
  obtain ⟨f, hf1, hfodd, hfF, hfE⟩ := quadratic_cutoff_odd_concentration d m a α b β r
    H (π m hm) J hodd (hchar m hm) ha0 (haε.trans hε₁1)
    hb0' (hbε₂.trans hε₂1) haα hbβ hr hr1 hrphi
  exact ⟨_, _, hE, hF, f, quadraticSet_radial d _ _, quadraticSet_radial d _ _,
    hfodd, hf1, hfF, hfE⟩

name: SVW.represented_cutoff_radical_lower
statement:
theorem represented_cutoff_radical_lower
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [Nontrivial H] (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (α₀ α β₀ β : ℝ) (hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1)
    (hβ₀0 : 0 < β₀) (hβ₀1 : β₀ < 1) (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β) :
    phiRadical α₀ β₀ ≤
      ‖π (reducedCyclicMap true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β) *
        reducedCyclicMap false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α))‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [reducedFreeCStar_representation_isometric (H →L[ℂ] H) π]
  exact freeCircleCutoffs_radical_lower α₀ α β₀ β hα₀0 hα₀1 hβ₀0 hβ₀1 hα hβ

name: SVW.quadratic_cutoff_odd_near_vector
statement:
theorem quadratic_cutoff_odd_near_vector
    (d : ℕ) (m α₀ α β₀ β r : ℝ)
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [Nontrivial H] (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Hilbert d) (hodd : ∀ x : H, OddVector d (J x))
    (hchar : ∀ (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (x : H),
      J (π (reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) x) =
        oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of i ^ k) (J x))
    (hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hβ₀0 : 0 < β₀) (hβ₀1 : β₀ < 1)
    (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrphi : r < phiRadical α₀ β₀) :
    ∃ x : Hilbert d, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧
      OddVector d (quadraticCyclicCalculus d m false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α) x) ∧
      r < ‖quadraticCyclicCalculus d m true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β)
        (quadraticCyclicCalculus d m false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α) x)‖
proof:
:= by
  let T := π (reducedCyclicMap true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β) *
    reducedCyclicMap false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α))
  have hrT : r < ‖T‖ := hrphi.trans_le
    (represented_cutoff_radical_lower H π α₀ α β₀ β hα₀0 hα₀1 hβ₀0 hβ₀1 hα hβ)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hTx⟩ := T.exists_nnnorm_eq_one_lt_apply_of_lt_opNNNorm
    (r := ⟨r, hr⟩) hrT
  have hx' : ‖x‖ = 1 := congrArg (fun t : ℝ≥0 => (t:ℝ)) hx
  have hTx' : r < ‖T x‖ := hTx
  have hinter (i : Bool) (f : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)) (y : H) :
      J (π (reducedCyclicMap i f) y) = quadraticCyclicCalculus d m i f (J y) :=
    cyclic_calculus_intertwining H (Hilbert d) π J i (quadraticCyclicCalculus d m i)
      (fun k y => by rw [quadraticCyclicCalculus_monomial]; exact hchar i k y) f y
  refine ⟨J x, by rw [J.norm_map, hx'], ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hinter]
    exact hodd _
  · rw [← hinter, ← hinter, J.norm_map]
    change r < ‖(π (reducedCyclicMap true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β)) *
      π (reducedCyclicMap false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α))) x‖
    rw [← map_mul]
    exact hTx'

name: SVW.quadratic_cutoff_odd_concentration
statement:
theorem quadratic_cutoff_odd_concentration
    (d : ℕ) (m α₀ α β₀ β r : ℝ)
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [Nontrivial H] (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Hilbert d) (hodd : ∀ x : H, OddVector d (J x))
    (hchar : ∀ (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (x : H),
      J (π (reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) x) =
        oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of i ^ k) (J x))
    (hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hβ₀0 : 0 < β₀) (hβ₀1 : β₀ < 1)
    (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hrphi : r < phiRadical α₀ β₀) :
    let E := quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc α)
    let F := quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β)
    let hE := (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc α) (circleArc_measurable α)).nullMeasurableSet
    let hF := (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc β) (circleArc_measurable β)).nullMeasurableSet
    ∃ f : Hilbert d, ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ OddVector d f ∧
      cut volume Fᶜ hF.compl (fourier d f) = 0 ∧
      ‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.compl f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2)/r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxodd, hnear⟩ := quadratic_cutoff_odd_near_vector d m α₀ α β₀ β r
    H π J hodd hchar hα₀0 hα₀1 hβ₀0 hβ₀1 hα hβ hr.le hrphi
  dsimp only
  let E := quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc α)
  let F := quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β)
  let hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume :=
    (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc α) (circleArc_measurable α)).nullMeasurableSet
  let hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume :=
    (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc β) (circleArc_measurable β)).nullMeasurableSet
  let P := positionProjection volume E hE
  let Q := frequencyProjection d F hF
  let A := quadraticCyclicCalculus d m false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α)
  let B := quadraticCyclicCalculus d m true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β)
  have hPA : P*A = A := quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_left d m α₀ α hα
  have hBQ : B*Q = B := by
    change quadraticFourierConjugation d (quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff β₀ β)) *
      quadraticFourierConjugation d (positionProjection volume F hF) =
        quadraticFourierConjugation d (quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff β₀ β))
    rw [← quadraticFourierConjugation_mul, quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_right d m β₀ β hβ]
  have hconc := cutoff_vector_concentration (Hilbert d) P Q A B
    (positionProjection_isStarProjection volume E hE) (frequencyProjection_isStarProjection d F hF)
    ((quadraticCyclicCalculus_norm_le d m false _).trans (circleArcCutoff_norm_le_one α₀ α))
    ((quadraticCyclicCalculus_norm_le d m true _).trans (circleArcCutoff_norm_le_one β₀ β))
    hPA hBQ x hx r hr hr1 hnear
  let g := Q (A x)
  let f := (‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g
  change ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ Q f = f ∧ ‖f-P f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2)/r at hconc
  refine ⟨f, hconc.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact oddVector_smul d _ g (oddVector_frequencyProjection_of_radial d F hF
      (quadraticSet_radial d (m/2) (circleArc β)) (A x) hxodd)
  · apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← frequency_residual_norm d F hF, hconc.2.1, sub_self, norm_zero]
  · rw [cut_compl volume E hE]
    exact hconc.2.2

name: SVW.oddVector_iff_reflection
statement:
theorem oddVector_iff_reflection (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    OddVector d f ↔ reflectionL2 d f = -f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [reflectionL2_coe d f, Lp.coeFn_neg f, hf] with x hr hn ho
    rw [hr, hn, Pi.neg_apply, ho]
  · intro hf
    filter_upwards [reflectionL2_coe d f, Lp.coeFn_neg f] with x hr hn
    have h := congrArg (fun g : Hilbert d => g x) hf
    simpa only [hr, hn, Pi.neg_apply] using h

name: SVW.oddVector_iff_mem_oddL2Subspace
statement:
theorem oddVector_iff_mem_oddL2Subspace (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    OddVector d f ↔ f ∈ oddL2Subspace d
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddVector_iff_reflection]
  change reflectionL2 d f = -f ↔ reflectionL2 d f + f = 0
  exact eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero

name: SVW.fourier_square_reflection
statement:
theorem fourier_square_reflection (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    fourier d (fourier d f) = reflectionL2 d f
proof:
:= by
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on f
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro g
  rw [schwartzToL2_apply]
  change (𝓕 (𝓕 (g.toLp 2)) : Hilbert d) = reflectionL2 d (g.toLp 2)
  rw [SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq, SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq]
  apply Lp.ext
  have he := (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure (Space d))).quasiMeasurePreserving
    |>.ae_eq_comp (g.coeFn_toLp 2 volume)
  filter_upwards [(𝓕 (𝓕 g)).coeFn_toLp 2 volume, reflectionL2_coe d (g.toLp 2), he]
    with x hff hr hg
  change g.toLp 2 volume (-x) = g (-x) at hg
  rw [hff, hr, hg]
  have h : (𝓕⁻ (𝓕 g) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (-x) = g (-x) := by simp
  simpa only [SchwartzMap.fourierInv_coe, Real.fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg,
    neg_neg, SchwartzMap.fourier_coe] using h

name: SVW.fourier_reflection
statement:
theorem fourier_reflection (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    fourier d (reflectionL2 d f) = reflectionL2 d (fourier d f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fourier_square_reflection d f, ← fourier_square_reflection d (fourier d f)]

name: SVW.inverseFourier_reflection
statement:
theorem inverseFourier_reflection (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (fourier d).symm (reflectionL2 d f) = reflectionL2 d ((fourier d).symm f)
proof:
:= by
  apply (fourier d).injective
  rw [(fourier d).apply_symm_apply, fourier_reflection, (fourier d).apply_symm_apply]

name: SVW.oddVector_fourier
statement:
theorem oddVector_fourier (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) :
    OddVector d (fourier d f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddVector_iff_reflection] at hf ⊢
  rw [← fourier_reflection, hf, map_neg]

name: SVW.oddVector_inverseFourier
statement:
theorem oddVector_inverseFourier (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) :
    OddVector d ((fourier d).symm f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddVector_iff_reflection] at hf ⊢
  rw [← inverseFourier_reflection, hf, map_neg]

name: SVW.oddVector_cut_of_even
statement:
theorem oddVector_cut_of_even (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (heven : ∀ x : Space d, -x ∈ E ↔ x ∈ E)
    (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) : OddVector d (cut volume E hE f)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure (Space d))).quasiMeasurePreserving
    |>.ae_eq_comp (cut_coe volume E hE f)
  filter_upwards [he, cut_coe volume E hE f, hf] with x hn hx ho
  change cut volume E hE f (-x) = E.indicator f (-x) at hn
  rw [hn, hx]
  by_cases hmem : x ∈ E
  · rw [indicator_of_mem hmem, indicator_of_mem ((heven x).mpr hmem), ho]
  · rw [indicator_of_notMem hmem, indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hmem ((heven x).mp h)), neg_zero]

name: SVW.radial_even
statement:
theorem radial_even (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Space d)) (hE : Radial d E) (x : Space d) :
    -x ∈ E ↔ x ∈ E
proof: := hE (-x) x (norm_neg x)

name: SVW.oddVector_cut_of_radial
statement:
theorem oddVector_cut_of_radial (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (hradial : Radial d E)
    (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) : OddVector d (cut volume E hE f)
proof:
:=
  oddVector_cut_of_even d E hE (radial_even d E hradial) f hf

name: SVW.oddVector_frequencyProjection_of_even
statement:
theorem oddVector_frequencyProjection_of_even (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (heven : ∀ x : Space d, -x ∈ E ↔ x ∈ E)
    (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) : OddVector d (frequencyProjection d E hE f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frequencyProjection_apply]
  exact oddVector_inverseFourier d _
    (oddVector_cut_of_even d E hE heven _ (oddVector_fourier d f hf))

name: SVW.oddVector_frequencyProjection_of_radial
statement:
theorem oddVector_frequencyProjection_of_radial (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (hradial : Radial d E)
    (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) : OddVector d (frequencyProjection d E hE f)
proof:
:=
  oddVector_frequencyProjection_of_even d E hE (radial_even d E hradial) f hf

name: SVW.oddVector_smul
statement:
theorem oddVector_smul (d : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (f : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) :
    OddVector d (c • f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddVector_iff_reflection] at hf ⊢
  rw [map_smul, hf, smul_neg]

name: SVW.oddVector_add
statement:
theorem oddVector_add (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) (hf : OddVector d f) (hg : OddVector d g) :
    OddVector d (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddVector_iff_reflection] at hf hg ⊢
  rw [map_add, hf, hg, neg_add]

name: SVW.criticalDensity_le_half_of_saturation
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_le_half_of_saturation (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ)
    (hsat : theta d κ (1/2) (1/2) = 1) : criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2
proof:
:=
  criticalDensity_upper_of_saturation d κ (1/2) (by norm_num) hsat

name: SVW.concentrationThreshold_pos
statement: theorem concentrationThreshold_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < concentrationThreshold n
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  unfold concentrationThreshold
  have h : (1:ℝ)/((n:ℝ)+2) < 1 := (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
  linarith

name: SVW.concentrationThreshold_lt_one
statement: theorem concentrationThreshold_lt_one (n : ℕ) : concentrationThreshold n < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold concentrationThreshold
  have h : 0 < (1:ℝ)/((n:ℝ)+2) := by positivity
  linarith

name: SVW.concentrationThreshold_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem concentrationThreshold_tendsto_one :
    Tendsto concentrationThreshold atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 2)
  have h : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1/((n:ℝ)+2)) atTop (nhds (0:ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat] using ht
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1-1/((n:ℝ)+2)) atTop (nhds 1)
  simpa only [sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).sub h

name: SVW.concentrationResidualBound_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem concentrationResidualBound_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => sqrt (1-concentrationThreshold n^2) / concentrationThreshold n)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).sub (concentrationThreshold_tendsto_one.pow 2)).sqrt
  have hd := hs.div concentrationThreshold_tendsto_one (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≠ 0)
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => sqrt (1-concentrationThreshold n^2) / concentrationThreshold n)
    atTop (nhds (sqrt (1-(1:ℝ)^2)/1)) at hd
  simpa only [one_pow, sub_self, sqrt_zero, zero_div] using hd

name: SVW.exists_odd_concentrating_sequence_of_approximations
statement:
theorem exists_odd_concentrating_sequence_of_approximations
    (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (happrox : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 →
      ∃ E F : Set (Space d), ∃ (hE : WolffThin d κ ε₁ E) (hF : WolffThin d κ ε₂ F),
      ∃ f : Hilbert d,
        Radial d E ∧ Radial d F ∧ OddVector d f ∧ ‖f‖ = 1 ∧
        ‖cut volume Fᶜ hF.1.compl (fourier d f)‖ = 0 ∧
        ‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.1.compl f‖ ≤ sqrt (1-r^2)/r) :
    ∃ E F : ℕ → Set (Space d), ∃ f : ℕ → Hilbert d,
      ∃ (hE : ∀ n : ℕ, WolffThin d κ ε₁ (E n)) (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, WolffThin d κ ε₂ (F n)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, Radial d (E n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, Radial d (F n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, OddVector d (f n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ‖f n‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ‖cut volume (F n)ᶜ (hF n).1.compl (fourier d (f n))‖ = 0) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖cut volume (E n)ᶜ (hE n).1.compl (f n)‖ +
        ‖cut volume (F n)ᶜ (hF n).1.compl (fourier d (f n))‖) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  choose E F hE hF f hradE hradF hodd hnorm hfreq hpos using
    fun n : ℕ => happrox (concentrationThreshold n) (concentrationThreshold_pos n)
      (concentrationThreshold_lt_one n)
  refine ⟨E, F, f, hE, hF, hradE, hradF, hodd, hnorm, hfreq, ?_⟩
  apply squeeze_zero (fun n => add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
    (fun n => ?_) concentrationResidualBound_tendsto_zero
  simpa only [hfreq n, add_zero] using hpos n

name: SVW.concentrating_sequence_refutes_uniform_uncertainty
statement:
theorem concentrating_sequence_refutes_uniform_uncertainty
    (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ) (E F : ℕ → Set (Space d)) (f : ℕ → Hilbert d)
    (hE : ∀ n : ℕ, WolffThin d κ ε₁ (E n)) (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, WolffThin d κ ε₂ (F n))
    (hnorm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖f n‖ = 1)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖cut volume (E n)ᶜ (hE n).1.compl (f n)‖ +
      ‖cut volume (F n)ᶜ (hF n).1.compl (fourier d (f n))‖) atTop (nhds 0))
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ¬ UncertaintyEstimate d (E n) (F n) (hE n).1 (hF n).1 C
proof:
:= by
  have he := (tendsto_order.mp hlim).2 (1/C) (one_div_pos.mpr hC)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := he.exists
  refine ⟨n, fun hU => ?_⟩
  have hbad := hU (f n)
  rw [hnorm n] at hbad
  have hsmall := (lt_div_iff₀ hC).mp hn
  rw [mul_comm] at hsmall
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hbad) hsmall

name: SVW.circleArcCutoffReal_nonneg
statement:
theorem circleArcCutoffReal_nonneg (α β : ℝ) (z : UnitAddCircle) :
    0 ≤ circleArcCutoffReal α β z
proof: := le_min zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _)

name: SVW.circleArcCutoffReal_le_one
statement:
theorem circleArcCutoffReal_le_one (α β : ℝ) (z : UnitAddCircle) :
    circleArcCutoffReal α β z ≤ 1
proof: := min_le_left _ _

name: SVW.circleArcCutoff_norm_le_one
