statement: theorem circleArcCutoff_norm_le_one (α β : ℝ) : ‖circleArcCutoff α β‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ zero_le_one).mpr
  intro z
  change ‖(circleArcCutoffReal α β z : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1
  simpa only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (circleArcCutoffReal_nonneg α β z)] using circleArcCutoffReal_le_one α β z

name: SVW.circleArcCutoff_eq_one
statement:
theorem circleArcCutoff_eq_one (α β : ℝ) (hαβ : α < β) (z : UnitAddCircle)
    (hz : z ∈ circleArc α) : circleArcCutoff α β z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdist : dist z 0 ≤ α / 2 := hz
  have hcoef : 1 ≤ (β - 2 * dist z 0) / (β - α) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hαβ)).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hmax : 1 ≤ max 0 ((β - 2 * dist z 0) / (β - α)) := hcoef.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  change ((min 1 (max 0 ((β - 2 * dist z 0) / (β - α))) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1
  rw [min_eq_left hmax, Complex.ofReal_one]

name: SVW.circleArcCutoff_eq_zero_off
statement:
theorem circleArcCutoff_eq_zero_off (α β : ℝ) (hαβ : α < β) (z : UnitAddCircle)
    (hz : z ∉ circleArc β) : circleArcCutoff α β z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdist : β / 2 < dist z 0 := lt_of_not_ge hz
  have hcoef : (β - 2 * dist z 0) / (β - α) ≤ 0 :=
    div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (sub_pos.mpr hαβ).le
  change ((min 1 (max 0 ((β - 2 * dist z 0) / (β - α))) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0
  rw [max_eq_left hcoef, min_eq_right zero_le_one, Complex.ofReal_zero]

name: SVW.circleArcCutoff_support_subset
statement:
theorem circleArcCutoff_support_subset (α β : ℝ) (hαβ : α < β) :
    Function.support (circleArcCutoff α β) ⊆ circleArc β
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  by_contra hzout
  exact hz (circleArcCutoff_eq_zero_off α β hαβ z hzout)

name: SVW.unitCircle_haar_eq_volume
statement:
theorem unitCircle_haar_eq_volume :
    (AddCircle.haarAddCircle : Measure UnitAddCircle) = volume
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle (T := (1 : ℝ))).symm

name: SVW.circleArc_haar_real
statement:
theorem circleArc_haar_real (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    AddCircle.haarAddCircle.real (circleArc α) = α
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitCircle_haar_eq_volume, circleArc_volume_real α hα0 hα1]

name: SVW.freeCircleCutoffs_radical_lower
statement:
theorem freeCircleCutoffs_radical_lower (α₀ α β₀ β : ℝ)
    (hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hβ₀0 : 0 < β₀) (hβ₀1 : β₀ < 1)
    (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β) :
    phiRadical α₀ β₀ ≤
      ‖freeContinuousCyclic true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β) *
        freeContinuousCyclic false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hA := circleArc_haar_real α₀ hα₀0.le hα₀1.le
  have hB := circleArc_haar_real β₀ hβ₀0.le hβ₀1.le
  have h := freeContinuousCyclic_product_radical_lower (circleArcCutoff α₀ α)
    (circleArcCutoff β₀ β) (circleArc α₀) (circleArc β₀)
    (circleArc_measurable α₀) (circleArc_measurable β₀)
    (circleArcCutoff_eq_one α₀ α hα) (circleArcCutoff_eq_one β₀ β hβ)
    (by simpa only [hA] using hα₀0) (by simpa only [hA] using hα₀1)
    (by simpa only [hB] using hβ₀0) (by simpa only [hB] using hβ₀1)
  simpa only [hA, hB] using h

name: SVW.boundedSymbol_mask_left
statement:
theorem boundedSymbol_mask_left (m : BoundedSymbol X μ) (E : Set X)
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∉ E → m x = 0) :
    positionProjection μ E hE * m.operator = m.operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE (m.operator f), m.operator_coe f, hm] with x hc hop hzero
  change cut μ E hE (m.operator f) x = m.operator f x
  rw [hc]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E
  · simp [hx]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
    rw [hop, hzero hx, zero_mul]

name: SVW.boundedSymbol_mask_right
statement:
theorem boundedSymbol_mask_right (m : BoundedSymbol X μ) (E : Set X)
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E μ) (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∉ E → m x = 0) :
    m.operator * positionProjection μ E hE = m.operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe μ E hE f, m.operator_coe (cut μ E hE f), m.operator_coe f, hm]
    with x hc hop hraw hzero
  change m.operator (cut μ E hE f) x = m.operator f x
  rw [hop, hraw, hc]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E
  · simp [hx]
  · rw [hzero hx, zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: SVW.masked_product_norm_le
statement:
theorem masked_product_norm_le (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    (P Q A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ 1)
    (hPA : P * A = A) (hBQ : B * Q = B) : ‖B * A‖ ≤ ‖Q * P‖
proof:
:= by
  have heq : B * (Q * P) * A = B * A := by
    calc
      _ = (B * Q) * (P * A) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hBQ, hPA]
  calc
    _ = ‖B * (Q * P) * A‖ := congrArg norm heq.symm
    _ ≤ (‖B‖ * ‖Q * P‖) * ‖A‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (1 * ‖Q * P‖) * 1 := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (norm_nonneg _)) hA (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: SVW.concentration_norm_reverse
statement:
theorem concentration_norm_reverse (d : ℕ) (E F : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) :
    ‖frequencyProjection d F hF * positionProjection volume E hE‖ =
      ‖positionProjection volume E hE * frequencyProjection d F hF‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ‖star (frequencyProjection d F hF * positionProjection volume E hE)‖ := (norm_star _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [star_mul, (positionProjection_isStarProjection volume E hE).isSelfAdjoint,
      (frequencyProjection_isStarProjection d F hF).isSelfAdjoint]

name: SVW.quadratic_density_lower_from_representation
statement:
theorem quadratic_density_lower_from_representation
    (d : ℕ) (κ ε₁ ε₂ m α₀ α β₀ β : ℝ)
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [Nontrivial H]
    (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Hilbert d)
    (hchar : ∀ (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (x : H),
      J (π (reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) x) =
        oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of i ^ k) (J x))
    (hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hβ₀0 : 0 < β₀) (hβ₀1 : β₀ < 1)
    (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β)
    (hE : WolffThin d κ ε₁ (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc α)))
    (hF : WolffThin d κ ε₂ (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β))) :
    phiRadical α₀ β₀ ≤ theta d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:= by
  have htransfer := cyclic_cutoffs_radical_lower H (Hilbert d) π J (quadraticCyclicCalculus d m)
    (fun i k x => by rw [quadraticCyclicCalculus_monomial]; exact hchar i k x)
    α₀ α β₀ β hα₀0 hα₀1 hβ₀0 hβ₀1 hα hβ
  have hmask := quadratic_cutoff_product_le_masks d m α₀ α β₀ β hα hβ
  have hl := htransfer.trans hmask
  rw [concentration_norm_reverse] at hl
  exact hl.trans (concentration_norm_le_theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ _ _ hE hF)

name: SVW.phiRadical_le_of_strict_inner_bounds
statement:
theorem phiRadical_le_of_strict_inner_bounds (a b t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → x < a → 0 < y → y < b → phiRadical x y ≤ t) :
    phiRadical a b ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => phiRadical p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold phiRadical
    fun_prop
  have hc : IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | phiRadical p.1 p.2 ≤ t} := isClosed_le hcont continuous_const
  have hsub : Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) a ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) b ⊆ {p | phiRadical p.1 p.2 ≤ t} := by
    rintro ⟨x,y⟩ ⟨hx,hy⟩
    exact h x y hx.1 hx.2 hy.1 hy.2
  have he : (a,b) ∈ closure (Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) a ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) b) := by
    rw [closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo ha.ne, closure_Ioo hb.ne]
    exact ⟨⟨ha.le, le_rfl⟩, ⟨hb.le, le_rfl⟩⟩
  exact closure_minimal hsub hc he

name: SVW.frequencyChirpUnitary_zpow
statement:
theorem frequencyChirpUnitary_zpow (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    frequencyChirpUnitary d ((k:ℝ)*m) = (frequencyChirpUnitary d m)^k
proof:
:= by
  have h := (MulAut.conj ((fourier d).symm)).toMonoidHom.map_zpow (chirpUnitary d m) k
  rw [← chirpUnitary_zpow] at h
  have he (t : ℝ) : (MulAut.conj ((fourier d).symm)).toMonoidHom (chirpUnitary d t) =
      frequencyChirpUnitary d t := by
    apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
    intro f
    rfl
  rw [he, he] at h
  exact h

name: SVW.quadraticCyclicCalculus_monomial
statement:
theorem quadraticCyclicCalculus_monomial (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    quadraticCyclicCalculus d m i (_root_.fourier k) =
      (oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of i ^ k) : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zpow]
  cases i
  · change quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (_root_.fourier k) = _
    rw [quadraticContinuousMultiplier_monomial, oscillatorWord_first, ← chirpUnitary_zpow]
  · change quadraticFourierConjugation d (quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (_root_.fourier k)) = _
    rw [quadraticContinuousMultiplier_monomial, oscillatorWord_second,
      ← frequencyChirpUnitary_zpow]
    rfl

name: SVW.quadraticFourierConjugation_mul
statement:
theorem quadraticFourierConjugation_mul (d : ℕ) (A B : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d) :
    quadraticFourierConjugation d (A*B) =
      quadraticFourierConjugation d A * quadraticFourierConjugation d B
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  change (fourier d).symm (A (B (fourier d u))) =
    (fourier d).symm (A (fourier d ((fourier d).symm (B (fourier d u)))))
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: SVW.quadraticFourierConjugation_position
statement:
theorem quadraticFourierConjugation_position (d : ℕ) (E : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) :
    quadraticFourierConjugation d (positionProjection volume E hE) =
      frequencyProjection d E hE
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.quadratic_cutoff_product_le_masks
statement:
theorem quadratic_cutoff_product_le_masks (d : ℕ) (m α₀ α β₀ β : ℝ)
    (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β) :
    ‖quadraticCyclicCalculus d m true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β) *
      quadraticCyclicCalculus d m false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α)‖ ≤
    ‖frequencyProjection d (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β))
        (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc β) (circleArc_measurable β)).nullMeasurableSet *
      positionProjection volume (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc α))
        (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc α) (circleArc_measurable α)).nullMeasurableSet‖
proof:
:= by
  apply masked_product_norm_le
  · exact (quadraticCyclicCalculus_norm_le d m false _).trans (circleArcCutoff_norm_le_one α₀ α)
  · exact (quadraticCyclicCalculus_norm_le d m true _).trans (circleArcCutoff_norm_le_one β₀ β)
  · exact quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_left d m α₀ α hα
  · change quadraticFourierConjugation d (quadraticContinuousMultiplier d m (circleArcCutoff β₀ β)) *
      quadraticFourierConjugation d (positionProjection volume (quadraticSet d (m/2) (circleArc β))
        (quadraticSet_measurable d (m/2) (circleArc β) (circleArc_measurable β)).nullMeasurableSet) = _
    rw [← quadraticFourierConjugation_mul, quadraticContinuousMultiplier_cutoff_mask_right d m β₀ β hβ]
    rfl

name: SVW.starProjection_pythagoras
statement:
theorem starProjection_pythagoras (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (x : H) :
    ‖x‖^2 = ‖P x‖^2 + ‖x-P x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcomplete, hEq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hP
  letI := hcomplete
  have he := Submodule.norm_sq_eq_add_norm_sq_starProjection x P.range
  rw [Submodule.starProjection_orthogonal_val, ← hEq] at he
  exact he

name: SVW.starProjection_residual_norm_le
statement:
theorem starProjection_residual_norm_le (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (x : H) : ‖x-P x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have he := starProjection_pythagoras H P hP x
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg (x-P x), sq_nonneg ‖P x‖]

name: SVW.starProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem starProjection_norm_le (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (x : H) : ‖P x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have he := starProjection_pythagoras H P hP x
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg (P x), sq_nonneg ‖x-P x‖]

name: SVW.cutoff_vector_concentration
statement:
theorem cutoff_vector_concentration
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q A B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q)
    (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ 1) (hPA : P*A = A) (hBQ : B*Q = B)
    (x : H) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hnear : r < ‖B (A x)‖) :
    let g := Q (A x)
    let f := (‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g
    ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ Q f = f ∧ ‖f-P f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2)/r
proof:
:= by
  let y : H := A x
  let g : H := Q y
  have hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ‖y‖ ≤ ‖A‖*‖x‖ := A.le_opNorm x
      _ ≤ 1 := by rw [hx, mul_one]; exact hA
  have hPy : P y = y := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T x) hPA
  have hBg : B g = B y := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T y) hBQ
  have hg : r < ‖g‖ := by
    calc
      r < ‖B y‖ := hnear
      _ = ‖B g‖ := congrArg norm hBg.symm
      _ ≤ ‖B‖*‖g‖ := B.le_opNorm g
      _ ≤ ‖g‖ := by simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (norm_nonneg g)
  have hg0 : 0 < ‖g‖ := hr.trans hg
  have hg1 : ‖g‖ ≤ 1 := (starProjection_norm_le H Q hQ y).trans hy
  have hQgg : Q g = g := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T y) hQ.isIdempotentElem
  have hpyth := starProjection_pythagoras H Q hQ y
  have hrad : 0 ≤ 1-r^2 := by nlinarith
  have hres : ‖g-P g‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2) := by
    have hdist : ‖g-y‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2) := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
      apply (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) hrad).mpr
      change ‖y-g‖^2 ≤ 1-r^2
      have hysq : ‖y‖^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
      have hrsq : r^2 ≤ ‖g‖^2 := (sq_le_sq₀ hr.le (norm_nonneg g)).mpr hg.le
      nlinarith
    have he : g-P g = (g-y)-P (g-y) := by rw [map_sub, hPy]; abel
    rw [he]
    exact (starProjection_residual_norm_le H P hP (g-y)).trans hdist
  change ‖(‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g‖ = 1 ∧ Q ((‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g) = (‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g ∧
    ‖(‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g-P ((‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ) • g)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-r^2)/r
  have hc : ‖(‖g‖⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = ‖g‖⁻¹ := by
    rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg g)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, hc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hg0.ne']
  · rw [map_smul, hQgg]
  · rw [map_smul, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, hc]
    calc
      ‖g‖⁻¹ * ‖g-P g‖ ≤ ‖g‖⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (1-r^2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hres (inv_nonneg.mpr hg0.le)
      _ ≤ r⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (1-r^2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (inv_le_inv₀ hg0 hr |>.mpr hg.le) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: SVW.theta_ge_profile
statement:
theorem theta_ge_profile (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) :
    phi ε₁ ε₂ ≤ theta d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin d := ⟨0, hd⟩
  exact quadratic_phi_lower_of_models d (GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
    (oscillatorReducedModel d i) (hermiteGaussianSector d i).subtypeₗᵢ
    (fun m hm b k x => oscillatorReducedModel_coe d i m hm (FreeGroup.of b ^ k) x)
    hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1

name: SVW.theta_eq_one_of_density_sum
statement:
theorem theta_eq_one_of_density_sum (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) (hsum : 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂) :
    theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta_ge_profile d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1
  rw [phi_eq_one_of_one_le_add ε₁ ε₂ hε₁0.le hε₂0.le hsum] at h
  exact le_antisymm (theta_le_one d κ ε₁ ε₂ hε₁0.le hε₂0.le) h

name: SVW.radial_odd_concentration
statement:
theorem radial_odd_concentration (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) (hsum : 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂) :
    RadialOddConcentration d κ ε₁ ε₂
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin d := ⟨0, hd⟩
  apply exists_odd_concentrating_sequence_of_approximations
  intro r hr hr1
  obtain ⟨E, F, hE, hF, f, hradE, hradF, hodd, hunit, hfreq, hpos⟩ :=
    quadratic_odd_witness_of_models d (GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
      (oscillatorReducedModel d i) (hermiteGaussianSector d i).subtypeₗᵢ
      (fun m hm b k x => oscillatorReducedModel_coe d i m hm (FreeGroup.of b ^ k) x)
      (gaussianSectorHilbert_odd d i) hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1 hsum r hr hr1
  exact ⟨E, F, hE, hF, f, hradE, hradF, hodd, hunit, by rw [hfreq, norm_zero], hpos⟩

name: SVW.svw_counterexample
statement:
theorem svw_counterexample (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε₁0 : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hε₂0 : 0 < ε₂) (hε₂1 : ε₂ < 1) (hsum : 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ E F : Set (Space d), ∃ (hE : WolffThin d κ ε₁ E) (hF : WolffThin d κ ε₂ F),
    ∃ f : Hilbert d, Radial d E ∧ Radial d F ∧ OddVector d f ∧ ‖f‖ = 1 ∧
      C * (‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.1.compl f‖ + ‖cut volume Fᶜ hF.1.compl (fourier d f)‖) < ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, F, f, hE, hF, hradE, hradF, hodd, hunit, _hfreq, hlim⟩ :=
    radial_odd_concentration d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1 hsum
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ((tendsto_order.mp hlim).2 (1/C) (one_div_pos.mpr hC)).exists
  refine ⟨E n, F n, hE n, hF n, f n, hradE n, hradF n, hodd n, hunit n, ?_⟩
  rw [hunit n]
  have hs := (lt_div_iff₀ hC).mp hn
  rwa [mul_comm] at hs

name: SVW.criticalDensity_le_half
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_le_half (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2
proof:
:=
  criticalDensity_le_half_of_saturation d κ
    (theta_eq_one_of_density_sum d hd κ (1/2) (1/2) hκ
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: SVW.svw_half_density_obstruction
statement:
theorem svw_half_density_obstruction (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    (∀ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ → ε₁ < 1 → 0 < ε₂ → ε₂ < 1 →
      phi ε₁ ε₂ ≤ theta d κ ε₁ ε₂) ∧
    (∀ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ → ε₁ < 1 → 0 < ε₂ → ε₂ < 1 → 1 ≤ ε₁+ε₂ →
      theta d κ ε₁ ε₂ = 1 ∧ RadialOddConcentration d κ ε₁ ε₂) ∧
    criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, criticalDensity_le_half d hd κ hκ⟩
  · intro ε₁ ε₂ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1
    exact theta_ge_profile d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1
  · intro ε₁ ε₂ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1 hsum
    exact ⟨theta_eq_one_of_density_sum d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1 hsum,
      radial_odd_concentration d hd κ ε₁ ε₂ hκ hε₁0 hε₁1 hε₂0 hε₂1 hsum⟩

name: SVW.periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (θ a b : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => g (s + θ)) volume a b
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using
    (hg.intervalIntegrable₀ (by norm_num) hi (a + θ) (b + θ)).comp_add_right θ

name: SVW.periodic_shift_mean_zero
statement:
theorem periodic_shift_mean_zero (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (s + θ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right]
  simpa only [zero_add, add_comm 1 θ] using
    (hg.intervalIntegral_add_eq θ 0).trans (by simpa using hmean)

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_periodic
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_periodic (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (θ : ℝ) :
    Function.Periodic (periodicPrimitive g θ) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  unfold periodicPrimitive
  rw [(hg.add_const θ).intervalIntegral_add_eq_add 0 t
    (periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable g hg hi θ)]
  simpa only [zero_add, add_zero] using
    congrArg ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, g (s + θ)) + ·) (periodic_shift_mean_zero g hg hmean θ)

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_zero
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_zero (g : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    periodicPrimitive g θ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [periodicPrimitive, intervalIntegral.integral_same]

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_one
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_one (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (θ : ℝ) :
    periodicPrimitive g θ 1 = 0
proof:
:=
  periodic_shift_mean_zero g hg hmean θ

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_fract
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_fract (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (θ t : ℝ) :
    periodicPrimitive g θ (Int.fract t) = periodicPrimitive g θ t
proof:
:= by
  have hp := periodicPrimitive_periodic g hg hi hmean θ
  simpa only [Int.fract, mul_one] using hp.sub_int_mul_eq (x := t) (Int.floor t)

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_abs_le_one (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ t : ℝ) : |periodicPrimitive g θ t| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← periodicPrimitive_fract g hg hi hmean θ t]
  have hnorm : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..Int.fract t, g (s + θ)‖ ≤
      (1 : ℝ) * |Int.fract t - 0| :=
    intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (fun s _ => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (s + θ))
  have hfrac := Int.fract_lt_one t
  simpa only [periodicPrimitive, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, Int.abs_fract, one_mul]
    using hnorm.trans (by simpa only [sub_zero, Int.abs_fract, one_mul] using hfrac.le)

name: SVW.continuous_periodicPrimitive
statement:
theorem continuous_periodicPrimitive (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    Continuous (periodicPrimitive g θ)
proof:
:=
  intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable g hg hi θ) 0

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_sub
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_sub (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1) (θ a b : ℝ) :
    periodicPrimitive g θ b - periodicPrimitive g θ a =
      ∫ s in a..b, g (s + θ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold periodicPrimitive
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable g hg hi θ 0 a)
    (periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable g hg hi θ a b)
  linarith

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_abs_sub_le
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_abs_sub_le (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (θ a b : ℝ) : |periodicPrimitive g θ b - periodicPrimitive g θ a| ≤ |b - a|
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodicPrimitive_sub g hg hi θ a b]
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul] using
    intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := a) (b := b) (C := (1 : ℝ)) (f := fun s : ℝ => g (s + θ))
      (fun s _ => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (s + θ))

name: SVW.periodic_shift_locallyIntegrable
statement:
theorem periodic_shift_locallyIntegrable (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    LocallyIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => g (s + θ)) volume
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨Set.Ioc (x - 1) (x + 1), ?_,
    (periodic_shift_intervalIntegrable g hg hi θ (x - 1) (x + 1)).1⟩
  exact Ioc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: SVW.periodicPrimitive_ae_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem periodicPrimitive_ae_hasDerivAt (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (periodicPrimitive g θ) (g (t + θ)) t
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [_root_.LocallyIntegrable.ae_hasDerivAt_integral
    (periodic_shift_locallyIntegrable g hg hi θ)]
    with t ht using ht 0

name: SVW.lipschitzWith_periodicPrimitive
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_periodicPrimitive (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (θ : ℝ) : LipschitzWith (1 : ℝ≥0) (periodicPrimitive g θ)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro a b
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using
    periodicPrimitive_abs_sub_le g hg hi hbound θ b a

name: SVW.absolutelyContinuous_periodicPrimitive
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuous_periodicPrimitive (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ a b : ℝ) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (periodicPrimitive g θ) a b
proof:
:=
  (lipschitzWith_periodicPrimitive g hg hi hbound θ).lipschitzOnWith
    |>.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval

name: SVW.periodic_integral_mul_eq_boundary_sub
statement:
theorem periodic_integral_mul_eq_boundary_sub (g w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ a b : ℝ)
    (hw : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval w a b) :
    (∫ s in a..b, w s * g (s + θ)) =
      w b * periodicPrimitive g θ b - w a * periodicPrimitive g θ a -
        ∫ s in a..b, deriv w s * periodicPrimitive g θ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hw.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
    (absolutelyContinuous_periodicPrimitive g hg hi hbound θ a b)]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [periodicPrimitive_ae_hasDerivAt g hg hi θ] with s hs _
  rw [hs.deriv]

name: SVW.periodic_weighted_integral_abs_le
statement:
theorem periodic_weighted_integral_abs_le (g w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hw : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval w a b)
    (hwa : 0 ≤ w a) (hwb : 0 ≤ w b)
    (hw' : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioc a b, deriv w s ≤ 0) :
    |∫ s in a..b, w s * g (s + θ)| ≤ 2 * w a
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : |∫ s in a..b, deriv w s * periodicPrimitive g θ s| ≤ w a - w b := by
    have hnorm : ‖∫ s in a..b, deriv w s * periodicPrimitive g θ s‖ ≤
        ∫ s in a..b, -deriv w s := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hab
      · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        intro s hs
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonpos (hw' s hs)]
        simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (periodicPrimitive_abs_le_one g hg hi hmean hbound θ s)
          (neg_nonneg.mpr (hw' s hs))
      · exact hw.intervalIntegrable_deriv.neg
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, hw.integral_deriv_eq_sub] at hnorm
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, neg_sub] using hnorm
  have ha : |w a * periodicPrimitive g θ a| ≤ w a := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hwa]
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (periodicPrimitive_abs_le_one g hg hi hmean hbound θ a) hwa
  have hb : |w b * periodicPrimitive g θ b| ≤ w b := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hwb]
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (periodicPrimitive_abs_le_one g hg hi hmean hbound θ b) hwb
  rw [periodic_integral_mul_eq_boundary_sub g w hg hi hbound θ a b hw]
  calc
    |w b * periodicPrimitive g θ b - w a * periodicPrimitive g θ a -
        ∫ s in a..b, deriv w s * periodicPrimitive g θ s|
      ≤ |w b * periodicPrimitive g θ b - w a * periodicPrimitive g θ a| +
          |∫ s in a..b, deriv w s * periodicPrimitive g θ s| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ (|w b * periodicPrimitive g θ b| + |w a * periodicPrimitive g θ a|) +
          |∫ s in a..b, deriv w s * periodicPrimitive g θ s| :=
      add_le_add (abs_sub _ _) le_rfl
    _ ≤ 2 * w a := by linarith

name: SVW.quadraticWeight_nonneg
statement: theorem quadraticWeight_nonneg (c t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ quadraticWeight c t
proof:
:= by
  unfold quadraticWeight
  positivity

name: SVW.quadraticWeight_at_square
statement:
theorem quadraticWeight_at_square (c u : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hu : 0 < u) :
    quadraticWeight c (c * u ^ 2) = 1 / (2 * c * u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold quadraticWeight
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul hc.le, Real.sqrt_sq hu.le]
  have hs : Real.sqrt c ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hc).ne'
  have hc' : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
  have hu' : u ≠ 0 := hu.ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hc.le]

name: SVW.quadraticWeight_deriv_nonpos
statement:
theorem quadraticWeight_deriv_nonpos (c t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    deriv (quadraticWeight c) t ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt t ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht).ne'
  have hd : HasDerivAt (quadraticWeight c)
      ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt c)) * (-(1 / (2 * Real.sqrt t)) / (Real.sqrt t) ^ 2)) t :=
    ((Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt ht.ne').inv hs).const_mul _
  rw [hd.deriv]
  apply mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
  · positivity
  · apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    · apply neg_nonpos.mpr
      positivity
    · exact sq_nonneg _

name: SVW.absolutelyContinuous_quadraticWeight
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuous_quadraticWeight (c a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (quadraticWeight c) a b
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, 0 < t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at ht
    exact ha.trans_le ht.1
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Real.sqrt (Set.uIcc a b) :=
    contDiffOn_id.sqrt (fun t ht => (hp t ht).ne')
  have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (quadraticWeight c) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
    contDiffOn_const.mul (hs.inv (fun t ht => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hp t ht)).ne'))
  exact hw.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval

name: SVW.quadraticWeight_integral_abs_le
statement:
theorem quadraticWeight_integral_abs_le (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ c a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    |∫ s in a..b, quadraticWeight c s * g (s + θ)| ≤ 2 * quadraticWeight c a
proof:
:= by
  apply periodic_weighted_integral_abs_le g (quadraticWeight c) hg hi hmean hbound
    θ a b hab (absolutelyContinuous_quadraticWeight c a b ha hab)
    (quadraticWeight_nonneg c a) (quadraticWeight_nonneg c b)
  intro s hs
  exact quadraticWeight_deriv_nonpos c s (ha.trans hs.1)

name: SVW.quadratic_integral_eq_weighted
statement:
theorem quadratic_integral_eq_weighted (g : ℝ → ℝ) (θ c a b : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ u in a..b, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)) =
      ∫ s in (c * a ^ 2)..(c * b ^ 2), quadraticWeight c s * g (s + θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc a b, 0 < u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at hu
    exact ha.trans_le hu.1
  have hderiv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => c * v ^ 2) (2 * c * u) u := by
    intro u
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 u).const_mul c
  have hchange := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv_of_deriv_nonneg (a := a) (b := b)
    (f := fun u : ℝ => c * u ^ 2) (f' := fun u : ℝ => 2 * c * u)
    (g := fun s : ℝ => quadraticWeight c s * g (s + θ))
    (by fun_prop) (fun u _ => hderiv u)
    (fun u hu => by
      have hu' : u ∈ Set.uIcc a b := Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inl
        ⟨by simpa only [min_eq_left hab] using hu.1.le,
          by simpa only [max_eq_right hab] using hu.2.le⟩)
      exact le_of_lt (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hc) (hp u hu')))
  rw [← hchange]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro u hu
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [quadraticWeight_at_square c u hc (hp u hu)]
  have hc' : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
  have hu' : u ≠ 0 := (hp u hu).ne'
  field_simp

name: SVW.quadratic_tail_abs_le
statement:
theorem quadratic_tail_abs_le (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Function.Periodic g 1)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ c a b : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    |∫ u in a..b, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 1 / (c * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadratic_integral_eq_weighted g θ c a b hc ha hab]
  have ha' : 0 < c * a ^ 2 := mul_pos hc (sq_pos_of_pos ha)
  have hab' : c * a ^ 2 ≤ c * b ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((sq_le_sq₀ ha.le (ha.le.trans hab)).mpr hab) hc.le
  have h := quadraticWeight_integral_abs_le g hg hi hmean hbound θ c
    (c * a ^ 2) (c * b ^ 2) ha' hab'
  rw [quadraticWeight_at_square c a hc ha] at h
  convert h using 1
  have hc' : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
  have ha'' : a ≠ 0 := ha.ne'
  field_simp

name: SVW.intervalIntegrable_of_measurable_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_of_measurable_abs_le_one (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (a b : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable g volume a b
proof:
:= by
  apply (intervalIntegrable_const (a := a) (b := b) (c := (1 : ℝ))).mono_fun'
  · exact hgm.aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound s)

name: SVW.quadratic_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem quadratic_intervalIntegrable (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ c a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)) volume a b
proof:
:=
  intervalIntegrable_of_measurable_abs_le_one _ (hgm.comp (by fun_prop))
    (fun u => hbound (c * u ^ 2 + θ)) a b

name: SVW.quadratic_integral_abs_le_length
statement:
theorem quadratic_integral_abs_le_length (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ c a b : ℝ) :
    |∫ u in a..b, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ |b - a|
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul] using
    intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := a) (b := b) (C := (1 : ℝ)) (f := fun u : ℝ => g (c * u ^ 2 + θ))
      (fun u _ => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (c * u ^ 2 + θ))

name: SVW.quadratic_primitive_neg
statement:
theorem quadratic_primitive_neg (g : ℝ → ℝ) (θ c R : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(-R), g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)) =
      -(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..R, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (f := fun u : ℝ => g (c * u ^ 2 + θ))
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := R)
  simp only [neg_zero, neg_sq] at h
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm (-R) 0, ← h]

name: SVW.quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two_nonneg
statement:
theorem quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two_nonneg (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    |∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..R, g (u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 1 :=
    intervalIntegrable_of_measurable_abs_le_one g hgm hbound 0 1
  by_cases hR' : R ≤ 1
  · have h := quadratic_integral_abs_le_length g hbound θ 1 0 R
    simp only [one_mul, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hR] at h
    linarith
  · have h1R : 1 ≤ R := le_of_not_ge hR'
    have hhead : |∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [one_mul, sub_zero, abs_one] using
        quadratic_integral_abs_le_length g hbound θ 1 0 1
    have htail : |∫ u in (1 : ℝ)..R, g (u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [one_mul, one_div_one] using
        quadratic_tail_abs_le g hg hi hmean hbound θ 1 1 R (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h1R
    have hadd : (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) +
        (∫ u in (1 : ℝ)..R, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) =
        ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..R, g (u ^ 2 + θ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      · simpa only [one_mul] using quadratic_intervalIntegrable g hgm hbound θ 1 0 1
      · simpa only [one_mul] using quadratic_intervalIntegrable g hgm hbound θ 1 1 R
    rw [← hadd]
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)

name: SVW.quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ R : ℝ) :
    |∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..R, g (u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hR : 0 ≤ R
  · exact quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two_nonneg g hg hgm hmean hbound θ R hR
  · have hR' : 0 ≤ -R := by linarith
    have h := quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two_nonneg g hg hgm hmean hbound θ (-R) hR'
    have heq := quadratic_primitive_neg g θ 1 R
    simp only [one_mul] at heq
    rw [heq, abs_neg] at h
    exact h

name: SVW.quadratic_interval_abs_le_four
statement:
theorem quadratic_interval_abs_le_four (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ a b : ℝ) :
    |∫ u in a..b, g (u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  have ha := quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two g hg hgm hmean hbound θ a
  have hb := quadratic_primitive_abs_le_two g hg hgm hmean hbound θ b
  have hadd : (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..a, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) +
      (∫ u in a..b, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) = ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..b, g (u ^ 2 + θ) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    · simpa only [one_mul] using quadratic_intervalIntegrable g hgm hbound θ 1 0 a
    · simpa only [one_mul] using quadratic_intervalIntegrable g hgm hbound θ 1 a b
  have heq : (∫ u in a..b, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) =
      (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..b, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) - (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..a, g (u ^ 2 + θ)) := by
    linarith
  rw [heq]
  exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith)

name: SVW.quadratic_integral_rescale
statement:
theorem quadratic_integral_rescale (g : ℝ → ℝ) (θ c a b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ u in a..b, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)) =
      (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ * ∫ v in (Real.sqrt c * a)..(Real.sqrt c * b), g (v ^ 2 + θ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∫ u in a..b, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)) =
        ∫ u in a..b, g ((Real.sqrt c * u) ^ 2 + θ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro u _
      dsimp only
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hc.le]
    _ = (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ *
        ∫ v in (Real.sqrt c * a)..(Real.sqrt c * b), g (v ^ 2 + θ) := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun v : ℝ => g (v ^ 2 + θ))
          (a := a) (b := b) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hc).ne'

name: SVW.quadratic_integral_abs_le_four_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem quadratic_integral_abs_le_four_div_sqrt (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (θ c a b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    |∫ u in a..b, g (c * u ^ 2 + θ)| ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt c
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadratic_integral_rescale g θ c a b hc, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg c))]
  calc
    (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ * |∫ v in (Real.sqrt c * a)..(Real.sqrt c * b), g (v ^ 2 + θ)|
      ≤ (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ * 4 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (quadratic_interval_abs_le_four g hg hgm hmean hbound θ
            (Real.sqrt c * a) (Real.sqrt c * b))
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg c))
    _ = 4 / Real.sqrt c := by ring

name: SVW.radial_ball_integral_isometry
statement:
theorem radial_ball_integral_isometry (E F : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c R : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (∫ y in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫ y in Metric.ball (e x) R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : e ⁻¹' Metric.ball (e x) R = Metric.ball x R := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, e.dist_map]
  have h := e.measurePreserving.setIntegral_preimage_emb e.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding
    (fun y : F => g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) (Metric.ball (e x) R)
  rw [hpre] at h
  simpa only [e.norm_map] using h

name: SVW.radial_ball_integral_eq_of_norm_eq
statement:
theorem radial_ball_integral_eq_of_norm_eq (E : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c R : ℝ) (x y : E) (hxy : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖z‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫ z in Metric.ball y R, g (c * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E := (ℝ ∙ (x - y))ᗮ.reflection
  have he : e x = y := Submodule.reflection_sub hxy
  simpa only [he] using radial_ball_integral_isometry E E e g c R x

name: SVW.quadratic_ball_abs_integral_le_crude
statement:
theorem quadratic_ball_abs_integral_le_crude (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c R : ℝ) (x : Space (n + 1)) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) :
    |∫ y in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)| ≤
      (4 / Real.sqrt c) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space n) R)
proof:
:= by
  let e := finSuccOptionIsometry n
  rw [radial_ball_integral_isometry (Space (n + 1)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n)))
    e g c R x]
  have hnorm : ‖e x‖ = ‖optionAxisPoint n ‖x‖‖ := by
    rw [e.norm_map, optionAxisPoint_norm, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)]
  rw [radial_ball_integral_eq_of_norm_eq (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n))) g c R
    (e x) (optionAxisPoint n ‖x‖) hnorm]
  exact euclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_crude n g hg hgm hmean hbound c ‖x‖ R hc hR

name: SVW.quadratic_ball_abs_integral_le_tail
statement:
theorem quadratic_ball_abs_integral_le_tail (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c R : ℝ) (x : Space (n + 1)) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) (hRx : R < ‖x‖) :
    |∫ y in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)| ≤
      (1 / (c * (‖x‖ - R))) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space n) R)
proof:
:= by
  let e := finSuccOptionIsometry n
  rw [radial_ball_integral_isometry (Space (n + 1)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n)))
    e g c R x]
  have hnorm : ‖e x‖ = ‖optionAxisPoint n ‖x‖‖ := by
    rw [e.norm_map, optionAxisPoint_norm, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)]
  rw [radial_ball_integral_eq_of_norm_eq (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n))) g c R
    (e x) (optionAxisPoint n ‖x‖) hnorm]
  exact euclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_tail n g hg hgm hmean hbound c ‖x‖ R hc hR hRx

name: SVW.ball_volume_real_pos
statement:
theorem ball_volume_real_pos (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    0 < volume.real (Metric.ball x R)
proof:
:= by
  exact ENNReal.toReal_pos (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume x hR).ne' measure_ball_ne_top

name: SVW.unitBallVolume_pos
statement: theorem unitBallVolume_pos (d : ℕ) : 0 < unitBallVolume d
proof:
:=
  ball_volume_real_pos d 0 1 (by norm_num)

name: SVW.sliceVolumeRatio_pos
statement: theorem sliceVolumeRatio_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < sliceVolumeRatio n
proof:
:=
  div_pos (unitBallVolume_pos n) (unitBallVolume_pos (n + 1))

name: SVW.ball_volume_real_scaling
statement:
theorem ball_volume_real_scaling (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball x R) = R ^ d * unitBallVolume d
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitBallVolume
  simp only [Measure.real]
  rw [Measure.addHaar_ball_of_pos volume x hR, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hR.le d)]

name: SVW.transverse_ball_volume_ratio
statement:
theorem transverse_ball_volume_ratio (n : ℕ) (x : Space (n + 1)) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space n) R) / volume.real (Metric.ball x R) =
      sliceVolumeRatio n / R
proof:
:= by
  rw [ball_volume_real_scaling n 0 R hR, ball_volume_real_scaling (n + 1) x R hR]
  unfold sliceVolumeRatio
  have hR' : R ≠ 0 := hR.ne'
  have hv : unitBallVolume (n + 1) ≠ 0 := (unitBallVolume_pos (n + 1)).ne'
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: SVW.quadratic_ball_normalized_crude
statement:
theorem quadratic_ball_normalized_crude (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c R : ℝ) (x : Space (n + 1)) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) :
    |∫ y in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)| / volume.real (Metric.ball x R) ≤
      4 * sliceVolumeRatio n / (R * Real.sqrt c)
proof:
:= by
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (quadratic_ball_abs_integral_le_crude n g hg hgm hmean hbound c R x hc hR)
    (ball_volume_real_pos (n + 1) x R hR).le
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  rw [mul_div_assoc, transverse_ball_volume_ratio n x R hR]
  ring

name: SVW.quadratic_ball_normalized_tail
statement:
theorem quadratic_ball_normalized_tail (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c R : ℝ) (x : Space (n + 1)) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) (hRx : R < ‖x‖) :
    |∫ y in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)| / volume.real (Metric.ball x R) ≤
      sliceVolumeRatio n / (c * R * (‖x‖ - R))
proof:
:= by
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (quadratic_ball_abs_integral_le_tail n g hg hgm hmean hbound c R x hc hR hRx)
    (ball_volume_real_pos (n + 1) x R hR).le
  refine h.trans_eq ?_
  rw [mul_div_assoc, transverse_ball_volume_ratio n x R hR]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  ring

name: SVW.quadraticError_nonneg
statement:
theorem quadraticError_nonneg (n : ℕ) (κ c : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    0 ≤ quadraticError n κ c
proof:
:= by
  have hγ := (sliceVolumeRatio_pos n).le
  unfold quadraticError
  positivity

name: SVW.reciprocalRadius_inv_le_near
statement:
theorem reciprocalRadius_inv_le_near (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (x : Space d) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 2) : (reciprocalRadius κ x)⁻¹ ≤ 1 + 2 / κ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · rw [hx0, reciprocalRadius_zero, inv_one]
    have hp : 0 ≤ 2 / κ := by positivity
    linarith
  · by_cases hratio : 1 ≤ κ / ‖x‖
    · have hr : reciprocalRadius κ x = 1 := by
        simp only [reciprocalRadius, if_neg hx0, min_eq_left hratio]
      rw [hr, inv_one]
      have hp : 0 ≤ 2 / κ := by positivity
      linarith
    · have hr : reciprocalRadius κ x = κ / ‖x‖ := by
        simp only [reciprocalRadius, if_neg hx0, min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hratio)]
      rw [hr, inv_div]
      exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hx hκ.le).trans (by linarith)

name: SVW.reciprocalRadius_mul_norm_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem reciprocalRadius_mul_norm_of_ne_one (d : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (x : Space d)
    (hR : reciprocalRadius κ x ≠ 1) : reciprocalRadius κ x * ‖x‖ = κ
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    apply hR
    rw [hx, reciprocalRadius_zero]
  have hratio : κ / ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hh
    have hr : reciprocalRadius κ x = 1 := by
      simp only [reciprocalRadius, if_neg hx0, min_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hh)]
    exact hR hr
  rw [reciprocalRadius, if_neg hx0, min_eq_right hratio]
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ κ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx0)

name: SVW.quadratic_testingBall_normalized
statement:
theorem quadratic_testingBall_normalized (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (κ c : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hc : 0 < c) (x : Space (n + 1)) :
    |∫ y in testingBall (n + 1) κ x, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)| /
      volume.real (testingBall (n + 1) κ x) ≤ quadraticError n κ c
proof:
:= by
  let R : ℝ := reciprocalRadius κ x
  have hR : 0 < R := reciprocalRadius_pos (Space (n + 1)) κ hκ x
  have hR1 : R ≤ 1 := reciprocalRadius_le_one (Space (n + 1)) κ x
  have hγ : 0 ≤ sliceVolumeRatio n := (sliceVolumeRatio_pos n).le
  change |∫ y in Metric.ball x R, g (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)| /
    volume.real (Metric.ball x R) ≤ quadraticError n κ c
  by_cases hnear : R = 1 ∨ ‖x‖ ≤ 2
  · have hinv : R⁻¹ ≤ 1 + 2 / κ := by
      rcases hnear with hunit | hx
      · rw [hunit, inv_one]
        have hp : 0 ≤ 2 / κ := by positivity
        linarith
      · exact reciprocalRadius_inv_le_near (n + 1) κ hκ x hx
    have hb := quadratic_ball_normalized_crude n g hg hgm hmean hbound c R x hc hR
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ 4 * sliceVolumeRatio n / Real.sqrt c := by positivity
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv hcoef
    have hsmall : 4 * sliceVolumeRatio n / (R * Real.sqrt c) ≤
        (4 * sliceVolumeRatio n / Real.sqrt c) * (1 + 2 / κ) := by
      calc
        _ = (4 * sliceVolumeRatio n / Real.sqrt c) * R⁻¹ := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hmul
    have htail : 0 ≤ 2 * sliceVolumeRatio n / (c * κ) := by positivity
    unfold quadraticError
    exact (hb.trans hsmall).trans (by linarith)
  · have hunit : R ≠ 1 := fun h => hnear (Or.inl h)
    have hfar : 2 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hnear (Or.inr h))
    have hRx : R < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hprod : R * ‖x‖ = κ := reciprocalRadius_mul_norm_of_ne_one (n + 1) κ x hunit
    have hden : κ / 2 ≤ R * (‖x‖ - R) := by
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖x‖ - R by linarith) hR.le
      nlinarith
    have hden' : c * (κ / 2) ≤ c * R * (‖x‖ - R) := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hden hc.le
    have hb := quadratic_ball_normalized_tail n g hg hgm hmean hbound c R x hc hR hRx
    have hfrac := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hγ (mul_pos hc (half_pos hκ)) hden'
    have heq : sliceVolumeRatio n / (c * (κ / 2)) = 2 * sliceVolumeRatio n / (c * κ) := by ring
    have hsmall := hb.trans (hfrac.trans_eq heq)
    have hcrude : 0 ≤ (4 * sliceVolumeRatio n / Real.sqrt c) * (1 + 2 / κ) := by positivity
    unfold quadraticError
    exact hsmall.trans (by linarith)

name: SVW.circle_volume_bounds
statement:
theorem circle_volume_bounds (A : Set UnitAddCircle) :
    0 ≤ volume.real A ∧ volume.real A ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨measureReal_nonneg, ?_⟩
  have h := measureReal_mono (μ := (volume : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (Set.subset_univ A)
  simpa only [Measure.real, UnitAddCircle.measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one] using h

name: SVW.circleCenteredIndicator_periodic
statement:
theorem circleCenteredIndicator_periodic (A : Set UnitAddCircle) :
    Function.Periodic (circleCenteredIndicator A) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  simp only [circleCenteredIndicator, AddCircle.coe_add_period]

name: SVW.circleCenteredIndicator_measurable
statement:
theorem circleCenteredIndicator_measurable (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    Measurable (circleCenteredIndicator A)
proof:
:=
  ((measurable_const.indicator hA).comp AddCircle.measurable_mk').sub measurable_const

name: SVW.circleCenteredIndicator_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem circleCenteredIndicator_abs_le_one (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (s : ℝ) :
    |circleCenteredIndicator A s| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hα := circle_volume_bounds A
  by_cases hs : (s : UnitAddCircle) ∈ A
  · rw [circleCenteredIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hs]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rw [circleCenteredIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hs]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: SVW.circleCenteredIndicator_mean_zero
statement:
theorem circleCenteredIndicator_mean_zero (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, circleCenteredIndicator A s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (fun z : UnitAddCircle => A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - volume.real A) s) = 0
  have hpre := UnitAddCircle.intervalIntegral_preimage 0
    (fun z : UnitAddCircle => A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - volume.real A)
  simp only [zero_add] at hpre
  rw [hpre]
  rw [integral_sub ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator hA) (integrable_const _)]
  rw [integral_indicator_const (μ := (volume : Measure UnitAddCircle)) (1 : ℝ) hA, integral_const]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Measure.real, UnitAddCircle.measure_univ,
    ENNReal.toReal_one, one_mul, sub_self]

name: SVW.quadraticSet_measurable
statement:
theorem quadraticSet_measurable (d : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (A : Set UnitAddCircle)
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) : MeasurableSet (quadraticSet d c A)
proof:
:= by
  exact hA.preimage (AddCircle.measurable_mk'.comp (by fun_prop))

name: SVW.quadraticSet_radial
statement:
theorem quadraticSet_radial (d : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (A : Set UnitAddCircle) :
    Radial d (quadraticSet d c A)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  simp only [quadraticSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hxy]

name: SVW.quadraticSet_volume_discrepancy
statement:
theorem quadraticSet_volume_discrepancy (d : ℕ) (c R : ℝ) (x : Space d)
    (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (∫ y in Metric.ball x R, circleCenteredIndicator A (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) =
      volume.real (quadraticSet d c A ∩ Metric.ball x R) -
        volume.real A * volume.real (Metric.ball x R)
proof:
:= by
  have hE := quadraticSet_measurable d c A hA
  have hf : (fun y : Space d => circleCenteredIndicator A (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) =
      (fun y => (quadraticSet d c A).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y - volume.real A) := by
    funext y
    by_cases hy : ((c * ‖y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) ∈ A
    · simp [circleCenteredIndicator, quadraticSet, Set.indicator, hy]
    · simp [circleCenteredIndicator, quadraticSet, Set.indicator, hy]
  have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ)) (Metric.ball x R) volume :=
    integrableOn_const measure_ball_ne_top
  have hα : IntegrableOn (fun _ : Space d => volume.real A) (Metric.ball x R) volume :=
    integrableOn_const measure_ball_ne_top
  rw [hf, integral_sub (h1.indicator hE) hα]
  rw [setIntegral_indicator hE]
  simp only [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Set.inter_comm]
  ring

name: SVW.quadraticSet_wolffThin
statement:
theorem quadraticSet_wolffThin (n : ℕ) (κ c : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    WolffThin (n + 1) κ (volume.real A + quadraticError n κ c)
      (quadraticSet (n + 1) c A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(quadraticSet_measurable (n + 1) c A hA).nullMeasurableSet, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h := quadratic_testingBall_normalized n (circleCenteredIndicator A)
    (circleCenteredIndicator_periodic A) (circleCenteredIndicator_measurable A hA)
    (circleCenteredIndicator_mean_zero A hA) (circleCenteredIndicator_abs_le_one A) κ c hκ hc x
  have hv : 0 < volume.real (testingBall (n + 1) κ x) :=
    ball_volume_real_pos (n + 1) x _ (reciprocalRadius_pos _ κ hκ x)
  have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hv).mp h
  have hle := (le_abs_self (∫ y in testingBall (n + 1) κ x,
    circleCenteredIndicator A (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2))).trans hmul
  change (∫ y in Metric.ball x (reciprocalRadius κ x),
    circleCenteredIndicator A (c * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) ≤ _ at hle
  rw [quadraticSet_volume_discrepancy (n + 1) c _ x A hA] at hle
  change volume.real (quadraticSet (n + 1) c A ∩ Metric.ball x (reciprocalRadius κ x)) ≤ _
  dsimp only [testingBall] at *
  nlinarith

name: SVW.quadraticError_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem quadraticError_tendsto_zero (n : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (quadraticError n κ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => quadraticError n κ c) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  have hs : Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop
  have hi : Filter.Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => c⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero
  have hsum := ((hs.const_mul (4 * sliceVolumeRatio n)).mul_const (1 + 2 / κ)).add
    (hi.const_mul (2 * sliceVolumeRatio n / κ))
  simpa only [quadraticError, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add,
    mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hsum

name: SVW.quadraticError_nat_half_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem quadraticError_nat_half_tendsto_zero (n : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => quadraticError n κ ((m : ℝ) / 2))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) / 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
      Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (show (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num)
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  exact (quadraticError_tendsto_zero n κ).comp hm

name: SVW.quadraticSet_eventually_wolffThin
statement:
theorem quadraticSet_eventually_wolffThin (n : ℕ) (κ δ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop, WolffThin (n + 1) κ (volume.real A + δ)
      (quadraticSet (n + 1) ((m : ℝ) / 2) A)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (quadraticError_nat_half_tendsto_zero n κ).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ)
  filter_upwards [he, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with m hm hm0
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
  exact wolffThin_mono (n + 1) κ _ _ _
    (quadraticSet_wolffThin n κ _ hκ hc A hA) (by linarith)

name: SVW.quadraticSet_wolffThin_of_dimension_pos
statement:
theorem quadraticSet_wolffThin_of_dimension_pos (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (κ c : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hc : 0 < c) (A : Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    WolffThin d κ (volume.real A + quadraticError (d - 1) κ c) (quadraticSet d c A)
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
    simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel_right] using
      quadraticSet_wolffThin n κ c hκ hc A hA

name: SVW.circleArc_measurable
statement: theorem circleArc_measurable (α : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (circleArc α)
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_closedBall

name: SVW.circleArc_volume_real
statement:
theorem circleArc_volume_real (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    volume.real (circleArc α) = α
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleArc Measure.real
  rw [AddCircle.volume_closedBall]
  rw [show 2 * (α / 2) = α by ring, min_eq_right hα1, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hα0]

name: SVW.quadraticArc_eventually_wolffThin
statement:
theorem quadraticArc_eventually_wolffThin (n : ℕ) (κ α ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hαε : α < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop, WolffThin (n + 1) κ ε
      (quadraticSet (n + 1) ((m : ℝ) / 2) (circleArc α))
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadraticSet_eventually_wolffThin n κ (ε - α) hκ (sub_pos.mpr hαε)
    (circleArc α) (circleArc_measurable α)
  have he : α + (ε - α) = ε := by ring
  simpa only [circleArc_volume_real α hα0 hα1, he] using h

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_measurable
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_measurable (n : ℕ) (r R : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (quadraticProductBall n r R)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n => (x.1 - r) ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2) :=
    by fun_prop
  exact (isOpen_lt hc continuous_const).measurableSet

name: SVW.splitEuclidean_norm_sq
statement:
theorem splitEuclidean_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : SplitEuclideanSpace n)‖ ^ 2 = x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  simp only [WithLp.toLp_fst, WithLp.toLp_snd, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: SVW.splitEuclidean_sub_norm_sq
statement:
theorem splitEuclidean_sub_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n) (r : ℝ) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : SplitEuclideanSpace n) - WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0)‖ ^ 2 =
      (x.1 - r) ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  simp only [WithLp.sub_fst, WithLp.sub_snd, WithLp.toLp_fst, WithLp.toLp_snd,
    sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_eq_preimage (n : ℕ) (r R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    quadraticProductBall n r R =
      (WithLp.toLp 2 : (ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n) → SplitEuclideanSpace n) ⁻¹'
        Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0)) R
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [quadraticProductBall, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball,
    dist_eq_norm]
  have hs := splitEuclidean_sub_norm_sq n x r
  have hn := norm_nonneg ((WithLp.toLp 2 x : SplitEuclideanSpace n) - WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0))
  constructor <;> intro hx <;> nlinarith

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_volume_lt_top
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_volume_lt_top (n : ℕ) (r R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    volume (quadraticProductBall n r R) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticProductBall_eq_preimage n r R hR,
    (WithLp.volume_preserving_toLp ℝ (OrthogonalCoordinates n)).measure_preimage
      measurableSet_ball.nullMeasurableSet]
  exact measure_ball_lt_top

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_section
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_section (n : ℕ) (r R u : ℝ) (v : OrthogonalCoordinates n) :
    (u, v) ∈ quadraticProductBall n r R ↔
      u ∈ Set.Ioo (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v) (r + sliceHalfWidth n R v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quadraticProductBall, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ioo, sliceHalfWidth]
  have h := Real.sq_lt (x := u - r) (y := R ^ 2 - ‖v‖ ^ 2)
  constructor
  · intro hu
    have hh := h.mp (by linarith)
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro hu
    have hh : -(Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - ‖v‖ ^ 2)) < u - r ∧
        u - r < Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by constructor <;> linarith
    have hh' := h.mpr hh
    linarith

name: SVW.sliceHalfWidth_nonneg
statement:
theorem sliceHalfWidth_nonneg (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (v : OrthogonalCoordinates n) :
    0 ≤ sliceHalfWidth n R v
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: SVW.sliceHalfWidth_le_radius
statement:
theorem sliceHalfWidth_le_radius (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (v : OrthogonalCoordinates n) : sliceHalfWidth n R v ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  unfold sliceHalfWidth
  calc
    Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - ‖v‖ ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (R ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖v‖])
    _ = R := Real.sqrt_sq hR

name: SVW.sliceHalfWidth_eq_zero_outside
statement:
theorem sliceHalfWidth_eq_zero_outside (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (v : OrthogonalCoordinates n) (hv : v ∉ Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R) :
    sliceHalfWidth n R v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv' : R ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, not_lt] using hv
  unfold sliceHalfWidth
  apply Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos
  have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ hR.le (norm_nonneg v)).mpr hv'
  linarith

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_integrable
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_integrable (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (c r R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n => g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2)))
      (quadraticProductBall n r R) volume
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.of_bound (quadraticProductBall_volume_lt_top n r R hR)
    (f := fun x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n => g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))) ?_ 1 ?_
  · exact (hgm.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2)))

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_inner_integral
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_inner_integral (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c r R : ℝ)
    (v : OrthogonalCoordinates n) :
    (∫ u : ℝ, (quadraticProductBall n r R).indicator
      (fun x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n => g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))) (u, v)) =
      ∫ u in (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v)..(r + sliceHalfWidth n R v),
        g (c * u ^ 2 + c * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun u : ℝ => (quadraticProductBall n r R).indicator
      (fun x : ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n => g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))) (u, v)) =
      (Set.Ioo (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v) (r + sliceHalfWidth n R v)).indicator
        (fun u : ℝ => g (c * u ^ 2 + c * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) := by
    funext u
    by_cases hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v) (r + sliceHalfWidth n R v)
    · have hx := (quadraticProductBall_section n r R u v).mpr hu
      simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hu]
      congr 1
      ring
    · have hx : (u, v) ∉ quadraticProductBall n r R :=
        fun hx => hu ((quadraticProductBall_section n r R u v).mp hx)
      simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hu]
  rw [heq, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo, ← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith [sliceHalfWidth_nonneg n R v])]

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_integral_slicing
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_integral_slicing (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (c r R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in quadraticProductBall n r R, g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))) =
      ∫ v in Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R,
        ∫ u in (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v)..(r + sliceHalfWidth n R v),
          g (c * u ^ 2 + c * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_indicator (quadraticProductBall_measurable n r R)]
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ (OrthogonalCoordinates n)]
  rw [integral_prod_symm _
    ((quadraticProductBall_integrable n g hgm hbound c r R hR).integrable_indicator
      (quadraticProductBall_measurable n r R))]
  simp_rw [quadraticProductBall_inner_integral]
  symm
  apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
  intro v hv
  rw [sliceHalfWidth_eq_zero_outside n R hR v hv, sub_zero, add_zero,
    intervalIntegral.integral_same]

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_abs_integral_le_crude
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_abs_integral_le_crude (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) :
    |∫ x in quadraticProductBall n r R, g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))| ≤
      (4 / Real.sqrt c) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticProductBall_integral_slicing n g hgm hbound c r R hR]
  have hs : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R,
      ‖∫ u in (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v)..(r + sliceHalfWidth n R v),
        g (c * u ^ 2 + c * ‖v‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt c := by
    intro v _
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      quadratic_integral_abs_le_four_div_sqrt g hg hgm hmean hbound (c * ‖v‖ ^ 2) c
        (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v) (r + sliceHalfWidth n R v) hc
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const measure_ball_lt_top hs

name: SVW.quadraticProductBall_abs_integral_le_tail
statement:
theorem quadraticProductBall_abs_integral_le_tail (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) (hRr : R < r) :
    |∫ x in quadraticProductBall n r R, g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))| ≤
      (1 / (c * (r - R))) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticProductBall_integral_slicing n g hgm hbound c r R hR]
  have hi := intervalIntegrable_of_measurable_abs_le_one g hgm hbound 0 1
  have hs : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R,
      ‖∫ u in (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v)..(r + sliceHalfWidth n R v),
        g (c * u ^ 2 + c * ‖v‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ 1 / (c * (r - R)) := by
    intro v _
    have hwidth := sliceHalfWidth_le_radius n R hR.le v
    have ha : 0 < r - sliceHalfWidth n R v := by linarith
    have hab : r - sliceHalfWidth n R v ≤ r + sliceHalfWidth n R v := by
      linarith [sliceHalfWidth_nonneg n R v]
    have hslice := quadratic_tail_abs_le g hg hi hmean hbound (c * ‖v‖ ^ 2) c
      (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v) (r + sliceHalfWidth n R v) hc ha hab
    have hden : c * (r - R) ≤ c * (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hc.le
    have hinv := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (mul_pos hc (sub_pos.mpr hRr)) hden
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hslice.trans hinv
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const measure_ball_lt_top hs

name: SVW.splitEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_product
statement:
theorem splitEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_product (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0) : SplitEuclideanSpace n) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫ x in quadraticProductBall n r R, g (c * (x.1 ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (WithLp.volume_preserving_toLp ℝ (OrthogonalCoordinates n)).setIntegral_preimage_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (ℝ × OrthogonalCoordinates n)).measurableEmbedding
    (fun x : SplitEuclideanSpace n => g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2))
    (Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0)) R)
  rw [← quadraticProductBall_eq_preimage n r R hR] at h
  simpa only [splitEuclidean_norm_sq] using h.symm

name: SVW.splitEuclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_crude
statement:
theorem splitEuclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_crude (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) :
    |∫ x in Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0) : SplitEuclideanSpace n) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)| ≤
      (4 / Real.sqrt c) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_product n g c r R hR]
  exact quadraticProductBall_abs_integral_le_crude n g hg hgm hmean hbound c r R hc hR

name: SVW.splitEuclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_tail
statement:
theorem splitEuclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_tail (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) (hRr : R < r) :
    |∫ x in Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0) : SplitEuclideanSpace n) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)| ≤
      (1 / (c * (r - R))) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_product n g c r R hR]
  exact quadraticProductBall_abs_integral_le_tail n g hg hgm hmean hbound c r R hc hR hRr

name: SVW.optionSplitLinearEquiv_fst
statement:
theorem optionSplitLinearEquiv_fst (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n))) :
    (optionSplitLinearEquiv n x).fst = x none
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.optionSplitLinearEquiv_snd
statement:
theorem optionSplitLinearEquiv_snd (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n))) :
    (optionSplitLinearEquiv n x).snd = WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin n => x (some i))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.optionSplitIsometry_axis
statement:
theorem optionSplitIsometry_axis (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    optionSplitIsometry n (optionAxisPoint n r) = WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.optionEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_split
statement:
theorem optionEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_split (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (c r R : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in Metric.ball (optionAxisPoint n r) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0) : SplitEuclideanSpace n) R,
        g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let e := optionSplitIsometry n
  have hpre : e ⁻¹' Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0) : SplitEuclideanSpace n) R =
      Metric.ball (optionAxisPoint n r) R := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball]
    rw [← optionSplitIsometry_axis n r]
    exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t < R) (e.dist_map x (optionAxisPoint n r)))
  have h := e.measurePreserving.setIntegral_preimage_emb e.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding
    (fun x : SplitEuclideanSpace n => g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2))
    (Metric.ball (WithLp.toLp 2 (r, 0)) R)
  rw [hpre] at h
  simpa only [e.norm_map] using h

name: SVW.euclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_crude
statement:
theorem euclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_crude (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) :
    |∫ x in Metric.ball (optionAxisPoint n r) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)| ≤
      (4 / Real.sqrt c) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [optionEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_split n g c r R]
  exact splitEuclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_crude n g hg hgm hmean hbound c r R hc hR

name: SVW.euclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_tail
statement:
theorem euclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_tail (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : Function.Periodic g 1) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hmean : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g s) = 0) (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1)
    (c r R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < R) (hRr : R < r) :
    |∫ x in Metric.ball (optionAxisPoint n r) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)| ≤
      (1 / (c * (r - R))) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [optionEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_split n g c r R]
  exact splitEuclidean_ball_abs_integral_le_tail n g hg hgm hmean hbound c r R hc hR hRr

name: SVW.optionEuclidean_finrank
statement:
theorem optionEuclidean_finrank (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin n))) = n + 1
proof: := by simp

name: SVW.optionAxisPoint_norm
statement: theorem optionAxisPoint_norm (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ‖optionAxisPoint n r‖ = |r|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (optionSplitIsometry n).norm_map (optionAxisPoint n r), optionSplitIsometry_axis]
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using WithLp.norm_toLp_fst 2 ℝ (OrthogonalCoordinates n) r

name: SVW.euclidean_ball_integral_slicing
statement:
theorem euclidean_ball_integral_slicing (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℝ, |g s| ≤ 1) (c r R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in Metric.ball (optionAxisPoint n r) R, g (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫ v in Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates n) R,
        ∫ u in (r - sliceHalfWidth n R v)..(r + sliceHalfWidth n R v),
          g (c * u ^ 2 + c * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [optionEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_split n g c r R,
    splitEuclidean_ball_integral_eq_product n g c r R hR]
  exact quadraticProductBall_integral_slicing n g hgm hbound c r R hR

name: SVW.zeroDimensional_ball_volume
statement:
theorem zeroDimensional_ball_volume (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : OrthogonalCoordinates 0) R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (volume (Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0)) R)).toReal = 1
  rw [volume_euclideanSpace_eq_dirac (Fin 0)]
  simp [hR]

name: SVW.gaussianCayley_gap
statement:
theorem gaussianCayley_gap (s : ℂ) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    1-‖1-1/s‖^2 = (2*s.re-1)/‖s‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖s‖^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hs)
  have he : (1-1/s : ℂ) = (s-1)/s := by field_simp
  rw [he, norm_div, div_pow]
  rw [sub_div' hn, one_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re,
    Complex.sub_im, Complex.one_im, sub_zero]
  ring

name: SVW.gaussianCayley_norm_lt_one
statement: theorem gaussianCayley_norm_lt_one (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) : ‖1-1/s‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hs; linarith
  have hg : 0 < 1-‖1-1/s‖^2 := by
    rw [gaussianCayley_gap s hs0]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hs0) _)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1-1/s)]

name: SVW.gaussianCayley_power_normalization
statement:
theorem gaussianCayley_power_normalization (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) (p : ℝ) :
    ‖(1/s)^(p : ℂ)‖^2 / (1-‖1-1/s‖^2)^p = (1/(2*s.re-1))^p
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hs; linarith
  have hgap : 0 < 1-‖1-1/s‖^2 := by
    have h := gaussianCayley_norm_lt_one s hs
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1-1/s)]
  have he : ‖(1/s)^(p : ℂ)‖^2 = (‖1/s‖^2)^p := by
    rw [Complex.norm_cpow_real]
    rw [← rpow_natCast (‖1/s‖^p) 2, ← rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _),
      ← rpow_natCast ‖1/s‖ 2, ← rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he, ← div_rpow (sq_nonneg _) hgap.le]
  congr 1
  rw [gaussianCayley_gap s hs0, norm_div, norm_one, div_pow, one_pow]
  have hn : ‖s‖^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hs0)
  field_simp

name: SVW.gaussianDifferenceQuotient_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianDifferenceQuotient_nonneg (h u : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    0 ≤ gaussianDifferenceQuotient h u
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianDifferenceQuotient
  apply div_nonneg _ hh.le
  have he : exp (-h*u) ≤ 1 := (exp_le_one_iff).mpr (by nlinarith)
  linarith

name: SVW.gaussianDifferenceQuotient_le
statement:
theorem gaussianDifferenceQuotient_le (h u : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    gaussianDifferenceQuotient h u ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianDifferenceQuotient, div_le_iff₀ hh]
  have he := add_one_le_exp (-h*u)
  nlinarith

name: SVW.gaussianDifferenceQuotient_tendsto
statement:
theorem gaussianDifferenceQuotient_tendsto (u : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => gaussianDifferenceQuotient h u) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds u)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).const_mul (-u)).exp).const_sub 1
  have ht := he.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  simpa [gaussianDifferenceQuotient, id_eq, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using ht

name: SVW.continuous_hermiteDifferenceFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_hermiteDifferenceFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    Continuous (hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermiteDifferenceFunction gaussianDifferenceQuotient
  exact (show Continuous (fun x : Space d => ((1-exp (-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2)))/h)^n) by fun_prop).smul
    (continuous_firstHermiteFunction d i)

name: SVW.hermiteDifferenceFunction_norm_le
statement:
theorem hermiteDifferenceFunction_norm_le (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (x : Space d) :
    ‖hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n h x‖ ≤
      ‖hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 ≤ 2*π*‖x‖^2 := by positivity
  simp only [hermiteDifferenceFunction, hermitePolynomialFunction, norm_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_real, eval_pow, eval_X]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (gaussianDifferenceQuotient_nonneg h _ hh hu) _),
    abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg hu _)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (gaussianDifferenceQuotient_nonneg h _ hh hu)
      (gaussianDifferenceQuotient_le h _ hh) n) (norm_nonneg _)

name: SVW.memLp_hermiteDifferenceFunction
statement:
theorem memLp_hermiteDifferenceFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) : MemLp (hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n h) 2 volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n)).mono
    (continuous_hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n h).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all _ (hermiteDifferenceFunction_norm_le d i n h hh)

name: SVW.hermiteDifferenceVector_coe
statement:
theorem hermiteDifferenceVector_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    (hermiteDifferenceVector d i n h hh : Space d → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
      hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n h
proof: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.hermiteDifferenceFunction_shift
statement:
theorem hermiteDifferenceFunction_shift (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (h : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (x : Space d) :
    ((exp (-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2)))^k : ℝ) • firstHermiteFunction d i x =
      (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        hermiteGaussian d i ((π+2*π*h*k : ℝ) : ℂ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hg : hermiteGaussian d i ((π+2*π*h*k : ℝ) : ℂ) x =
      ((x i * exp (-(π+2*π*h*k)*‖x‖^2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp [hermiteGaussian, complexGaussian, Complex.ofReal_exp]
  rw [hg, ← exp_nat_mul, firstHermiteFunction_formula]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  congr 1
  have he : exp ((k : ℝ)*(-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2))) * exp (-π*‖x‖^2) =
      exp (-(π+2*π*h*k)*‖x‖^2) := by
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  calc
    _ = (2^((d : ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π) * x i *
      (exp ((k : ℝ)*(-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2))) * exp (-π*‖x‖^2)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he]; ring

name: SVW.hermiteDifferenceFunction_sum
statement:
theorem hermiteDifferenceFunction_sum (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n h x =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        (((1/h)^n*(-1)^k*(n.choose k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          ((((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ) •
            hermiteGaussian d i ((π+2*π*h*k : ℝ) : ℂ) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteDifferenceFunction, gaussianDifferenceQuotient, div_pow]
  have hh := add_pow (-exp (-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2))) (1 : ℝ) n
  simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at hh
  rw [show 1-exp (-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2)) = -exp (-h*(2*π*‖x‖^2))+1 by ring, hh]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hs := hermiteDifferenceFunction_shift d i h k x
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hs
  rw [← hs, neg_pow, Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  simp only [one_mul, inv_pow]
  ring

name: SVW.hermiteDifferenceVector_mem_span
statement:
theorem hermiteDifferenceVector_mem_span (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) : hermiteDifferenceVector d i n h hh ∈ hermiteGaussianSpan d i
proof:
:= by
  have hp (k : ℕ) : 0 < (((π+2*π*h*k : ℝ) : ℂ).re) := by
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
    positivity
  let c : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => (((1/h)^n*(-1)^k*(n.choose k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let v : ℕ → Hilbert d := fun k => c k • hermiteGaussianVector d i _ (hp k)
  have hc (k : ℕ) : (v k : Space d → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x => c k • hermiteGaussian d i ((π+2*π*h*k : ℝ) : ℂ) x := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (c k) (hermiteGaussianVector d i _ (hp k)),
      hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i _ (hp k)] with x hx hy
    change (c k • hermiteGaussianVector d i _ (hp k)) x = _
