    rw [hx, Pi.smul_apply, hy]
  have he : hermiteDifferenceVector d i n h hh = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), v k := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hermiteDifferenceVector_coe d i n h hh,
      Lp.coeFn_finsetSum (Finset.range (n+1)) v, ae_all_iff.mpr hc] with x hx hy hz
    rw [hx, hy, Finset.sum_apply, hermiteDifferenceFunction_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [hz k]
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [smul_smul]
  rw [he]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro k hk
  exact (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).smul_mem (c k) (hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span d i _ (hp k))

name: SVW.hermiteDifferenceVector_tendsto
statement:
theorem hermiteDifferenceVector_tendsto (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => hermiteDifferenceVector d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) (by positivity))
      atTop (nhds (hermitePolynomialVector d i (X^n)))
proof:
:= by
  let B : Space d → ℝ := fun x => 4*‖hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖^2
  have hB : Integrable B volume :=
    ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
      (continuous_hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n)).aestronglyMeasurable).mp
        (memLp_hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n))).const_mul 4
  have ht : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 1/((m : ℝ)+1)) atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat,
      Eventually.of_forall (fun m => by change 0 < 1/((m : ℝ)+1); positivity)⟩
  have hpoint (x : Space d) : Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ => ‖hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x -
        hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖^2) atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hq := ((gaussianDifferenceQuotient_tendsto (2*π*‖x‖^2)).comp ht).pow n
    have hv := (hq.smul_const (firstHermiteFunction d i x)).sub
      (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (2*π*‖x‖^2)^n • firstHermiteFunction d i x))
    change Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x -
      (2*π*‖x‖^2)^n • firstHermiteFunction d i x) atTop (nhds (_-_)) at hv
    simpa only [hermitePolynomialFunction, eval_pow, eval_X, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)] using hv.norm.pow 2
  have hb (m : ℕ) (x : Space d) :
      ‖‖hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x -
        hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖^2‖ ≤ B x := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    have h := hermiteDifferenceFunction_norm_le d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) (by positivity) x
    have hs := norm_sub_le (hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x)
      (hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x)
    have hn : ‖hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x -
        hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖ ≤ 2*‖hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖ := by linarith
    have hh := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*‖hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖)).mpr hn
    dsimp [B]
    nlinarith
  have hi := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence B
    (Eventually.of_forall fun m : ℕ => (((continuous_hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1))).sub
      (continuous_hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n))).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun m : ℕ => ae_of_all _ (hb m)) hB (ae_of_all _ hpoint)
  have he (m : ℕ) :
      ‖hermiteDifferenceVector d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) (by positivity) - hermitePolynomialVector d i (X^n)‖^2 =
        ∫ x : Space d, ‖hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x -
          hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖^2 := by
    rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (hermiteDifferenceVector d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) (by positivity))
      (hermitePolynomialVector d i (X^n)), hermiteDifferenceVector_coe d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) (by positivity),
      hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i (X^n)] with x hx hy hz
    rw [hx, Pi.sub_apply, hy, hz]
  change Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∫ x : Space d,
    ‖hermiteDifferenceFunction d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) x -
      hermitePolynomialFunction d i (X^n) x‖^2) atTop (nhds (∫ _x : Space d, (0 : ℝ))) at hi
  simp only [← he, integral_zero] at hi
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  simpa only [sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), sqrt_zero] using hi.sqrt

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialVector_monomial_mem_sector
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialVector_monomial_mem_sector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) :
    hermitePolynomialVector d i (X^n) ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:=
  (hermiteGaussianSector_isClosed d i).mem_of_tendsto (hermiteDifferenceVector_tendsto d i n)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun m => (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).le_topologicalClosure
      (hermiteDifferenceVector_mem_span d i n (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) (by positivity)))

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialVector_add
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialVector_add (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    hermitePolynomialVector d i (p+q) = hermitePolynomialVector d i p + hermitePolynomialVector d i q
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i (p+q),
    hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i p, hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i q,
    Lp.coeFn_add (hermitePolynomialVector d i p) (hermitePolynomialVector d i q)] with x hp hq hr hs
  rw [hp, hs, Pi.add_apply, hq, hr]
  simp only [hermitePolynomialFunction, eval_add, Complex.ofReal_add, add_smul]

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialVector_monomial
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialVector_monomial (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    hermitePolynomialVector d i (monomial n c) = (c : ℂ) • hermitePolynomialVector d i (X^n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i (monomial n c),
    hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i (X^n),
    Lp.coeFn_smul (c : ℂ) (hermitePolynomialVector d i (X^n))] with x hp hq hr
  rw [hp, hr, Pi.smul_apply, hq]
  simp only [hermitePolynomialFunction, eval_monomial, eval_pow, eval_X, Complex.ofReal_mul,
    smul_smul]

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialVector_mem_sector
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialVector_mem_sector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    hermitePolynomialVector d i p ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [hermitePolynomialVector_add]
    exact (hermiteGaussianSector d i).add_mem hp hq
  | monomial n c =>
    rw [hermitePolynomialVector_monomial]
    exact (hermiteGaussianSector d i).smul_mem _ (hermitePolynomialVector_monomial_mem_sector d i n)

name: SVW.laguerreVector_mem_gaussianSector
statement:
theorem laguerreVector_mem_gaussianSector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n : ℕ) :
    laguerreVector d i n ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:=
  (hermiteGaussianSector d i).smul_mem _ (hermitePolynomialVector_mem_sector d i _)

name: SVW.laguerreSector_le_gaussianSector
statement:
theorem laguerreSector_le_gaussianSector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    laguerreSector d i ≤ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact laguerreVector_mem_gaussianSector d i n
  · exact hermiteGaussianSector_isClosed d i

name: SVW.integrable_coordinate_radial_of_integrable
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_radial_of_integrable (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : Integrable (fun x : Space d => (‖x‖^2 : ℝ) • F (‖x‖^2)) volume)
    (hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 • F (‖x‖^2)) volume) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 • F (‖x‖^2)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply hF.norm.mono' hm
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg _)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (x i)) (norm_nonneg x)).mpr (PiLp.norm_apply_le x i)

name: SVW.integral_coordinate_radial_eq
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_radial_eq (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin d) (F : ℝ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 • F (‖x‖^2)) = ∫ x : Space d, (x j)^2 • F (‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Space d ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space d := LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ (Equiv.swap i j)
  have he (x : Space d) : (e x) i = x j := by
    simp [e, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply, Equiv.piCongrLeft']
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : Space d, ((e x) i)^2 • F (‖e x‖^2) :=
      (e.measurePreserving.integral_comp e.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding _).symm
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [he, e.norm_map]

name: SVW.radial_square_substitution
statement:
theorem radial_square_substitution (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (F : ℝ → ℂ) :
    (∫ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, r^(d-1) • ((r^2 : ℝ) • F (r^2))) =
      (1/2 : ℝ) • ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^((d : ℝ)/2) • F t
proof:
:= by
  have hs := integral_comp_rpow_Ioi (fun t : ℝ => t^((d : ℝ)/2) • F t)
    (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : (r^2)^((d : ℝ)/2) = r^d := by
    rw [← rpow_natCast r 2, ← rpow_mul hr.le]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [show (2 : ℝ)*((d : ℝ)/2) = d by ring, rpow_natCast]
  have hpow : d-1+2 = d+1 := by omega
  calc
    _ = (1/2 : ℝ) • ∫ r : ℝ in Ioi 0,
        (|(2 : ℝ)| * r^((2 : ℝ)-1)) • ((r^(2 : ℝ))^((d : ℝ)/2) • F (r^(2 : ℝ))) := by
      rw [← integral_smul]
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro r hr
      simp only [show (2 : ℝ)-1=1 by norm_num, rpow_one,
        show |(2 : ℝ)|=2 by norm_num, rpow_two, he r hr, smul_smul]
      rw [← pow_add, hpow, pow_succ]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hs]

name: SVW.integral_coordinate_radial
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_radial (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hint : ∀ j : Fin d, Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x j)^2 • F (‖x‖^2)) volume) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 • F (‖x‖^2)) =
      (volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) 1)/2) •
        ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^((d : ℝ)/2) • F t
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  letI : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hsum : (∫ x : Space d, (‖x‖^2 : ℝ) • F (‖x‖^2)) =
      (d : ℝ) • ∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 • F (‖x‖^2) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Fin d, ∫ x : Space d, (x j)^2 • F (‖x‖^2) := by
        rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hint j)]
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with x
        rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Finset.sum_smul]
      _ = _ := by
        simp_rw [integral_coordinate_radial_eq d _ i F]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  have hp := integral_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure (Space d))
    (fun r : ℝ => (r^2 : ℝ) • F (r^2))
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ] at hp
  rw [radial_square_substitution d hd F, hsum] at hp
  have hd0 : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt).ne'
  apply (smul_right_injective (M := ℂ) hd0)
  simpa only [smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, mul_assoc, one_mul] using hp

name: SVW.radial_integral_scaling
statement:
theorem radial_integral_scaling (α a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (F : ℝ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^α • F (a*t)) =
      a^(-(α+1)) • ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^α • F t
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = a^(-α) • ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, (a*t)^α • F (a*t) := by
      rw [← integral_smul]
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro t ht
      dsimp only
      rw [smul_smul, mul_rpow ha.le ht.le, ← mul_assoc, ← rpow_add ha,
        neg_add_cancel, rpow_zero, one_mul]
    _ = a^(-α) • (a⁻¹ • ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^α • F t) := by
      rw [integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun t : ℝ => t^α • F t) 0 ha, mul_zero]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [smul_smul, ← rpow_neg_one, ← rpow_add ha]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.integral_coordinate_scaled_radial
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_scaled_radial (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hint : ∀ j : Fin d, Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x j)^2 • F (a*‖x‖^2)) volume) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 • F (a*‖x‖^2)) =
      laguerreRadialConstant d a • ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^((d : ℝ)/2) • F t
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_coordinate_radial d i (fun t => F (a*t)) hint,
    radial_integral_scaling _ a ha, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  unfold laguerreRadialConstant
  ring

name: SVW.firstHermite_radial_constant
statement:
theorem firstHermite_radial_constant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2)) * laguerreRadialConstant d (2*π) =
      1/Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := integral_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial d (2*π) (by positivity) i (1 : ℝ[X])
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_one, mul_one] at hc
  have hgamma : (∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t) = Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1) := by
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using
      laguerreWeight_monomial_integral ((d : ℝ)/2) (by positivity) 0
  rw [hgamma] at hc
  have hn := integral_firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq d i
  simp_rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq] at hn
  rw [integral_const_mul, hc] at hn
  apply (eq_div_iff (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (d : ℝ)/2+1)).ne').mpr
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using hn

name: SVW.integral_firstHermite_radial_complex
statement:
theorem integral_firstHermite_radial_complex (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hint : ∀ j : Fin d, Integrable (fun x : Space d =>
      (x j)^2 • (exp (-(2*π*‖x‖^2)) • F (2*π*‖x‖^2))) volume) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 • F (2*π*‖x‖^2)) =
      (1/Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1)) •
        ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t • F t
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Space d) : ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 • F (2*π*‖x‖^2) =
      (4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2)) •
        ((x i)^2 • (exp (-(2*π*‖x‖^2)) • F (2*π*‖x‖^2))) := by
    rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
    simp only [gaussian, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring_nf
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_smul, integral_coordinate_scaled_radial d i (2*π) (by positivity)
    (fun t => exp (-t) • F t) hint, smul_smul, firstHermite_radial_constant d i]
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  simp only [laguerreWeight, smul_smul]

name: SVW.laguerrePolynomial_eval
statement:
theorem laguerrePolynomial_eval (α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), laguerreCoefficient α n k * x^k
proof:
:= by
  simp [laguerrePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]

name: SVW.laguerreWeight_monomial_integrable
statement:
theorem laguerreWeight_monomial_integrable (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (k : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => laguerreWeight α x * x^k) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < α + (k : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  apply (Real.GammaIntegral_convergent hp).congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
  rw [show α + (k : ℝ) + 1 - 1 = α + k by ring, Real.rpow_add hx,
    Real.rpow_natCast]
  unfold laguerreWeight
  ring

name: SVW.laguerreWeight_monomial_integral
statement:
theorem laguerreWeight_monomial_integral (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight α x * x^k) = Gamma (α + k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.Gamma_eq_integral (by positivity : 0 < α + (k : ℝ) + 1)]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro x hx
  dsimp only
  rw [show α + (k : ℝ) + 1 - 1 = α + k by ring, Real.rpow_add hx,
    Real.rpow_natCast]
  unfold laguerreWeight
  ring

name: SVW.laguerreWeight_polynomial_integrable
statement:
theorem laguerreWeight_polynomial_integrable (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => laguerreWeight α x * p.eval x) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [eval_add, mul_add] using! hp.add hq
  | monomial k c =>
    simpa only [eval_monomial, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using!
      (laguerreWeight_monomial_integrable α hα k).const_mul c

name: SVW.gamma_add_nat_eq_ascPochhammer
statement:
theorem gamma_add_nat_eq_ascPochhammer (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (n : ℕ) :
    Gamma (a + n) = Gamma a * (ascPochhammer ℝ n).eval a
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, ← add_assoc, Gamma_add_one (by positivity : a + (n : ℝ) ≠ 0),
      ih, ascPochhammer_succ_eval]
    ring

name: SVW.ascPochhammer_natDegree_real
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_natDegree_real (n : ℕ) :
    (ascPochhammer ℝ n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ascPochhammer_succ_right,
      Polynomial.natDegree_mul' (by
        rw [(monic_ascPochhammer ℝ n).leadingCoeff, one_mul]
        exact (monic_X_add_C (n : ℝ)).leadingCoeff ▸ one_ne_zero), ih]
    simp only [show (n : ℝ[X]) = C (n : ℝ) from (Polynomial.C_eq_natCast n).symm, natDegree_X_add_C]

name: SVW.laguerre_signed_difference
statement:
theorem laguerre_signed_difference (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℝ)^k * (n.choose k : ℝ) * p.eval (a + k)) =
      (-1 : ℝ)^n * ((fwdDiff (1 : ℝ))^[n] p.eval) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hsign : (-1 : ℝ)^n * (-1 : ℝ)^(n-k) = (-1 : ℝ)^k := by
    have hs : (-1 : ℝ)^(n-k) * (-1 : ℝ)^(n-k) = 1 := by
      rw [← mul_pow]
      norm_num
    nth_rw 1 [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hkn]
    rw [pow_add]
    calc
      (-1 : ℝ)^(n-k) * (-1 : ℝ)^k * (-1 : ℝ)^(n-k) =
          (-1 : ℝ)^k * ((-1 : ℝ)^(n-k) * (-1 : ℝ)^(n-k)) := by ring
      _ = (-1 : ℝ)^k := by rw [hs, mul_one]
  simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one,
    Int.cast_natCast, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [← hsign]
  ring

name: SVW.laguerre_ascPochhammer_difference
statement:
theorem laguerre_ascPochhammer_difference (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (a : ℝ) :
    ((fwdDiff (1 : ℝ))^[n] (ascPochhammer ℝ m).eval) a =
      if m = n then (n.factorial : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hmn.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
  · have h := congrFun (Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_degree_eq_factorial (ascPochhammer ℝ m)) a
    simpa [ascPochhammer_natDegree_real, (monic_ascPochhammer ℝ m).leadingCoeff] using h
  · rw [Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
      (by simpa only [ascPochhammer_natDegree_real] using hlt), if_neg hlt.ne]
    rfl

name: SVW.laguerre_monomial_moment_as_difference
statement:
theorem laguerre_monomial_moment_as_difference
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n m : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight α x * x^m * (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x) =
      Gamma (α + n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ) * (-1 : ℝ)^n *
        ((fwdDiff (1 : ℝ))^[n] (ascPochhammer ℝ m).eval) (α + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : ℝ) : laguerreWeight α x * x^m * (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), laguerreCoefficient α n k *
        (laguerreWeight α x * x^(m+k)) := by
    rw [laguerrePolynomial_eval, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _hk
    rw [pow_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _hk =>
    (laguerreWeight_monomial_integrable α hα (m+k)).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, laguerreWeight_monomial_integral α hα]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add]
  have hgamma (k : ℕ) : Gamma (α + (m+k) + 1) =
      Gamma (α + k + 1) * (ascPochhammer ℝ m).eval (α + 1 + k) := by
    simpa only [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using
      gamma_add_nat_eq_ascPochhammer (α + k + 1) (by positivity) m
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), laguerreCoefficient α n k * Gamma (α + (m+k) + 1)) =
        Gamma (α + n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ) *
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℝ)^k * (n.choose k : ℝ) *
            (ascPochhammer ℝ m).eval (α + 1 + k) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _hk
      rw [hgamma]
      unfold laguerreCoefficient
      have hg : Gamma (α + k + 1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
      field_simp
    _ = _ := by rw [laguerre_signed_difference]; ring

name: SVW.laguerre_monomial_moment
statement:
theorem laguerre_monomial_moment (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n m : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (∫ x in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight α x * x^m * (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x) =
      if m = n then (-1 : ℝ)^n * Gamma (α + n + 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerre_monomial_moment_as_difference α hα,
    laguerre_ascPochhammer_difference m n hmn]
  split_ifs with heq
  · have hf : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  · simp

name: SVW.laguerre_polynomial_product_integrable
statement:
theorem laguerre_polynomial_product_integrable (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n m : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => laguerreWeight α x *
      (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x * (laguerrePolynomial α m).eval x) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [eval_mul, mul_assoc] using
    laguerreWeight_polynomial_integrable α hα (laguerrePolynomial α n * laguerrePolynomial α m)

name: SVW.laguerreCoefficient_top
statement:
theorem laguerreCoefficient_top (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n : ℕ) :
    laguerreCoefficient α n n = (-1 : ℝ)^n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold laguerreCoefficient
  rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
  have hg : Gamma (α + n + 1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  field_simp

name: SVW.laguerre_polynomial_inner_of_le
statement:
theorem laguerre_polynomial_inner_of_le
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n m : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (∫ x in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight α x *
      (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x * (laguerrePolynomial α m).eval x) =
        if m = n then Gamma (α + n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : ℝ) : laguerreWeight α x *
      (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x * (laguerrePolynomial α m).eval x =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m+1), laguerreCoefficient α m k *
          (laguerreWeight α x * x^k * (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x) := by
    rw [laguerrePolynomial_eval α m, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _hk
    ring
  have hi (k : ℕ) : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => laguerreWeight α x * x^k *
      (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x) (Ioi 0) volume := by
    have hh := laguerreWeight_polynomial_integrable α hα
      ((X : ℝ[X])^k * laguerrePolynomial α n)
    apply hh.congr
    filter_upwards with x
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _hk => (hi k).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hs : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m+1), laguerreCoefficient α m k *
      ∫ x in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight α x * x^k * (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m+1), if k = n then
          laguerreCoefficient α m k * ((-1 : ℝ)^n * Gamma (α + n + 1)) else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [laguerre_monomial_moment α hα n k ((Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)).trans hmn), mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [hs, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  by_cases hmn' : m = n
  · subst m
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_self, if_true, laguerreCoefficient_top α hα]
    have hsquare : (-1 : ℝ)^n * (-1 : ℝ)^n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    calc
      (-1 : ℝ)^n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * ((-1 : ℝ)^n * Gamma (α + n + 1)) =
          ((-1 : ℝ)^n * (-1 : ℝ)^n) * (Gamma (α + n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hsquare, one_mul]
  · have hm : m < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hmn hmn'
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm), if_false, hmn']

name: SVW.laguerre_orthogonality
statement:
theorem laguerre_orthogonality (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n m : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in Ioi 0, x^α * exp (-x) *
      (laguerrePolynomial α n).eval x * (laguerrePolynomial α m).eval x) =
        if n = m then Gamma (n + α + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total m n with hmn | hnm
  · have h := laguerre_polynomial_inner_of_le α hα n m hmn
    simpa only [laguerreWeight, eq_comm, add_comm (n : ℝ) α] using h
  · have h := laguerre_polynomial_inner_of_le α hα m n hnm
    by_cases hnm' : n = m
    · subst m
      simpa only [laguerreWeight, add_comm (n : ℝ) α] using h
    · rw [if_neg hnm'] at h ⊢
      convert! h using 1
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro x _hx
      unfold laguerreWeight
      ring

name: SVW.ascPochhammer_eval_prod_real
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_eval_prod_real (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (ascPochhammer ℝ n).eval a = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (a + j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [ascPochhammer_succ_eval, ih, Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: SVW.laguerreCoefficient_eq_product
statement:
theorem laguerreCoefficient_eq_product (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    laguerreCoefficient α n k =
      (-1 : ℝ)^k * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (n-k), (α + k + 1 + j)) /
        ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n-k).factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ := gamma_add_nat_eq_ascPochhammer (α + k + 1) (by positivity) (n-k)
  have he : α + k + 1 + ((n-k : ℕ) : ℝ) = α + n + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hkn]
    ring
  rw [he] at hΓ
  have hfact : (n.choose k : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n-k).factorial : ℝ) =
      (n.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hkn
  have hratio : (n.choose k : ℝ) / (n.factorial : ℝ) =
      1 / ((k.factorial : ℝ) * ((n-k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using hfact
  have hg : Gamma (α + k + 1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  calc
    laguerreCoefficient α n k = (-1 : ℝ)^k * (ascPochhammer ℝ (n-k)).eval (α + k + 1) *
        ((n.choose k : ℝ) / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
      unfold laguerreCoefficient
      rw [hΓ]
      field_simp
    _ = _ := by rw [hratio, ascPochhammer_eval_prod_real]; ring

name: SVW.laguerreCoefficient_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem laguerreCoefficient_eq_zero_of_lt (α : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) (hnk : n < k) :
    laguerreCoefficient α n k = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laguerreCoefficient, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero,
    zero_mul, zero_div]

name: SVW.laguerrePolynomial_coeff
statement:
theorem laguerrePolynomial_coeff (α : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) :
    (laguerrePolynomial α n).coeff k = laguerreCoefficient α n k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laguerrePolynomial, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  split_ifs with hk
  · rfl
  · exact (laguerreCoefficient_eq_zero_of_lt α n k
      (Nat.lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hk (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h))))).symm

name: SVW.laguerrePolynomial_zero
statement: theorem laguerrePolynomial_zero (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) : laguerrePolynomial α 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold laguerrePolynomial
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, mul_one]
  rw [laguerreCoefficient_top α hα]
  simp

name: SVW.laguerrePolynomial_one
statement:
theorem laguerrePolynomial_one (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    laguerrePolynomial α 1 = C (α+1) - X
proof:
:= by
  unfold laguerrePolynomial
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one]
  rw [laguerreCoefficient_top α hα,
    laguerreCoefficient_eq_product α hα 1 0 (Nat.zero_le 1)]
  norm_num
  ring

name: SVW.normalizedHermiteGaussian_laguerre_norm_saturation
statement:
theorem normalizedHermiteGaussian_laguerre_norm_saturation (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ‖inner ℂ (laguerreVector d i n) (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs)‖^2)
      (‖normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := ‖(1/s)^(((d : ℝ)/2+1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖^2
  let q : ℝ := ‖1-1/s‖^2
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := sq_nonneg _
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hq0]
    have h := gaussianCayley_norm_lt_one s hs
    dsimp only [q]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1-1/s)]
  have he (n : ℕ) :
      ‖inner ℂ (laguerreVector d i n) (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs)‖^2 =
        C*(laguerreSquaredNorm d n*q^n) := by
    rw [laguerreVector_inner_normalizedHermiteGaussian]
    simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, mul_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _), sq_sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm_pos d n).le]
    dsimp only [C, q]
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm n 2]
    ring
  have ht := (laguerreSquaredNorm_hasSum d q hq).mul_left C
  have hv : C*(1/(1-q)^((d : ℝ)/2+1)) = ‖normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs‖^2 := by
    rw [mul_one_div, normalizedHermiteGaussian_norm_sq]
    exact gaussianCayley_power_normalization s hs ((d : ℝ)/2+1)
  simpa only [← he, hv] using ht

name: SVW.normalizedHermiteGaussian_mem_laguerreSector
statement:
theorem normalizedHermiteGaussian_mem_laguerreSector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) : normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs ∈ laguerreSector d i
proof:
:=
  mem_closed_span_of_orthonormal_norm_saturation (Hilbert d) (laguerreVector d i)
    (laguerreVector_orthonormal d i) (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs)
    (normalizedHermiteGaussian_laguerre_norm_saturation d i s hs)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_mem_laguerreSector
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_mem_laguerreSector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) : hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb ∈ laguerreSector d i
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℂ := (b/π+1)/2
  have hre : s.re = (b.re/π+1)/2 := by
    simp [s, Complex.div_ofReal_re]
  have hs : 1/2 < s.re := by
    rw [hre]
    have h := div_pos hb pi_pos
    linarith
  have hp : normalizedGaussianPrecision s = b := by
    unfold normalizedGaussianPrecision s
    have hπ : (π : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr pi_ne_zero
    field_simp
    ring
  have ha : (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (mul_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _)
      (sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos)).ne'
  have hm : (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ) • hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb ∈
      laguerreSector d i := by
    simpa only [normalizedHermiteGaussian, hp] using
      normalizedHermiteGaussian_mem_laguerreSector d i s hs
  have hi := (laguerreSector d i).smul_mem
    ((((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) hm
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul] using hi

name: SVW.gaussianSector_le_laguerreSector
statement:
theorem gaussianSector_le_laguerreSector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    hermiteGaussianSector d i ≤ laguerreSector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hermiteGaussianVector_mem_laguerreSector d i b b.property
  · exact (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (laguerreVector d i))).isClosed_topologicalClosure

name: SVW.gaussianSector_eq_laguerreSector
statement:
theorem gaussianSector_eq_laguerreSector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    hermiteGaussianSector d i = laguerreSector d i
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (gaussianSector_le_laguerreSector d i) (laguerreSector_le_gaussianSector d i)

name: SVW.laguerreSector_fourier_reduces
statement:
theorem laguerreSector_fourier_reduces (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (∀ f ∈ laguerreSector d i, fourier d f ∈ laguerreSector d i) ∧
    (∀ f ∈ (laguerreSector d i)ᗮ, fourier d f ∈ (laguerreSector d i)ᗮ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gaussianSector_eq_laguerreSector]
  exact hermiteGaussianSector_fourier_reduces d i

name: SVW.laguerreSector_chirp_reduces
statement:
theorem laguerreSector_chirp_reduces (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    (∀ f ∈ laguerreSector d i, chirpUnitary d m f ∈ laguerreSector d i) ∧
    (∀ f ∈ (laguerreSector d i)ᗮ, chirpUnitary d m f ∈ (laguerreSector d i)ᗮ)
proof:
:= by

  exact hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_reduces d i m

name: SVW.normalizedGaussianPrecision_pos
statement:
theorem normalizedGaussianPrecision_pos (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    0 < (normalizedGaussianPrecision s).re
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedGaussianPrecision, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.re_ofNat,
    Complex.im_ofNat, Complex.one_re, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  exact mul_pos pi_pos (by linarith)

name: SVW.normalizedHermiteGaussian_coe
statement:
theorem normalizedHermiteGaussian_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs : Space d → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x => Complex.exp (-(s-1)*(2*π*‖x‖^2 : ℝ)) * firstHermiteFunction d i x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ)
    (hermiteGaussianVector d i _ (normalizedGaussianPrecision_pos s hs)),
    hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i _ (normalizedGaussianPrecision_pos s hs)] with x hx hy
  change (_ • hermiteGaussianVector d i _ _) x = _
  rw [hx, Pi.smul_apply, hy, firstHermiteFunction_formula]
  simp only [hermiteGaussian, complexGaussian, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.ofReal_pow]
  have he : Complex.exp (-(s-1)*(2*π*‖x‖^2 : ℝ)) * Complex.exp (-↑π*(‖x‖:ℂ)^2) =
      Complex.exp (-normalizedGaussianPrecision s*(‖x‖:ℂ)^2) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    unfold normalizedGaussianPrecision
    push_cast
    ring
  calc
    _ = (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1):ℝ):ℂ) * (sqrt π : ℂ) * (x i : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-normalizedGaussianPrecision s*(‖x‖:ℂ)^2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← he]; push_cast; ring

name: SVW.normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner_ae
statement:
theorem normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner_ae (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (fun x : Space d => inner ℂ (hermitePolynomialVector d i p x)
      (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs x)) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x => ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 •
        (Complex.exp (-(s-1)*(2*π*‖x‖^2 : ℝ)) * ((p.eval (2*π*‖x‖^2) : ℝ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i p,
    normalizedHermiteGaussian_coe d i s hs] with x hx hy
  rw [hx, hy, hermitePolynomialFunction]
  change inner ℂ ((_ : ℂ) • firstHermiteFunction d i x)
    (Complex.exp _ • firstHermiteFunction d i x) = _
  simp only [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_pow]
  ring_nf
  rfl

name: SVW.normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner
statement:
theorem normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    inner ℂ (hermitePolynomialVector d i p) (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs) =
      (1/Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1)) • ∫ t in Ioi 0,
        gammaLaplaceIntegrand ((d : ℝ)/2+1) s t * ((p.eval t : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (-(s-1)*t)*((p.eval t : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hint (j : Fin d) : Integrable (fun x : Space d =>
      (x j)^2 • (exp (-(2*π*‖x‖^2)) • F (2*π*‖x‖^2))) volume := by
    have hc : (4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hhint : Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖firstHermiteFunction d j x‖^2 •
        F (2*π*‖x‖^2)) volume := ((L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (hermitePolynomialVector d j p)
      (normalizedHermiteGaussian d j s hs)).congr
        (normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner_ae d j s hs p))
    apply (hhint.smul ((4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2))⁻¹)).congr
    filter_upwards with x
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
    rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
    simp only [gaussian, smul_smul, F]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  rw [integral_congr_ae (normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner_ae d i s hs p),
    integral_firstHermite_radial_complex d i F hint]
  congr 1
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t ht
  dsimp only [F, laguerreWeight, gammaLaplaceIntegrand]
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_exp]
  have he : Complex.exp (-(t:ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-(s-1)*t) = Complex.exp (-s*t) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [Complex.ofReal_neg]
  calc
    _ = ((t^((d : ℝ)/2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (-t) * Complex.exp (-(s-1)*t)) * ((p.eval t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he]

name: SVW.rawLaguerreVector_inner_normalizedHermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem rawLaguerreVector_inner_normalizedHermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    inner ℂ (rawLaguerreVector d i n) (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs) =
      (laguerreSquaredNorm d n : ℂ)*(1/s)^(((d : ℝ)/2+1 : ℝ) : ℂ)*(1-1/s)^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawLaguerreVector, normalizedHermiteGaussian_polynomial_inner,
    laguerre_laplace_integral _ (by positivity) n s (by linarith), Complex.real_smul]
  unfold laguerreSquaredNorm
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.laguerreVector_inner_normalizedHermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem laguerreVector_inner_normalizedHermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    inner ℂ (laguerreVector d i n) (normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs) =
      (sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm d n) : ℂ)*(1/s)^(((d : ℝ)/2+1 : ℝ) : ℂ)*(1-1/s)^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerreVector, inner_smul_left, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    rawLaguerreVector_inner_normalizedHermiteGaussian]
  have he : laguerreNormalization d n * laguerreSquaredNorm d n = sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm d n) := by
    unfold laguerreNormalization
    calc
      _ = (sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm d n))⁻¹ *
          (sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm d n)*sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm d n)) := by
        rw [← pow_two, sq_sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm_pos d n).le]
      _ = _ := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (sqrt_pos.mpr (laguerreSquaredNorm_pos d n)).ne' _
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, he]

name: SVW.normalizedHermiteGaussian_norm_sq
statement:
theorem normalizedHermiteGaussian_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    ‖normalizedHermiteGaussian d i s hs‖^2 = (1/(2*s.re-1))^((d : ℝ)/2+1)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℂ := (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hbase := congrArg (fun f : Hilbert d => ‖f‖^2) (firstHermiteVector_eq_hermiteGaussianVector d i)
  rw [firstHermiteVector_norm, one_pow, norm_smul, mul_pow, hermiteGaussianVector_norm_sq] at hbase
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at hbase
  have hπ : π/(2*π) = (1/2 : ℝ) := by field_simp
  rw [hπ] at hbase
  have hr : 0 < 2*s.re-1 := by linarith
  have hre : (normalizedGaussianPrecision s).re = π*(2*s.re-1) := by
    simp [normalizedGaussianPrecision, Complex.mul_re]
  have h1 : 1/(4*(π*(2*s.re-1))) = (1/(4*π))*(1/(2*s.re-1)) := by field_simp
  have h2 : π/(2*(π*(2*s.re-1))) = (1/2)*(1/(2*s.re-1)) := by field_simp
  rw [normalizedHermiteGaussian, norm_smul, mul_pow, hermiteGaussianVector_norm_sq,
    hre, h1, h2, mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2) (by positivity)]
  change ‖A‖^2 * ((1/(4*π)*(1/(2*s.re-1))) *
    ((1/2)^((d : ℝ)/2)*(1/(2*s.re-1))^((d : ℝ)/2))) = _
  calc
    _ = (‖A‖^2*((1/(4*π))*(1/2)^((d : ℝ)/2))) *
        ((1/(2*s.re-1))^((d : ℝ)/2)*(1/(2*s.re-1))) := by ring
    _ = (1/(2*s.re-1))^((d : ℝ)/2)*(1/(2*s.re-1)) := by rw [← hbase, one_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [rpow_add (by positivity), rpow_one]

name: SVW.gammaLaplaceIntegrand_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem gammaLaplaceIntegrand_mul_monomial (α : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (k : ℕ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t * ((t^k : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+k+1) z t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gammaLaplaceIntegrand, add_sub_cancel_right, Complex.real_smul]
  rw [rpow_add ht, rpow_natCast]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.integrableOn_gammaLaplace_monomial
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gammaLaplace_monomial (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) (k : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t * ((t^k : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrableOn_gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+k+1) (by positivity) z hz).congr
  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
  exact (gammaLaplaceIntegrand_mul_monomial α z k t ht).symm

name: SVW.integral_gammaLaplace_monomial
statement:
theorem integral_gammaLaplace_monomial (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t * ((t^k : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      (1/z)^((α+k+1 : ℝ) : ℂ)*(Gamma (α+k+1) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gammaLaplace_eq (α+k+1) (by positivity) z hz]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro t ht
  exact gammaLaplaceIntegrand_mul_monomial α z k t ht

name: SVW.integrableOn_gammaLaplace_polynomial
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gammaLaplace_polynomial (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t * ((p.eval t : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [eval_add, Complex.ofReal_add, mul_add] using! hp.add hq
  | monomial k c =>
    simpa only [eval_monomial, Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using!
      (integrableOn_gammaLaplace_monomial α hα z hz k).const_mul (c : ℂ)

name: SVW.laguerre_signed_binomial_power
statement:
theorem laguerre_signed_binomial_power (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℂ)^k*(n.choose k : ℂ)*q^k) = (1-q)^n
proof:
:= by
  have hh := add_pow (-q) (1 : ℂ) n
  simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at hh
  rw [show (1-q : ℂ) = -q+1 by ring, hh]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [neg_pow]
  ring

name: SVW.laguerreLaplace_coefficient_identity
statement:
theorem laguerreLaplace_coefficient_identity (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (n k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    (laguerreCoefficient α n k : ℂ)*
      ((1/z)^((α+k+1 : ℝ) : ℂ)*(Gamma (α+k+1) : ℂ)) =
      (((Gamma (α+n+1)/(n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)*(1/z)^((α+1 : ℝ) : ℂ))*
        ((-1 : ℂ)^k*(n.choose k : ℂ)*(1/z)^k)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (1/z : ℂ) ≠ 0 := one_div_ne_zero hz
  have hΓ : (Gamma (α+k+1) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  have he : ((α+k+1 : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((α+1 : ℝ) : ℂ)+(k : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, Complex.cpow_add _ _ hq, Complex.cpow_natCast]
  unfold laguerreCoefficient
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: SVW.laguerre_laplace_integral
statement:
theorem laguerre_laplace_integral (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n : ℕ)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t *
      (((laguerrePolynomial α n).eval t : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      (((Gamma (α+n+1)/(n.factorial : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)*(1/z)^((α+1 : ℝ) : ℂ))*
        (1-1/z)^n
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hz
  have he (t : ℝ) : gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t *
      (((laguerrePolynomial α n).eval t : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (laguerreCoefficient α n k : ℂ)*
        (gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t * ((t^k : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    rw [laguerrePolynomial_eval]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ =>
    (integrableOn_gammaLaplace_monomial α hα z hz k).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gammaLaplace_monomial α hα z hz,
    laguerreLaplace_coefficient_identity α hα n _ z hz0]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, laguerre_signed_binomial_power]

name: SVW.laguerreSquaredNorm_eq_choose
statement:
theorem laguerreSquaredNorm_eq_choose (d n : ℕ) :
    laguerreSquaredNorm d n = Ring.choose ((d : ℝ)/2+n) n
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ : Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  have hfac : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero
  have he : (d : ℝ)/2+n+1 = ((d : ℝ)/2+1)+n := by ring
  rw [laguerreSquaredNorm, he, gamma_add_nat_eq_ascPochhammer _ (by positivity)]
  rw [Ring.choose_eq_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [descPochhammer_smeval_eq_ascPochhammer]
  simp only [ascPochhammer_smeval_cast, ascPochhammer_smeval_eq_eval]
  rw [show (d : ℝ)/2+n-n+1 = (d : ℝ)/2+1 by ring]
  field_simp

name: SVW.laguerreSquaredNorm_hasSum
statement:
theorem laguerreSquaredNorm_hasSum (d : ℕ) (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => laguerreSquaredNorm d n * q^n)
      (1/(1-q)^((d : ℝ)/2+1))
proof:
:= by
  have he : q ∈ Metric.eball (0 : ℝ) (1 : ENNReal) := by
    simpa only [← ENNReal.ofReal_one, Metric.eball_ofReal, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hq
  have hs := (Real.one_div_one_sub_rpow_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_zero ((d : ℝ)/2+1)).hasSum he
  simpa only [zero_add, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq, smul_eq_mul,
    laguerreSquaredNorm_eq_choose, show ∀ n : ℕ, (d : ℝ)/2+1+n-1 = (d : ℝ)/2+n by intro n; ring] using hs

name: SVW.laguerreCoefficient_eq_factor
statement:
theorem laguerreCoefficient_eq_factor (α : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) :
    laguerreCoefficient α n k = (n.choose k : ℝ) * laguerreCoefficientFactor α n k
proof:
:= by
  unfold laguerreCoefficient laguerreCoefficientFactor
  ring

name: SVW.laguerre_factor_raise_degree
statement:
theorem laguerre_factor_raise_degree (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n k : ℕ) :
    ((n : ℝ)+1) * laguerreCoefficientFactor α (n+1) k =
      (α+n+1) * laguerreCoefficientFactor α n k
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ : Gamma (α + ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) =
      (α+n+1) * Gamma (α+n+1) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using
      (Gamma_add_one (by positivity : α + (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0))
  unfold laguerreCoefficientFactor
  rw [hΓ, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hk : Gamma (α + k + 1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  field_simp

name: SVW.laguerre_factor_raise_monomial
statement:
theorem laguerre_factor_raise_monomial (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n k : ℕ) :
    (α+k+1) * laguerreCoefficientFactor α n (k+1) =
      -laguerreCoefficientFactor α n k
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ : Gamma (α + ((k+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) =
      (α+k+1) * Gamma (α+k+1) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc] using
      (Gamma_add_one (by positivity : α + (k : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0))
  unfold laguerreCoefficientFactor
  rw [hΓ, pow_succ]
  have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hk : Gamma (α + k + 1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  have ha : α + (k : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: SVW.laguerre_binomial_step
statement:
theorem laguerre_binomial_step (α : ℝ) (n r : ℕ) :
    (α+n+2) * ((n+2).choose (r+1) : ℝ) +
      ((n : ℝ)+1) * (n.choose (r+1) : ℝ) -
      (α+r+1) * ((n+1).choose r : ℝ) -
      (2*((n : ℝ)+1)+α+1) * ((n+1).choose (r+1) : ℝ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp₁ : ((n+2).choose (r+1) : ℝ) =
      ((n+1).choose r : ℝ) + ((n+1).choose (r+1) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_succ_succ (n+1) r
  have hp₀ : ((n+1).choose (r+1) : ℝ) =
      (n.choose r : ℝ) + (n.choose (r+1) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_succ_succ n r
  have hm₀ : ((n : ℝ)+1) * (n.choose r : ℝ) =
      ((n+1).choose (r+1) : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ)+1) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq n r
  have hm₁ : ((n : ℝ)+2) * ((n+1).choose r : ℝ) =
      ((n+2).choose (r+1) : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ)+1) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (n+1) r
  linear_combination (α+(n : ℝ)+(r : ℝ)+3)*hp₁ - ((n : ℝ)+1)*hp₀ - hm₀ + hm₁

name: SVW.laguerre_three_term_recurrence_succ
statement:
theorem laguerre_three_term_recurrence_succ (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n : ℕ) :
    C ((n : ℝ)+2) * laguerrePolynomial α (n+2) =
      (C (2*((n : ℝ)+1)+α+1) - X) * laguerrePolynomial α (n+1) -
        C ((n : ℝ)+1+α) * laguerrePolynomial α n
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [sub_mul, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_mul_zero,
      laguerrePolynomial_coeff, sub_zero, laguerreCoefficient_eq_factor,
      Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
    have h₁ := laguerre_factor_raise_degree α hα n 0
    have h₂ := laguerre_factor_raise_degree α hα (n+1) 0
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h₂
    linear_combination h₂ - h₁
  | succ r =>
    simp only [sub_mul, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_mul,
      laguerrePolynomial_coeff, laguerreCoefficient_eq_factor]
    have h₁ := laguerre_factor_raise_degree α hα n (r+1)
    have h₂ := laguerre_factor_raise_degree α hα (n+1) (r+1)
    have hk := laguerre_factor_raise_monomial α hα (n+1) r
    have hb := laguerre_binomial_step α n r
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h₂
    linear_combination ((n+2).choose (r+1) : ℝ)*h₂ - (n.choose (r+1) : ℝ)*h₁ +
      ((n+1).choose r : ℝ)*hk + laguerreCoefficientFactor α (n+1) (r+1)*hb

name: SVW.laguerre_three_term_recurrence
statement:
theorem laguerre_three_term_recurrence (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    C ((n : ℝ)+1) * laguerrePolynomial α (n+1) =
      (C (2*(n : ℝ)+α+1) - X) * laguerrePolynomial α n -
        C ((n : ℝ)+α) * laguerrePolynomial α (n-1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn))
  simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    add_assoc, show (1 : ℝ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num] using
    laguerre_three_term_recurrence_succ α hα m

name: SVW.laguerre_choose_adjacent
statement:
theorem laguerre_choose_adjacent (n k : ℕ) :
    ((k : ℝ)+1) * (n.choose (k+1) : ℝ) =
      ((n : ℝ)-k) * (n.choose k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
  · have h := congrArg (fun z : ℕ => (z : ℝ)) (Nat.choose_succ_right_eq n k)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_sub hkn, mul_comm] using h
  · have hnk : n < k := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hkn
    simp only [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk,
      Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (hnk.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k)), Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: SVW.laguerreCoefficient_adjacent
statement:
theorem laguerreCoefficient_adjacent (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n k : ℕ) :
    ((k : ℝ)+1) * (α+k+1) * laguerreCoefficient α n (k+1) =
      ((k : ℝ)-n) * laguerreCoefficient α n k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laguerreCoefficient_eq_factor]
  have hf := laguerre_factor_raise_monomial α hα n k
  have hc := laguerre_choose_adjacent n k
  linear_combination ((k : ℝ)+1)*(n.choose (k+1) : ℝ)*hf -
    laguerreCoefficientFactor α n k*hc

name: SVW.laguerre_differential_equation
statement:
theorem laguerre_differential_equation (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (n : ℕ) :
    X * (laguerrePolynomial α n).derivative.derivative +
      (C (α+1) - X) * (laguerrePolynomial α n).derivative +
        C (n : ℝ) * laguerrePolynomial α n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [sub_mul, coeff_add, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_mul_zero,
      coeff_derivative, coeff_zero, laguerrePolynomial_coeff,
      Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_one, sub_zero]
    have h := laguerreCoefficient_adjacent α hα n 0
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, zero_sub, one_mul] at h
    linear_combination h
  | succ r =>
    simp only [sub_mul, coeff_add, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul,
      coeff_X_mul, coeff_derivative, coeff_zero, laguerrePolynomial_coeff,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have h := laguerreCoefficient_adjacent α hα n (r+1)
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h
    linear_combination h

name: SVW.continuous_hermitePolynomialFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_hermitePolynomialFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    Continuous (hermitePolynomialFunction d i p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermitePolynomialFunction
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : Space d => (2*π*‖x‖^2 : ℝ)) := by fun_prop
  exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (p.continuous.comp hc)).smul
    (continuous_firstHermiteFunction d i)

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialFunction_norm_sq
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialFunction_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) (x : Space d) :
    ‖hermitePolynomialFunction d i p x‖^2 =
      ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 * (p*p).eval (2*π*‖x‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermitePolynomialFunction, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    mul_pow, sq_abs, eval_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.memLp_hermitePolynomialFunction
statement:
theorem memLp_hermitePolynomialFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    MemLp (hermitePolynomialFunction d i p) 2 volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (continuous_hermitePolynomialFunction d i p).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  simpa only [hermitePolynomialFunction_norm_sq] using!
    integrable_firstHermite_radial_polynomial d i (p*p)

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialVector_coe
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialVector_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (hermitePolynomialVector d i p : Space d → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
      hermitePolynomialFunction d i p
proof:
:=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialFunction_inner
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialFunction_inner (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p q : ℝ[X]) (x : Space d) :
    inner ℂ (hermitePolynomialFunction d i p x) (hermitePolynomialFunction d i q x) =
      ((‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 * (p*q).eval (2*π*‖x‖^2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermitePolynomialFunction, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
    inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, eval_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_pow]
  ring_nf
  rfl

name: SVW.hermitePolynomialVector_inner
statement:
theorem hermitePolynomialVector_inner (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    inner ℂ (hermitePolynomialVector d i p) (hermitePolynomialVector d i q) =
      (((∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t * (p*q).eval t) /
        Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, inner ℂ (hermitePolynomialVector d i p x)
        (hermitePolynomialVector d i q x)) =
      ∫ x : Space d, ((‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 *
        (p*q).eval (2*π*‖x‖^2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i p,
        hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i q] with x hp hq
      rw [hp, hq, hermitePolynomialFunction_inner]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_complex_ofReal, integral_firstHermite_radial_polynomial]

name: SVW.laguerreSquaredNorm_pos
statement: theorem laguerreSquaredNorm_pos (d : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : 0 < laguerreSquaredNorm d n
proof:
:= by
  unfold laguerreSquaredNorm
  exact div_pos (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity))
    (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_pos) (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)))

name: SVW.rawLaguerreVector_inner
statement:
theorem rawLaguerreVector_inner (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (n m : ℕ) :
    inner ℂ (rawLaguerreVector d i n) (rawLaguerreVector d i m) =
      if n=m then (laguerreSquaredNorm d n : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawLaguerreVector, rawLaguerreVector, hermitePolynomialVector_inner]
  have ho := laguerre_orthogonality ((d : ℝ)/2) (by positivity) n m
  have he : (∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t *
      ((laguerrePolynomial ((d : ℝ)/2) n)*(laguerrePolynomial ((d : ℝ)/2) m)).eval t) =
      if n=m then Gamma (n+(d : ℝ)/2+1)/(n.factorial : ℝ) else 0 := by
    convert ho using 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    simp only [laguerreWeight, eval_mul]
    ring
  rw [he]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp only [laguerreSquaredNorm, div_div, add_comm (n : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)/2)]
  · simp

name: SVW.laguerreNormalization_pos
statement: theorem laguerreNormalization_pos (d : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : 0 < laguerreNormalization d n
proof:
:=
  inv_pos.mpr (sqrt_pos.mpr (laguerreSquaredNorm_pos d n))

name: SVW.laguerreNormalization_sq_mul
statement:
theorem laguerreNormalization_sq_mul (d : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    (laguerreNormalization d n)^2 * laguerreSquaredNorm d n = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold laguerreNormalization
  rw [inv_pow, sq_sqrt (laguerreSquaredNorm_pos d n).le]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (laguerreSquaredNorm_pos d n).ne'

name: SVW.laguerreVector_orthonormal
statement:
theorem laguerreVector_orthonormal (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    Orthonormal ℂ (laguerreVector d i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro n m
  simp only [laguerreVector, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
    Complex.conj_ofReal, rawLaguerreVector_inner]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst m
    have hn := congrArg Complex.ofReal (laguerreNormalization_sq_mul d n)
    push_cast at hn
    simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using hn
  · simp

name: SVW.rawLaguerreVector_zero
statement:
theorem rawLaguerreVector_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    rawLaguerreVector d i 0 = firstHermiteVector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hermitePolynomialVector_coe d i (laguerrePolynomial ((d : ℝ)/2) 0),
    firstHermiteVector_coe d i] with x hp hq
  change hermitePolynomialVector d i (laguerrePolynomial ((d : ℝ)/2) 0) x = _
  rw [hp, hq]
  simp [hermitePolynomialFunction, laguerrePolynomial_zero ((d : ℝ)/2) (by positivity)]

name: SVW.laguerreVector_zero
statement:
theorem laguerreVector_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    laguerreVector d i 0 = firstHermiteVector d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [laguerreVector, rawLaguerreVector_zero]
  have hn : laguerreNormalization d 0 = 1 := by
    simp [laguerreNormalization, laguerreSquaredNorm,
      (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (d : ℝ)/2+1)).ne']
  rw [hn, Complex.ofReal_one, one_smul]

name: SVW.radial_monomial_identity
statement:
theorem radial_monomial_identity (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    r^(d-1) * (r^2 * exp (-a*r^2) * (a*r^2)^k) =
      a^k * (r^(d+1+2*k) * exp (-a*r^2))
proof:
:= by
  have he : d+1+2*k = (d-1)+2+2*k := by omega
  rw [he, pow_add, pow_add, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian_radial_monomial
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_radial_monomial
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) volume
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  apply (integrable_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure (Space d))
    (f := fun r : ℝ => r^2 * exp (-a*r^2) * (a*r^2)^k)).mpr
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [radial_monomial_identity d hd a k]
  have h := integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq ha
    (by have hh : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _; linarith : (-1 : ℝ) < ((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ))
  simpa only [rpow_natCast] using! h.const_mul (a^k)

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_radial_monomial
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_radial_monomial
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) =
      (d : ℝ) * laguerreRadialConstant d a * Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+k+1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hrad := integral_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure (Space d))
    (fun r : ℝ => r^2 * exp (-a*r^2) * (a*r^2)^k)
  change (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖^2 * exp (-a*‖x‖^2) * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) = _
  rw [hrad]
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [radial_monomial_identity d hd a k]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hgamma : (∫ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, r^(d+1+2*k) * exp (-a*r^2)) =
      a^(-(((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ)+1)/2) * (1/2) *
        Gamma ((((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ)+1)/2) := by
    simpa only [show (2 : ℝ) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, rpow_natCast] using!
      (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := ((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ)) (b := a)
        (by norm_num) (by have hh : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _; linarith) ha)
  rw [hgamma]
  have he : ((((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ)+1)/2) = (d : ℝ)/2+k+1 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he]
  have he' : -(((d+1+2*k : ℕ) : ℝ)+1)/2 = -((d : ℝ)/2+k+1) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he']
  have hp : a^k * a^(-((d : ℝ)/2+k+1)) = a^(-((d : ℝ)/2+1)) := by
    rw [← rpow_natCast a k, ← rpow_add ha]
    congr 1
    ring
  unfold laguerreRadialConstant
  calc
    (d : ℝ) * (volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) 1) *
        (a^k * (a^(-((d : ℝ)/2+k+1)) * (1/2) * Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+k+1)))) =
      (d : ℝ) * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) 1) *
        ((a^k * a^(-((d : ℝ)/2+k+1))) * (1/2) * Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+k+1)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hp]; ring

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian_coordinate_monomial
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_coordinate_monomial
    (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (i : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  apply (integrable_gaussian_radial_monomial d hd a ha k).mono'
  · exact (show Continuous (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) by
      unfold gaussian; fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (gaussian_pos d a x).le) (by positivity))]
    have hc : (x i)^2 ≤ ‖x‖^2 := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (x i)) (norm_nonneg x)).mpr (PiLp.norm_apply_le x i)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (gaussian_pos d a x).le) (by positivity)

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_coordinate_monomial_eq
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_coordinate_monomial_eq
    (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (i j : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) =
      ∫ x : Space d, (x j)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Space d ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space d := LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ (Equiv.swap i j)
  have he (x : Space d) : (e x) i = x j := by
    simp [e, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply, Equiv.piCongrLeft']
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : Space d, ((e x) i)^2 * gaussian d a (e x) * (a*‖e x‖^2)^k :=
      (e.measurePreserving.integral_comp e.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [he]
      simp only [gaussian, e.norm_map]

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_coordinate_monomial
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_coordinate_monomial
    (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (i : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) =
      laguerreRadialConstant d a * Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+k+1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  have heq : (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) =
      ∑ j : Fin d, ∫ x : Space d, (x j)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k := by
    rw [← integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => integrable_gaussian_coordinate_monomial d a ha j k)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hmoment := integral_gaussian_radial_monomial d hd a ha k
  rw [heq] at hmoment
  simp_rw [integral_gaussian_coordinate_monomial_eq d a _ i k] at hmoment
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hmoment
  have hd0 : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt).ne'
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd0
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using hmoment

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial
    (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * p.eval (a*‖x‖^2)) volume
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [eval_add, mul_add] using! hp.add hq
  | monomial k c =>
    simpa only [eval_monomial, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using!
      (integrable_gaussian_coordinate_monomial d a ha i k).const_mul c

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial
    (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * p.eval (a*‖x‖^2)) =
      laguerreRadialConstant d a *
        ∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t * p.eval t
proof:
:= by
  have hα : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)/2 := by positivity
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [eval_add, mul_add]
    rw [integral_add (integrable_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial d a ha i p)
      (integrable_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial d a ha i q),
      integral_add (laguerreWeight_polynomial_integrable _ hα p)
      (laguerreWeight_polynomial_integrable _ hα q), hp, hq, mul_add]
  | monomial k c =>
    simp only [eval_monomial]
    have hl : (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * (c*(a*‖x‖^2)^k)) =
        c * (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x * (a*‖x‖^2)^k) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      ring
    have hr : (∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t * (c*t^k)) =
        c * (∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t * t^k) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with t
      ring
    rw [hl, hr, integral_gaussian_coordinate_monomial d a ha i k,
      laguerreWeight_monomial_integral _ hα]
    ring

name: SVW.integrable_firstHermite_radial_polynomial
statement:
theorem integrable_firstHermite_radial_polynomial
    (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 *
      p.eval (2*π*‖x‖^2)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial d (2*π) (by positivity) i p).const_mul
    (4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2))).congr
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
  ring

name: SVW.integral_firstHermite_radial_polynomial
statement:
theorem integral_firstHermite_radial_polynomial
    (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 * p.eval (2*π*‖x‖^2)) =
      (∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t * p.eval t) /
        Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1)
proof:
:= by
  have hα : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)/2 := by positivity
  have hc := integral_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial d (2*π) (by positivity) i (1 : ℝ[X])
  simp only [eval_one, mul_one] at hc
  have hgamma : (∫ t in Ioi 0, laguerreWeight ((d : ℝ)/2) t) = Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1) := by
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using
      laguerreWeight_monomial_integral ((d : ℝ)/2) hα 0
  rw [hgamma] at hc
  have hn := integral_firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq d i
  simp_rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq] at hn
  rw [integral_const_mul, hc] at hn
  have hΓ : Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  have hconstant : (4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2)) * laguerreRadialConstant d (2*π) =
      1 / Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2+1) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hΓ).mpr
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hn
  simp_rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, ((4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2)) * ((x i)^2 * gaussian d (2*π) x)) *
        p.eval (2*π*‖x‖^2)) = (4*π*(2 : ℝ)^((d : ℝ)/2)) *
      ∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d (2*π) x * p.eval (2*π*‖x‖^2) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_gaussian_coordinate_polynomial d (2*π) (by positivity) i p,
        ← mul_assoc, hconstant]
      ring

name: SVW.mpCoefficientWeight_norm_sq
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientWeight_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    ‖((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹‖^2 = z.im^((d:ℝ)/2+1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_inv, norm_pow, MpRoot.fromIwasawa_root, norm_mul, Circle.norm_coe,
    mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (MpRoot.sectionRoot_pos z)]
  calc
    _ = ((MpRoot.sectionRoot z^2)⁻¹)^(d+2) := by
      rw [← inv_pow, ← inv_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (d+2) 2]
    _ = (Real.sqrt z.im)^(d+2) := by rw [MpRoot.sectionRoot_sq, one_div, inv_inv]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul z.im_pos.le]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring

name: SVW.mpCoefficientWeight_star_mul
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientWeight_star_mul (d : ℕ) (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    star (((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹) *
      ((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹ =
        ((z.im^((d:ℝ)/2+1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mpCoefficientWeight_norm_sq d z u]
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_pow, starRingEnd_apply] using
    (Complex.conj_mul' (((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹))

name: SVW.mpCoefficientWeight_density
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientWeight_density (d : ℕ) (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    ‖((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹‖^2 * z.im^(-2:ℝ) =
      z.im^((d:ℝ)/2-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mpCoefficientWeight_norm_sq, ← Real.rpow_add z.im_pos]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.mpCoefficientWeight_density_div
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientWeight_density_div (d : ℕ) (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    ((1/z.im)^2) * ‖((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹‖^2 =
      z.im^((d:ℝ)/2-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (1/z.im)^2 = z.im^(-2:ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg z.im_pos.le, Real.rpow_two, one_div, inv_pow]
  rw [hw, mul_comm]
  exact mpCoefficientWeight_density d z u

name: SVW.measurable_laplacePowerKernel
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_laplacePowerKernel (b : ℂ) (p : ℝ) : Measurable (laplacePowerKernel b p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold laplacePowerKernel
  fun_prop

name: SVW.laplacePowerKernel_norm
statement:
theorem laplacePowerKernel_norm (b : ℂ) (p x : ℝ) :
    ‖laplacePowerKernel b p x‖ = ‖b + (2*π*Complex.I)*(x:ℂ)‖^(-p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [laplacePowerKernel, Complex.norm_cpow_real, norm_div, norm_one, one_div,
    ← Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow]

name: SVW.laplacePowerKernel_norm_affine
statement:
theorem laplacePowerKernel_norm_affine (b : ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖laplacePowerKernel b p x‖ = b.re^(-p) *
      (1 + (b.im/b.re + (2*π/b.re)*x)^2)^(-p/2)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := b.im/b.re + (2*π/b.re)*x
  have hn : ‖b + (2*π*Complex.I)*(x:ℂ)‖^2 = b.re^2*(1+a^2) := by
    rw [Complex.sq_norm]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.re_ofNat, Complex.im_ofNat, zero_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero, zero_add,
      mul_one]
    dsimp [a]
    field_simp
  rw [laplacePowerKernel_norm]
  calc
    _ = (‖b + (2*π*Complex.I)*(x:ℂ)‖^2)^(-p/2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = (b.re^2)^(-p/2) * (1+a^2)^(-p/2) := by
      rw [hn, Real.mul_rpow (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul hb.le]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.integrable_laplacePowerKernel
statement:
theorem integrable_laplacePowerKernel (b : ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hp : 1 < p) :
    Integrable (laplacePowerKernel b p) (volume : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_norm_iff (measurable_laplacePowerKernel b p).aestronglyMeasurable).mp
  have hbase : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (1+‖x‖^2)^(-p/2)) :=
    integrable_rpow_neg_one_add_norm_sq (by simpa using hp)
  have haff := (hbase.comp_add_left (b.im/b.re)).comp_mul_left'
    (show 2*π/b.re ≠ 0 from div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero pi_ne_zero) hb.ne')
  have h := haff.const_mul (b.re^(-p))
  convert! h using 1
  funext x
  rw [laplacePowerKernel_norm_affine b p hb]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: SVW.memLp_laplacePowerKernel_two
statement:
theorem memLp_laplacePowerKernel_two (b : ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hp : 1/2 < p) :
    MemLp (laplacePowerKernel b p) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (measurable_laplacePowerKernel b p).aestronglyMeasurable]
  have h := (integrable_laplacePowerKernel b (2*p) hb (by linarith)).norm
  convert! h using 1
  funext x
  rw [laplacePowerKernel_norm, laplacePowerKernel_norm, ← Real.rpow_two,
    ← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawa_lintegral_point
statement:
theorem iwasawa_lintegral_point (f : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ a, f a.point ∂iwasawaMeasure = ∫⁻ z : ℍ, f z
proof:
:= by
  rw [iwasawa_lintegral (fun a : MpRoot => f a.point) (hf.comp continuous_point.measurable)]
  simp only [fromIwasawa_point, lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawa_lintegral_of_phase_independent
statement:
theorem iwasawa_lintegral_of_phase_independent (f : MpRoot → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f)
    (h : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (heq : ∀ (z : ℍ) (u : Circle), f (fromIwasawa (z,u)) = h z) :
    ∫⁻ a, f a ∂iwasawaMeasure = ∫⁻ z : ℍ, h z
proof:
:= by
  rw [iwasawa_lintegral f hf]
  simp only [heq, lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]

name: SVW.coherentOrthogonalityConstant_pos
statement:
theorem coherentOrthogonalityConstant_pos (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    0 < coherentOrthogonalityConstant d
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd)
  unfold coherentOrthogonalityConstant laplaceHeightConstant
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (coherentLaplaceConstant_pos d))
    (mul_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _) (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)))

name: SVW.coherentOrthogonalityConstant_eq
statement:
theorem coherentOrthogonalityConstant_eq (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    coherentOrthogonalityConstant d = (2 : ℝ)^(-((d : ℝ)/2))/((d : ℝ)/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd)
  have hα : 0 < (d : ℝ)/2 := by positivity
  have hΓ : Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2) ≠ 0 := (Gamma_pos_of_pos hα).ne'
  have hπ : π^((d : ℝ)/2)*π^(-((d : ℝ)/2)) = 1 := by
    rw [← rpow_add pi_pos]
    simp
  unfold coherentOrthogonalityConstant coherentLaplaceConstant laplaceHeightConstant
  rw [Gamma_add_one hα.ne', mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) pi_pos.le]
  calc
    _ = ((2 : ℝ)^(-((d : ℝ)/2))/((d : ℝ)/2))*
      (π^((d : ℝ)/2)*π^(-((d : ℝ)/2))) := by
      field_simp
    _ = _ := by rw [hπ, mul_one]

name: SVW.coherentCoefficient_inner
statement:
theorem coherentCoefficient_inner (d : ℕ) (b c : ℂ) (x y : ℝ) :
    inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d c x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y) =
      ((coherentLaplaceConstant d)^2 : ℂ)*
        inner ℂ (gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)/2+1) ((c+π*y)+π*Complex.I*x))
          (gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)/2+1) ((b+π*y)+π*Complex.I*x))
proof:
:= by
  change inner ℂ ((coherentLaplaceConstant d : ℂ) •
      gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)/2+1) ((c+π*y)+π*Complex.I*x))
    ((coherentLaplaceConstant d : ℂ) •
      gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)/2+1) ((b+π*y)+π*Complex.I*x)) = _
  simp only [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, Complex.conj_ofReal, pow_two]
  ring

name: SVW.integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal
statement:
theorem integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d c x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)) =
      (2*(coherentLaplaceConstant d)^2 : ℝ) •
        gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)+1) (star c+b+(2*π)*y)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd)
  have hp : 1 < (d : ℝ)/2+1 := by linarith
  have hby : 0 < (b+π*y : ℂ).re := by simp; positivity
  have hcy : 0 < (c+π*y : ℂ).re := by simp; positivity
  simp_rw [coherentCoefficient_inner]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gammaLaplace_inner_half _ hp _ _ hcy hby]
  have he : 2*((d : ℝ)/2+1)-1 = (d : ℝ)+1 := by ring
  have hz : star (c+π*y : ℂ)+(b+π*y) = star c+b+(2*π)*y := by
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
    ring
  rw [he, hz]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat, Complex.ofReal_pow]
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal
statement:
theorem integrable_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d c x y)
      (coherentCoefficient d b x y)) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd)
  have hp : 1 < (d : ℝ)/2+1 := by linarith
  have hby : 0 < (b+π*y : ℂ).re := by simp; positivity
  have hcy : 0 < (c+π*y : ℂ).re := by simp; positivity
  simp_rw [coherentCoefficient_inner]
  exact (integrable_gammaLaplace_inner_half _ hp _ _ hcy hby).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_height
statement:
theorem integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_height (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    (∫ y in Ioi 0, (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
      ∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d c x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)) =
      coherentOrthogonalityConstant d • coherentLaplaceKernel d (star c+b)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd)
  have hz : 0 < (star c+b).re := by simpa using add_pos hc hb
  calc
    _ = (2*(coherentLaplaceConstant d)^2 : ℝ) •
        ∫ y in Ioi 0, (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
          gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)+1) (star c+b+(2*π)*y) := by
      rw [← integral_smul]
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro y hy
      dsimp only
      rw [integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal d hd b c hb hc y hy]
      exact smul_comm _ _ _
    _ = _ := by
      have hh : (∫ y in Ioi 0, (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
          gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)+1) (star c+b+(2*π)*y)) =
          laplaceHeightConstant ((d : ℝ)/2) (2*π) • gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)/2+1) (star c+b) := by
        simpa only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat,
          show 2*((d : ℝ)/2)+1 = (d : ℝ)+1 by ring] using!
          gammaLaplace_weighted_integral ((d : ℝ)/2) (2*π) (by positivity) (by positivity) (star c+b) hz
      rw [hh]
      simp only [coherentOrthogonalityConstant, coherentLaplaceKernel, Complex.real_smul,
        Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat, Complex.ofReal_pow]
      ring

name: SVW.integrableOn_coherentCoefficient_inner_height
statement:
theorem integrableOn_coherentCoefficient_inner_height (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
      ∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d c x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd)
  have hz : 0 < (star c+b).re := by simpa using add_pos hc hb
  have hi := (integrableOn_gammaLaplace_weighted ((d : ℝ)/2) (2*π)
    (by positivity) (by positivity) (star c+b) hz).smul
      (2*(coherentLaplaceConstant d)^2 : ℝ)
  apply hi.congr
  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
  rw [integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal d hd b c hb hc y hy]
  have he : 2*((d : ℝ)/2)+1 = (d : ℝ)+1 := by ring
  rw [he]
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat, Pi.smul_apply] using!
    smul_comm (2*(coherentLaplaceConstant d)^2 : ℝ) (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ)
      (gammaLaplace ((d : ℝ)+1) (star c+b+(2*π)*y))

name: SVW.stronglyMeasurable_gammaLaplace
statement: theorem stronglyMeasurable_gammaLaplace (p : ℝ) : StronglyMeasurable (gammaLaplace p)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : StronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℂ × ℝ => gammaLaplaceIntegrand p v.1 v.2) := by
    apply Measurable.stronglyMeasurable
    unfold gammaLaplaceIntegrand
    fun_prop
  exact hm.integral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict (Ioi 0))

name: SVW.measurable_coherentCoefficient
statement:
theorem measurable_coherentCoefficient (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) :
    Measurable (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => coherentCoefficient d b v.2 v.1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coherentCoefficient coherentLaplaceKernel
  exact measurable_const.mul ((stronglyMeasurable_gammaLaplace _).measurable.comp (by fun_prop))

name: SVW.measurable_coherentPairIntegrand
statement:
theorem measurable_coherentPairIntegrand (d : ℕ) (b c : ℂ) :
    Measurable (coherentPairIntegrand d b c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coherentPairIntegrand
  exact (measurable_fst.pow_const _).smul
    ((measurable_coherentCoefficient d c).inner (measurable_coherentCoefficient d b))

name: SVW.real_smul_scalar_inner_self
statement:
theorem real_smul_scalar_inner_self (w : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    w • inner ℂ z z = ((w*‖z‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : inner ℂ z z = ((‖z‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_pow] using! (inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K (𝕜 := ℂ) z)
  rw [hi, Complex.real_smul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: SVW.coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm
statement:
theorem coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ‖coherentPairIntegrand d b b (y,x)‖ =
      y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) * ‖coherentCoefficient d b x y‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentPairIntegrand, real_smul_scalar_inner_self, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (rpow_pos_of_pos hy _).le (sq_nonneg _))]

name: SVW.coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm_eq_re
statement:
theorem coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm_eq_re (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ‖coherentPairIntegrand d b b (y,x)‖ = (coherentPairIntegrand d b b (y,x)).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm d b x y hy]
