  simp only [coherentPairIntegrand, real_smul_scalar_inner_self, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: SVW.integrable_coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal
statement:
theorem integrable_coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (coherentPairIntegrand d b b)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (measurable_coherentPairIntegrand d b b).aestronglyMeasurable
    (μ := (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume)
  apply (integrable_prod_iff hm).mpr
  constructor
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
    exact (integrable_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal d hd b b hb hb y hy).smul
      (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ)
  · have hi := (integrableOn_coherentCoefficient_inner_height d hd b b hb hb).re
    apply hi.congr
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
    rw [← integral_smul]
    have his : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
        inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d b x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)) volume := by
      simpa only [Pi.smul_apply] using!
        (integrable_coherentCoefficient_inner_horizontal d hd b b hb hb y hy).smul
          (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ)
    have hRe : (∫ x : ℝ, (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
        inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d b x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)).re =
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
          inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d b x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)).re := by
      simpa using! (integral_re his).symm
    convert! hRe.trans ?_ using 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    exact (coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm_eq_re d b x y hy).symm

name: SVW.coherentPairIntegrand_norm_le_diagonal
statement:
theorem coherentPairIntegrand_norm_le_diagonal (d : ℕ) (b c : ℂ) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ‖coherentPairIntegrand d b c (y,x)‖ ≤
      (‖coherentPairIntegrand d b b (y,x)‖+‖coherentPairIntegrand d c c (y,x)‖)/2
proof:
:= by
  have hw : 0 ≤ y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) := (rpow_pos_of_pos hy _).le
  have hab : ‖coherentCoefficient d c x y‖*‖coherentCoefficient d b x y‖ ≤
      (‖coherentCoefficient d b x y‖^2+‖coherentCoefficient d c x y‖^2)/2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖coherentCoefficient d b x y‖-‖coherentCoefficient d c x y‖)]
  calc
    _ = y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) *
        ‖inner ℂ (coherentCoefficient d c x y) (coherentCoefficient d b x y)‖ := by
      simp only [coherentPairIntegrand, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hw]
    _ ≤ y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) *
        (‖coherentCoefficient d c x y‖*‖coherentCoefficient d b x y‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_inner_le_norm _ _) hw
    _ ≤ y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) *
        ((‖coherentCoefficient d b x y‖^2+‖coherentCoefficient d c x y‖^2)/2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab hw
    _ = _ := by
      rw [coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm d b x y hy,
        coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal_norm d c x y hy]
      ring

name: SVW.integrable_coherentPairIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrable_coherentPairIntegrand (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    Integrable (coherentPairIntegrand d b c)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (((integrable_coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal d hd b hb).norm).add
    ((integrable_coherentPairIntegrand_diagonal d hd c hc).norm)).div_const 2
  apply hi.mono' (measurable_coherentPairIntegrand d b c).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_le
    (measurable_coherentPairIntegrand d b c).norm
    (((measurable_coherentPairIntegrand d b b).norm.add
      (measurable_coherentPairIntegrand d c c).norm).div_const 2))).mpr
  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
  exact ae_of_all _ fun x => coherentPairIntegrand_norm_le_diagonal d b c x y hy

name: SVW.integrable_coherentGaussian_pair
statement:
theorem integrable_coherentGaussian_pair (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    Integrable (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => (v.1^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
      (inner ℂ (coherentGaussianVector d i v.2 v.1) (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) *
        inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc) (coherentGaussianVector d i v.2 v.1)))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  apply (integrable_coherentPairIntegrand d hd b c hb hc).congr
  have hy : ∀ᵐ v : ℝ × ℝ ∂((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume), 0 < v.1 := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_fst)).mpr
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
    exact ae_of_all _ fun _ => hy
  filter_upwards [hy] with v hv
  rw [coherentGaussianVector_inner_laplace d i b hb v.2 v.1 hv,
    coherentGaussianVector_inner_reverse_laplace d i c hc v.2 v.1 hv]
  simp only [coherentPairIntegrand, coherentCoefficient, RCLike.inner_apply', Complex.star_def]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.coherentGaussian_orthogonality
statement:
theorem coherentGaussian_orthogonality (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    (∫ y in Ioi 0, ∫ x : ℝ, (y^((d : ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
      (inner ℂ (coherentGaussianVector d i x y) (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) *
        inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc) (coherentGaussianVector d i x y))) =
      coherentOrthogonalityConstant d •
        inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc) (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  rw [hermiteGaussianVector_inner_laplace]
  rw [← integral_coherentCoefficient_inner_height d hd b c hb hc]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro y hy
  dsimp only
  rw [← integral_smul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [coherentGaussianVector_inner_laplace d i b hb x y hy,
    coherentGaussianVector_inner_reverse_laplace d i c hc x y hy]
  simp only [coherentCoefficient, RCLike.inner_apply', Complex.star_def]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.laplace_height_power_identity
statement:
theorem laplace_height_power_identity (α a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) :
    t^(2*α) * (1/(a*t))^α = a^(-α)*t^α
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_div, inv_rpow (mul_pos ha ht).le, mul_rpow ha.le ht.le,
    mul_inv, ← rpow_neg ha.le, ← rpow_neg ht.le]
  calc
    t^(2*α) * (a^(-α)*t^(-α)) = a^(-α)*(t^(2*α)*t^(-α)) := by ring_nf
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← rpow_add ht]
      congr 2
      ring_nf

name: SVW.laplaceDoubleIntegrand_factor
statement:
theorem laplaceDoubleIntegrand_factor (α a : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (t y : ℝ) :
    laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y =
      (t^(2*α) : ℝ) • (Complex.exp (-z*t) *
        ((y^(α-1)*exp (-(a*t*y)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laplaceDoubleIntegrand, gammaLaplaceIntegrand, add_sub_cancel_right,
    Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_neg]
  have he : -(z+(a : ℂ)*y)*t = -z*t+(-(a : ℂ)*t*y) := by ring_nf
  rw [he, Complex.exp_add]
  ring_nf

name: SVW.laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height_integrable
statement:
theorem laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height_integrable (α a : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    IntegrableOn (laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => ((y^(α-1)*exp (-(a*t*y)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [neg_mul] using!
      (integrableOn_gammaLaplace_majorant α (a*t) hα (mul_pos ha ht)).ofReal
  apply (hi.const_mul (((t^(2*α) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.exp (-z*t))).congr
  filter_upwards with y
  rw [laplaceDoubleIntegrand_factor]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul]
  ring_nf

name: SVW.integral_laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height
statement:
theorem integral_laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height (α a : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ y in Ioi 0, laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y) =
      laplaceHeightConstant α a • gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (fun y => laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y) =
      (fun y => ((t^(2*α) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.exp (-z*t)*
        ((y^(α-1)*exp (-(a*t*y)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    funext y
    rw [laplaceDoubleIntegrand_factor]
    simp only [Complex.real_smul]
    ring_nf
  rw [hf, integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal,
    integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi hα (mul_pos ha ht)]
  simp only [laplaceHeightConstant, gammaLaplaceIntegrand, add_sub_cancel_right,
    Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have he := congrArg Complex.ofReal (laplace_height_power_identity α a t ha ht)
  push_cast at he
  calc
    ((t^(2*α) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.exp (-z*t)*
      ((((1/(a*t))^α : ℝ) : ℂ)*(Gamma α : ℂ)) =
        (((t^(2*α) : ℝ) : ℂ)*(((1/(a*t))^α : ℝ) : ℂ))*
          (Gamma α : ℂ)*Complex.exp (-z*t) := by ring_nf
    _ = _ := by rw [he]; ring_nf

name: SVW.laplaceDoubleIntegrand_norm
statement:
theorem laplaceDoubleIntegrand_norm (α a : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (t y : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ‖laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y‖ =
      t^(2*α)*exp (-z.re*t) * (y^(α-1)*exp (-(a*t*y)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [laplaceDoubleIntegrand_factor]
  simp only [norm_smul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos ht _), Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
    mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos hy _), abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
  ring_nf

name: SVW.integral_laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height_norm
statement:
theorem integral_laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height_norm (α a : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ y in Ioi 0, ‖laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y‖) =
      laplaceHeightConstant α a * (t^α*exp (-z.re*t))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (t^(2*α)*exp (-z.re*t)) *
        ∫ y in Ioi 0, y^(α-1)*exp (-(a*t*y)) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro y hy
      exact laplaceDoubleIntegrand_norm α a z t y ht hy
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi hα (mul_pos ha ht)]
      have he := laplace_height_power_identity α a t ha ht
      unfold laplaceHeightConstant
      calc
        _ = (t^(2*α)*(1/(a*t))^α)*Gamma α*exp (-z.re*t) := by ring_nf
        _ = _ := by rw [he]; ring_nf

name: SVW.integrable_laplaceDoubleIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrable_laplaceDoubleIntegrand (α a : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Integrable (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z v.1 v.2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ × ℝ => laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z v.1 v.2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))) := by
    unfold laplaceDoubleIntegrand gammaLaplaceIntegrand
    exact (by fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply (integrable_prod_iff hm).mpr
  constructor
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height_integrable α a hα ha z t ht
  · have hi := (integrableOn_gammaLaplace_majorant (α+1) z.re (by linarith) hz).const_mul
      (laplaceHeightConstant α a)
    apply hi.congr
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using
      (integral_laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height_norm α a hα ha z t ht).symm

name: SVW.gammaLaplace_weighted_integral
statement:
theorem gammaLaplace_weighted_integral (α a : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    (∫ y in Ioi 0, (y^(α-1) : ℝ) • gammaLaplace (2*α+1) (z+a*y)) =
      laplaceHeightConstant α a • gammaLaplace (α+1) z
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a hα ha z hz
  calc
    _ = ∫ y in Ioi 0, ∫ t in Ioi 0, laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y := by
      simp only [laplaceDoubleIntegrand, gammaLaplace, integral_smul]
    _ = ∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ y in Ioi 0, laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a z t y :=
      integral_integral_swap hi.swap
    _ = laplaceHeightConstant α a • ∫ t in Ioi 0, gammaLaplaceIntegrand (α+1) z t := by
      rw [← integral_smul]
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro t ht
      exact integral_laplaceDoubleIntegrand_height α a hα ha z t ht
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SVW.integrableOn_gammaLaplace_weighted
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gammaLaplace_weighted (α a : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => (y^(α-1) : ℝ) • gammaLaplace (2*α+1) (z+a*y)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => (y^(α-1) : ℝ) • gammaLaplace (2*α+1) (z+a*y))
    (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))
  simpa only [laplaceDoubleIntegrand, gammaLaplace, Function.comp_apply,
    Prod.swap_prod_mk, integral_smul] using!
      (integrable_laplaceDoubleIntegrand α a hα ha z hz).swap.integral_prod_left

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_automorphyPhase
statement: theorem continuous_automorphyPhase : Continuous (fun p : MpRoot × ℍ => automorphyPhase p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_automorphy.div (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_automorphy.norm)
    (fun p => by exact_mod_cast (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (p.1.automorphy_ne_zero p.2)))

name: SVW.MpRoot.point_mul
statement: theorem point_mul (a b : MpRoot) : (a*b).point = a.base • b.point
proof:
:= by
  simp only [point, base_mul, mul_smul]

name: SVW.MpRoot.phase_mul
statement: theorem phase_mul (a b : MpRoot) : (a*b).phase = automorphyPhase a b.point * b.phase
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (a*b).root / (‖(a*b).root‖ : ℂ) =
    (a.automorphy b.point / (‖a.automorphy b.point‖ : ℂ)) *
      (b.root / (‖b.root‖ : ℂ))
  rw [root_mul]
  change (a.automorphy b.point * b.root) / (‖a.automorphy b.point * b.root‖ : ℂ) = _
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul, div_mul_div_comm]

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawaAction_coordinate
statement:
theorem iwasawaAction_coordinate (a b : MpRoot) :
    iwasawaHomeomorph (a*b) = iwasawaAction a (iwasawaHomeomorph b)
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext (point_mul a b) (phase_mul a b)

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawaAction_fromIwasawa
statement:
theorem iwasawaAction_fromIwasawa (a : MpRoot) (p : ℍ × Circle) :
    fromIwasawa (iwasawaAction a p) = a * fromIwasawa p
proof:
:= by
  apply iwasawaHomeomorph.injective
  rw [iwasawaAction_coordinate]
  change iwasawaHomeomorph (iwasawaHomeomorph.symm (iwasawaAction a p)) =
    iwasawaAction a (iwasawaHomeomorph (iwasawaHomeomorph.symm p))
  rw [Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawaAction_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem iwasawaAction_measurePreserving (a : MpRoot) :
    MeasurePreserving (iwasawaAction a) iwasawaProductMeasure iwasawaProductMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hb : MeasurePreserving (fun z : ℍ => a.base • z) volume volume := by
    simpa only [] using! (measurePreserving_smul (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ a.base)
      (volume : Measure ℍ))
  change MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℍ × Circle => (a.base • p.1, automorphyPhase a p.1 * p.2))
    ((volume : Measure ℍ).prod circleHaar) ((volume : Measure ℍ).prod circleHaar)
  apply hb.skew_product (g := fun z u => automorphyPhase a z * u)
  · exact ((continuous_automorphyPhase.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_fst)).mul
      continuous_snd).measurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => map_mul_left_eq_self circleHaar (automorphyPhase a z))

name: SVW.MpRoot.fromIwasawa_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem fromIwasawa_measurePreserving :
    MeasurePreserving fromIwasawa iwasawaProductMeasure iwasawaMeasure
proof:
:=
  ⟨continuous_fromIwasawa.measurable, rfl⟩

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawa_lintegral
statement:
theorem iwasawa_lintegral (f : MpRoot → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ a, f a ∂iwasawaMeasure = ∫⁻ z : ℍ, ∫⁻ u : Circle, f (fromIwasawa (z,u)) ∂circleHaar
proof:
:= by
  rw [iwasawaMeasure, lintegral_map hf continuous_fromIwasawa.measurable]
  exact lintegral_prod _ (hf.comp continuous_fromIwasawa.measurable).aemeasurable

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawa_integrable_iff
statement:
theorem iwasawa_integrable_iff (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] (f : MpRoot → E) :
    Integrable f iwasawaMeasure ↔ Integrable (fun p : ℍ × Circle => f (fromIwasawa p))
      iwasawaProductMeasure
proof:
:=
  iwasawaHomeomorph.symm.measurableEmbedding.integrable_map_iff

name: SVW.MpRoot.iwasawa_integral
statement:
theorem iwasawa_integral (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (f : MpRoot → E) (hf : Integrable f iwasawaMeasure) :
    ∫ a, f a ∂iwasawaMeasure = ∫ z : ℍ, ∫ u : Circle, f (fromIwasawa (z,u)) ∂circleHaar
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fromIwasawa_measurePreserving.integral_comp iwasawaHomeomorph.symm.measurableEmbedding f]
  exact integral_prod _ ((iwasawa_integrable_iff E f).mp hf)

name: SVW.mpDenom_ne_zero
statement: theorem mpDenom_ne_zero (g : MpBase) (z : ℍ) : mpDenom g z ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  UpperHalfPlane.denom_ne_zero (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ g) z

name: SVW.mpDenom_one
statement: @[simp] theorem mpDenom_one (z : ℍ) : mpDenom (1 : MpBase) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mpDenom]

name: SVW.mpDenom_continuous
statement: theorem mpDenom_continuous : Continuous (fun p : MpBase × ℍ => mpDenom p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mpDenom
  fun_prop

name: SVW.mpDenom_mul
statement:
theorem mpDenom_mul (g h : MpBase) (z : ℍ) :
    mpDenom (g * h) z = mpDenom g (h • z) * mpDenom h z
proof:
:= by
  have hd := UpperHalfPlane.denom_cocycle (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ g)
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ h) z.im_ne_zero
  simp only [← map_mul] at hd
  simpa [UpperHalfPlane.denom, UpperHalfPlane.num, mpDenom,
    UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL_coe_matrix] using hd

name: SVW.mpDenomRatio_mem_slitPlane
statement:
theorem mpDenomRatio_mem_slitPlane (g : MpBase) (z : ℍ) :
    mpDenomRatio g z ∈ Complex.slitPlane
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
  by_cases hc : g 1 0 = 0
  · left
    have hd : (g 1 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by simpa [mpDenom, hc] using mpDenom_ne_zero g z
    simp [mpDenomRatio, mpDenom, hc, hd]
  · by_cases hq : (mpDenomRatio g z).im = 0
    · left
      have hp : mpDenomRatio g z * mpDenom g UpperHalfPlane.I = mpDenom g z :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ (mpDenom_ne_zero g UpperHalfPlane.I)
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hp
      have hr : (mpDenomRatio g z).re = z.im := by
        apply mul_right_cancel₀ hc
        simpa only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          UpperHalfPlane.coe_I, UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, hq, zero_mul, mul_zero,
          mul_one, one_mul, add_zero, zero_add, mpDenom, mul_comm] using him
      rw [hr]
      exact z.im_pos
    · exact Or.inr hq

name: SVW.mpDenomRatio_continuous
statement: theorem mpDenomRatio_continuous : Continuous (fun p : MpBase × ℍ => mpDenomRatio p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact mpDenom_continuous.div
    (mpDenom_continuous.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const))
    (fun p => mpDenom_ne_zero p.1 UpperHalfPlane.I)

name: SVW.complexSqrt_sq
statement: theorem complexSqrt_sq (z : ℂ) : z.sqrt ^ (2 : ℕ) = z
proof:
:= by
  simp [Complex.sqrt]

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_sq
statement: theorem root_sq (a : MpRoot) : a.root ^ (2 : ℕ) = mpDenom a.base UpperHalfPlane.I

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_ne_zero
statement: theorem root_ne_zero (a : MpRoot) : a.root ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact mpDenom_ne_zero a.base UpperHalfPlane.I (by rw [← a.root_sq, h, zero_pow (by norm_num)])

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_sq
statement: theorem automorphy_sq (a : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) : a.automorphy z ^ (2 : ℕ) = mpDenom a.base z
proof:
:= by
  rw [automorphy, mul_pow, root_sq, complexSqrt_sq, mpDenomRatio]
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (mpDenom_ne_zero a.base UpperHalfPlane.I)

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_ne_zero
statement: theorem automorphy_ne_zero (a : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) : a.automorphy z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact mpDenom_ne_zero a.base z (by rw [← a.automorphy_sq z, h, zero_pow (by norm_num)])

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_I
statement: @[simp] theorem automorphy_I (a : MpRoot) : a.automorphy UpperHalfPlane.I = a.root
proof:
:= by
  rw [automorphy, mpDenomRatio, div_self (mpDenom_ne_zero a.base UpperHalfPlane.I),
    Complex.sqrt_one, mul_one]

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_base
statement: theorem continuous_base : Continuous (base : MpRoot → MpBase)
proof: := continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_root
statement: theorem continuous_root : Continuous (root : MpRoot → ℂ)
proof: := continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_automorphy
statement: theorem continuous_automorphy : Continuous (fun p : MpRoot × ℍ => p.1.automorphy p.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold automorphy
  apply (continuous_root.comp continuous_fst).mul
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro p
  have hin : ContinuousAt (fun q : MpRoot × ℍ => mpDenomRatio q.1.base q.2) p :=
    (mpDenomRatio_continuous.comp
      ((continuous_base.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)).continuousAt
  exact (Complex.continuousAt_sqrt
    ((mpDenomRatio_mem_slitPlane p.1.base p.2).imp le_of_lt id)).comp
      (f := fun q : MpRoot × ℍ => mpDenomRatio q.1.base q.2) hin

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_unique
statement:
theorem automorphy_unique (a : MpRoot) (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hsq : ∀ z : ℍ, f z ^ (2 : ℕ) = mpDenom a.base z)
    (hI : f UpperHalfPlane.I = a.root) : f = a.automorphy
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous a.automorphy := continuous_automorphy.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have heq := isPreconnected_univ.eq_of_sq_eq hf.continuousOn hcont.continuousOn
    (fun z _ => (hsq z).trans (a.automorphy_sq z).symm)
    (fun {z} _ => a.automorphy_ne_zero z) (mem_univ UpperHalfPlane.I)
    (hI.trans a.automorphy_I.symm)
  funext z
  exact heq (mem_univ z)

name: SVW.MpRoot.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {a b : MpRoot} (hbase : a.base = b.base) (hroot : a.root = b.root) : a = b
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hbase hroot)

name: SVW.MpRoot.base_one
statement: @[simp] theorem base_one : (1 : MpRoot).base = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_one
statement: @[simp] theorem root_one : (1 : MpRoot).root = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.base_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem base_mul (a b : MpRoot) : (a * b).base = a.base * b.base
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem root_mul (a b : MpRoot) :
    (a * b).root = a.automorphy (b.base • UpperHalfPlane.I) * b.root
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_one
statement: theorem automorphy_one (z : ℍ) : (1 : MpRoot).automorphy z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := automorphy_unique 1 (fun _ => 1) continuous_const
    (fun w => by simp) (by rfl)
  exact (congrFun h z).symm

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_mul
statement:
theorem automorphy_mul (a b : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) :
    (a * b).automorphy z = a.automorphy (b.base • z) * b.automorphy z
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun w : ℍ => a.automorphy (b.base • w) * b.automorphy w) :=
    (continuous_automorphy.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const_smul b.base))).mul
      (continuous_automorphy.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
  have he := automorphy_unique (a * b) _ hc (fun w => by
    rw [mul_pow, automorphy_sq, automorphy_sq, base_mul, mpDenom_mul]) (by
    rw [automorphy_I, root_mul])
  exact (congrFun he z).symm

name: SVW.MpRoot.mpDenom_inv
statement:
theorem mpDenom_inv (g : MpBase) (z : ℍ) :
    mpDenom g⁻¹ z = (mpDenom g (g⁻¹ • z))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := mpDenom_mul g g⁻¹ z
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, mpDenom_one] at h
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (mpDenom_ne_zero g (g⁻¹ • z))
  rw [← h, mul_inv_cancel₀ (mpDenom_ne_zero g (g⁻¹ • z))]

name: SVW.MpRoot.base_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem base_inv (a : MpRoot) : (a⁻¹).base = a.base⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem root_inv (a : MpRoot) :
    (a⁻¹).root = (a.automorphy (a.base⁻¹ • UpperHalfPlane.I))⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_inv
statement:
theorem automorphy_inv (a : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) :
    (a⁻¹).automorphy z = (a.automorphy (a.base⁻¹ • z))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun w : ℍ => (a.automorphy (a.base⁻¹ • w))⁻¹) :=
    (continuous_automorphy.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const_smul a.base⁻¹))).inv₀
      (fun w => a.automorphy_ne_zero _)
  have he := automorphy_unique a⁻¹ _ hc (fun w => by
    rw [inv_pow, automorphy_sq, base_inv, mpDenom_inv]) (by rfl)
  exact (congrFun he z).symm

name: SVW.MpRoot.projection_surjective
statement: theorem projection_surjective : Function.Surjective projection
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  exact ⟨⟨(g, (mpDenom g UpperHalfPlane.I).sqrt), complexSqrt_sq _⟩, rfl⟩

name: SVW.MpRoot.roots_eq_or_neg
statement:
theorem roots_eq_or_neg (a b : MpRoot) (hbase : a.base = b.base) :
    a.root = b.root ∨ a.root = -b.root
proof:
:= by
  apply sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp
  rw [root_sq, root_sq, hbase]

name: SVW.mpCoefficient_gaussian_memLp
statement:
theorem mpCoefficient_gaussian_memLp (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (z : ℍ) :
    MemLp (mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i z)) 2 MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (mpCoefficient_continuous d i _).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  have hi := (integrable_mpCoefficientPair d i z z).re
  apply hi.congr
  exact ae_of_all _ fun g => by
    change (mpCoefficientPair d i z z g).re = _
    simp only [mpCoefficientPair, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

name: SVW.mpCoefficientVector_coe
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientVector_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (z : ℍ) :
    mpCoefficientVector d i z =ᵐ[MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure] mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i z)
proof:
:=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.mpCoefficientVector_inner
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientVector_inner (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (w z : ℍ) :
    inner ℂ (mpCoefficientVector d i w) (mpCoefficientVector d i z) =
      coherentOrthogonalityConstant d • inner ℂ (mpGaussianSector d i w) (mpGaussianSector d i z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    _ = ∫ g : MpRoot, mpCoefficientPair d i z w g ∂MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [mpCoefficientVector_coe d i w, mpCoefficientVector_coe d i z] with g hw hz
      simp only [hw, hz, RCLike.inner_apply', mpCoefficientPair, Complex.star_def]
    _ = _ := integral_mpCoefficientPair d i z w

name: SVW.mpCoefficientScale_sq
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientScale_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (mpCoefficientScale d)^2 * coherentOrthogonalityConstant d = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  have hc := coherentOrthogonalityConstant_pos d hd
  rw [mpCoefficientScale, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hc.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne']

name: SVW.mpNormalizedCoefficient_gram
statement:
theorem mpNormalizedCoefficient_gram (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (w z : ℍ) :
    inner ℂ (mpGaussianSector d i w) (mpGaussianSector d i z) =
      inner ℂ (mpNormalizedCoefficient d i w) (mpNormalizedCoefficient d i z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mpNormalizedCoefficient, mpNormalizedCoefficient, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
    mpCoefficientVector_inner]
  simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.real_smul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hc := mpCoefficientScale_sq d i
  rw [pow_two] at hc
  rw [hc, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: SVW.mpCoefficientEmbedding_generator
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientEmbedding_generator (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (z : ℍ) :
    mpCoefficientEmbedding d i (mpGaussianSector d i z) = mpNormalizedCoefficient d i z
proof:
:=
  gramExtension_generator ℍ _ _ _ _ (mpGaussianSector_dense d i) (mpNormalizedCoefficient_gram d i) z

name: SVW.mpNormalizedCoefficient_coe
statement:
theorem mpNormalizedCoefficient_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (z : ℍ) :
    mpNormalizedCoefficient d i z =ᵐ[MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure]
      (fun g : MpRoot => (mpCoefficientScale d : ℂ) * mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i z) g)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (mpCoefficientScale d : ℂ) (mpCoefficientVector d i z),
    mpCoefficientVector_coe d i z] with g hs hg
  change ((mpCoefficientScale d : ℂ) • mpCoefficientVector d i z) g = _
  rw [hs]
  change (mpCoefficientScale d : ℂ) * mpCoefficientVector d i z g = _
  rw [hg]

name: SVW.mpNormalizedCoefficient_covariant
statement:
theorem mpNormalizedCoefficient_covariant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) :
    actionL2Operator MpRoot MpRoot MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure a (mpNormalizedCoefficient d i z) =
      mpGaussianScalar d a z • mpNormalizedCoefficient d i (a.base • z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  have ht := (measurePreserving_smul a⁻¹ MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
    (mpNormalizedCoefficient_coe d i z)
  filter_upwards [actionL2Operator_coe MpRoot MpRoot MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure a
      (mpNormalizedCoefficient d i z), ht,
    Lp.coeFn_smul (mpGaussianScalar d a z) (mpNormalizedCoefficient d i (a.base • z)),
    mpNormalizedCoefficient_coe d i (a.base • z)] with g ha ht hs hz
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at ht
  rw [ha, ht, hs]
  change (mpCoefficientScale d : ℂ) * mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i z) (a⁻¹*g) =
    mpGaussianScalar d a z * mpNormalizedCoefficient d i (a.base • z) g
  rw [hz, ← mpCoefficient_covariant, mpGaussianUnitary_apply, mpGaussianOperator_generator]
  rw [mpCoefficient_eq]
  change (mpCoefficientScale d : ℂ) *
    inner ℂ (mpGaussianImage d i g UpperHalfPlane.I)
      (mpGaussianScalar d a z • mpGaussian d i (a.base • z)) = _
  rw [inner_smul_right, mpCoefficient_eq]
  simp only [mpGaussianSector]
  ring

name: SVW.mpCoefficientEmbedding_intertwines
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientEmbedding_intertwines (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot)
    (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) :
    mpCoefficientEmbedding d i (mpGaussianUnitary d i a f) =
      actionL2Operator MpRoot MpRoot MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure a (mpCoefficientEmbedding d i f)
proof:
:= by
  let T : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] MpRegularHilbert :=
    (mpCoefficientEmbedding d i).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (mpGaussianOperator d i a)
  let S : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] MpRegularHilbert :=
    (actionL2Operator MpRoot MpRoot MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure a).comp
      (mpCoefficientEmbedding d i).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hg : ∀ z : ℍ, T (mpGaussianSector d i z) = S (mpGaussianSector d i z) := by
    intro z
    change mpCoefficientEmbedding d i (mpGaussianOperator d i a (mpGaussianSector d i z)) = _
    rw [mpGaussianOperator_generator]
    change mpCoefficientEmbedding d i (mpGaussianScalar d a z • mpGaussianSector d i (a.base • z)) =
      actionL2Operator MpRoot MpRoot MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure a
        (mpCoefficientEmbedding d i (mpGaussianSector d i z))
    rw [map_smul, mpCoefficientEmbedding_generator, mpCoefficientEmbedding_generator,
      mpNormalizedCoefficient_covariant]
  have he : (T : GaussianSectorHilbert d i → MpRegularHilbert) = S := by
    apply (mpGaussianSector_dense d i).equalizer T.continuous S.continuous
    funext c
    classical
    simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, hg]
  exact congrFun he f

name: SVW.mpGaussian_upperHalfPlaneXY
statement:
theorem mpGaussian_upperHalfPlaneXY (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    mpGaussian d i (upperHalfPlaneXY x y) = coherentGaussianVector d i x y
proof:
:= by
  have hp : mpPrecision (upperHalfPlaneXY x y) = coherentPrecision x y := by
    unfold mpPrecision coherentPrecision
    rw [upperHalfPlaneXY_coe x y hy]
    ring_nf
    simp [Complex.I_sq]
  rw [coherentGaussianVector_eq d i x y hy]
  simp only [mpGaussian, hp]

name: SVW.mpGaussianPair_weight_xy
statement:
theorem mpGaussianPair_weight_xy (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℍ) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ((1/y)^2 : ℝ) • mpGaussianPair d i b c (upperHalfPlaneXY x y) =
      (y^((d:ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
        (inner ℂ (coherentGaussianVector d i x y) (mpGaussian d i b) *
          inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (coherentGaussianVector d i x y))
proof:
:= by
  have him : (upperHalfPlaneXY x y).im = y := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.im (upperHalfPlaneXY_coe x y hy)
    simpa using h
  have hw := mpCoefficientWeight_density_div d (upperHalfPlaneXY x y) (1 : Circle)
  rw [mpCoefficientWeight_norm_sq, him] at hw
  rw [mpGaussianPair, him, mpGaussian_upperHalfPlaneXY d i x y hy, smul_smul, hw]

name: SVW.integrable_mpGaussianPair
statement:
theorem integrable_mpGaussianPair (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℍ) :
    Integrable (mpGaussianPair d i b c) (volume : Measure ℍ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_prod _).mpr
  have hi := (integrable_coherentGaussian_pair d i (mpPrecision b) (mpPrecision c)
    (mpPrecision_re_pos b) (mpPrecision_re_pos c)).swap
  apply hi.congr
  have hy : ∀ᵐ v : ℝ × ℝ ∂(volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))), 0 < v.2 := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_snd)).mpr
    exact ae_of_all _ fun _ => self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi
  filter_upwards [hy] with v hv
  exact (mpGaussianPair_weight_xy d i b c v.1 v.2 hv).symm

name: SVW.integral_mpGaussianPair
statement:
theorem integral_mpGaussianPair (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℍ) :
    (∫ z : ℍ, mpGaussianPair d i b c z) =
      coherentOrthogonalityConstant d • inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (mpGaussian d i b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_upperHalfPlane_yx _ (integrable_mpGaussianPair d i b c)]
  calc
    _ = ∫ y in Ioi 0, ∫ x : ℝ, (y^((d:ℝ)/2-1) : ℝ) •
      (inner ℂ (coherentGaussianVector d i x y) (mpGaussian d i b) *
        inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (coherentGaussianVector d i x y)) := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro y hy
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => mpGaussianPair_weight_xy d i b c x y hy
    _ = _ := coherentGaussian_orthogonality d i _ _ _ _

name: SVW.mpCoefficientPair_iwasawa
statement:
theorem mpCoefficientPair_iwasawa (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    mpCoefficientPair d i b c (MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)) = mpGaussianPair d i b c z
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mpCoefficientPair, mpGaussianPair, Complex.real_smul] using
    mpCoefficient_gaussian_product_iwasawa d i b c z u

name: SVW.integrable_mpCoefficientPair
statement:
theorem integrable_mpCoefficientPair (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℍ) :
    Integrable (mpCoefficientPair d i b c) MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure
proof:
:= by
  apply (MpRoot.iwasawa_integrable_iff ℂ _).mpr
  have hi := (integrable_mpGaussianPair d i b c).comp_fst MpRoot.circleHaar
  apply hi.congr
  exact ae_of_all _ fun p => (mpCoefficientPair_iwasawa d i b c p.1 p.2).symm

name: SVW.integral_mpCoefficientPair
statement:
theorem integral_mpCoefficientPair (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℍ) :
    (∫ g : MpRoot, mpCoefficientPair d i b c g ∂MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure) =
      coherentOrthogonalityConstant d • inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (mpGaussian d i b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MpRoot.iwasawa_integral ℂ _ (integrable_mpCoefficientPair d i b c)]
  simp_rw [mpCoefficientPair_iwasawa]
  simpa using integral_mpGaussianPair d i b c

name: SVW.measurable_hyperbolicDensity
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_hyperbolicDensity : Measurable hyperbolicDensity
proof:
:= by
  unfold hyperbolicDensity
  fun_prop

name: SVW.hyperbolicDensity_coe
statement: theorem hyperbolicDensity_coe (z : ℍ) : (hyperbolicDensity z : ℝ) = (1 / z.im)^2
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.hyperbolicDensity_ne_zero
statement: theorem hyperbolicDensity_ne_zero (z : ℍ) : hyperbolicDensity z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply pow_ne_zero
  apply one_div_ne_zero
  intro h
  exact z.im_ne_zero (congrArg (fun u : ℝ≥0 => (u : ℝ)) h)

name: SVW.upperHalfPlaneLebesgue_preserving
statement:
theorem upperHalfPlaneLebesgue_preserving :
    MeasurePreserving UpperHalfPlane.coe upperHalfPlaneLebesgue
      (volume.restrict UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨UpperHalfPlane.measurable_coe, ?_⟩
  rw [upperHalfPlaneLebesgue, UpperHalfPlane.measurableEmbedding_coe.map_comap,
    UpperHalfPlane.range_coe]

name: SVW.measurable_upperHalfPlane_ofComplex
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_upperHalfPlane_ofComplex : Measurable UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex
proof:
:= by
  apply UpperHalfPlane.measurableEmbedding_coe.measurable_comp_iff.mp
  have heq : (UpperHalfPlane.coe ∘ UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex) =
      fun z : ℂ => if 0 < z.im then z else ((Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty ℍ) : ℍ) : ℂ) := by
    funext z
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply_eq_ite]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const (by fun_prop)) measurable_id measurable_const

name: SVW.lintegral_upperHalfPlane_complex
statement:
theorem lintegral_upperHalfPlane_complex (f : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫⁻ z : ℂ in UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / z.im)^2) * f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫⁻ z, f z ∂upperHalfPlaneLebesgue.withDensity (fun z => ↑(hyperbolicDensity z))) = _
  rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul_non_measurable _
    measurable_hyperbolicDensity.coe_nnreal_ennreal (ae_of_all _ fun z => ENNReal.coe_lt_top)]
  have h := upperHalfPlaneLebesgue_preserving.lintegral_comp_emb
    UpperHalfPlane.measurableEmbedding_coe
    (fun z : ℂ => ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / z.im)^2) * f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
  simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply, UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, ← hyperbolicDensity_coe,
    ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using h

name: SVW.measurable_upperHalfPlaneXY
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_upperHalfPlaneXY : Measurable (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => upperHalfPlaneXY xy.1 xy.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperHalfPlaneXY
  fun_prop

name: SVW.upperHalfPlaneXY_coe
statement:
theorem upperHalfPlaneXY_coe (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (upperHalfPlaneXY x y : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ)*Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperHalfPlaneXY, UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos (by simpa using hy)]

name: SVW.lintegral_upperHalfPlane_prod
statement:
theorem lintegral_upperHalfPlane_prod (f : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫⁻ xy : ℝ × ℝ,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / xy.2)^2) * f (upperHalfPlaneXY xy.1 xy.2)
        ∂(volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_upperHalfPlane_complex]
  have h := (Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm
    Complex.measurableEquivRealProd).setLIntegral_comp_preimage_emb
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm.measurableEmbedding
      (fun z : ℂ => ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / z.im)^2) * f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
      UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet
  have hset : Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm ⁻¹' UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet =
      (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi 0 := by ext xy; simp
  rw [hset] at h
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← Measure.prod_restrict, Measure.restrict_univ] at h
  convert! h.symm using 1
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro xy
  congr 2
  apply congrArg UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.measurableEquivRealProd_symm_apply]

name: SVW.lintegral_upperHalfPlane_yx
statement:
theorem lintegral_upperHalfPlane_yx (f : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫⁻ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ x : ℝ,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / y)^2) * f (upperHalfPlaneXY x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_upperHalfPlane_prod, lintegral_prod_symm]
  exact (Measurable.mul (by fun_prop) (hf.comp measurable_upperHalfPlaneXY)).aemeasurable

name: SVW.lintegral_upperHalfPlane_xy
statement:
theorem lintegral_upperHalfPlane_xy (f : ℍ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫⁻ x : ℝ, ∫⁻ y : ℝ in Ioi 0,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / y)^2) * f (upperHalfPlaneXY x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_upperHalfPlane_prod, lintegral_prod]
  exact (Measurable.mul (by fun_prop) (hf.comp measurable_upperHalfPlaneXY)).aemeasurable

name: SVW.integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_complex
statement:
theorem integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_complex (f : ℍ → E) :
    Integrable f (volume : Measure ℍ) ↔
      IntegrableOn (fun z : ℂ => ((1 / z.im)^2) • f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
        UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet volume
proof:
:= by
  change Integrable f (upperHalfPlaneLebesgue.withDensity (fun z => ↑(hyperbolicDensity z))) ↔ _
  rw [integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_coe_smul measurable_hyperbolicDensity]
  have h := upperHalfPlaneLebesgue_preserving.integrable_comp_emb
    UpperHalfPlane.measurableEmbedding_coe
    (g := fun z : ℂ => ((1 / z.im)^2) • f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
  simpa only [IntegrableOn, Function.comp_def, UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply, UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, hyperbolicDensity_coe] using h

name: SVW.integral_upperHalfPlane_complex
statement:
theorem integral_upperHalfPlane_complex (f : ℍ → E) :
    (∫ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫ z : ℂ in UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet,
      ((1 / z.im)^2) • f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ z, f z ∂upperHalfPlaneLebesgue.withDensity (fun z => ↑(hyperbolicDensity z))) = _
  rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul measurable_hyperbolicDensity]
  have h := upperHalfPlaneLebesgue_preserving.integral_comp
    UpperHalfPlane.measurableEmbedding_coe
    (fun z : ℂ => ((1 / z.im)^2) • f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
  simpa only [UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply, UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, NNReal.smul_def, hyperbolicDensity_coe] using h

name: SVW.complexRealProd_symm_xy
statement:
private theorem complexRealProd_symm_xy (xy : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm xy = (xy.1 : ℂ) + (xy.2 : ℂ)*Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp

name: SVW.complexRealProd_preimage_upperHalfPlane
proof: := by ext xy; simp

name: SVW.integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_prod
statement:
theorem integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_prod (f : ℍ → E) :
    Integrable f (volume : Measure ℍ) ↔
      Integrable (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 / xy.2)^2) • f (upperHalfPlaneXY xy.1 xy.2))
        (volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_complex]
  have h := (Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm
    Complex.measurableEquivRealProd).integrableOn_comp_preimage
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm.measurableEmbedding
      (f := fun z : ℂ => ((1 / z.im)^2) • f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
      (s := UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet)
  rw [complexRealProd_preimage_upperHalfPlane] at h
  simp only [IntegrableOn, Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← Measure.prod_restrict, Measure.restrict_univ,
    Function.comp_def, complexRealProd_symm_xy, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero,
    add_zero, zero_add] at h
  simpa only [IntegrableOn, upperHalfPlaneXY] using h.symm

name: SVW.integral_upperHalfPlane_prod
statement:
theorem integral_upperHalfPlane_prod (f : ℍ → E) :
    (∫ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫ xy : ℝ × ℝ,
      ((1 / xy.2)^2) • f (upperHalfPlaneXY xy.1 xy.2)
        ∂(volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_upperHalfPlane_complex]
  have h := ((Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm
    Complex.measurableEquivRealProd).restrict_preimage_emb
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm.measurableEmbedding
      UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet).integral_comp
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm.measurableEmbedding
      (fun z : ℂ => ((1 / z.im)^2) • f (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))
  rw [complexRealProd_preimage_upperHalfPlane, Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← Measure.prod_restrict,
    Measure.restrict_univ] at h
  simpa only [complexRealProd_symm_xy, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add,
    upperHalfPlaneXY] using h.symm

name: SVW.integral_upperHalfPlane_yx
statement:
theorem integral_upperHalfPlane_yx (f : ℍ → E) (hf : Integrable f (volume : Measure ℍ)) :
    (∫ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, ∫ x : ℝ,
      ((1 / y)^2) • f (upperHalfPlaneXY x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_upperHalfPlane_prod]
  exact integral_prod_symm _ ((integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_prod f).mp hf)

name: SVW.integral_upperHalfPlane_xy
statement:
theorem integral_upperHalfPlane_xy (f : ℍ → E) (hf : Integrable f (volume : Measure ℍ)) :
    (∫ z : ℍ, f z) = ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0,
      ((1 / y)^2) • f (upperHalfPlaneXY x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_upperHalfPlane_prod]
  exact integral_prod _ ((integrable_upperHalfPlane_iff_prod f).mp hf)

name: SVW.gammaLaplaceIntegrand_norm
statement:
theorem gammaLaplaceIntegrand_norm (p : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ‖gammaLaplaceIntegrand p z t‖ = t^(p-1) * exp (-z.re*t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gammaLaplaceIntegrand, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos ht _), Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
    mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: SVW.integrableOn_gammaLaplace_majorant
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gammaLaplace_majorant (p r : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t^(p-1)*exp (-r*t)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using!
    (integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow (p := (1 : ℝ)) (s := p-1)
      (b := r) (by linarith) (by norm_num) hr)

name: SVW.gammaLaplaceIntegrand_aestronglyMeasurable
statement:
theorem gammaLaplaceIntegrand_aestronglyMeasurable (p : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (gammaLaplaceIntegrand p z)
      (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))
proof:
:= by
  unfold gammaLaplaceIntegrand
  exact ((measurable_id.pow_const (p-1)).smul (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable

name: SVW.integrableOn_gammaLaplaceIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gammaLaplaceIntegrand (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    IntegrableOn (gammaLaplaceIntegrand p z) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrableOn_gammaLaplace_majorant p z.re hp hz).mono'
    (gammaLaplaceIntegrand_aestronglyMeasurable p z)
  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
  exact (gammaLaplaceIntegrand_norm p z t ht).le

name: SVW.hasDerivAt_gammaLaplaceIntegrand
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_gammaLaplaceIntegrand (p : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => gammaLaplaceIntegrand p w t)
      ((-t : ℂ)*gammaLaplaceIntegrand p z t) z
proof:
:= by
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_id z).neg.mul_const (t : ℂ)).cexp).const_smul (t^(p-1) : ℝ)
  convert! h using 1
  simp only [gammaLaplaceIntegrand, Complex.real_smul, one_mul, neg_mul, Pi.neg_apply, id_eq]
  ring

name: SVW.differentiableAt_gammaLaplace
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_gammaLaplace (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (gammaLaplace p) z
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℂ := {w | z.re/2 < w.re}
  have hs : s ∈ nhds z := (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds
    (by dsimp [s]; linarith)
  have hb : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t^p*exp (-(z.re/2)*t)) (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using!
      integrableOn_gammaLaplace_majorant (p+1) (z.re/2) (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => (-t : ℂ))
      (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by fun_prop
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (F := gammaLaplaceIntegrand p)
    (F' := fun w t => (-t : ℂ)*gammaLaplaceIntegrand p w t)
    (bound := fun t : ℝ => t^p*exp (-(z.re/2)*t)) hs
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (gammaLaplaceIntegrand_aestronglyMeasurable p))
    (integrableOn_gammaLaplaceIntegrand p hp z hz)
    (hm.mul (gammaLaplaceIntegrand_aestronglyMeasurable p z))
    (by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      intro w hw
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht,
        gammaLaplaceIntegrand_norm p w t ht]
      have he : t*t^(p-1) = t^p := by
        nth_rw 1 [← rpow_one t]
        rw [← rpow_add ht]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [← mul_assoc, he]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (rpow_pos_of_pos ht p).le
      apply exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hw' : z.re/2 < w.re := hw
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (neg_le_neg hw'.le) (le_of_lt ht))
    hb
    (ae_of_all _ (fun t w _ => hasDerivAt_gammaLaplaceIntegrand p w t))
  exact h.2.differentiableAt

name: SVW.gammaLaplace_ofReal
statement:
theorem gammaLaplace_ofReal (p r : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) :
    gammaLaplace p (r : ℂ) = ((1/r : ℂ)^(p : ℂ)) * (Gamma p : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gammaLaplace
  calc
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, gammaLaplaceIntegrand p (r : ℂ) t) =
        ((∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, t^(p-1)*exp (-(r*t)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro t ht
      simp only [gammaLaplaceIntegrand, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul,
        Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_neg]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi hp hr, Complex.ofReal_mul,
        Complex.ofReal_cpow (by positivity), Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_one]

name: SVW.gammaLaplace_eq
statement:
theorem gammaLaplace_eq (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    gammaLaplace p z = (1/z)^(p : ℂ) * (Gamma p : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set ℂ := {w | 0 < w.re}
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
  have hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (gammaLaplace p) U := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd _ hU
    intro w hw
    exact (differentiableAt_gammaLaplace p hp w hw).differentiableWithinAt
  have hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (1/w)^(p : ℂ)*(Gamma p : ℂ)) U := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd _ hU
    intro w hw
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h, U] at hw
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    apply DifferentiableAt.mul_const
    apply DifferentiableAt.cpow_const
    · exact (differentiableAt_const (c := (1 : ℂ))).div (differentiableAt_id) hw0
    · rw [one_div, Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
      apply Or.inl
      rw [Complex.inv_re]
      exact div_pos hw (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hw0)
  have ht : Tendsto Complex.ofReal (nhdsWithin (1 : ℝ) (Ioi 1))
      (nhdsWithin (1 : ℂ) ({1}ᶜ)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one] using!
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (1 : ℝ)).mono_left inf_le_left
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
      simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
      exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hr)
  have he : ∃ᶠ w in nhdsWithin (1 : ℂ) ({1}ᶜ),
      gammaLaplace p w = (1/w)^(p : ℂ)*(Gamma p : ℂ) := by
    apply ht.frequently
    apply Filter.Eventually.frequently
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    exact gammaLaplace_ofReal p r hp (by have hr' : (1 : ℝ) < r := hr; linarith)
  exact hf.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq hg
    (convex_halfSpace_re_gt 0).isPreconnected (by simp [U]) he hz

name: SVW.gammaFourierProfile_eq_indicator
statement:
theorem gammaFourierProfile_eq_indicator (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (b : ℂ) :
    gammaFourierProfile p b = (Ioi 0).indicator (gammaLaplaceIntegrand p b)
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  by_cases ht : 0 < t
  · simp [gammaFourierProfile, gammaLaplaceIntegrand, ht, max_eq_left ht.le]
  · have htp : p-1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    simp [gammaFourierProfile, ht, max_eq_right (le_of_not_gt ht), zero_rpow htp]

name: SVW.continuous_gammaFourierProfile
statement:
theorem continuous_gammaFourierProfile (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (b : ℂ) :
    Continuous (gammaFourierProfile p b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gammaFourierProfile
  exact ((continuous_rpow_const (by linarith : 0 ≤ p-1)).comp
    (continuous_id.max continuous_const)).smul (by fun_prop)

name: SVW.integrable_gammaFourierProfile
statement:
theorem integrable_gammaFourierProfile (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) : Integrable (gammaFourierProfile p b) volume
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaFourierProfile_eq_indicator p hp b, integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Ioi]
  exact integrableOn_gammaLaplaceIntegrand p (by linarith) b hb

name: SVW.fourier_gammaFourierProfile
statement:
theorem fourier_gammaFourierProfile (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (b : ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    𝓕 (gammaFourierProfile p b) x = gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq', gammaFourierProfile_eq_indicator p hp b]
  unfold gammaLaplace
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  by_cases ht : 0 < t
  · simp only [indicator_of_mem (show t ∈ Ioi 0 from ht),
      gammaLaplaceIntegrand, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 2
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply,
      conj_trivial, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
    ring
  · simp [indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Ioi 0 from ht)]

name: SVW.fourier_gammaFourierProfile_eq
statement:
theorem fourier_gammaFourierProfile_eq (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (x : ℝ) :
    𝓕 (gammaFourierProfile p b) x =
      (1/(b+(2*π*Complex.I)*x))^(p : ℂ)*(Gamma p : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_gammaFourierProfile, gammaLaplace_eq p (by linarith)]
  · simpa using hb
  · exact hp

name: SVW.scalar_fourier_parseval_of_integrable
statement:
theorem scalar_fourier_parseval_of_integrable (f g : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable f volume) (hg : Integrable g volume)
    (hFg : Integrable (𝓕 g) volume) (hgc : Continuous g) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (𝓕 f x) (𝓕 g x)) = ∫ t : ℝ, inner ℂ (f t) (g t)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (𝓕 f x) (𝓕 g x)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, inner ℂ (f t) (𝓕⁻ (𝓕 g) t) := by
    simpa using!
      (VectorFourier.integral_sesq_fourierIntegral_eq_neg_flip (innerSL ℂ)
        (L := innerₗ ℝ) Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner hf hFg)
  rw [hh]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [hg.fourierInv_fourier_eq hFg hgc.continuousAt]

name: SVW.gammaFourierProfile_inner
statement:
theorem gammaFourierProfile_inner (p : ℝ) (b c : ℂ) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    inner ℂ (gammaFourierProfile p b t) (gammaFourierProfile p c t) =
      gammaLaplaceIntegrand (2*p-1) (star b+c) t
proof:
:= by
  have he : t^(p-1)*t^(p-1) = t^(2*p-1-1) := by
    rw [← rpow_add ht]
    congr 1
    ring
  simp only [gammaFourierProfile, max_eq_left ht.le, Complex.real_smul,
    RCLike.inner_apply', map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, gammaLaplaceIntegrand,
    Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_neg, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  calc
    _ = ((t^(p-1)*t^(p-1) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (-(starRingEnd ℂ b)*t)*Complex.exp (-c*t)) := by push_cast; ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [he, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.integral_gammaFourierProfile_inner
statement:
theorem integral_gammaFourierProfile_inner (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (b c : ℂ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, inner ℂ (gammaFourierProfile p b t) (gammaFourierProfile p c t)) =
      gammaLaplace (2*p-1) (star b+c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gammaLaplace
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  by_cases ht : 0 < t
  · rw [indicator_of_mem (show t ∈ Ioi 0 from ht)]
    exact gammaFourierProfile_inner p b c t ht
  · simp only [gammaFourierProfile_eq_indicator p hp,
      indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Ioi 0 from ht), inner_zero_left]

name: SVW.cpow_positive_real_mul
statement:
theorem cpow_positive_real_mul (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (z q : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ((r : ℂ)*z)^q = (r : ℂ)^q*z^q
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne'
  rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hr0 hz),
    Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hr0, Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hz,
    Complex.log_ofReal_mul hr hz, ← Complex.ofReal_log hr.le, add_mul, Complex.exp_add]

name: SVW.coherentLaplaceConstant_pos
statement: theorem coherentLaplaceConstant_pos (d : ℕ) : 0 < coherentLaplaceConstant d
proof:
:= by
  unfold coherentLaplaceConstant
  positivity

name: SVW.gaussianGram_eq_laplace
statement:
theorem gaussianGram_eq_laplace (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    (1/(2*z))*(π/z)^(α : ℂ) =
      ((π^α/(2*Gamma (α+1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)*gammaLaplace (α+1) z
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hz
  have hi0 : (1/z : ℂ) ≠ 0 := one_div_ne_zero hz0
  have hΓ : (Gamma (α+1) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)).ne'
  have hpi : (π/z : ℂ) = (π : ℂ)*(1/z) := by ring
  rw [hpi, cpow_positive_real_mul π pi_pos _ _ hi0,
    ← Complex.ofReal_cpow pi_pos.le, gammaLaplace_eq (α+1) (by linarith) z hz]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_one]
  rw [Complex.cpow_add _ _ hi0, Complex.cpow_one]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_inner_laplace
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_inner_laplace (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc) =
      coherentLaplaceKernel d (star b+c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteGaussianVector_inner]
  have hz : 0 < (star b+c).re := by simpa using add_pos hb hc
  simpa only [coherentLaplaceKernel, coherentLaplaceConstant,
    Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_natCast, Complex.ofReal_ofNat] using!
      gaussianGram_eq_laplace ((d : ℝ)/2) (by positivity) (star b+c) hz

name: SVW.coherentPrecision_re
statement: theorem coherentPrecision_re (x y : ℝ) : (coherentPrecision x y).re = π*y
proof:
:= by
  simp [coherentPrecision]

name: SVW.coherentPrecision_re_pos
statement: theorem coherentPrecision_re_pos (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : 0 < (coherentPrecision x y).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentPrecision_re]
  exact mul_pos pi_pos hy

name: SVW.coherentGaussianVector_eq
statement:
theorem coherentGaussianVector_eq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    coherentGaussianVector d i x y = hermiteGaussianVector d i (coherentPrecision x y)
      (coherentPrecision_re_pos x y hy)
proof: := by simp [coherentGaussianVector, hy]

name: SVW.coherentGaussianVector_inner_laplace
statement:
theorem coherentGaussianVector_inner_laplace (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re)
    (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    inner ℂ (coherentGaussianVector d i x y) (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) =
      coherentLaplaceKernel d (b+π*y+π*Complex.I*x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentGaussianVector_eq d i x y hy, hermiteGaussianVector_inner_laplace]
  congr 1
  simp only [coherentPrecision, map_sub, map_mul, Complex.star_def,
    Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
  ring

name: SVW.coherentGaussianVector_inner_reverse_laplace
statement:
theorem coherentGaussianVector_inner_reverse_laplace (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (c : ℂ) (hc : 0 < c.re) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc) (coherentGaussianVector d i x y) =
      star (coherentLaplaceKernel d (c+π*y+π*Complex.I*x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inner_conj_symm, coherentGaussianVector_inner_laplace d i c hc x y hy]
  rfl

name: SVW.integrable_fourier_gammaFourierProfile
statement:
theorem integrable_fourier_gammaFourierProfile (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) : Integrable (𝓕 (gammaFourierProfile p b)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_laplacePowerKernel b p hb hp).mul_const (Gamma p : ℂ)).congr
  exact ae_of_all _ fun x => (fourier_gammaFourierProfile_eq p hp b hb x).symm

name: SVW.memLp_two_fourier_gammaFourierProfile
statement:
theorem memLp_two_fourier_gammaFourierProfile (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) : MemLp (𝓕 (gammaFourierProfile p b)) 2 volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((memLp_laplacePowerKernel_two b p hb (by linarith)).mul_const (Gamma p : ℂ)).ae_eq
  exact ae_of_all _ fun x => (fourier_gammaFourierProfile_eq p hp b hb x).symm

name: SVW.scalar_integrable_inner_of_memLp_two
statement:
theorem scalar_integrable_inner_of_memLp_two (f g : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (hg : MemLp g 2 volume) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => inner ℂ (f x) (g x)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (L2.integrable_inner (hf.toLp f) (hg.toLp g)).congr
  filter_upwards [hf.coeFn_toLp, hg.coeFn_toLp] with x hx hy
  rw [hx, hy]

name: SVW.integral_gammaLaplace_inner
statement:
theorem integral_gammaLaplace_inner (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*x))
      (gammaLaplace p (c+(2*π*Complex.I)*x))) = gammaLaplace (2*p-1) (star b+c)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← fourier_gammaFourierProfile p hp]
  rw [scalar_fourier_parseval_of_integrable _ _
    (integrable_gammaFourierProfile p hp b hb)
    (integrable_gammaFourierProfile p hp c hc)
    (integrable_fourier_gammaFourierProfile p hp c hc)
    (continuous_gammaFourierProfile p hp c)]
  exact integral_gammaFourierProfile_inner p hp b c

name: SVW.integrable_gammaLaplace_inner
statement:
theorem integrable_gammaLaplace_inner (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*x))
      (gammaLaplace p (c+(2*π*Complex.I)*x))) volume
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← fourier_gammaFourierProfile p hp]
  exact scalar_integrable_inner_of_memLp_two _ _
    (memLp_two_fourier_gammaFourierProfile p hp b hb)
    (memLp_two_fourier_gammaFourierProfile p hp c hc)

name: SVW.integral_gammaLaplace_inner_half
statement:
theorem integral_gammaLaplace_inner_half (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+π*Complex.I*x))
      (gammaLaplace p (c+π*Complex.I*x))) = (2 : ℝ) • gammaLaplace (2*p-1) (star b+c)
proof:
:= by
  have he (w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : w+(2*π*Complex.I)*(x/2 : ℝ) = w+π*Complex.I*x := by
    push_cast
    ring
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*(x/2 : ℝ)))
        (gammaLaplace p (c+(2*π*Complex.I)*(x/2 : ℝ))) := by simp_rw [he]
    _ = _ := by
      have hdiv := Measure.integral_comp_div (fun t : ℝ =>
        inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*t))
          (gammaLaplace p (c+(2*π*Complex.I)*t))) (2 : ℝ)
      have hdiv' : (∫ x : ℝ, inner ℂ
          (gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*(x/2 : ℝ)))
          (gammaLaplace p (c+(2*π*Complex.I)*(x/2 : ℝ)))) =
          (2 : ℝ) • (∫ t : ℝ, inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+(2*π*Complex.I)*t))
            (gammaLaplace p (c+(2*π*Complex.I)*t))) := by
        simpa only [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)] using! hdiv
      rw [hdiv', integral_gammaLaplace_inner p hp b c hb hc]

name: SVW.integrable_gammaLaplace_inner_half
statement:
theorem integrable_gammaLaplace_inner_half (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => inner ℂ (gammaLaplace p (b+π*Complex.I*x))
      (gammaLaplace p (c+π*Complex.I*x))) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (integrable_gammaLaplace_inner p hp b c hb hc).comp_mul_left'
    (by norm_num : (1/2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  convert! hi using 1
  funext x
  congr 2 <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: SVW.mpBase_ext_of_point_denom
statement:
theorem mpBase_ext_of_point_denom (g h : MpBase)
    (hz : g • UpperHalfPlane.I = h • UpperHalfPlane.I)
    (hd : mpDenom g UpperHalfPlane.I = mpDenom h UpperHalfPlane.I) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  have hden (a : MpBase) : mpDenom a UpperHalfPlane.I =
      (a 1 1 : ℂ) + (a 1 0 : ℂ)*Complex.I := by simp [mpDenom, add_comm]
  have hc : g 1 0 = h 1 0 := by
    have hi := congrArg Complex.im hd
    simpa [hden] using hi
  have hdd : g 1 1 = h 1 1 := by
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re hd
    simpa [hden] using hr
  have hn (a : MpBase) : ((a • UpperHalfPlane.I : ℍ) : ℂ) * mpDenom a UpperHalfPlane.I =
      (a 0 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I + (a 0 1 : ℂ) := by
    rw [UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, UpperHalfPlane.coe_I, mpDenom] using
      div_mul_cancel₀ ((a 0 0 : ℂ)*Complex.I+(a 0 1 : ℂ))
        (mpDenom_ne_zero a UpperHalfPlane.I)
  have he : (g 0 0 : ℂ)*Complex.I+(g 0 1 : ℂ) =
      (h 0 0 : ℂ)*Complex.I+(h 0 1 : ℂ) := by rw [← hn g, ← hn h, hz, hd]
  have ha : g 0 0 = h 0 0 := by simpa using congrArg Complex.im he
  have hb : g 0 1 = h 0 1 := by simpa using congrArg Complex.re he
  apply Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.ext
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> assumption

name: SVW.mpCircleBase_denom
statement: theorem mpCircleBase_denom (u : Circle) : mpDenom (mpCircleBase u) UpperHalfPlane.I = (u:ℂ)^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold mpDenom mpCircleBase
  simp only [UpperHalfPlane.coe_I, Matrix.of_apply,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Fin.isValue]
  simpa only [add_comm] using Complex.re_add_im ((u:ℂ)^2)

name: SVW.mpCircleBase_smul_I
statement: theorem mpCircleBase_smul_I (u : Circle) : mpCircleBase u • UpperHalfPlane.I = UpperHalfPlane.I
proof:
:= by
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ext
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
  apply (div_eq_iff (mpDenom_ne_zero (mpCircleBase u) UpperHalfPlane.I)).mpr
  simp [mpDenom, mpCircleBase, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]

name: SVW.MpRoot.circleLift_base
statement: @[simp] theorem circleLift_base (u : Circle) : (circleLift u).base = mpCircleBase u
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.circleLift_root
statement: @[simp] theorem circleLift_root (u : Circle) : (circleLift u).root = (u:ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionRoot_pos
statement: theorem sectionRoot_pos (z : ℍ) : 0 < sectionRoot z
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionRoot
  exact one_div_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr z.im_pos))

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionRoot_sq
statement: theorem sectionRoot_sq (z : ℍ) : sectionRoot z ^ 2 = 1 / Real.sqrt z.im
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionRoot
  rw [div_pow, one_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionLift_base
statement: @[simp] theorem sectionLift_base (z : ℍ) : (sectionLift z).base = z.toSL2R
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionLift_root
statement: @[simp] theorem sectionLift_root (z : ℍ) : (sectionLift z).root = (sectionRoot z : ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionLift_smul_I
statement: @[simp] theorem sectionLift_smul_I (z : ℍ) : (sectionLift z).base • UpperHalfPlane.I = z
proof:
:=
  UpperHalfPlane.toSL2R_smul_I z

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionLift_automorphy
statement: theorem sectionLift_automorphy (z w : ℍ) : (sectionLift z).automorphy w = (sectionRoot z : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := automorphy_unique (sectionLift z) (fun _ => (sectionRoot z : ℂ)) continuous_const
    (fun v => by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, sectionRoot_sq]
      simp [mpDenom, UpperHalfPlane.coe_toSL2R]) rfl
  exact (congrFun h w).symm

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_sectionLift
statement: theorem continuous_sectionLift : Continuous sectionLift
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact UpperHalfPlane.continuous_toSL2R.prodMk
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.div
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp UpperHalfPlane.continuous_im))
      (fun z => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr z.im_pos)).ne')))

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_circleLift
statement: theorem continuous_circleLift : Continuous circleLift
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  have hb : Continuous mpCircleBase := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    fun_prop
  exact hb.prodMk continuous_subtype_val

name: SVW.MpRoot.fromIwasawa_point
statement: theorem fromIwasawa_point (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) : (fromIwasawa (z,u)).point = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [point, fromIwasawa, base_mul, mul_smul, circleLift_base,
    mpCircleBase_smul_I, sectionLift_smul_I]

name: SVW.MpRoot.fromIwasawa_root
statement:
theorem fromIwasawa_root (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    (fromIwasawa (z,u)).root = (sectionRoot z : ℂ) * (u:ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fromIwasawa, root_mul, sectionLift_automorphy, circleLift_root]

name: SVW.MpRoot.fromIwasawa_phase
statement: theorem fromIwasawa_phase (z : ℍ) (u : Circle) : (fromIwasawa (z,u)).phase = u
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (fromIwasawa (z,u)).root / (‖(fromIwasawa (z,u)).root‖ : ℂ) = (u:ℂ)
  rw [fromIwasawa_root, norm_mul, Circle.norm_coe, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (sectionRoot_pos z)]
  have h : (sectionRoot z : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (sectionRoot_pos z).ne'
  exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h

name: SVW.MpRoot.point_im
statement: theorem point_im (a : MpRoot) : a.point.im = 1 / ‖a.root‖^4
proof:
:= by
  have hi := UpperHalfPlane.im_smul_eq_div_normSq
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ a.base) UpperHalfPlane.I
  have hd : Complex.normSq (mpDenom a.base UpperHalfPlane.I) = ‖a.root‖^4 := by
    rw [← a.root_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, norm_pow]
    ring
  have hm : a.point.im = 1 / Complex.normSq (mpDenom a.base UpperHalfPlane.I) := by
    simpa [point, mpDenom, UpperHalfPlane.denom] using! hi
  rw [hd] at hm
  exact hm

name: SVW.MpRoot.sectionRoot_point
statement: theorem sectionRoot_point (a : MpRoot) : sectionRoot a.point = ‖a.root‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionRoot, point_im]
  simp only [one_div, Real.sqrt_inv]
  rw [show ‖a.root‖^4 = (‖a.root‖^2)^2 by ring, Real.sqrt_sq (sq_nonneg _),
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), inv_inv]

name: SVW.MpRoot.fromIwasawa_coordinates
statement: theorem fromIwasawa_coordinates (a : MpRoot) : fromIwasawa (a.point, a.phase) = a
proof:
:= by
  apply MpRoot.ext
  · apply mpBase_ext_of_point_denom
    · exact fromIwasawa_point _ _
    · rw [← MpRoot.root_sq, ← MpRoot.root_sq, fromIwasawa_root, sectionRoot_point]
      congr 1
      change (‖a.root‖ : ℂ) * (a.root / (‖a.root‖ : ℂ)) = a.root
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by exact_mod_cast (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr a.root_ne_zero))
  · rw [fromIwasawa_root, sectionRoot_point]
    change (‖a.root‖ : ℂ) * (a.root / (‖a.root‖ : ℂ)) = a.root
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by exact_mod_cast (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr a.root_ne_zero))

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_point
statement: theorem continuous_point : Continuous point
proof:
:=
  continuous_base.smul continuous_const

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_phase
statement: theorem continuous_phase : Continuous phase
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_root.div (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_root.norm)
    (fun a => by exact_mod_cast (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr a.root_ne_zero))

name: SVW.MpRoot.continuous_fromIwasawa
statement: theorem continuous_fromIwasawa : Continuous fromIwasawa
proof:
:=
  (continuous_sectionLift.comp continuous_fst).mul (continuous_circleLift.comp continuous_snd)

name: SVW.mpCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem mpCoefficient_eq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) (g : MpRoot) :
    mpCoefficient d i f g = inner ℂ (mpGaussianImage d i g UpperHalfPlane.I) (f : Hilbert d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mpCoefficient
  rw [mpGaussianUnitary_apply, mpGaussianOperator_generator]
  rfl

name: SVW.mpCoefficient_continuous
statement:
theorem mpCoefficient_continuous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) :
    Continuous (mpCoefficient d i f)
proof:
:= by
  have him : Continuous (fun g : MpRoot => mpGaussianImage d i g UpperHalfPlane.I) :=
    Continuous.uncurry_right (f := mpGaussianImage d i) UpperHalfPlane.I
      (mpGaussianImage_continuous d i)
  have hc : Continuous (fun g : MpRoot => inner ℂ
      (mpGaussianImage d i g UpperHalfPlane.I) (f : Hilbert d)) := him.inner continuous_const
  have he : mpCoefficient d i f = fun g : MpRoot =>
      inner ℂ (mpGaussianImage d i g UpperHalfPlane.I) (f : Hilbert d) :=
    funext (mpCoefficient_eq d i f)
  rw [he]
  exact hc

name: SVW.mpCoefficient_covariant
statement:
theorem mpCoefficient_covariant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
    (a g : MpRoot) :
    mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianUnitary d i a f) g = mpCoefficient d i f (a⁻¹*g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (mpGaussianUnitary d i a).inner_map_map
    (mpGaussianUnitary d i (a⁻¹*g) (mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I)) f
  rw [← mpGaussianUnitary_mul_apply, mul_inv_cancel_left] at h
  exact h

name: SVW.mpCoefficient_gaussian
statement:
theorem mpCoefficient_gaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (w : ℍ) (g : MpRoot) :
    mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i w) g =
      star ((g.root^(d+2))⁻¹) * inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i g.point) (mpGaussian d i w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mpCoefficient_eq]
  simp only [mpGaussianImage, mpGaussianScalar, MpRoot.automorphy_I, inner_smul_left]
  rfl

name: SVW.mpCoefficient_gaussian_product_iwasawa
statement:
theorem mpCoefficient_gaussian_product_iwasawa (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c z : ℍ) (u : Circle) :
    star (mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i c) (MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u))) *
      mpCoefficient d i (mpGaussianSector d i b) (MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)) =
        ((z.im^((d:ℝ)/2+1) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i z) (mpGaussian d i b) *
            inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (mpGaussian d i z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mpCoefficient_gaussian, mpCoefficient_gaussian, MpRoot.fromIwasawa_point]
  simp only [star_mul, star_star]
  have hi : star (inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i z) (mpGaussian d i c)) =
      inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (mpGaussian d i z) :=
    inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) (mpGaussian d i c) (mpGaussian d i z)
  rw [hi]
  calc
    _ = (star (((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹) *
        (((MpRoot.fromIwasawa (z,u)).root^(d+2))⁻¹)) *
      (inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i z) (mpGaussian d i b) *
        inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i c) (mpGaussian d i z)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [mpCoefficientWeight_star_mul]

name: SVW.cartanCoefficientDensity_nonneg
statement:
theorem cartanCoefficientDensity_nonneg (p t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ cartanCoefficientDensity p t
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (rpow_nonneg (cosh_pos t).le _) (sinh_nonneg_iff.mpr (by linarith))

name: SVW.cartanCoefficientDensity_bound
statement:
theorem cartanCoefficientDensity_bound (p t : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    cartanCoefficientDensity p t ≤ (2:ℝ)^(2*p) * exp ((2-2*p)*t)
proof:
:= by
  have hcosh : exp t / 2 ≤ cosh t := by
    rw [cosh_eq]
    linarith [exp_pos (-t)]
  have hsinh : sinh (2*t) ≤ exp (2*t) := by
    rw [sinh_eq]
    linarith [exp_pos (2*t), exp_pos (-(2*t))]
  have hrpow : cosh t ^ (-2*p) ≤ (exp t/2)^(-2*p) :=
    rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hcosh (by linarith)
  calc
    cartanCoefficientDensity p t ≤ (exp t/2)^(-2*p) * exp (2*t) :=
      mul_le_mul hrpow hsinh (sinh_nonneg_iff.mpr (by linarith)) (by positivity)
    _ = (2:ℝ)^(2*p) * exp ((2-2*p)*t) := by
      rw [div_rpow (exp_pos t).le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2), ← exp_mul]
      simp only [neg_mul]
      rw [rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2), div_inv_eq_mul]
      rw [mul_right_comm, ← exp_add, mul_comm]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.cartanCoefficientDensity_integrable
statement:
theorem cartanCoefficientDensity_integrable (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    IntegrableOn (cartanCoefficientDensity p) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmajor : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (2:ℝ)^(2*p)*exp ((2-2*p)*t)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 2-2*p < 0) 0).const_mul _
  apply hmajor.mono'
  · apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold cartanCoefficientDensity
    exact (continuous_cosh.rpow_const (fun t => Or.inl (cosh_pos t).ne')).mul
      (continuous_sinh.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (cartanCoefficientDensity_nonneg p t ht.le)]
    exact cartanCoefficientDensity_bound p t hp ht.le

name: SVW.oscillator_cartan_integrable
statement:
theorem oscillator_cartan_integrable (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    IntegrableOn (cartanCoefficientDensity ((d:ℝ)/2+1)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  cartanCoefficientDensity_integrable _ (by
    have h : (1:ℝ)≤d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    linarith)

name: SVW.orbitSaturation_measurable
statement:
theorem orbitSaturation_measurable (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X]
    (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) : MeasurableSet (orbitSaturation Γ X s)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : orbitSaturation Γ X s = ⋃ g : Γ, (fun x : X => g • x) ⁻¹' s := by
    ext x
    simp [orbitSaturation]
  rw [heq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun g => hs.preimage (measurable_const_smul g))

name: SVW.orbitSaturation_smul_iff
statement:
theorem orbitSaturation_smul_iff (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [MulAction Γ X]
    (s : Set X) (g : Γ) (x : X) :
    g • x ∈ orbitSaturation Γ X s ↔ x ∈ orbitSaturation Γ X s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    exact ⟨h * g, by simpa only [mul_smul] using hh⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    refine ⟨h * g⁻¹, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mul_smul, inv_smul_smul] using hh

name: SVW.orbitTransversal_measurable
statement:
theorem orbitTransversal_measurable (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X]
    (V : ℕ → Set X) (hV : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (V n)) :
    MeasurableSet (orbitTransversal Γ X V)
proof:
:= by
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro n
  exact (hV n).diff (MeasurableSet.iUnion fun k : Fin n => orbitSaturation_measurable Γ X _ (hV k))

name: SVW.orbitTransversal_covers
statement:
theorem orbitTransversal_covers (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [MulAction Γ X]
    (V : ℕ → Set X) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ V n) (x : X) :
    ∃ g : Γ, g • x ∈ orbitTransversal Γ X V
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ orbitSaturation Γ X (V n) := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hcover x
    exact ⟨n, 1, by simpa only [one_smul] using hn⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine ⟨g, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Nat.find hex, hg, ?_⟩⟩
  intro hprev
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hprev
  exact Nat.find_min hex k.isLt ((orbitSaturation_smul_iff Γ X (V k) g x).mp hk)

name: SVW.orbitTransversal_unique
statement:
theorem orbitTransversal_unique (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [MulAction Γ X]
    (V : ℕ → Set X)
    (hchart : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Γ) (x : X), x ∈ V n → g • x ∈ V n → g = 1)
    (x : X) (g h : Γ) (hg : g • x ∈ orbitTransversal Γ X V)
    (hh : h • x ∈ orbitTransversal Γ X V) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hgn⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hg
  obtain ⟨m, hhm⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
  have hnm : n = m := by
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · apply hhm.2
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨n, hlt⟩,
        (orbitSaturation_smul_iff Γ X (V n) h x).mpr ⟨g, hgn.1⟩⟩
    · apply hgn.2
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨m, hlt⟩,
        (orbitSaturation_smul_iff Γ X (V m) g x).mpr ⟨h, hhm.1⟩⟩
  subst m
  have hid : g * h⁻¹ = 1 := hchart n (g * h⁻¹) (h • x) hhm.1 (by
    simpa only [mul_smul, inv_smul_smul] using hgn.1)
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.mp hid

name: SVW.orbitTransversal_isFundamentalDomain
statement:
theorem orbitTransversal_isFundamentalDomain (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X)
    (V : ℕ → Set X) (hV : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (V n))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ V n)
    (hchart : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Γ) (x : X), x ∈ V n → g • x ∈ V n → g = 1) :
    IsFundamentalDomain Γ (orbitTransversal Γ X V) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFundamentalDomain.mk' (orbitTransversal_measurable Γ X V hV).nullMeasurableSet
  intro x
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := orbitTransversal_covers Γ X V hcover x
  exact ⟨g, hg, fun h hh => orbitTransversal_unique Γ X V hchart x h g hh hg⟩

name: SVW.discrete_subgroup_wandering_neighborhood
statement:
theorem discrete_subgroup_wandering_neighborhood (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] (Γ : Subgroup G) [DiscreteTopology Γ] :
    ∃ U : Set G, IsOpen U ∧ (1 : G) ∈ U ∧
      ∀ (g : Γ) (x : G), x ∈ U → (g : G) * x ∈ U → g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen ({1} : Set Γ) := isOpen_discrete _
  obtain ⟨O, hOo, hO⟩ := (Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.isOpen_iff).mp hopen
  have hOmem (g : Γ) : (g : G) ∈ O ↔ g = 1 := by
    exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun s : Set Γ => g ∈ s) hO)
  have hOone : (1 : G) ∈ O := (hOmem 1).mpr rfl
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, hVone, hVV⟩ := exists_open_nhds_one_mul_subset (hOo.mem_nhds hOone)
  refine ⟨V ∩ V⁻¹, hVo.inter hVo.inv, ⟨hVone, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hVone
  · intro g x hx hgx
    have hxinv : x⁻¹ ∈ V := hx.2
    have hgO : (g : G) ∈ O := by
      apply hVV
      exact ⟨(g : G) * x, hgx.1, x⁻¹, hxinv, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩
    exact (hOmem g).mp hgO

name: SVW.discrete_subgroup_countable_wandering_cover
statement:
theorem discrete_subgroup_countable_wandering_cover (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
