    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [SecondCountableTopology G] (Γ : Subgroup G) [DiscreteTopology Γ] :
    ∃ V : ℕ → Set G, (∀ n : ℕ, IsOpen (V n)) ∧ (∀ x : G, ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ V n) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Γ) (x : G), x ∈ V n → (g : G) * x ∈ V n → g = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hUone, hU⟩ := discrete_subgroup_wandering_neighborhood G Γ
  let W : G → Set G := fun a => (fun x : G => x * a⁻¹) ⁻¹' U
  have hWo : ∀ a : G, IsOpen (W a) := fun a => hUo.preimage (continuous_mul_const a⁻¹)
  have hcover : (univ : Set G) ⊆ ⋃ a : G, W a := by
    intro x _
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, by simpa only [W, mem_preimage, mul_inv_cancel] using hUone⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := isLindelof_univ.indexed_countable_subcover W hWo hcover
  refine ⟨fun n => W (a n), fun n => hWo (a n), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact mem_iUnion.mp (ha (mem_univ x))
  · intro n g x hx hgx
    change ((g : G) * x) * (a n)⁻¹ ∈ U at hgx
    exact hU g (x * (a n)⁻¹) hx (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hgx)

name: SVW.discrete_subgroup_exists_measurable_fundamentalDomain
statement:
theorem discrete_subgroup_exists_measurable_fundamentalDomain (G : Type*) [Group G]
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [SecondCountableTopology G]
    [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (Γ : Subgroup G) [Countable Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
    (μ : Measure G) : ∃ D : Set G, MeasurableSet D ∧ IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, hcover, hchart⟩ := discrete_subgroup_countable_wandering_cover G Γ
  have hVm : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (V n) := fun n => (hVo n).measurableSet
  refine ⟨orbitTransversal Γ G V, orbitTransversal_measurable Γ G V hVm, ?_⟩
  exact orbitTransversal_isFundamentalDomain Γ G μ V hVm hcover hchart

name: SVW.regularOperator_mem_span
statement:
theorem regularOperator_mem_span (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) :
    regularOperator G g ∈ regularSpan G
proof: := Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, rfl⟩

name: SVW.regularSpan_one
statement:
theorem regularSpan_one (G : Type*) [Group G] : (1 : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) ∈
    regularSpan G
proof:
:= by
  have he : regularOperator G 1 = 1 := (regularOperatorRepresentation G).map_one
  exact he ▸ regularOperator_mem_span G 1

name: SVW.regularSpan_mul
statement:
theorem regularSpan_mul (G : Type*) [Group G]
    (A B : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G)
    (hA : A ∈ regularSpan G) (hB : B ∈ regularSpan G) : A*B ∈ regularSpan G
proof:
:= by
  have hleft (g : G) : regularOperator G g * B ∈ regularSpan G := by
    induction hB using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem X hX =>
      obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hX
      have he : regularOperator G g * regularOperator G h = regularOperator G (g*h) :=
        ((regularOperatorRepresentation G).map_mul g h).symm
      rw [he]
      exact regularOperator_mem_span G (g*h)
    | zero => simpa only [mul_zero] using (regularSpan G).zero_mem
    | add X Y _hX _hY hX hY =>
      simpa only [mul_add] using (regularSpan G).add_mem hX hY
    | smul c X _hX hX =>
      simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using (regularSpan G).smul_mem c hX
  induction hA using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem X hX =>
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hX
    exact hleft g
  | zero => simpa only [zero_mul] using (regularSpan G).zero_mem
  | add X Y _hX _hY hX hY =>
    simpa only [add_mul] using (regularSpan G).add_mem hX hY
  | smul c X _hX hX =>
    simpa only [smul_mul_assoc] using (regularSpan G).smul_mem c hX

name: SVW.regularSpan_star
statement:
theorem regularSpan_star (G : Type*) [Group G]
    (A : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) (hA : A ∈ regularSpan G) :
    star A ∈ regularSpan G
proof:
:= by
  induction hA using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem X hX =>
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hX
    rw [regularOperator_star]
    exact regularOperator_mem_span G g⁻¹
  | zero => simpa only [star_zero] using (regularSpan G).zero_mem
  | add X Y _hX _hY hX hY =>
    simpa only [star_add] using (regularSpan G).add_mem hX hY
  | smul c X _hX hX =>
    simpa only [star_smul] using (regularSpan G).smul_mem (star c) hX

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_mem_closure_span
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_mem_closure_span
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hA : A ∈ reducedFreeCStar) :
    A ∈ closure (regularSpan (FreeGroup Bool) : Set (FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert))
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ
      (Set.range (fun i : Bool => regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i))) ≤
      regularPolynomialAlgebra (FreeGroup Bool) := by
    apply StarAlgebra.adjoin_le
    rintro X ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact regularOperator_mem_span (FreeGroup Bool) (FreeGroup.of i)
  exact closure_mono hsub hA

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_polynomial_approximation
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_polynomial_approximation
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hA : A ∈ reducedFreeCStar)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖A - c.sum (fun g z => z • regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) g)‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hdist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp (reducedFreeCStar_mem_closure_span A hA) ε hε
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hB
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  rw [hc]
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hdist

name: SVW.reducedCyclicMap_monomial
statement:
theorem reducedCyclicMap_monomial (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) :
    reducedCyclicMap i (_root_.fourier k) =
      reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact freeContinuousCyclic_monomial i k

name: SVW.circleLinearMap_ext
statement:
theorem circleLinearMap_ext (D : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup D] [NormedSpace ℂ D]
    (L M : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] D)
    (h : ∀ k : ℤ, L (_root_.fourier k) = M (_root_.fourier k)) : L = M
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on (s := Set.range (_root_.fourier (T := (1:ℝ))))
  · rw [dense_iff_closure_eq]
    change ((Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (_root_.fourier (T := (1:ℝ))))).topologicalClosure :
      Set C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)) = Set.univ
    rw [span_fourier_closure_eq_top]
    rfl
  · rintro f ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact h k

name: SVW.cyclic_calculus_intertwining
statement:
theorem cyclic_calculus_intertwining
    (H K : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] K)
    (i : Bool) (L : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K))
    (hchar : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : H),
      J (π (reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) x) = L (_root_.fourier k) (J x))
    (f : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)) (x : H) :
    J (π (reducedCyclicMap i f) x) = L f (J x)
proof:
:= by
  let A : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] K := J.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ H x).comp
      ((reducedStarRepresentationCLM (H →L[ℂ] H) π).comp (reducedCyclicMap i)))
  let B : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] K := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ K (J x)).comp L
  have heq : A = B := by
    apply circleLinearMap_ext K A B
    intro k
    change J (π (reducedCyclicMap i (_root_.fourier k)) x) = L (_root_.fourier k) (J x)
    rw [reducedCyclicMap_monomial]
    exact hchar k x
  exact congrArg (fun T : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] K => T f) heq

name: SVW.cyclic_product_norm_lower
statement:
theorem cyclic_product_norm_lower
    (H K : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [Nontrivial H] [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] K)
    (L : Bool → C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K))
    (hchar : ∀ (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (x : H),
      J (π (reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) x) = L i (_root_.fourier k) (J x))
    (f g : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ)) :
    ‖freeContinuousCyclic true g * freeContinuousCyclic false f‖ ≤ ‖L true g * L false f‖
proof:
:= by
  let A : reducedFreeCStar := reducedCyclicMap true g * reducedCyclicMap false f
  have hnorm : ‖π A‖ = ‖A‖ :=
    reducedFreeCStar_representation_isometric (H →L[ℂ] H) π A
  have hbound : ‖π A‖ ≤ ‖L true g * L false f‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
    intro x
    have hinter : J (π A x) = (L true g * L false f) (J x) := by
      change J (π (reducedCyclicMap true g * reducedCyclicMap false f) x) = _
      rw [map_mul]
      change J (π (reducedCyclicMap true g) (π (reducedCyclicMap false f) x)) = _
      rw [cyclic_calculus_intertwining H K π J true (L true) (hchar true),
        cyclic_calculus_intertwining H K π J false (L false) (hchar false)]
      rfl
    calc
      ‖π A x‖ = ‖J (π A x)‖ := (J.norm_map _).symm
      _ = ‖(L true g * L false f) (J x)‖ := congrArg norm hinter
      _ ≤ ‖L true g * L false f‖ * ‖J x‖ := (L true g * L false f).le_opNorm (J x)
      _ = _ := by rw [J.norm_map]
  rw [hnorm] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: SVW.cyclic_cutoffs_radical_lower
statement:
theorem cyclic_cutoffs_radical_lower
    (H K : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [Nontrivial H] [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (J : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] K)
    (L : Bool → C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) →L[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K))
    (hchar : ∀ (i : Bool) (k : ℤ) (x : H),
      J (π (reducedRegularElement (FreeGroup.of i ^ k)) x) = L i (_root_.fourier k) (J x))
    (α₀ α β₀ β : ℝ) (hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1)
    (hβ₀0 : 0 < β₀) (hβ₀1 : β₀ < 1) (hα : α₀ < α) (hβ : β₀ < β) :
    phiRadical α₀ β₀ ≤ ‖L true (circleArcCutoff β₀ β) * L false (circleArcCutoff α₀ α)‖
proof:
:=
  (freeCircleCutoffs_radical_lower α₀ α β₀ β hα₀0 hα₀1 hβ₀0 hβ₀1 hα hβ).trans
    (cyclic_product_norm_lower H K π J L hchar _ _)

name: SVW.regularAverage_sub
statement:
theorem regularAverage_sub (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : ℕ) (γ : Fin N → G)
    (T S : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    regularAverage G N γ (T-S) = regularAverage G N γ T - regularAverage G N γ S
proof:
:=
  average_conjugates_sub G N γ T S

name: SVW.regularAverage_norm_le
statement:
theorem regularAverage_norm_le (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (γ : Fin N → G) (T : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    ‖regularAverage G N γ T‖ ≤ ‖T‖
proof: := average_conjugates_contractive G N hN γ T

name: SVW.regularAverage_one
statement:
theorem regularAverage_one (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (γ : Fin N → G) :
    regularAverage G N γ 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN0 : (N:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hN))
  have he (i : Fin N) : regularOperator G (γ i) * 1 * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [mul_one]
    change regularOperatorRepresentation G (γ i) * regularOperatorRepresentation G (γ i)⁻¹ = 1
    rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]
  unfold regularAverage
  simp only [he, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℂ, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hN0, one_smul]

name: SVW.finiteRegularOperator_center
statement:
theorem finiteRegularOperator_center (G : Type*) [Group G] (c : G →₀ ℂ) :
    finiteRegularOperator G (c-Finsupp.single 1 (c 1)) = finiteRegularOperator G c - (c 1) • 1
proof:
:= by
  have hl (s : G →₀ ℂ) : finiteRegularOperator G s =
      Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ (regularOperator G) s := rfl
  rw [hl, map_sub, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, ← hl]
  have h1 : regularOperator G 1 = 1 := (regularOperatorRepresentation G).map_one
  rw [h1]

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_centered_polynomial_approximation
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_centered_polynomial_approximation
    (T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hT : T ∈ reducedFreeCStar)
    (htrace : regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) T = 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ, c 1 = 0 ∧ ‖T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := reducedFreeCStar_polynomial_approximation T hT (ε/2) (by positivity)
  change ‖T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖ < ε/2 at hc
  have htr : ‖c 1‖ < ε/2 := by
    have he : regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c-T) = c 1 := by
      rw [map_sub, htrace, sub_zero, finiteRegularOperator_trace]
    rw [← he]
    exact (regularTrace_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) _).trans_lt (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hc)
  refine ⟨c-Finsupp.single 1 (c 1), by simp, ?_⟩
  rw [finiteRegularOperator_center]
  have he : T-(finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c-(c 1) • 1) =
      (T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c)+(c 1) • 1 := by abel
  rw [he]
  calc
    ‖T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c+(c 1) • 1‖ ≤
        ‖T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖+‖(c 1) • (1 : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)‖ :=
      norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖+‖c 1‖ := by
      have h1 : ‖(1 : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)‖ ≤ 1 :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
      rw [norm_smul]
      simpa only [mul_one] using add_le_add le_rfl
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (norm_nonneg (c 1)))
    _ < ε := by linarith

name: SVW.exists_nat_powers_error_small
statement:
theorem exists_nat_powers_error_small (C ε : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ 2*C/Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((2*C/ε)^2)
  have hNp : 0 < (N:ℝ) := (sq_nonneg _).trans_lt hN
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hNp
  have hroot : 0 < Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNp
  have hr : 2*C/ε < Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hNp.le
    have hc : 0 ≤ 2*C/ε := by positivity
    by_contra hn
    have hle : Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) ≤ 2*C/ε := le_of_not_gt hn
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨N, hN1, (div_lt_iff₀ hroot).mpr ?_⟩
  have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hr
  nlinarith

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_powers_averaging
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_powers_averaging
    (T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hT : T ∈ reducedFreeCStar)
    (htrace : regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) T = 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (_hN : 1 ≤ N) (γ : Fin N → FreeGroup Bool),
      ‖regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ T‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, happ⟩ := reducedFreeCStar_centered_polynomial_approximation T hT htrace (ε/2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hsmall⟩ := exists_nat_powers_error_small
    ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖ (ε/2) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := freeGroup_powers_averaging c hc N hN
  change ‖regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ (finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c)‖ ≤ _ at hγ
  have hdiff := regularAverage_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) N hN γ (T-finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c)
  rw [regularAverage_sub] at hdiff
  refine ⟨N, hN, γ, ?_⟩
  have he : regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ T =
      (regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ T -
        regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ (finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c)) +
        regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ (finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c) := by abel
  rw [he]
  have hb := (norm_add_le _ _).trans_lt (add_lt_add (hdiff.trans_lt happ) (hγ.trans_lt hsmall))
  linarith

name: SVW.reducedPolynomialMap_coe
statement:
theorem reducedPolynomialMap_coe (c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ) :
    (reducedPolynomialMap c : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) =
      finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c
proof:
:= by
  change reducedFreeCStar.subtype (c.sum (fun g z => z • reducedRegularElement g)) = _
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul, reducedRegularElement,
    StarSubalgebra.subtype_apply, finiteRegularOperator]

name: SVW.reducedPolynomialMap_dense
statement: theorem reducedPolynomialMap_dense : DenseRange reducedPolynomialMap
proof:
:= by
  intro A
  rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := reducedFreeCStar_polynomial_approximation
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) A.property ε hε
  refine ⟨reducedPolynomialMap c, ⟨c, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  change ‖(A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) -
    (reducedPolynomialMap c : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)‖ < ε
  rw [reducedPolynomialMap_coe]
  exact hc

name: SVW.reducedRegularElement_one
statement: theorem reducedRegularElement_one : reducedRegularElement 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool)).map_one

name: SVW.reducedRegularElement_mul
statement:
theorem reducedRegularElement_mul (g h : FreeGroup Bool) :
    reducedRegularElement (g*h) = reducedRegularElement g * reducedRegularElement h
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (regularOperatorRepresentation (FreeGroup Bool)).map_mul g h

name: SVW.reducedRegularElement_star
statement:
theorem reducedRegularElement_star (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    star (reducedRegularElement g) = reducedRegularElement g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact regularOperator_star (FreeGroup Bool) g

name: SVW.reducedRepresentationLinear_polynomial
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentationLinear_polynomial (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ) :
    reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ (reducedPolynomialMap c) =
      c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq reducedPolynomialMap_dense
  refine ⟨1, fun a => ?_⟩
  rw [one_mul]
  change ‖a.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤
    ‖(reducedPolynomialMap a : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)‖
  rw [reducedPolynomialMap_coe]
  exact hρ a

name: SVW.reducedRepresentationLinear_generator
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentationLinear_generator (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ (reducedRegularElement g) = ρ g
proof:
:= by
  have h := reducedRepresentationLinear_polynomial D ρ hρ (Finsupp.single g 1)
  simpa only [reducedPolynomialMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul,
    Finsupp.sum_single_index, zero_smul] using h

name: SVW.reducedRepresentationLinear_mul_generator
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentationLinear_mul_generator (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (g : FreeGroup Bool) (A : reducedFreeCStar) :
    reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ (reducedRegularElement g * A) =
      ρ g * reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ A
proof:
:= by
  refine reducedPolynomialMap_dense.induction_on A
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro c
  simp only [reducedPolynomialMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.mul_sum, mul_smul_comm, map_sum, map_smul,
    ← reducedRegularElement_mul, reducedRepresentationLinear_generator D ρ hρ, map_mul]

name: SVW.reducedRepresentationLinear_mul
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentationLinear_mul (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (A B : reducedFreeCStar) :
    reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ (A*B) =
      reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ A * reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ B
proof:
:= by
  refine reducedPolynomialMap_dense.induction_on A
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro c
  simp only [reducedPolynomialMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.sum_mul, smul_mul_assoc, map_sum, map_smul,
    reducedRepresentationLinear_mul_generator D ρ hρ,
    reducedRepresentationLinear_generator D ρ hρ]

name: SVW.reducedRepresentationLinear_star
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentationLinear_star (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hstar : ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, star (ρ g) = ρ g⁻¹)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (A : reducedFreeCStar) :
    reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ (star A) = star (reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ A)
proof:
:= by
  refine reducedPolynomialMap_dense.induction_on A
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro c
  simp only [reducedPolynomialMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    star_sum, star_smul, map_sum, map_smul, reducedRegularElement_star,
    reducedRepresentationLinear_generator D ρ hρ, hstar]

name: SVW.reducedRepresentation_generator
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentation_generator (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hstar : ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, star (ρ g) = ρ g⁻¹)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    reducedRepresentation D ρ hstar hρ (reducedRegularElement g) = ρ g
proof:
:=
  reducedRepresentationLinear_generator D ρ hρ g

name: SVW.regular_polynomial_norm_eq_of_domination
statement:
theorem regular_polynomial_norm_eq_of_domination (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D] [Nontrivial D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hstar : ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, star (ρ g) = ρ g⁻¹)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖)
    (c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ = ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖
proof:
:= by
  have he := reducedFreeCStar_representation_isometric D
    (reducedRepresentation D ρ hstar hρ) (reducedPolynomialMap c)
  change ‖reducedRepresentationLinear D ρ (reducedPolynomialMap c)‖ =
    ‖(reducedPolynomialMap c : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)‖ at he
  rw [reducedRepresentationLinear_polynomial D ρ hρ c, reducedPolynomialMap_coe] at he
  exact he

name: SVW.reducedAverage_coe
statement:
theorem reducedAverage_coe (N : ℕ) (γ : Fin N → FreeGroup Bool) (T : reducedFreeCStar) :
    (reducedAverage N γ T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) =
      regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ (T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)
proof:
:= by
  change reducedFreeCStar.subtype ((N:ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
    reducedRegularElement (γ i) * T * reducedRegularElement (γ i)⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_smul, map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul]
  rfl

name: SVW.regularTrace_one
statement:
theorem regularTrace_one (G : Type*) [Group G] :
    regularTrace G (1 : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : regularOperator G 1 = 1 := (regularOperatorRepresentation G).map_one
  simpa only [he, ite_true] using regularTrace_regularOperator G 1

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_representation_injective
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_representation_injective
    (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D] [Nontrivial D]
    (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D) : Function.Injective π
proof:
:= by
  have hker : ∀ A : reducedFreeCStar, π A = 0 → A = 0 := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra hA0
    let B : reducedFreeCStar := star A * A
    let c : ℂ := regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (B : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc0
      have hv : (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) = 0 :=
        reducedFreeCStar_trace_faithful _ A.property hc0
      exact hA0 (Subtype.ext hv)
    let T : reducedFreeCStar := c⁻¹ • B
    have hπT : π T = 0 := by
      simp [T, B, map_smul, map_mul, map_star, hA]
    have hTtrace : regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) = 1 := by
      change regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (c⁻¹ • (B : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)) = 1
      rw [map_smul]
      change c⁻¹*c = 1
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hc
    have hStrace : regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool)
        ((T-1 : reducedFreeCStar) : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) = 0 := by
      change regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) ((T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)-1) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hTtrace, regularTrace_one, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨N, hN, γ, hsmall⟩ := reducedFreeCStar_powers_averaging
      ((T-1 : reducedFreeCStar) : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (T-1).property hStrace 1 zero_lt_one
    let V : reducedFreeCStar := reducedAverage N γ T
    have hπV : π V = 0 := by
      simp [V, reducedAverage, map_smul, map_sum, map_mul, hπT]
    have hvnorm : ‖(1 : reducedFreeCStar)-V‖ < 1 := by
      change ‖(1 : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)-(V : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)‖ < 1
      change ‖regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ ((T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert)-1)‖ < 1 at hsmall
      rw [regularAverage_sub, regularAverage_one (FreeGroup Bool) N hN γ] at hsmall
      rw [show (V : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) =
        regularAverage (FreeGroup Bool) N γ (T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) from
          reducedAverage_coe N γ T]
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
      exact hsmall
    have hl : 1 ≤ ‖(1 : reducedFreeCStar)-V‖ := by
      calc
        1 = ‖π ((1 : reducedFreeCStar)-V)‖ := by rw [map_sub, map_one, hπV, sub_zero, norm_one]
        _ ≤ ‖(1 : reducedFreeCStar)-V‖ := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le π _
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hl) hvnorm
  intro A B hAB
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hker
  rw [map_sub, hAB, sub_self]

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_representation_isometric
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_representation_isometric
    (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D] [Nontrivial D]
    (π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D) (A : reducedFreeCStar) : ‖π A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map π (reducedFreeCStar_representation_injective D π) A

name: SVW.rightRegularOperator_apply
statement:
theorem rightRegularOperator_apply (G : Type*) [Group G] (g h : G) (f : GroupHilbert G) :
    rightRegularOperator G g f h = f (h*g⁻¹)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.rightRegularOperator_vacuum
statement:
theorem rightRegularOperator_vacuum (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) :
    rightRegularOperator G g (groupVacuum G) = groupDelta G g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext h
  simp only [rightRegularOperator_apply, groupVacuum, groupDelta_apply, mul_inv_eq_one]

name: SVW.regularOperator_commute_right
statement:
theorem regularOperator_commute_right (G : Type*) [Group G] (g h : G) :
    Commute (regularOperator G g) (rightRegularOperator G h)
proof:
:= by
  ext f k
  change f ((g⁻¹*k)*h⁻¹) = f (g⁻¹*(k*h⁻¹))
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: SVW.regularSpan_commute_right
statement:
theorem regularSpan_commute_right (G : Type*) [Group G]
    (A : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) (hA : A ∈ regularSpan G) (g : G) :
    Commute A (rightRegularOperator G g)
proof:
:= by
  induction hA using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem X hX =>
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hX
    exact regularOperator_commute_right G h g
  | zero => exact Commute.zero_left _
  | add X Y _hX _hY hX hY => exact hX.add_left hY
  | smul c X _hX hX => exact hX.smul_left c

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_commute_right
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_commute_right
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hA : A ∈ reducedFreeCStar) (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    Commute A (rightRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) g)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsClosed {B : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert |
      Commute B (rightRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) g)} :=
    isClosed_eq (continuous_id.mul continuous_const) (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  exact closure_minimal (fun B hB => regularSpan_commute_right (FreeGroup Bool) B hB g) hc
    (reducedFreeCStar_mem_closure_span A hA)

name: SVW.groupDelta_inner_apply
statement:
theorem groupDelta_inner_apply (G : Type*) (g : G) (f : GroupHilbert G) :
    inner ℂ (groupDelta G g) f = f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [groupDelta, lp.inner_single_left]

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_vacuum_separating
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_vacuum_separating
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hA : A ∈ reducedFreeCStar)
    (hz : A freeVacuum = 0) : A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd (g : FreeGroup Bool) : A (groupDelta (FreeGroup Bool) g) = 0 := by
    rw [← rightRegularOperator_vacuum (FreeGroup Bool) g]
    have he := congrArg (fun T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert => T freeVacuum)
      (reducedFreeCStar_commute_right A hA g).eq
    change A (rightRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) g freeVacuum) =
      rightRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) g (A freeVacuum) at he
    rw [hz, map_zero] at he
    exact he
  have hadj : A.adjoint = 0 := by
    ext f g
    rw [← groupDelta_inner_apply (FreeGroup Bool) g (A.adjoint f),
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, hd, inner_zero_left]
    rfl
  have he := congrArg (fun T : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert => T.adjoint) hadj
  simpa using he

name: SVW.reducedFreeCStar_trace_faithful
statement:
theorem reducedFreeCStar_trace_faithful
    (A : FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert) (hA : A ∈ reducedFreeCStar)
    (hz : regularTrace (FreeGroup Bool) (star A * A) = 0) : A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : inner ℂ (A freeVacuum) (A freeVacuum) = 0 := by
    change inner ℂ freeVacuum (A.adjoint (A freeVacuum)) = 0 at hz
    rwa [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right] at hz
  exact reducedFreeCStar_vacuum_separating A hA (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hs)

name: SVW.groupL2Cut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupL2Cut_apply (G : Type*) (A : Set G) (f : GroupHilbert G) (g : G) :
    groupL2Cut G A f g = if g ∈ A then f g else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rfl

name: SVW.groupL2Cut_norm_le
statement:
theorem groupL2Cut_norm_le (G : Type*) (A : Set G) (f : GroupHilbert G) :
    ‖groupL2Cut G A f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≠ 0)
  intro g
  simp only [groupL2Cut_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: SVW.groupCoordinateProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupCoordinateProjection_apply (G : Type*) (A : Set G)
    (f : GroupHilbert G) (g : G) :
    groupCoordinateProjection G A f g = if g ∈ A then f g else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rfl

name: SVW.groupCoordinateProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem groupCoordinateProjection_norm_le (G : Type*) (A : Set G) :
    ‖groupCoordinateProjection G A‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro f
  simpa only [one_mul] using! groupL2Cut_norm_le G A f

name: SVW.groupCoordinateProjection_star
statement:
theorem groupCoordinateProjection_star (G : Type*) (A : Set G) :
    star (groupCoordinateProjection G A) = groupCoordinateProjection G A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
  intro f h
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, lp.inner_eq_tsum]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro g
  by_cases hg : g ∈ A <;> simp [hg]

name: SVW.groupCoordinateProjection_add_compl
statement:
theorem groupCoordinateProjection_add_compl (G : Type*) (A : Set G) :
    groupCoordinateProjection G A + groupCoordinateProjection G Aᶜ = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext f g
  by_cases hg : g ∈ A <;> simp [hg]

name: SVW.regularOperator_norm_le
statement:
theorem regularOperator_norm_le (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) :
    ‖regularOperator G g‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro f
  change ‖leftRegularL2 G g f‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖
  simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, one_mul, le_refl]

name: SVW.regularConjugate_norm_le
statement:
theorem regularConjugate_norm_le (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G)
    (T : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    ‖regularOperator G g * T * regularOperator G g⁻¹‖ ≤ ‖T‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖regularOperator G g‖ * ‖T‖ * ‖regularOperator G g⁻¹‖ :=
      (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖T‖ * 1 := by
      gcongr
      · exact regularOperator_norm_le G g
      · exact regularOperator_norm_le G g⁻¹
    _ = _ := by ring

name: SVW.translated_coordinate_ranges_orthogonal
statement:
theorem translated_coordinate_ranges_orthogonal
    (G : Type*) [Group G] (A B : Set G) (g h : G)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (g • A) (h • B)) (x y : GroupHilbert G) :
    inner ℂ (regularOperator G g (groupCoordinateProjection G A x))
      (regularOperator G h (groupCoordinateProjection G B y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [lp.inner_eq_tsum]
  refine (tsum_congr (g := fun _ : G => (0 : ℂ)) ?_).trans (by simp)
  intro k
  by_cases hA : g⁻¹ * k ∈ A
  · by_cases hB : h⁻¹ * k ∈ B
    · have ha : k ∈ g • A := ⟨g⁻¹ * k, hA, by simp [smul_eq_mul]⟩
      have hb : k ∈ h • B := ⟨h⁻¹ * k, hB, by simp [smul_eq_mul]⟩
      exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj ha hb)
    · simp [regularOperator_apply, hB]
  · simp [regularOperator_apply, hA]

name: SVW.coordinate_compression_regular_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coordinate_compression_regular_eq_zero
    (G : Type*) [Group G] (A : Set G) (g : G) (hdisj : Disjoint (g • A) A) :
    groupCoordinateProjection G A * regularOperator G g * groupCoordinateProjection G A = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext f k
  by_cases hk : k ∈ A
  · by_cases hh : g⁻¹ * k ∈ A
    · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj
        (show k ∈ g • A from ⟨g⁻¹ * k, hh, by simp [smul_eq_mul]⟩) hk)
    · simp [mul_apply_eq_comp, regularOperator_apply, hk, hh]
  · simp [mul_apply_eq_comp, hk]

name: SVW.coordinate_compression_finite_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coordinate_compression_finite_eq_zero
    (G : Type*) [Group G] (c : G →₀ ℂ) (A : Set G)
    (hA : ∀ g ∈ c.support, Disjoint (g • A) A) :
    groupCoordinateProjection G A * finiteRegularOperator G c * groupCoordinateProjection G A = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finiteRegularOperator, Finsupp.sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul,
    mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro g hg
  rw [coordinate_compression_regular_eq_zero G A g (hA g hg), smul_zero]

name: SVW.freeGroup_powers_averaging
statement:
theorem freeGroup_powers_averaging (c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ) (hc : c 1 = 0)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∃ γ : Fin N → FreeGroup Bool,
      ‖(N : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
        regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c *
          regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹‖ ≤
        2 * ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖ / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c
  have hc1 : 1 ∉ c.support := by simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hc, ne_self_iff_false, not_false_eq_true]
  obtain ⟨C, D, hCD, hcover, γ, hleft, hpair⟩ := freeGroup_powers_partition c.support hc1 N
  have hD : D = Cᶜ := by
    apply Set.ext
    intro g
    constructor
    · intro hgD hgC
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hgC hgD
    · intro hg
      have hu : g ∈ C ∪ D := by rw [hcover]; trivial
      exact hu.resolve_left hg
  subst D
  let P := groupCoordinateProjection (FreeGroup Bool) C
  let Q := groupCoordinateProjection (FreeGroup Bool) Cᶜ
  have hPQ : P + Q = 1 := groupCoordinateProjection_add_compl (FreeGroup Bool) C
  have hPTP : P * T * P = 0 := coordinate_compression_finite_eq_zero (FreeGroup Bool) c C hleft
  have hPT : P * T = P * T * Q := by
    calc
      P * T = P * T * (P + Q) := by rw [hPQ, mul_one]
      _ = P * T * P + P * T * Q := mul_add _ _ _
      _ = P * T * Q := by rw [hPTP, zero_add]
  have hdecomp : T = Q * T + P * T * Q := by
    calc
      T = (Q + P) * T := by rw [add_comm, hPQ, one_mul]
      _ = Q * T + P * T := add_mul _ _ _
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun R => Q * T + R) hPT
  let A : Fin N → FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert := fun i =>
    regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * (Q * T) * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹
  let B : Fin N → FreeHilbert →L[ℂ] FreeHilbert := fun i =>
    regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * (P * T * Q) * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹
  have hA (i : Fin N) : ‖A i‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
    apply (regularConjugate_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) (Q * T)).trans
    calc
      ‖Q * T‖ ≤ ‖Q‖ * ‖T‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖T‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (groupCoordinateProjection_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) Cᶜ) (norm_nonneg T)
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  have hB (i : Fin N) : ‖B i‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
    apply (regularConjugate_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) (P * T * Q)).trans
    calc
      ‖P * T * Q‖ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖T‖ * ‖Q‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖T‖ * 1 := by
        gcongr
        · exact groupCoordinateProjection_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) C
        · exact groupCoordinateProjection_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) Cᶜ
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hAorth (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≠ j) (v : FreeHilbert) :
      inner ℂ (A i v) (A j v) = 0 := by
    exact translated_coordinate_ranges_orthogonal (FreeGroup Bool) Cᶜ Cᶜ (γ i) (γ j)
      (hpair hij) (T (regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹ v)) (T (regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ j)⁻¹ v))
  have hstarB (i : Fin N) : star (B i) =
      regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * Q * star T * P * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [B, star_mul, regularOperator_star, inv_inv, P, Q,
      groupCoordinateProjection_star, mul_assoc]
  have hBorth (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≠ j) (v : FreeHilbert) :
      inner ℂ (star (B i) v) (star (B j) v) = 0 := by
    rw [hstarB, hstarB]
    exact translated_coordinate_ranges_orthogonal (FreeGroup Bool) Cᶜ Cᶜ (γ i) (γ j)
      (hpair hij) (star T (P (regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹ v)))
        (star T (P (regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ j)⁻¹ v)))
  have hAsum := norm_sum_orthogonal_operators_le FreeHilbert N A ‖T‖ (norm_nonneg T) hA hAorth
  have hBstar_bound (i : Fin N) : ‖star (B i)‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
    calc
      ‖star (B i)‖ = ‖B i‖ := norm_star (B i)
      _ ≤ ‖T‖ := hB i
  have hBsumstar := norm_sum_orthogonal_operators_le FreeHilbert N (fun i => star (B i)) ‖T‖
    (norm_nonneg T) hBstar_bound hBorth
  have hBsum : ‖∑ i : Fin N, B i‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) * ‖T‖ := by
    calc
      _ = ‖star (∑ i : Fin N, B i)‖ := (norm_star _).symm
      _ = ‖∑ i : Fin N, star (B i)‖ := by rw [star_sum]
      _ ≤ _ := hBsumstar
  have hsplit (i : Fin N) :
      regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * T * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹ = A i + B i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp, mul_add, add_mul]
  have hsum : ‖∑ i : Fin N, regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * T * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹‖ ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) * ‖T‖ := by
    simp_rw [hsplit]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans ((add_le_add hAsum hBsum).trans_eq (by ring))
  have hNr : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hN)
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNr
  refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
  change ‖(N : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
    regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * T * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹‖ ≤ 2 * ‖T‖ / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
  calc
    _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ i : Fin N,
        regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i) * T * regularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) (γ i)⁻¹‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast]
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) * ‖T‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (inv_nonneg.mpr hNr.le)
    _ = 2 * ‖T‖ / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := by
      field_simp [hNr.ne', hsqrt.ne']
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hNr.le]

name: SVW.finiteRegularOperator_trace
statement:
theorem finiteRegularOperator_trace (G : Type*) [Group G] (c : G →₀ ℂ) :
    regularTrace G (finiteRegularOperator G c) = c 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finiteRegularOperator, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul,
    regularTrace_regularOperator, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp h).symm

name: SVW.average_conjugates_contractive
statement:
theorem average_conjugates_contractive (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (γ : Fin N → G) (T : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    ‖(N : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
      regularOperator G (γ i) * T * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹‖ ≤ ‖T‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : ‖∑ i : Fin N, regularOperator G (γ i) * T * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹‖ ≤
      (N : ℝ) * ‖T‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, ‖regularOperator G (γ i) * T * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹‖ :=
        norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin N, ‖T‖ :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _hi => regularConjugate_norm_le G (γ i) T)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hNr : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hN))
  calc
    _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ i : Fin N,
        regularOperator G (γ i) * T * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast]
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((N : ℝ) * ‖T‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
    _ = ‖T‖ := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNr, one_mul]

name: SVW.average_conjugates_sub
statement:
theorem average_conjugates_sub (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : ℕ) (γ : Fin N → G)
    (T S : GroupHilbert G →L[ℂ] GroupHilbert G) :
    (N : ℂ)⁻¹ • (∑ i : Fin N,
      regularOperator G (γ i) * (T - S) * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹) =
      (N : ℂ)⁻¹ • (∑ i : Fin N,
        regularOperator G (γ i) * T * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹) -
      (N : ℂ)⁻¹ • (∑ i : Fin N,
        regularOperator G (γ i) * S * regularOperator G (γ i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]

name: SVW.coefficient_embedding_polynomial_norm_le
statement:
theorem coefficient_embedding_polynomial_norm_le
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
    (μ : Measure G) [Measure.IsMulLeftInvariant μ]
    (ι : FreeGroup Bool →* G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) [DiscreteTopology ι.range]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* (H →L[ℂ] H)) (W : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    (hinter : ∀ (g : FreeGroup Bool) (x : H),
      W (ρ g x) = actionL2Operator G G μ (ι g) (W x))
    (c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖
proof:
:= by
  let T : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
    c.sum (fun g z => z • actionL2Operator G G μ (ι g))
  have hT : ‖T‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖ :=
    injective_discrete_hom_regular_restriction_norm_le (FreeGroup Bool) G ι hι μ c
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
  intro x
  have he : W ((c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)) x) = T (W x) := by
    simp only [T, Finsupp.sum, sum_apply, smul_apply,
      map_sum, map_smul, hinter]
  calc
    ‖(c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)) x‖ = ‖W ((c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)) x)‖ :=
      (W.norm_map _).symm
    _ = ‖T (W x)‖ := congrArg norm he
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖W x‖ := T.le_opNorm (W x)
    _ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖ * ‖x‖ := by
      rw [W.norm_map]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT (norm_nonneg x)

name: SVW.finiteRegularSum_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteRegularSum_apply (Γ : Type*) [Group Γ] (c : Γ →₀ ℂ)
    (f : GroupHilbert Γ) (g : Γ) :
    finiteRegularSum Γ c f g = c.sum (fun h z => z * f (h⁻¹ * g))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteRegularSum, Finsupp.sum, sum_apply, smul_apply,
    lp.coeFn_sum, lp.coeFn_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, regularOperator_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: SVW.squareEnergy_lp
statement:
theorem squareEnergy_lp (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    squareEnergy X μ f = ‖f‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eLpNorm_nnreal_pow_eq_lintegral (μ := μ) (f := (f : X → ℂ))
    (p := (2 : ℝ≥0)) (by norm_num)
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_ofNat, ENNReal.rpow_ofNat, ← Lp.enorm_def,
    squareEnergy] using h.symm

name: SVW.groupHilbert_energy
statement:
theorem groupHilbert_energy (Γ : Type*) (f : GroupHilbert Γ) :
    (∑' g : Γ, ‖f g‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)) = ‖f‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun g : Γ => sq_nonneg ‖f g‖)
    (lp_two_summable_sq Γ (fun _ => ℂ) f)
  rw [← lp_two_norm_sq Γ (fun _ => ℂ) f] at h
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm] using h.symm

name: SVW.memℓp_of_energy_ne_top
statement:
theorem memℓp_of_energy_ne_top (Γ : Type*) (f : Γ → ℂ)
    (hf : (∑' g : Γ, ‖f g‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ≠ ∞) : Memℓp f 2
proof:
:= by
  apply memℓp_gen
  have h := ENNReal.tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable_coe.mp
    (show (∑' g : Γ, ((‖f g‖₊ ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)) ≠ ∞ by
      simpa only [ENNReal.coe_pow, enorm_eq_nnnorm] using hf)
  simpa using h

name: SVW.finiteRegularSum_energy_le
statement:
theorem finiteRegularSum_energy_le (Γ : Type*) [Group Γ] (c : Γ →₀ ℂ)
    (f : Γ → ℂ) (hf : Memℓp f 2) :
    (∑' g : Γ, ‖c.sum (fun h z => z * f (h⁻¹ * g))‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ≤
      ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) * ∑' g : Γ, ‖f g‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let v : GroupHilbert Γ := ⟨f, hf⟩
  have hnorm := (finiteRegularSum Γ c).le_opNorm v
  have hsq : ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖ ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow] using (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr hnorm
  have henn := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hsq
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)] at henn
  simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm] at henn
  rw [← groupHilbert_energy Γ (finiteRegularSum Γ c v), ← groupHilbert_energy Γ v] at henn
  simpa only [finiteRegularSum_apply] using henn

name: SVW.actionPolynomialFunction_measurable
statement:
theorem actionPolynomialFunction_measurable (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [MulAction Γ X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) (f : X → ℂ)
    (hf : Measurable f) : Measurable (actionPolynomialFunction Γ X c f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold actionPolynomialFunction Finsupp.sum
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun g _ => measurable_const.mul (hf.comp (measurable_const_smul g⁻¹)))

name: SVW.squareEnergy_fundamentalDomain
statement:
theorem squareEnergy_fundamentalDomain (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X)
    [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ] (D : Set X) (hD : IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ)
    (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) :
    squareEnergy X μ f = ∫⁻ x in D, ∑' g : Γ, ‖f (g • x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareEnergy, hD.lintegral_eq_tsum'']
  exact (lintegral_tsum (fun g : Γ =>
    ((hf.comp (measurable_const_smul g)).enorm.pow_const (2 : ℕ)).aemeasurable)).symm

name: SVW.fundamentalDomain_fiber_memℓp
statement:
theorem fundamentalDomain_fiber_memℓp (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X)
    [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ] (D : Set X) (hD : IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ)
    (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (henergy : squareEnergy X μ f ≠ ∞) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict D, Memℓp (fun g : Γ => f (g • x)) 2
proof:
:= by
  have hint : (∫⁻ x in D, ∑' g : Γ, ‖f (g • x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ) ≠ ∞ := by
    rwa [← squareEnergy_fundamentalDomain Γ X μ D hD f hf]
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun x : X => ∑' g : Γ, ‖f (g • x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ)) :=
    Measurable.tsum (fun g => (hf.comp (measurable_const_smul g)).enorm.pow_const _)
  filter_upwards [ae_lt_top hmeas hint] with x hx
  exact memℓp_of_energy_ne_top Γ _ hx.ne

name: SVW.actionPolynomialFunction_energy_le
statement:
theorem actionPolynomialFunction_energy_le (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X)
    [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ] (D : Set X) (hD : IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ)
    (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (henergy : squareEnergy X μ f ≠ ∞) :
    squareEnergy X μ (actionPolynomialFunction Γ X c f) ≤
      ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) * squareEnergy X μ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareEnergy_fundamentalDomain Γ X μ D hD _
    (actionPolynomialFunction_measurable Γ X c f hf),
    squareEnergy_fundamentalDomain Γ X μ D hD f hf]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in D, ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) *
        ∑' g : Γ, ‖f (g • x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [fundamentalDomain_fiber_memℓp Γ X μ D hD f hf henergy] with x hx
      simpa only [actionPolynomialFunction, mul_smul] using finiteRegularSum_energy_le Γ c _ hx
    _ = _ := lintegral_const_mul _
      (Measurable.tsum (fun g : Γ => (hf.comp (measurable_const_smul g)).enorm.pow_const (2 : ℕ)))

name: SVW.actionL2Operator_coe
statement:
theorem actionL2Operator_coe (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X) [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ]
    (g : Γ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    actionL2Operator Γ X μ g f =ᵐ[μ] fun x : X => f (g⁻¹ • x)
proof:
:=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ)

name: SVW.actionPolynomialOperator_coe
statement:
theorem actionPolynomialOperator_coe (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X]
    (μ : Measure X) [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ] (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    actionPolynomialOperator Γ X μ c f =ᵐ[μ] actionPolynomialFunction Γ X c f
proof:
:= by
  have hh (g : Γ) : (c g • actionL2Operator Γ X μ g f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) =ᵐ[μ]
      (fun x : X => c g * f (g⁻¹ • x)) := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (c g) (actionL2Operator Γ X μ g f),
      actionL2Operator_coe Γ X μ g f] with x hs hg
    rw [hs]
    change c g * (actionL2Operator Γ X μ g f) x = c g * f (g⁻¹ • x)
    rw [hg]
  have hvec : actionPolynomialOperator Γ X μ c f =
      ∑ g ∈ c.support, c g • actionL2Operator Γ X μ g f := by
    simp only [actionPolynomialOperator, Finsupp.sum, sum_apply, smul_apply]
  rw [hvec]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_finsetSum c.support (fun g => c g • actionL2Operator Γ X μ g f),
    ae_all_iff.mpr hh] with x hsum hterms
  rw [hsum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, actionPolynomialFunction, Finsupp.sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => hterms g)

name: SVW.squareEnergy_congr_ae
statement:
theorem squareEnergy_congr_ae (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)
    (f g : X → ℂ) (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) : squareEnergy X μ f = squareEnergy X μ g
proof:
:= by
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hfg] with x hx
  rw [hx]

name: SVW.actionPolynomialOperator_norm_apply_le
statement:
theorem actionPolynomialOperator_norm_apply_le (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X)
    [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ] (D : Set X) (hD : IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ)
    (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ‖actionPolynomialOperator Γ X μ c f‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖ * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have henergy : squareEnergy X μ f ≠ ∞ := by rw [squareEnergy_lp]; finiteness
  have h := actionPolynomialFunction_energy_le Γ X μ D hD c f (Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).measurable henergy
  rw [← squareEnergy_congr_ae X μ _ _ (actionPolynomialOperator_coe Γ X μ c f),
    squareEnergy_lp, squareEnergy_lp] at h
  have hR := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness :
    ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) * ‖f‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≠ ∞) h
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_pow, toReal_enorm, mul_pow] using hR

name: SVW.actionPolynomialOperator_norm_le
statement:
theorem actionPolynomialOperator_norm_le (Γ X : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X] (μ : Measure X)
    [SMulInvariantMeasure Γ X μ] (D : Set X) (hD : IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ)
    (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) : ‖actionPolynomialOperator Γ X μ c‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
  exact actionPolynomialOperator_norm_apply_le Γ X μ D hD c

name: SVW.discrete_subgroup_regular_restriction_norm_le
statement:
theorem discrete_subgroup_regular_restriction_norm_le (G : Type*) [Group G]
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [SecondCountableTopology G]
    [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (Γ : Subgroup G) [Countable Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
    (μ : Measure G) [Measure.IsMulLeftInvariant μ] (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖actionPolynomialOperator Γ G μ c‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, _, hD⟩ := discrete_subgroup_exists_measurable_fundamentalDomain G Γ μ
  exact actionPolynomialOperator_norm_le Γ G μ D hD c

name: SVW.injective_discrete_hom_regular_restriction_norm_le
statement:
theorem injective_discrete_hom_regular_restriction_norm_le (Γ G : Type*) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [SecondCountableTopology G]
    [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (ι : Γ →* G) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    [DiscreteTopology ι.range] (μ : Measure G) [Measure.IsMulLeftInvariant μ] (c : Γ →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • actionL2Operator G G μ (ι g))‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularSum Γ c‖
proof:
:= by
  letI : Countable ι.range := Countable.of_equiv Γ (MonoidHom.ofInjective hι).toEquiv
  obtain ⟨D, _, hD⟩ := discrete_subgroup_exists_measurable_fundamentalDomain G ι.range μ
  letI : MulAction Γ G := MulAction.compHom G ι
  letI : MeasurableConstSMul Γ G := ⟨fun g => measurable_const_mul (ι g)⟩
  letI : SMulInvariantMeasure Γ G μ := ⟨fun g _ _ => measure_preimage_mul μ (ι g) _⟩
  have hDΓ : IsFundamentalDomain Γ D μ := by
    have he := hD.preimage_of_equiv (MeasurePreserving.id μ).quasiMeasurePreserving
      (MonoidHom.ofInjective hι).symm.bijective (fun g x => by
        change ι ((MonoidHom.ofInjective hι).symm g) * x = (g : G) * x
        rw [MonoidHom.apply_ofInjective_symm])
    simpa only [preimage_id] using he
  have haction (g : Γ) : actionL2Operator Γ G μ g = actionL2Operator G G μ (ι g) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [actionL2Operator_coe Γ G μ g f, actionL2Operator_coe G G μ (ι g) f]
      with x hleft hright
    rw [hleft, hright]
    change f (ι g⁻¹ * x) = f ((ι g)⁻¹ * x)
    rw [map_inv]
  have hpoly : actionPolynomialOperator Γ G μ c =
      c.sum (fun g z => z • actionL2Operator G G μ (ι g)) := by
    simp only [actionPolynomialOperator, haction]
  rw [← hpoly]
  exact actionPolynomialOperator_norm_le Γ G μ D hDΓ c

name: SVW.powers_mulHead_last
statement:
theorem powers_mulHead_last {i j : Bool} (w : PowersNeWord i j)
    (x : PowersFactor) (hx : x * w.head ≠ 1) (hw : 1 < w.toList.length) :
    (w.mulHead x hx).last = w.last
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | singleton y hy => simp at hw
  | append w₁ h w₂ => simp [NeWord.mulHead, NeWord.replaceHead]

name: SVW.powers_conjugate_normal_form
statement:
theorem powers_conjugate_normal_form {i j : Bool} (w : PowersNeWord i j)
    (x : PowersFactor) (hx : x ≠ 1) (hh : x * w.head ≠ 1)
    (ht : x * w.last⁻¹ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ v : PowersNeWord false false,
      v.prod = Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := false) x * w.prod *
        (Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := false) x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> cases j
  · cases w with
    | singleton y hy =>
      refine ⟨NeWord.singleton y hy, ?_⟩
      simp only [NeWord.prod_singleton, ← map_inv, ← map_mul]
      congr 1
      simp [mul_comm x y, mul_assoc]
    | @append _ j k _ w₁ h w₂ =>
      let w : PowersNeWord false false := NeWord.append w₁ h w₂
      have hw : 1 < w.toList.length := by
        have h₁ := List.length_pos_iff.mpr w₁.toList_ne_nil
        have h₂ := List.length_pos_iff.mpr w₂.toList_ne_nil
        simp only [w, NeWord.toList, List.length_append]
        omega
      have hl : (w.mulHead x hh).last = w.last := powers_mulHead_last w x hh hw
      have hh' : x * (w.mulHead x hh).inv.head ≠ 1 := by
        simpa only [NeWord.inv_head, hl] using ht
      refine ⟨((w.mulHead x hh).inv.mulHead x hh').inv, ?_⟩
      simp only [NeWord.inv_prod, NeWord.mulHead_prod, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]
      simp [w, mul_assoc]
  · let v : PowersNeWord false false := NeWord.append (w.mulHead x hh) (by decide : true ≠ false)
      (NeWord.singleton x⁻¹ (inv_ne_one.mpr hx))
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    simp [v]
  · let v : PowersNeWord false false := NeWord.append (NeWord.singleton x hx) (by decide : false ≠ true)
      ((w.inv.mulHead x (by simpa only [NeWord.inv_head] using ht)).inv)
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    simp [v, mul_assoc]
  · let v : PowersNeWord false false := NeWord.append
      (NeWord.append (NeWord.singleton x hx) (by decide : false ≠ true) w)
      (by decide : true ≠ false) (NeWord.singleton x⁻¹ (inv_ne_one.mpr hx))
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    simp [v]

name: SVW.powers_of_smul_first
statement:
theorem powers_of_smul_first (i : Bool) (x : PowersFactor) (hx : x ≠ 1)
    (w : PowersWord) (hw : w.fstIdx ≠ some i) :
    (Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := i) x • w).fstIdx = some i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Word.cons_eq_smul (h1 := hw) (h2 := hx)]
  exact Word.fstIdx_cons (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) x w hw hx

name: SVW.powers_neWord_smul_first
statement:
theorem powers_neWord_smul_first {i j : Bool} (w : PowersNeWord i j)
    (v : PowersWord) (hv : v.fstIdx ≠ some j) :
    (w.prod • v).fstIdx = some i
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | singleton x hx =>
    simpa only [NeWord.prod_singleton] using powers_of_smul_first _ x hx v hv
  | @append i j k l w₁ h w₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [NeWord.append_prod, mul_smul]
    apply ih₁
    rw [ih₂ v hv]
    exact fun he => h (Option.some.inj he).symm

name: SVW.powers_finite_conjugate
statement:
theorem powers_finite_conjugate (F : Finset PowersProduct) (hF : 1 ∉ F) :
    ∃ x : PowersFactor, x ≠ 1 ∧ ∀ f ∈ F,
      ∃ v : PowersNeWord false false,
        v.prod = Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := false) x * f *
          (Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := false) x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn (f : F) : ∃ i j : Bool, ∃ w : PowersNeWord i j, w.prod = f.val := by
    have hne : (Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) f.val ≠ Word.empty := by
      intro he
      have hp := congrArg Word.prod he
      have hf : f.val = 1 := by
        simpa only [Word.equiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Word.prod_smul, Word.prod_empty, mul_one] using hp
      exact hF (hf ▸ f.property)
    obtain ⟨i, j, w, hw⟩ := NeWord.of_word
      ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) f.val) hne
    refine ⟨i, j, w, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [NeWord.prod]
    rw [hw]
    exact (Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)).symm_apply_apply f.val
  choose i j w hw using hn
  let bad : Set PowersFactor := {1} ∪ Set.range (fun f : F => (w f).head⁻¹) ∪
    Set.range (fun f : F => (w f).last)
  have hbad : bad.Finite :=
    ((Set.finite_singleton 1).union (Set.finite_range _)).union (Set.finite_range _)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hbad.exists_notMem
  have hxone : x ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    exact hx (Or.inl (Or.inl he))
  refine ⟨x, hxone, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  let f' : F := ⟨f, hf⟩
  have hh : x * (w f').head ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    have hex : x = (w f').head⁻¹ := by
      calc
        x = (x * (w f').head) * (w f').head⁻¹ := by simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [he, one_mul]
    exact hx (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨f', hex.symm⟩))
  have ht : x * (w f').last⁻¹ ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    have hex : x = (w f').last := by
      calc
        x = (x * (w f').last⁻¹) * (w f').last := by simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [he, one_mul]
    exact hx (Or.inr ⟨f', hex.symm⟩)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := powers_conjugate_normal_form (w f') x hxone hh ht
  exact ⟨v, by simpa only [hw] using hv⟩

name: SVW.powers_word_mul
statement:
theorem powers_word_mul (g h : PowersProduct) :
    (Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (g * h) =
      g • (Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) h
proof:
:=
  mul_smul g h (Word.empty : PowersWord)

name: SVW.powers_first_syllable
statement:
theorem powers_first_syllable (x : PowersFactor) (w : PowersWord)
    (hw : w.fstIdx ≠ some true) :
    (Word.equivPair true
      (Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := true) x • w)).head = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Word.equivPair_smul_same, Word.equivPair_eq_of_fstIdx_ne hw]
  exact mul_one x

name: SVW.powers_partition_cyclic_product
statement:
theorem powers_partition_cyclic_product (F : Finset PowersProduct) (hF : 1 ∉ F) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C D : Set PowersProduct, Disjoint C D ∧ C ∪ D = Set.univ ∧
      ∃ γ : Fin N → PowersProduct,
        (∀ f ∈ F, Disjoint (f • C) C) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j : Fin N => Disjoint (γ i • D) (γ j • D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hconj⟩ := powers_finite_conjugate F hF
  let a : PowersProduct := Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := false) x
  let C : Set PowersProduct := {g | ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * g)).fstIdx = some true}
  let D : Set PowersProduct := Cᶜ
  let γ : Fin N → PowersProduct := fun k =>
    Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := true) (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((k.val : ℤ) + 1)) * a
  refine ⟨C, D, disjoint_compl_right, Set.union_compl_self C, γ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hconj f hf
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ hz
    have hc' : ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * c)).fstIdx ≠ some false := by
      rw [show ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * c)).fstIdx = some true from hc]
      decide
    have hh := powers_neWord_smul_first v
      ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * c)) hc'
    have he : a * (f * c) = v.prod * (a * c) := by
      rw [hv]
      dsimp [a]
      group
    change ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * (f * c))).fstIdx = some true at hz
    rw [he, powers_word_mul, hh] at hz
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (Option.some.inj hz)
  · intro k l hkl
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨c, hc, hcz⟩ ⟨d, hd, hdz⟩
    have hc' : ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * c)).fstIdx ≠ some true := hc
    have hd' : ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) (a * d)).fstIdx ≠ some true := hd
    have he : Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := true)
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((k.val : ℤ) + 1)) * (a * c) =
      Monoid.CoprodI.of (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor) (i := true)
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((l.val : ℤ) + 1)) * (a * d) := by
      simpa only [γ, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using hcz.trans hdz.symm
    have hp := congrArg (fun g : PowersProduct =>
      (Word.equivPair true ((Word.equiv (M := fun _ : Bool => PowersFactor)) g)).head) he
    rw [powers_word_mul _ (a * c), powers_word_mul _ (a * d),
      powers_first_syllable _ _ hc', powers_first_syllable _ _ hd'] at hp
    have hv := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hp
    change (k.val : ℤ) + 1 = (l.val : ℤ) + 1 at hv
    apply hkl
    apply Fin.ext
    exact_mod_cast (add_right_cancel hv : (k.val : ℤ) = (l.val : ℤ))

name: SVW.freeGroup_powers_partition
statement:
theorem freeGroup_powers_partition (F : Finset (FreeGroup Bool))
    (hF : 1 ∉ F) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C D : Set (FreeGroup Bool), Disjoint C D ∧ C ∪ D = Set.univ ∧
      ∃ γ : Fin N → FreeGroup Bool,
        (∀ f ∈ F, Disjoint (f • C) C) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j : Fin N => Disjoint (γ i • D) (γ j • D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := freeCyclicEquiv
  have hF' : 1 ∉ F.image e := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    apply hF
    have he : f = 1 := e.injective (hfe.trans e.map_one.symm)
    exact he ▸ hf
  obtain ⟨C, D, hCD, hcover, γ, hleft, hpair⟩ :=
    powers_partition_cyclic_product (F.image e) hF' N
  refine ⟨e ⁻¹' C, e ⁻¹' D, ?_, ?_, fun k => e.symm (γ k), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hCD.preimage e
  · rw [← Set.preimage_union, hcover, Set.preimage_univ]
  · intro f hf
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ hz
    have hm : e (f * c) ∈ e f • C := ⟨e c, hc, (e.map_mul f c).symm⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hleft (e f) (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)) hm hz
  · intro i j hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨c, hc, hcz⟩ ⟨d, hd, hdz⟩
    have hmi : e z ∈ γ i • D := by
      refine ⟨e c, hc, ?_⟩
      have he := congrArg e hcz
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul, e.map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply] using he
    have hmj : e z ∈ γ j • D := by
      refine ⟨e d, hd, ?_⟩
      have he := congrArg e hdz
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul, e.map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply] using he
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hpair hij) hmi hmj

name: SVW.chirpPhase_continuous
statement: theorem chirpPhase_continuous (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) : Continuous (chirpPhase d m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chirpPhase
  fun_prop

name: SVW.chirpPhase_norm
statement: theorem chirpPhase_norm (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (x : Space d) : ‖chirpPhase d m x‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _

name: SVW.chirpPhase_add
statement:
theorem chirpPhase_add (d : ℕ) (m n : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    chirpPhase d (m + n) x = chirpPhase d m x * chirpPhase d n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold chirpPhase
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.chirpPhase_neg
statement:
theorem chirpPhase_neg (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    chirpPhase d (-m) x = star (chirpPhase d m x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chirpPhase
  simp [← Complex.exp_conj]

name: SVW.chirpPhase_even
statement:
theorem chirpPhase_even (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    chirpPhase d m (-x) = chirpPhase d m x
proof: := by simp [chirpPhase]

name: SVW.chirpUnitary_coe
statement:
theorem chirpUnitary_coe (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    chirpUnitary d m f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => chirpPhase d m x * f x
proof:
:=
  (chirpSymbol d m).operator_coe f

name: SVW.chirpUnitary_add
statement:
theorem chirpUnitary_add (d : ℕ) (m n : ℝ) :
    chirpUnitary d (m + n) = chirpUnitary d m * chirpUnitary d n
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [chirpUnitary_coe d (m+n) f,
    chirpUnitary_coe d m (chirpUnitary d n f), chirpUnitary_coe d n f]
    with x ha hm hn
  change chirpUnitary d (m+n) f x = chirpUnitary d m (chirpUnitary d n f) x
  rw [ha, hm, hn, chirpPhase_add, mul_assoc]

name: SVW.chirpUnitary_zero
statement: theorem chirpUnitary_zero (d : ℕ) : chirpUnitary d 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [chirpUnitary_coe d 0 f] with x hx
  simpa [chirpPhase] using hx

name: SVW.chirpUnitary_inv
statement:
theorem chirpUnitary_inv (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) :
    (chirpUnitary d m)⁻¹ = chirpUnitary d (-m)
proof:
:= by
  apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right
  rw [← chirpUnitary_add, add_neg_cancel, chirpUnitary_zero]

name: SVW.frequencyChirpUnitary_apply
statement:
theorem frequencyChirpUnitary_apply (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    frequencyChirpUnitary d m f = (fourier d).symm (chirpUnitary d m (fourier d f))
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.oscillatorWord_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem oscillatorWord_first (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) :
    oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of false) = chirpUnitary d m
proof:
:= by
  simp [oscillatorWord]

name: SVW.oscillatorWord_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem oscillatorWord_second (d : ℕ) (m : ℝ) :
    oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of true) = frequencyChirpUnitary d m
proof:
:= by
  simp [oscillatorWord]

name: SVW.mpGaussianScalar_product_sq
statement:
theorem mpGaussianScalar_product_sq (d : ℕ) (a : MpRoot) (w z : ℍ) :
    (star (mpGaussianScalar d a w) * mpGaussianScalar d a z)^2 =
      ((star (mpDenom a.base w) * mpDenom a.base z)^(d+2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mpGaussianScalar, star_inv₀, star_pow]
  rw [← mul_inv, inv_pow, ← mul_pow, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (d+2) 2, pow_mul,
    mul_pow, ← star_pow, MpRoot.automorphy_sq, MpRoot.automorphy_sq]

name: SVW.mpGaussian_inner_sq
statement:
theorem mpGaussian_inner_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (w z : ℍ) :
    (inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i w) (mpGaussian d i z))^2 =
      (Real.pi:ℂ)^d / (4*(star (mpPrecision w)+mpPrecision z)^(d+2))
proof:
:=
  hermiteGaussianVector_inner_sq d i _ _ _ _

name: SVW.mpGaussianImage_inner_sq
statement:
theorem mpGaussianImage_inner_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) (w z : ℍ) :
    (inner ℂ (mpGaussianImage d i a w) (mpGaussianImage d i a z))^2 =
      (inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i w) (mpGaussian d i z))^2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mpGaussianImage, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (mpGaussianScalar d a z), mul_pow]
  change (star (mpGaussianScalar d a w) * mpGaussianScalar d a z)^2 * _ = _
  rw [mpGaussianScalar_product_sq, mpGaussian_inner_sq, mpGaussian_inner_sq]
  rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_div]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_comm (star (mpPrecision (a.base • w)) +
    mpPrecision (a.base • z)), mpPrecision_cross]

name: SVW.mpGaussian_inner_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mpGaussian_inner_ne_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (w z : ℍ) :
    inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i w) (mpGaussian d i z) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs := mpGaussian_inner_sq d i w z
  rw [h, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)] at hs
  have hp : (Real.pi : ℂ)^d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero)
  have ht : star (mpPrecision w) + mpPrecision z ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hr := add_pos (mpPrecision_re_pos w) (mpPrecision_re_pos z)
    have hre : (star (mpPrecision w) + mpPrecision z).re = 0 := congrArg Complex.re he
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] at hre
    linarith
  exact (div_ne_zero hp (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero _ ht))) hs.symm

name: SVW.inner_self_eq_of_sq_eq
statement:
theorem inner_self_eq_of_sq_eq (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (x y : H) (h : (inner ℂ x x)^2 = (inner ℂ y y)^2) : inner ℂ x x = inner ℂ y y
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (inner ℂ x x).im = 0 := inner_self_im (𝕜 := ℂ) x
  have hy : (inner ℂ y y).im = 0 := inner_self_im (𝕜 := ℂ) y
  apply Complex.ext
  · have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [pow_two, Complex.mul_re, hx, hy, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hre
    exact (mul_self_inj_of_nonneg (inner_self_nonneg (𝕜 := ℂ) (x := x))
      (inner_self_nonneg (𝕜 := ℂ) (x := y))).mp hre
  · rw [hx, hy]

name: SVW.mpGaussian_continuous
statement: theorem mpGaussian_continuous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) : Continuous (mpGaussian d i)
proof:
:=
  continuous_hermiteGaussianVector_upperHalfPlane d i

name: SVW.mpGaussianImage_continuous
statement:
theorem mpGaussianImage_continuous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    Continuous (fun p : MpRoot × ℍ => mpGaussianImage d i p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous (fun p : MpRoot × ℍ => mpGaussianScalar d p.1 p.2) :=
    (MpRoot.continuous_automorphy.pow (d+2)).inv₀
      (fun p => pow_ne_zero _ (p.1.automorphy_ne_zero p.2))
  have hq : Continuous (fun p : MpRoot × ℍ => mpGaussian d i (p.1.base • p.2)) :=
    (mpGaussian_continuous d i).comp
      ((MpRoot.continuous_base.comp continuous_fst).smul continuous_snd)
  exact hs.smul hq

name: SVW.mpGaussianImage_fixed_continuous
statement:
theorem mpGaussianImage_fixed_continuous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) :
    Continuous (mpGaussianImage d i a)
proof:
:=
  Continuous.uncurry_left (f := mpGaussianImage d i) a (mpGaussianImage_continuous d i)

statement: theorem mpGaussianGram_continuous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) : Continuous (mpGaussianGram d i)
proof:
:=

    ((mpGaussian_continuous d i).comp continuous_snd)

statement:
theorem mpGaussianImageGram_continuous (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) :
    Continuous (mpGaussianImageGram d i a)
proof:
:=
  ((mpGaussianImage_fixed_continuous d i a).comp continuous_fst).inner
    ((mpGaussianImage_fixed_continuous d i a).comp continuous_snd)

name: SVW.mpGaussianImageGram_sq
statement:
theorem mpGaussianImageGram_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) :
    (mpGaussianImageGram d i a)^2 = (mpGaussianGram d i)^2
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  exact mpGaussianImage_inner_sq d i a p.1 p.2

name: SVW.mpGaussianGram_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mpGaussianGram_ne_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (p : ℍ × ℍ) :
    mpGaussianGram d i p ≠ 0
proof: := mpGaussian_inner_ne_zero d i p.1 p.2

name: SVW.mpGaussianImageGram_at_base
statement:
theorem mpGaussianImageGram_at_base (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) :
    mpGaussianImageGram d i a (UpperHalfPlane.I, UpperHalfPlane.I) =
      mpGaussianGram d i (UpperHalfPlane.I, UpperHalfPlane.I)
proof:
:=
  inner_self_eq_of_sq_eq (Hilbert d)
    (mpGaussianImage d i a UpperHalfPlane.I) (mpGaussian d i UpperHalfPlane.I)
    (mpGaussianImage_inner_sq d i a UpperHalfPlane.I UpperHalfPlane.I)

name: SVW.mpGaussianImageGram_eq
statement:
theorem mpGaussianImageGram_eq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) :
    mpGaussianImageGram d i a = mpGaussianGram d i
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : IsPreconnected (Set.univ : Set (ℍ × ℍ)) := isPreconnected_univ
  have he : Set.EqOn (mpGaussianImageGram d i a) (mpGaussianGram d i) Set.univ :=
    hpre.eq_of_sq_eq (mpGaussianImageGram_continuous d i a).continuousOn
      (mpGaussianGram_continuous d i).continuousOn
      (fun p _ => congrFun (mpGaussianImageGram_sq d i a) p)
      (fun {p} (_hp : p ∈ (Set.univ : Set (ℍ × ℍ))) => mpGaussianGram_ne_zero d i p)
      (Set.mem_univ (UpperHalfPlane.I, UpperHalfPlane.I))
      (mpGaussianImageGram_at_base d i a)
  exact (Set.eqOn_univ _ _).mp he

name: SVW.mpGaussianImage_inner

name: SVW.mpGaussian_range
statement:
theorem mpGaussian_range (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    Set.range (mpGaussian d i) = hermiteGaussianGenerators d i
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨mpPrecision z, mpPrecision_re_pos z⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mpPrecision_surjective b b.property
    exact ⟨z, by simp only [mpGaussian, hz]⟩

name: SVW.mpGaussianSector_linearCombination_coe
statement:
theorem mpGaussianSector_linearCombination_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (c : ℍ →₀ ℂ) :
    (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ (mpGaussianSector d i) c : Hilbert d) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ (mpGaussian d i) c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, mpGaussianSector]

name: SVW.mpGaussianSector_dense
statement:
theorem mpGaussianSector_dense (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    DenseRange (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ (mpGaussianSector d i))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : DenseRange (Set.inclusion
      ((hermiteGaussianSpan d i).le_topologicalClosure :
        (hermiteGaussianSpan d i : Set (Hilbert d)) ⊆ hermiteGaussianSector d i)) :=
    (denseRange_inclusion_iff _).mpr Set.Subset.rfl
  apply hd.mono
  rintro f ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hv : (v : Hilbert d) ∈ LinearMap.range (Finsupp.linearCombination ℂ (mpGaussian d i)) := by
    rw [Finsupp.range_linearCombination, mpGaussian_range]
    exact v.property
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨c, Subtype.ext ((mpGaussianSector_linearCombination_coe d i c).trans hc)⟩

name: SVW.mpGaussianSector_operator_ext
statement:
theorem mpGaussianSector_operator_ext (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (T S : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
    (h : ∀ z : ℍ, T (mpGaussianSector d i z) = S (mpGaussianSector d i z)) : T = S
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.coe_injective
  apply (mpGaussianSector_dense d i).equalizer T.continuous S.continuous
  funext c
  classical
  simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, h]

name: SVW.mpGaussianSectorImage_gram
statement:
theorem mpGaussianSectorImage_gram (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) (w z : ℍ) :

statement:
theorem mpGaussianOperator_generator (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) :

proof:

name: SVW.mpGaussianOperator_norm
statement:
theorem mpGaussianOperator_norm (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot)
    (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) : ‖mpGaussianOperator d i a f‖ = ‖f‖

name: SVW.mpGaussianScalar_one
statement: @[simp] theorem mpGaussianScalar_one (d : ℕ) (z : ℍ) : mpGaussianScalar d 1 z = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mpGaussianScalar, MpRoot.automorphy_one]

name: SVW.mpGaussianScalar_mul
statement:
theorem mpGaussianScalar_mul (d : ℕ) (a b : MpRoot) (z : ℍ) :
    mpGaussianScalar d (a*b) z = mpGaussianScalar d a (b.base • z) * mpGaussianScalar d b z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mpGaussianScalar, MpRoot.automorphy_mul, mul_pow, mul_inv]

name: SVW.mpGaussianOperator_one
statement:
theorem mpGaussianOperator_one (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    mpGaussianOperator d i 1 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
proof:
:= by
  apply mpGaussianSector_operator_ext d i
  intro z
  simp [mpGaussianOperator_generator, mpGaussianSectorImage]

name: SVW.mpGaussianOperator_mul
statement:
theorem mpGaussianOperator_mul (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a b : MpRoot) :
    mpGaussianOperator d i (a*b) = (mpGaussianOperator d i a).comp (mpGaussianOperator d i b)
proof:
:= by
  apply mpGaussianSector_operator_ext d i
  intro z
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, mpGaussianOperator_generator, mpGaussianOperator_generator]
  change mpGaussianScalar d (a*b) z • mpGaussianSector d i ((a*b).base • z) =
    mpGaussianOperator d i a (mpGaussianScalar d b z • mpGaussianSector d i (b.base • z))
  rw [map_smul, mpGaussianOperator_generator]
  change mpGaussianScalar d (a*b) z • mpGaussianSector d i ((a*b).base • z) =
    mpGaussianScalar d b z • (mpGaussianScalar d a (b.base • z) •
      mpGaussianSector d i (a.base • (b.base • z)))
  rw [MpRoot.base_mul, mul_smul a.base b.base z, mpGaussianScalar_mul, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm (mpGaussianScalar d a (b.base • z))]
  exact mul_smul (mpGaussianScalar d b z) (mpGaussianScalar d a (b.base • z)) _

name: SVW.mpGaussianUnitary_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mpGaussianUnitary_apply (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : MpRoot)

theorem mpGaussianUnitary_mul_apply (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a b : MpRoot)
