name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_norm_mono_re
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_norm_mono_re (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℂ)
    (hbc : c.re ≤ b.re) (x : Space d) :
    ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x‖ ≤ ‖hermiteGaussian d i c x‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteGaussian, norm_mul, complexGaussian_norm]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
  unfold gaussian
  apply exp_le_exp.mpr
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_difference_bound
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_difference_bound (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (a : ℝ) (b c : ℂ)
    (hb : a/2 ≤ b.re) (hc : a/2 ≤ c.re) (x : Space d) :
    ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x‖^2 ≤
      4*((x i)^2 * gaussian d a x)
proof:
:= by
  have hnb := hermiteGaussian_norm_mono_re d i b ((a/2 : ℝ) : ℂ) hb x
  have hnc := hermiteGaussian_norm_mono_re d i c ((a/2 : ℝ) : ℂ) hc x
  have hn : ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x‖ ≤
      2*‖hermiteGaussian d i ((a/2 : ℝ) : ℂ) x‖ := by
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*‖hermiteGaussian d i ((a/2 : ℝ) : ℂ) x‖)).mpr hn
  rw [mul_pow, hermiteGaussian_norm_sq] at hs
  have he : 2*(((a/2 : ℝ) : ℂ).re) = a := by simp; ring
  simpa only [he, show (2:ℝ)^2 = 4 by norm_num] using hs

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_sub_norm_sq
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_sub_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    ‖hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb - hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc‖^2 =
      ∫ x : Space d, ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc),
    hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb, hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i c hc] with x hx hy hz
  rw [hx, Pi.sub_apply, hy, hz]

name: SVW.continuous_hermiteGaussianVector
statement:
theorem continuous_hermiteGaussianVector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    Continuous (fun b : GaussianPrecision => hermiteGaussianVector d i b b.property)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro c
  have hc : 0 < c.val.re := c.property
  have hre : Continuous (fun b : GaussianPrecision => b.val.re) :=
    Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ b : GaussianPrecision in nhds c, c.val.re/2 < b.val.re :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hre).mem_nhds (by change c.val.re/2 < c.val.re; linarith)
  let B : Space d → ℝ := fun x => 4*((x i)^2 * gaussian d c.val.re x)
  have hB : Integrable B volume :=
    (integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d c.val.re hc i).const_mul 4
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ b : GaussianPrecision in nhds c,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : Space d =>
        ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x‖^2) volume :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun b =>
      (((continuous_hermiteGaussian d i b).sub (continuous_hermiteGaussian d i c)).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ b : GaussianPrecision in nhds c, ∀ᵐ x : Space d ∂volume,
      ‖‖hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x‖^2‖ ≤ B x := by
    filter_upwards [hnear] with b hb
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact hermiteGaussian_difference_bound d i c.val.re b c hb.le (by linarith) x
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x : Space d ∂volume,
      Tendsto (fun b : GaussianPrecision => ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x‖^2)
        (nhds c) (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      have hf : Continuous (fun b : GaussianPrecision => hermiteGaussian d i b x) := by
        unfold hermiteGaussian complexGaussian
        fun_prop
      have ht : Tendsto (fun b : GaussianPrecision => hermiteGaussian d i b x - hermiteGaussian d i c x)
          (nhds c) (nhds (hermiteGaussian d i c x - hermiteGaussian d i c x)) :=
        (hf.tendsto c).sub tendsto_const_nhds
      simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)] using ht.norm.pow 2
  have ht := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence B hmeas hbound hB hpoint
  have hs : Tendsto (fun b : GaussianPrecision =>
      ‖hermiteGaussianVector d i b b.property - hermiteGaussianVector d i c c.property‖^2)
      (nhds c) (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [hermiteGaussianVector_sub_norm_sq, integral_zero] using ht
  rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  have hsqrt := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hs
  have heq : ((fun r : ℝ => sqrt r) ∘ (fun b : GaussianPrecision =>
      ‖hermiteGaussianVector d i b b.property - hermiteGaussianVector d i c c.property‖^2)) =
      (fun b : GaussianPrecision =>
        ‖hermiteGaussianVector d i b b.property - hermiteGaussianVector d i c c.property‖) := by
    funext b
    exact sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [heq] at hsqrt
  simpa only [sqrt_zero] using hsqrt

name: SVW.upperShear_add
statement: theorem upperShear_add (s t : ℝ) : upperShear (s + t) = upperShear s * upperShear t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [upperShear, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, add_comm]

name: SVW.upperShear_apply
statement:
theorem upperShear_apply (t : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    upperShear t • v = ![v 0 + t * v 1, v 1]
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [upperShear, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.smul_def,

  fin_cases i <;> simp [lowerShear, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.smul_def,

name: SVW.shear_growth
statement:
theorem shear_growth (a x y : ℝ) (ha : 2 ≤ |a|) (hxy : |x| < |y|) :
    |y| < |x + a * y|
proof:
:= by
  have htri : |a * y| ≤ |x + a * y| + |x| := by
    calc
      |a * y| = |(x + a * y) - x| := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ |x + a * y| + |x| := abs_sub _ _
  rw [abs_mul] at htri
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (abs_nonneg y)
  linarith

name: SVW.cyclic_parameter_abs_ge_two
statement:
theorem cyclic_parameter_abs_ge_two (m : ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (k : Multiplicative ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 1) :
    2 ≤ |((Multiplicative.toAdd k : ℤ) : ℝ) * m|
proof:
:= by
  have hkzero : Multiplicative.toAdd k ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hk
    exact congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd h
  have habs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((Multiplicative.toAdd k : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by
    exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hkzero
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ m)]
  nlinarith

name: SVW.shearCone_nonempty
statement: theorem shearCone_nonempty (i : Bool) : (shearCone i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  cases i
  · exact ⟨![1, 0], by norm_num [shearCone]⟩
  · exact ⟨![0, 1], by norm_num [shearCone]⟩

name: SVW.shearCone_disjoint
statement: theorem shearCone_disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j : Bool => Disjoint (shearCone i) (shearCone j))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  cases i <;> cases j
  · exact False.elim (hij rfl)
  · simp only [shearCone, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun v hv hw =>
      (show ¬ |v 0| < |v 1| from not_lt_of_gt hv) hw)
  · simp only [shearCone, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun v hv hw =>
      (show ¬ |v 1| < |v 0| from not_lt_of_gt hv) hw)
  · exact False.elim (hij rfl)

name: SVW.shearCyclic_pingpong
statement:
theorem shearCyclic_pingpong (m : ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    Pairwise (fun i j : Bool => ∀ k : Multiplicative ℤ, k ≠ 1 →
      shearCyclic m i k • shearCone j ⊆ shearCone i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij k hk
  have habs := cyclic_parameter_abs_ge_two m hm k hk
  cases i <;> cases j
  · exact False.elim (hij rfl)
  · rintro w ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    change |(upperShear (((Multiplicative.toAdd k : ℤ) : ℝ) * m) • v) 1| <
      |(upperShear (((Multiplicative.toAdd k : ℤ) : ℝ) * m) • v) 0|
    rw [upperShear_apply]
    exact shear_growth _ _ _ habs hv
  · rintro w ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    change |(lowerShear (-((Multiplicative.toAdd k : ℤ) : ℝ) * m) • v) 0| <
      |(lowerShear (-((Multiplicative.toAdd k : ℤ) : ℝ) * m) • v) 1|
    rw [lowerShear_apply]
    apply shear_growth _ _ _ _ hv
    simpa only [neg_mul, abs_neg] using habs
  · exact False.elim (hij rfl)

name: SVW.shear_free_product_injective
statement:
theorem shear_free_product_injective (m : ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    Function.Injective (Monoid.CoprodI.lift (shearCyclic m))
proof:
:= by
  apply Monoid.CoprodI.lift_injective_of_ping_pong (shearCyclic m) _
    shearCone shearCone_nonempty shearCone_disjoint (shearCyclic_pingpong m hm)
  exact Or.inr ⟨false, (Cardinal.natCast_le_aleph0 (n := 3)).trans (Cardinal.aleph0_le_mk _)⟩

name: SVW.cyclicProduct_left_inverse
statement:
theorem cyclicProduct_left_inverse :
    cyclicProductToFreeGroup.comp freeGroupToCyclicProduct = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp [cyclicProductToFreeGroup, freeGroupToCyclicProduct]

name: SVW.freeGroupToCyclicProduct_injective
statement: theorem freeGroupToCyclicProduct_injective : Function.Injective freeGroupToCyclicProduct
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := cyclicProductToFreeGroup)
  intro w
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun cyclicProduct_left_inverse w

name: SVW.shearRepresentation_eq
statement:
theorem shearRepresentation_eq (m : ℝ) :
    shearRepresentation m =
      (Monoid.CoprodI.lift (shearCyclic m)).comp freeGroupToCyclicProduct
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  cases i <;> simp [shearRepresentation, freeGroupToCyclicProduct, shearCyclic,
    upperCyclic, lowerCyclic]

name: SVW.shearRepresentation_injective
statement:
theorem shearRepresentation_injective (m : ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    Function.Injective (shearRepresentation m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shearRepresentation_eq]
  exact (shear_free_product_injective m hm).comp freeGroupToCyclicProduct_injective

name: SVW.shearRepresentation_ne_one
statement:
theorem shearRepresentation_ne_one (m : ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (w : FreeGroup Bool) (hw : w ≠ 1) : shearRepresentation m w ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hw
  exact shearRepresentation_injective m hm (h.trans (map_one _).symm)

name: SVW.mpPrecision_re_pos
statement: theorem mpPrecision_re_pos (z : ℍ) : 0 < (mpPrecision z).re
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mpPrecision] using mul_pos Real.pi_pos z.im_pos

name: SVW.mpPrecision_continuous
statement: theorem mpPrecision_continuous : Continuous mpPrecision
proof: := by unfold mpPrecision; fun_prop

name: SVW.mpPrecision_surjective
statement:
theorem mpPrecision_surjective :
    ∀ b : ℂ, 0 < b.re → ∃ z : ℍ, mpPrecision z = b
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  let z : ℍ := ⟨Complex.I * b / (Real.pi : ℂ), by
    simpa [Complex.div_re, Complex.div_im] using mul_pos hb Real.pi_pos⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  have hp : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  dsimp [mpPrecision, z]
  field_simp
  simp [Complex.I_sq]

name: SVW.mpDenom_cross
statement:
theorem mpDenom_cross (g : MpBase) (w z : ℍ) :
    star (mpDenom g w) * mpDenom g z *
      (((g • z : ℍ) : ℂ) - star ((g • w : ℍ) : ℂ)) = (z : ℂ) - star (w : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (g 0 0 : ℂ) * (g 1 1 : ℂ) - (g 0 1 : ℂ) * (g 1 0 : ℂ) = 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast (show g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 * g 1 0 = 1 by
      simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_two] using g.property)
  have hz := mpDenom_ne_zero g z
  have hw := star_ne_zero.mpr (mpDenom_ne_zero g w)
  simp only [UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
    RingHom.id_apply]
  simp only [mpDenom, map_add, map_mul, map_div₀, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal] at *
  field_simp [hz, hw]
  linear_combination ((z : ℂ) - star (w : ℂ)) * hd

name: SVW.mpPrecision_cross
statement:
theorem mpPrecision_cross (g : MpBase) (w z : ℍ) :
    star (mpDenom g w) * mpDenom g z *
      (star (mpPrecision (g • w)) + mpPrecision (g • z)) =
        star (mpPrecision w) + mpPrecision z
proof:
:= by
  have h := mpDenom_cross g w z
  simp only [mpPrecision, map_mul, map_neg, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    Complex.conj_I]
  linear_combination (-(Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) * h

name: SVW.gaussianSectorWord_coe
statement:
theorem gaussianSectorWord_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) (g : FreeGroup Bool)
    (x : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) :
    (gaussianSectorWord d i m g x : Hilbert d) = oscillatorWord d m g (x : Hilbert d)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, ∀ x : GaussianSectorHilbert d i,
      (gaussianSectorWord d i m g x : Hilbert d) = oscillatorWord d m g (x : Hilbert d) := by
    intro g
    induction g using FreeGroup.induction_on with
    | C1 => intro x; simp
    | of b =>
      intro x
      cases b <;> simp only [gaussianSectorWord, oscillatorWord, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of,
        Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      <;> rfl
    | inv_of b ih =>
      intro x
      simp only [map_inv]
      change (((gaussianSectorWord d i m (FreeGroup.of b)).symm x) : Hilbert d) =
        (oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of b)).symm (x : Hilbert d)
      apply (oscillatorWord d m (FreeGroup.of b)).injective
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      have he := ih ((gaussianSectorWord d i m (FreeGroup.of b)).symm x)
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at he
      exact he.symm
    | mul g h ihg ihh =>
      intro x
      simp only [map_mul]
      change (gaussianSectorWord d i m g (gaussianSectorWord d i m h x) : Hilbert d) =
        oscillatorWord d m g (oscillatorWord d m h (x : Hilbert d))
      rw [ihg, ihh]
  exact hi g x

name: SVW.gaussianSectorOperator_star
statement:
theorem gaussianSectorOperator_star (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    star (gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i m g) =
      gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i m g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change star (gaussianSectorWord d i m g :
    GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i) = _
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.star_eq_symm]
  change ((gaussianSectorWord d i m g).symm :
    GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i) =
    (gaussianSectorWord d i m g⁻¹ : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
  have he : gaussianSectorWord d i m g⁻¹ = (gaussianSectorWord d i m g).symm :=
    (gaussianSectorWord d i m).map_inv g
  rw [he]

name: SVW.gaussianSectorHilbert_odd
statement:
theorem gaussianSectorHilbert_odd (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) :
    OddVector d (f : Hilbert d)
proof: := hermiteGaussianSector_odd d i f f.property

name: SVW.mpPrecision_fourier
statement:
theorem mpPrecision_fourier (z : ℍ) :
    mpPrecision (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z) = (Real.pi : ℂ)^2 / mpPrecision z
proof:
:= by
  have hz : mpPrecision z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hp := mpPrecision_re_pos z
    simp [h] at hp
  have hz0 : (z : ℂ) ≠ 0 := UpperHalfPlane.ne_zero z
  unfold mpPrecision
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
  rw [MpRoot.fourierLift_base]
  simp
  field_simp
  simp [Complex.I_sq]

name: SVW.mpPrecision_shear
statement:
theorem mpPrecision_shear (m : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
    mpPrecision ((MpRoot.shear m).base • z) = mpPrecision z - (Real.pi : ℂ)*Complex.I*m
proof:
:= by
  unfold mpPrecision
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
  simp [MpRoot.base_shear, upperShear]
  ring

name: SVW.mpGaussianUnitary_shear
statement:
theorem mpGaussianUnitary_shear (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    mpGaussianUnitary d i (MpRoot.shear m) = gaussianSectorChirp d i m
proof:
:= by
  have hop : mpGaussianOperator d i (MpRoot.shear m) =
      (gaussianSectorChirp d i m : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i) := by
    apply mpGaussianSector_operator_ext d i
    intro z
    rw [mpGaussianOperator_generator]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change mpGaussianScalar d (MpRoot.shear m) z •
      hermiteGaussianVector d i (mpPrecision ((MpRoot.shear m).base • z)) (mpPrecision_re_pos ((MpRoot.shear m).base • z)) =
        chirpUnitary d m (hermiteGaussianVector d i (mpPrecision z) (mpPrecision_re_pos z))
    rw [chirpUnitary_hermiteGaussianVector]
    simp only [mpGaussianScalar, MpRoot.automorphy_shear, one_pow, inv_one, one_smul]
    congr 1
    exact mpPrecision_shear m z
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro f
  exact congrArg (fun T : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i => T f) hop

name: SVW.mpActualFourierScalar_ne_zero
statement: theorem mpActualFourierScalar_ne_zero (d : ℕ) (z : ℍ) : mpActualFourierScalar d z ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  hermiteFourierScalar_ne_zero d _ (mpPrecision_re_pos z)

name: SVW.gaussianSectorFourier_mpGaussian
statement:
theorem gaussianSectorFourier_mpGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (z : ℍ) :
    gaussianSectorFourier d i (mpGaussianSector d i z) =
      mpActualFourierScalar d z • mpGaussianSector d i (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change fourier d (hermiteGaussianVector d i (mpPrecision z) (mpPrecision_re_pos z)) =
    mpActualFourierScalar d z • hermiteGaussianVector d i (mpPrecision (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z)) (mpPrecision_re_pos (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z))
  rw [fourier_hermiteGaussianVector]
  change hermiteFourierScalar d (mpPrecision z) •
      hermiteGaussianVector d i ((Real.pi : ℂ)^2/mpPrecision z) _ =
    hermiteFourierScalar d (mpPrecision z) •
      hermiteGaussianVector d i (mpPrecision (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z)) _
  congr 2
  exact (mpPrecision_fourier z).symm

name: SVW.mpFourier_multiplier_cross
statement:
theorem mpFourier_multiplier_cross (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (w z : ℍ) :
    star (mpActualFourierScalar d w) * mpActualFourierScalar d z =
      star (mpGaussianScalar d MpRoot.fourierLift w) * mpGaussianScalar d MpRoot.fourierLift z
proof:
:= by
  have hF := (gaussianSectorFourier d i).inner_map_map
    (mpGaussianSector d i w) (mpGaussianSector d i z)
  rw [gaussianSectorFourier_mpGaussian, gaussianSectorFourier_mpGaussian] at hF
  change inner ℂ
    (mpActualFourierScalar d w • mpGaussian d i (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • w))
    (mpActualFourierScalar d z • mpGaussian d i (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z)) =
      inner ℂ (mpGaussian d i w) (mpGaussian d i z) at hF
  have hM := mpGaussianImage_inner d i MpRoot.fourierLift w z
  simp only [mpGaussianImage, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right] at hF hM
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (mpGaussian_inner_ne_zero d i (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • w)
    (MpRoot.fourierLift.base • z))
  simpa only [Complex.star_def, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hF.trans hM.symm

name: SVW.mpFourierPhase_ne_zero
statement: theorem mpFourierPhase_ne_zero (d : ℕ) : mpFourierPhase d ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  div_ne_zero (mpActualFourierScalar_ne_zero d _) (inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _
    (MpRoot.fourierLift.automorphy_ne_zero _)))

name: SVW.mpActualFourierScalar_eq
statement:
theorem mpActualFourierScalar_eq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (z : ℍ) :
    mpActualFourierScalar d z = mpFourierPhase d * mpGaussianScalar d MpRoot.fourierLift z
proof:
:= by
  have hc := mpFourier_multiplier_cross d i UpperHalfPlane.I z
  have hd := mpFourier_multiplier_cross d i UpperHalfPlane.I UpperHalfPlane.I
  have hs : star (mpActualFourierScalar d UpperHalfPlane.I) ≠ 0 :=
    star_ne_zero.mpr (mpActualFourierScalar_ne_zero d _)
  have hr : mpGaussianScalar d MpRoot.fourierLift UpperHalfPlane.I ≠ 0 :=
    inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (MpRoot.fourierLift.automorphy_ne_zero _))
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hs
  unfold mpFourierPhase
  rw [hc]
  field_simp
  linear_combination -(mpGaussianScalar d MpRoot.fourierLift z) * hd

name: SVW.gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase
statement:
theorem gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (gaussianSectorFourier d i : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i) =
      mpFourierPhase d • mpGaussianOperator d i MpRoot.fourierLift
proof:
:= by
  apply mpGaussianSector_operator_ext d i
  intro z
  change gaussianSectorFourier d i (mpGaussianSector d i z) =
    mpFourierPhase d • mpGaussianOperator d i MpRoot.fourierLift (mpGaussianSector d i z)
  rw [gaussianSectorFourier_mpGaussian, mpGaussianOperator_generator]
  simp only [mpGaussianSectorImage, smul_smul, mpActualFourierScalar_eq d i]

name: SVW.mpFourierPhase_norm
statement: theorem mpFourierPhase_norm (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) : ‖mpFourierPhase d‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun T : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i =>
    ‖T (mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I)‖) (gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase d i)
  change ‖gaussianSectorFourier d i (mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I)‖ =
    ‖mpFourierPhase d • mpGaussianOperator d i MpRoot.fourierLift
      (mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I)‖ at he
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, norm_smul, mpGaussianOperator_norm] at he
  have hn : ‖mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hz := norm_eq_zero.mp h
    have hinner := mpGaussian_inner_ne_zero d i UpperHalfPlane.I UpperHalfPlane.I
    have hk : inner ℂ (mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I)
        (mpGaussianSector d i UpperHalfPlane.I) = 0 := by rw [hz, inner_zero_left]
    exact hinner hk
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hn
  simpa only [one_mul] using he.symm

name: SVW.gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase_apply (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (f : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) : gaussianSectorFourier d i f =
      mpFourierPhase d • mpGaussianUnitary d i MpRoot.fourierLift f
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun T : GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i => T f)
    (gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase d i)

name: SVW.mpGaussianUnitary_lowerShear
statement:
theorem mpGaussianUnitary_lowerShear (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    mpGaussianUnitary d i (MpRoot.lowerShearLift m) = gaussianSectorFrequencyChirp d i m
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro f
  have hU : mpGaussianUnitary d i (MpRoot.lowerShearLift m) f =
      (mpGaussianUnitary d i MpRoot.fourierLift).symm
        (gaussianSectorChirp d i m (mpGaussianUnitary d i MpRoot.fourierLift f)) := by
    rw [MpRoot.lowerShearLift, mpGaussianUnitary_mul_apply, mpGaussianUnitary_mul_apply,
      mpGaussianUnitary_inv, mpGaussianUnitary_shear]
  apply (gaussianSectorFourier d i).injective
  rw [hU, gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change _ = gaussianSectorFourier d i ((gaussianSectorFourier d i).symm
    (gaussianSectorChirp d i m (gaussianSectorFourier d i f)))
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply, gaussianSectorFourier_eq_phase_apply, map_smul]

name: SVW.mpGaussianRepresentation_freeShearLift
statement:
theorem mpGaussianRepresentation_freeShearLift (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    (mpGaussianRepresentation d i).comp (MpRoot.freeShearLift m) = gaussianSectorWord d i m
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro b
  cases b <;> simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MpRoot.freeShearLift, gaussianSectorWord,
    FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  · exact mpGaussianUnitary_shear d i m
  · exact mpGaussianUnitary_lowerShear d i m

name: SVW.mpRotation_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem mpRotation_zero : mpRotation 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [mpRotation]

name: SVW.mpRotation_add
statement: theorem mpRotation_add (s t : ℝ) : mpRotation (s + t) = mpRotation s * mpRotation t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [mpRotation, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add] <;> ring

name: SVW.mpRotation_continuous
statement: theorem mpRotation_continuous : Continuous mpRotation
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  fun_prop

name: SVW.mpDenom_rotation_I
statement:
@[simp] theorem mpDenom_rotation_I (t : ℝ) :
    mpDenom (mpRotation t) UpperHalfPlane.I = Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mpDenom, mpRotation, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, add_comm]

name: SVW.mpRotation_smul_I
statement: @[simp] theorem mpRotation_smul_I (t : ℝ) : mpRotation t • UpperHalfPlane.I = UpperHalfPlane.I
proof:
:= by
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ext
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
  apply (div_eq_iff (mpDenom_ne_zero (mpRotation t) UpperHalfPlane.I)).mpr
  simp [mpDenom, mpRotation]
  ring_nf
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: SVW.MpRoot.base_rotation
statement:
@[simp] theorem base_rotation (t : Multiplicative ℝ) :
    (rotation t).base = mpRotation (Multiplicative.toAdd t)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_rotation
statement:
@[simp] theorem root_rotation (t : Multiplicative ℝ) :
    (rotation t).root = Complex.exp (((Multiplicative.toAdd t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I / 2)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.rotation_one
statement: @[simp] theorem rotation_one : rotation 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ext <;> simp

name: SVW.MpRoot.rotation_mul
statement: theorem rotation_mul (s t : Multiplicative ℝ) : rotation (s * t) = rotation s * rotation t
proof:
:= by
  apply ext
  · simp [mpRotation_add]
  · simp only [root_rotation, toAdd_mul, Complex.ofReal_add, root_mul,
      base_rotation, mpRotation_smul_I, automorphy_I]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring

name: SVW.MpRoot.rotation_continuous
statement: theorem rotation_continuous : Continuous rotation
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact (mpRotation_continuous.comp continuous_toAdd).prodMk (by fun_prop)

name: SVW.MpRoot.base_shear
statement: @[simp] theorem base_shear (t : ℝ) : (shear t).base = upperShear t
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.root_shear
statement: @[simp] theorem root_shear (t : ℝ) : (shear t).root = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.MpRoot.automorphy_shear

name: SVW.MpRoot.shear_add

name: SVW.MpRoot.shear_zero

name: SVW.complexGaussian_norm
statement:
theorem complexGaussian_norm (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (x : Space d) :

name: SVW.integrable_complexGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_complexGaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (complexGaussian d b) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_gaussian d b.re hb)).mono'
  · exact (continuous_complexGaussian d b).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => (complexGaussian_norm d b x).le

name: SVW.integrable_norm_mul_complexGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_mul_complexGaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖ * ‖complexGaussian d b x‖) volume
proof:

name: SVW.integrable_hermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_hermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :

proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_norm_mul_gaussian d b.re hb).mono'
  · exact (continuous_hermiteGaussian d i b).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [hermiteGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, complexGaussian_norm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (PiLp.norm_apply_le x i) (gaussian_pos d b.re x).le

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_norm_sq
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (x : Space d) :
    ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x‖^2 = (x i)^2 * gaussian d (2*b.re) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteGaussian, norm_mul, mul_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs,
    complexGaussian_norm]
  congr 1
  unfold gaussian
  rw [pow_two, ← exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.memLp_hermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem memLp_hermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    MemLp (hermiteGaussian d i b) 2 volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (continuous_hermiteGaussian d i b).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  simp_rw [hermiteGaussian_norm_sq]
  exact integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d (2*b.re) (by positivity) i

name: SVW.hasFDerivAt_complexGaussian
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_complexGaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (x : Space d) :
    HasFDerivAt (complexGaussian d b)
      ((complexGaussian d b x * (-2*b)) •
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (innerSL ℝ x))) x
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Space d => (‖y‖^2 : ℝ)) (2 • innerSL ℝ x) x :=
    (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcast := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp x hnorm
  convert! ((hcast.const_mul (-b)).cexp) using 1
  · funext y
    simp only [complexGaussian, Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, Complex.ofReal_pow]
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro y
    simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, complexGaussian]
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
    push_cast
    ring

name: SVW.fourier_complexGaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_complexGaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (complexGaussian d b) p =
      (π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2) * complexGaussian d (π^2/b) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold complexGaussian
  rw [fourier_gaussian_innerProductSpace hb]
  simp only [Space, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
  congr 2
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_fourierSMulRight_complexGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_fourierSMulRight_complexGaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (VectorFourier.fourierSMulRight (innerSL ℝ) (complexGaussian d b)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_norm_mul_complexGaussian d b hb).const_mul (2*π)).mono'
  · exact (continuous_complexGaussian d b).aestronglyMeasurable.fourierSMulRight
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [VectorFourier.norm_fourierSMulRight, innerSL_apply_norm]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl

name: SVW.fourier_hermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_hermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re)
    (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (hermiteGaussian d i b) p =
      (-π*Complex.I/b) * (π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2) * hermiteGaussian d i (π^2/b) p
proof:
:= by
  have hbf : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hb
  have hD := (hasFDerivAt_complexGaussian d (π^2/b) p).const_mul ((π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2))
  have heq : (𝓕 (complexGaussian d b)) =ᶠ[nhds p]
      (fun y : Space d => (π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2)*complexGaussian d (π^2/b) y) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fourier_complexGaussian d b hb)
  have hEq := (Real.hasFDerivAt_fourier (integrable_complexGaussian d b hb)
    (integrable_norm_mul_complexGaussian d b hb) p).unique (hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq)
  have hv := congrArg (fun L : Space d →L[ℝ] ℂ => L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) hEq
  rw [Real.fourier_continuousLinearMap_apply
    (integrable_fourierSMulRight_complexGaussian d b hb)] at hv
  have heval : (fun x : Space d => VectorFourier.fourierSMulRight (innerSL ℝ)
      (complexGaussian d b) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) =
      (fun x : Space d => (-(2*π*Complex.I)) * hermiteGaussian d i b x) := by
    funext x
    have hinner : (innerSL ℝ x) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = x i := by
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    change (-(2*π*Complex.I)) • (((innerSL ℝ x) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) •
      complexGaussian d b x) = (-(2*π*Complex.I)) * ((x i : ℂ) * complexGaussian d b x)
    rw [hinner, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [heval, fourier_function_const_mul] at hv
  have hright : (((π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2)) •
      ((complexGaussian d (π^2/b) p * (-2*(π^2/b))) •
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (innerSL ℝ p)))) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) =
      (π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2) * (complexGaussian d (π^2/b) p * (-2*(π^2/b))) * (p i : ℂ) := by
    simp [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,
      mul_assoc]
  change (-(2*π*Complex.I)) * 𝓕 (hermiteGaussian d i b) p = _ at hv
  rw [hright] at hv
  have hk : (-(2*π*Complex.I) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (by
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast pi_ne_zero)) Complex.I_ne_zero)
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hk
  rw [hv, hermiteGaussian]
  field_simp
  ring_nf
  simp only [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    0 < (π^2/b : ℂ).re
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hb
  simp only [Complex.div_re, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero]
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos pi_pos) hb) (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hb0)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_chirp_precision_re
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_chirp_precision_re (b : ℂ) (m : ℝ) :
    (b - π*Complex.I*m).re = b.re
proof: := by simp [Complex.mul_re]

name: SVW.chirp_hermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem chirp_hermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (m : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    chirpPhase d m x * hermiteGaussian d i b x =
      hermiteGaussian d i (b - π*Complex.I*m) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold chirpPhase hermiteGaussian complexGaussian
  calc
    _ = (x i : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((π*m*‖x‖^2 : ℝ)*Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp (-b*(‖x‖:ℂ)^2)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring

name: SVW.hermiteFourierScalar_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hermiteFourierScalar_ne_zero (d : ℕ) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    hermiteFourierScalar d b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hb
  have hπ : (π:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast pi_ne_zero
  exact mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hπ) Complex.I_ne_zero) hb0)
    (Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl (div_ne_zero hπ hb0)))

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_coe
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb =ᵐ[volume] hermiteGaussian d i b
proof: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.chirpUnitary_hermiteGaussianVector
statement:
theorem chirpUnitary_hermiteGaussianVector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re)
    (m : ℝ) :
    chirpUnitary d m (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) =
      hermiteGaussianVector d i (b - π*Complex.I*m)
        (by rw [hermiteGaussian_chirp_precision_re]; exact hb)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [chirpUnitary_coe d m (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb),
    hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb,
    hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i (b-π*Complex.I*m)
      (by rw [hermiteGaussian_chirp_precision_re]; exact hb)] with x hx hy hz
  rw [hx, hy, hz]
  exact chirp_hermiteGaussian d i b m x

name: SVW.fourier_hermiteGaussianVector
statement:
theorem fourier_hermiteGaussianVector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    fourier d (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) =
      hermiteFourierScalar d b • hermiteGaussianVector d i (π^2/b)
        (hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos b hb)
proof:
:= by
  apply fourierL2_eq_of_integrable d
  · exact (integrable_hermiteGaussian d i b hb).congr (hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb).symm
  · filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (hermiteFourierScalar d b)
        (hermiteGaussianVector d i (π^2/b) (hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos b hb)),
      hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i (π^2/b) (hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos b hb)]
        with p hp hv
    rw [Real.fourier_congr_ae (hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb), fourier_hermiteGaussian d i b hb,
      hp, Pi.smul_apply, hv]
    rfl

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (i : Fin d) : Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d a x) volume := by
    simpa only [shiftedGaussian, gaussian, inner_zero_left, add_zero] using
      integrable_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment d a ha 0
  apply hi.mono'
  · exact (show Continuous (fun x : Space d => (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x) by
      unfold gaussian; fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (gaussian_pos d a x).le)]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (gaussian_pos d a x).le
      have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le x i
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (x i)) (norm_nonneg x)).mpr h

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment_eq
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment_eq (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (i j : Fin d) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x) =
      ∫ x : Space d, (x j)^2 * gaussian d a x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Space d ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space d :=
    LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ (Equiv.swap i j)
  have he (x : Space d) : (e x) i = x j := by
    simp [e, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply, Equiv.piCongrLeft']
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x) =
        ∫ x : Space d, ((e x) i)^2 * gaussian d a (e x) :=
      (e.measurePreserving.integral_comp e.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by dsimp only; rw [he]; simp only [gaussian, e.norm_map]

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (i : Fin d) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x) =
      (1 / (2*a)) * (π/a)^((d:ℝ)/2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d a x) =
      ∑ j : Fin d, ∫ x : Space d, (x j)^2 * gaussian d a x := by
    rw [← integral_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun j _ => integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d a ha j)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by dsimp only; rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hmoment : (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d a x) =
      ((d:ℝ)/(2*a)) * (π/a)^((d:ℝ)/2) := by
    simpa only [shiftedGaussian, gaussian, inner_zero_left, add_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
      zero_div, exp_zero, mul_one] using integral_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment d a ha 0
  rw [heq] at hmoment
  simp_rw [integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment_eq d a _ i] at hmoment
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hmoment
  have hd : (d:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt).ne'
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hd)
  calc
    (d:ℝ) * (∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d a x) =
        ((d:ℝ)/(2*a)) * (π/a)^((d:ℝ)/2) := hmoment
    _ = (d:ℝ) * ((1/(2*a)) * (π/a)^((d:ℝ)/2)) := by ring

name: SVW.continuous_firstHermiteFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_firstHermiteFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    Continuous (firstHermiteFunction d i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold firstHermiteFunction gaussianWindow gaussian
  fun_prop

name: SVW.firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq
statement:
theorem firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
    ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 =
      (4 * π * (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2)) * ((x i)^2 * gaussian d (2*π) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstHermiteFunction, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, mul_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt pi_pos.le, gaussianWindow_sq]
  ring

name: SVW.memLp_firstHermiteFunction
statement:
theorem memLp_firstHermiteFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    MemLp (firstHermiteFunction d i) 2 volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (continuous_firstHermiteFunction d i).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  simp_rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
  exact (integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d (2*π) (by positivity) i).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq
statement:
theorem integral_firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d (2*π) (by positivity) i]
  have hbase : π/(2*π) = (2:ℝ)⁻¹ := by field_simp
  rw [hbase, inv_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2) ≠ 0 := (rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _).ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: SVW.firstHermiteVector_coe
statement:
theorem firstHermiteVector_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    firstHermiteVector d i =ᵐ[volume] firstHermiteFunction d i
proof: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.firstHermiteVector_norm
statement: theorem firstHermiteVector_norm (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) : ‖firstHermiteVector d i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖firstHermiteVector d i‖^2 = 1 := by
    rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume]
    calc
      (∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteVector d i x‖^2) =
          ∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2 := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [firstHermiteVector_coe d i] with x hx
        rw [hx]
      _ = 1 := integral_firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq d i
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (firstHermiteVector d i)]

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_dilation_product
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_dilation_product (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    gaussianWindow d x * gaussianWindow d (exp t • x) =
      (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2) * gaussian d (π*(1+(exp t)^2)) x
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4) * (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4) = (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2) := by
    rw [← rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
    congr 1
    ring
  unfold gaussianWindow gaussian
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (exp_pos t).le, mul_pow]
  calc
    _ = ((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4) * (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4)) *
        (exp (-π*‖x‖^2) * exp (-π*((exp t)^2*‖x‖^2))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hp, ← exp_add]; congr 2; ring

name: SVW.firstHermite_dilation_integrand
statement:
theorem firstHermite_dilation_integrand (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    inner ℂ (firstHermiteFunction d i x)
      ((exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2) : ℂ) * firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x)) =
      ((4*π*(2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2)*exp (((d:ℝ)/2+1)*t) *
        ((x i)^2*gaussian d (π*(1+(exp t)^2)) x) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : (exp t • x) i = exp t * x i := rfl
  have he : exp (((d:ℝ)/2+1)*t) = exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2)*exp t := by
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hw := gaussianWindow_dilation_product d t x
  simp only [firstHermiteFunction, RCLike.inner_apply', Complex.conj_ofReal,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  apply congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ))
  rw [hcoord, he]
  calc
    _ = 4*(sqrt π)^2*exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2)*exp t*(x i)^2 *
        (gaussianWindow d x * gaussianWindow d (exp t • x)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt pi_pos.le, hw]; ring

name: SVW.integrable_firstHermite_dilation_pairing
statement:
theorem integrable_firstHermite_dilation_pairing (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => inner ℂ (firstHermiteFunction d i x)
      ((exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2) : ℂ) * firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x))) volume
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [firstHermite_dilation_integrand]
  exact ((integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d (π*(1+(exp t)^2))
    (by positivity) i).const_mul _).ofReal

name: SVW.firstHermite_dilation_pairing_raw
statement:
theorem firstHermite_dilation_pairing_raw (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, inner ℂ (firstHermiteFunction d i x)
      ((exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2) : ℂ) * firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x))) =
      ((4*π*(2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2)*exp (((d:ℝ)/2+1)*t) *
        ((1/(2*(π*(1+(exp t)^2)))) *
          (π/(π*(1+(exp t)^2)))^((d:ℝ)/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [firstHermite_dilation_integrand]
  rw [integral_complex_ofReal, integral_const_mul,
    integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d (π*(1+(exp t)^2)) (by positivity) i]

name: SVW.firstHermite_coefficient_algebra
statement:
theorem firstHermite_coefficient_algebra (m t : ℝ) :
    4*π*(2:ℝ)^m*exp ((m+1)*t) *
      ((1/(2*(π*(1+(exp t)^2)))) * (π/(π*(1+(exp t)^2)))^m) =
        (cosh t)^(-(m+1))
proof:
:= by
  have he : exp t ≠ 0 := (exp_pos t).ne'
  have hc : cosh t ≠ 0 := (cosh_pos t).ne'
  have hD : 1+(exp t)^2 = 2*exp t*cosh t := by
    rw [cosh_eq, exp_neg]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hratio : π/(π*(1+(exp t)^2)) = (1+(exp t)^2)⁻¹ := by field_simp
  have hpow : (1+(exp t)^2)^m = (2:ℝ)^m * exp (m*t) * (cosh t)^m := by
    rw [hD, mul_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*exp t) (cosh_pos t).le,
      mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) (exp_pos t).le, ← exp_mul]
    rw [mul_comm t m]
  have hexp : exp ((m+1)*t) = exp (m*t)*exp t := by
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hratio, inv_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+(exp t)^2), hpow,
    hexp, hD, rpow_neg (cosh_pos t).le, rpow_add_one hc]
  have h₂ : (2:ℝ)^m ≠ 0 := (rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) m).ne'
  have hm : exp (m*t) ≠ 0 := (exp_pos _).ne'
  have hcm : (cosh t)^m ≠ 0 := (rpow_pos_of_pos (cosh_pos t) m).ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: SVW.firstHermite_dilation_pairing
statement:
theorem firstHermite_dilation_pairing (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, inner ℂ (firstHermiteFunction d i x)
      ((exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2) : ℂ) * firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x))) =
        (((cosh t)^(-((d:ℝ)/2+1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstHermite_dilation_pairing_raw, firstHermite_coefficient_algebra]

name: SVW.firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq
statement:
theorem firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    ‖firstHermiteDilationFunction d i t x‖^2 =
      exp ((d:ℝ)*t) * ‖firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x)‖^2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstHermiteDilationFunction, norm_mul, mul_pow, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
  congr 1
  rw [pow_two, ← exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.memLp_firstHermiteDilationFunction
statement:
theorem memLp_firstHermiteDilationFunction (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    MemLp (firstHermiteDilationFunction d i t) 2 volume
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : Continuous (fun x : Space d => exp t • x) := by fun_prop
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : Space d => (exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2) : ℂ) *
      firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x)) :=
    continuous_const.mul ((continuous_firstHermiteFunction d i).comp hscale)
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (firstHermiteDilationFunction d i t) volume :=
    hcont.aestronglyMeasurable
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm).mpr
  simp_rw [firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq]
  have hi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (continuous_firstHermiteFunction d i).aestronglyMeasurable).mp
      (memLp_firstHermiteFunction d i)
  exact (hi.comp_smul (exp_pos t).ne').const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq
statement:
theorem integral_firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteDilationFunction d i t x‖^2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq]
  rw [integral_const_mul,
    Measure.integral_comp_smul_of_nonneg volume (fun x : Space d => ‖firstHermiteFunction d i x‖^2)
      (exp t) (hR := (exp_pos t).le), integral_firstHermiteFunction_norm_sq]
  simp only [Space, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [← exp_nat_mul]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (exp_pos _).ne'

name: SVW.firstHermiteDilationVector_coe
statement:
theorem firstHermiteDilationVector_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    firstHermiteDilationVector d i t =ᵐ[volume] firstHermiteDilationFunction d i t
proof:
:=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.firstHermiteDilationVector_norm
statement:
theorem firstHermiteDilationVector_norm (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖firstHermiteDilationVector d i t‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖firstHermiteDilationVector d i t‖^2 = 1 := by
    rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume]
    calc
      (∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteDilationVector d i t x‖^2) =
          ∫ x : Space d, ‖firstHermiteDilationFunction d i t x‖^2 := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [firstHermiteDilationVector_coe d i t] with x hx
        rw [hx]
      _ = 1 := integral_firstHermiteDilationFunction_norm_sq d i t
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (firstHermiteDilationVector d i t)]

name: SVW.firstHermite_inner_dilation
statement:
theorem firstHermite_inner_dilation (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (t : ℝ) :
    inner ℂ (firstHermiteVector d i) (firstHermiteDilationVector d i t) =
      (((cosh t)^(-((d:ℝ)/2+1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, inner ℂ (firstHermiteVector d i x) (firstHermiteDilationVector d i t x)) =
        ∫ x : Space d, inner ℂ (firstHermiteFunction d i x)
          ((exp ((d:ℝ)*t/2) : ℂ) * firstHermiteFunction d i (exp t • x)) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [firstHermiteVector_coe d i, firstHermiteDilationVector_coe d i t] with x hx hy
      rw [hx, hy]
      rfl
    _ = _ := firstHermite_dilation_pairing d i t

name: SVW.firstHermiteFunction_formula
statement:
theorem firstHermiteFunction_formula (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
    firstHermiteFunction d i x =
      (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1) * sqrt π * x i * exp (-π*‖x‖^2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2), rpow_one]
  unfold firstHermiteFunction gaussianWindow gaussian
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.firstHermiteFunction_neg
statement:
theorem firstHermiteFunction_neg (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
    firstHermiteFunction d i (-x) = -firstHermiteFunction d i x
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstHermiteFunction, gaussianWindow, gaussian]

name: SVW.firstHermiteVector_odd
statement:
theorem firstHermiteVector_odd (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    ∀ᵐ x : Space d ∂volume, firstHermiteVector d i (-x) = -firstHermiteVector d i x
proof:
:= by
  have hneg := (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure (Space d))).quasiMeasurePreserving
    |>.ae_eq_comp (firstHermiteVector_coe d i)
  filter_upwards [firstHermiteVector_coe d i, hneg] with x hx hn
  change firstHermiteVector d i (-x) = firstHermiteFunction d i (-x) at hn
  rw [hn, hx, firstHermiteFunction_neg]

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb ∈ hermiteGaussianSpan d i
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨b,hb⟩, rfl⟩

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_isClosed
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_isClosed (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    IsClosed (hermiteGaussianSector d i : Set (Hilbert d))
proof:
:=
  (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).isClosed_topologicalClosure

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_invariant_of_generators
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_invariant_of_generators (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (T : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
    (hT : ∀ b : ℂ, ∀ hb : 0 < b.re,
      T (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) ∈ hermiteGaussianSpan d i) :
    ∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, T f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  have hs : hermiteGaussianSpan d i ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T.toLinearMap := by
    rw [Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_iff_map_le, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hT b b.property
  exact (Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_iff_forall_mem_of_mem T.toLinearMap).mp
    (Submodule.topologicalClosure_mem_invtSubmodule hs)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_invariant
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_invariant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    ∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, chirpUnitary d m f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply hermiteGaussianSector_invariant_of_generators d i (chirpUnitary d m : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
  intro b hb
  change chirpUnitary d m (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) ∈ hermiteGaussianSpan d i
  rw [chirpUnitary_hermiteGaussianVector]
  exact hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span d i _ _

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_fourier_invariant
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_fourier_invariant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    ∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, fourier d f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply hermiteGaussianSector_invariant_of_generators d i (fourier d : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
  intro b hb
  change fourier d (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) ∈ hermiteGaussianSpan d i
  rw [fourier_hermiteGaussianVector]
  exact (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).smul_mem _ (hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span d i _ _)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_involutive
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_involutive (b : ℂ) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (π^2 : ℂ)/(π^2/b) = b
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : (π:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast pi_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: SVW.inverseFourier_hermiteGaussianVector
statement:
theorem inverseFourier_hermiteGaussianVector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    (fourier d).symm (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) =
      (hermiteFourierScalar d (π^2/b))⁻¹ • hermiteGaussianVector d i (π^2/b)
        (hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos b hb)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hb
  have hc := hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_pos b hb
  apply (fourier d).injective
  rw [(fourier d).apply_symm_apply, map_smul, fourier_hermiteGaussianVector]
  simp only [hermiteGaussian_fourier_precision_involutive b hb0, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (hermiteFourierScalar_ne_zero d (π^2/b) hc), one_smul]

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_inverseFourier_invariant
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_inverseFourier_invariant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    ∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, (fourier d).symm f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply hermiteGaussianSector_invariant_of_generators d i
    ((fourier d).symm : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
  intro b hb
  change (fourier d).symm (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) ∈ hermiteGaussianSpan d i
  rw [inverseFourier_hermiteGaussianVector]
  exact (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).smul_mem _ (hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span d i _ _)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_inverseChirp_invariant
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_inverseChirp_invariant (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    ∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, (chirpUnitary d m).symm f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (chirpUnitary d m).symm = chirpUnitary d (-m) := chirpUnitary_inv d m
  rw [hi]
  exact hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_invariant d i (-m)

name: SVW.unitary_orthogonal_invariant
statement:
theorem unitary_orthogonal_invariant (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H) (S : Submodule ℂ H)
    (hU : ∀ f ∈ S, U.symm f ∈ S) : ∀ f ∈ Sᗮ, U f ∈ Sᗮ
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal] at hf ⊢
  intro g hg
  rw [← U.apply_symm_apply g, U.inner_map_map]
  exact hf _ (hU g hg)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_reduces
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_reduces (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℝ) :
    (∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, chirpUnitary d m f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i) ∧
    (∀ f ∈ (hermiteGaussianSector d i)ᗮ, chirpUnitary d m f ∈ (hermiteGaussianSector d i)ᗮ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hermiteGaussianSector_chirp_invariant d i m,
    unitary_orthogonal_invariant (Hilbert d) (chirpUnitary d m) (hermiteGaussianSector d i)
      (hermiteGaussianSector_inverseChirp_invariant d i m)⟩

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_fourier_reduces
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_fourier_reduces (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (∀ f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i, fourier d f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i) ∧
    (∀ f ∈ (hermiteGaussianSector d i)ᗮ, fourier d f ∈ (hermiteGaussianSector d i)ᗮ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hermiteGaussianSector_fourier_invariant d i,
    unitary_orthogonal_invariant (Hilbert d) (fourier d) (hermiteGaussianSector d i)
      (hermiteGaussianSector_inverseFourier_invariant d i)⟩

name: SVW.reflectionL2_coe
statement:
theorem reflectionL2_coe (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    reflectionL2 d f =ᵐ[volume] fun x : Space d => f (-x)
proof:
:=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (Measure.measurePreserving_neg volume)

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_neg
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_neg (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (x : Space d) :
    hermiteGaussian d i b (-x) = -hermiteGaussian d i b x
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteGaussian, complexGaussian]

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_mem_oddL2Subspace
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_mem_oddL2Subspace (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb ∈ oddL2Subspace d
proof:
:= by
  have hn : reflectionL2 d (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) = -hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb := by
    apply Lp.ext
    have he := (Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure (Space d))).quasiMeasurePreserving
      |>.ae_eq_comp (hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb)
    filter_upwards [reflectionL2_coe d (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb), he,
      hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb, Lp.coeFn_neg (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb)] with x hx hy hz hw
    change hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb (-x) = hermiteGaussian d i b (-x) at hy
    rw [hx, hy, hw, Pi.neg_apply, hz, hermiteGaussian_neg]
  change reflectionL2 d (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) + hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb = 0
  rw [hn, neg_add_cancel]

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_le_oddL2Subspace
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_le_oddL2Subspace (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    hermiteGaussianSector d i ≤ oddL2Subspace d
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hermiteGaussianVector_mem_oddL2Subspace d i b b.property
  · exact ContinuousLinearMap.isClosed_ker _

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianSector_odd
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianSector_odd (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (f : Hilbert d)
    (hf : f ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i) : ∀ᵐ x : Space d ∂volume, f (-x) = -f x
proof:
:= by
  have ho := hermiteGaussianSector_le_oddL2Subspace d i hf
  have hzero : reflectionL2 d f + f = 0 := ho
  have heq : reflectionL2 d f = -f := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hzero
  filter_upwards [reflectionL2_coe d f, Lp.coeFn_neg f] with x hx hz
  have hy : reflectionL2 d f x = (-f) x := congrArg (fun v : Hilbert d => v x) heq
  rw [← hx, hy, hz, Pi.neg_apply]

name: SVW.firstHermiteVector_eq_hermiteGaussianVector
statement:
theorem firstHermiteVector_eq_hermiteGaussianVector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    firstHermiteVector d i =
      (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        hermiteGaussianVector d i π (by simpa using pi_pos)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [firstHermiteVector_coe d i,
    Lp.coeFn_smul (((2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/4+1)*sqrt π : ℝ) : ℂ)
      (hermiteGaussianVector d i π (by simpa using pi_pos)),
    hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i π (by simpa using pi_pos)] with x hx hy hz
  rw [hx, hy, Pi.smul_apply, hz]
  simp [firstHermiteFunction_formula, hermiteGaussian, complexGaussian, Complex.ofReal_exp,
    mul_assoc]

name: SVW.firstHermiteVector_mem_sector
statement:
theorem firstHermiteVector_mem_sector (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    firstHermiteVector d i ∈ hermiteGaussianSector d i
proof:
:= by
  apply (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).le_topologicalClosure
  rw [firstHermiteVector_eq_hermiteGaussianVector]
  exact (hermiteGaussianSpan d i).smul_mem _ (hermiteGaussianVector_mem_span d i _ _)

name: SVW.complexCoordinate_apply
statement:
theorem complexCoordinate_apply (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
    complexCoordinate d i x = (x i : ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.hasFDerivAt_hermiteGaussian_zero
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_hermiteGaussian_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) :
    HasFDerivAt (hermiteGaussian d i b) (complexCoordinate d i) 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (complexCoordinate d i).hasFDerivAt.mul (hasFDerivAt_complexGaussian d b 0)
  convert! h using 1
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, complexCoordinate_apply,
    complexGaussian, norm_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), mul_zero,
    Complex.exp_zero, PiLp.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_norm_mul_hermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_mul_hermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖ * ‖hermiteGaussian d i b x‖) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖^2 * gaussian d b.re x) volume := by
    simpa only [shiftedGaussian, gaussian, inner_zero_left, add_zero] using
      integrable_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment d b.re hb 0
  apply hi.mono'
  · exact (continuous_norm.mul (continuous_hermiteGaussian d i b).norm).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_norm, norm_norm, hermiteGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
        complexGaussian_norm]
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (PiLp.norm_apply_le x i) (norm_nonneg x)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (gaussian_pos d b.re x).le]

name: SVW.integrable_fourierSMulRight_hermiteGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_fourierSMulRight_hermiteGaussian (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ)
    (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (VectorFourier.fourierSMulRight (innerSL ℝ) (hermiteGaussian d i b)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply ((integrable_norm_mul_hermiteGaussian d i b hb).const_mul (2*π)).mono'
  · exact (continuous_hermiteGaussian d i b).aestronglyMeasurable.fourierSMulRight
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [VectorFourier.norm_fourierSMulRight, innerSL_apply_norm]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl

name: SVW.integrable_complexGaussian_coordinate_secondMoment
statement:
theorem integrable_complexGaussian_coordinate_secondMoment (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d b x) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d b.re hb i).mono'
  · exact (show Continuous (fun x : Space d => (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d b x) by
      unfold complexGaussian; fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, complexGaussian_norm]

name: SVW.integral_complexGaussian_coordinate_secondMoment
statement:
theorem integral_complexGaussian_coordinate_secondMoment (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    (∫ x : Space d, (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d b x) =
      (1/(2*b)) * (π/b)^((d:ℂ)/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := (hasFDerivAt_hermiteGaussian_zero d i (π^2/b)).const_mul (hermiteFourierScalar d b)
  have heq : 𝓕 (hermiteGaussian d i b) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
      (fun p : Space d => hermiteFourierScalar d b * hermiteGaussian d i (π^2/b) p) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fourier_hermiteGaussian d i b hb)
  have hEq := (Real.hasFDerivAt_fourier (integrable_hermiteGaussian d i b hb)
    (integrable_norm_mul_hermiteGaussian d i b hb) 0).unique (hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq)
  have hv := congrArg (fun L : Space d →L[ℝ] ℂ => L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) hEq
  rw [Real.fourier_continuousLinearMap_apply
    (integrable_fourierSMulRight_hermiteGaussian d i b hb)] at hv
  have heval : (fun x : Space d => VectorFourier.fourierSMulRight (innerSL ℝ)
      (hermiteGaussian d i b) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) =
      (fun x : Space d => (-(2*π*Complex.I)) * ((x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d b x)) := by
    funext x
    have hinner : (innerSL ℝ x) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = x i := by
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    change (-(2*π*Complex.I)) • (((innerSL ℝ x) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) •
      hermiteGaussian d i b x) = _
    rw [hinner, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul, hermiteGaussian]
    ring
  rw [heval, fourier_function_const_mul] at hv
  have hz : 𝓕 (fun x : Space d => (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d b x) 0 =
      ∫ x : Space d, (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d b x := by
    simp [Real.fourier_eq']
  rw [hz] at hv
  have hright : (hermiteFourierScalar d b • complexCoordinate d i) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) =
      hermiteFourierScalar d b := by simp [smul_apply, complexCoordinate_apply]
  rw [hright] at hv
  have hk : (-(2*π*Complex.I) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      (by exact_mod_cast pi_ne_zero)) Complex.I_ne_zero)
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hb
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hk
  rw [hv, hermiteFourierScalar]
  field_simp

name: SVW.hermiteGaussian_inner_pointwise
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussian_inner_pointwise (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b c : ℂ) (x : Space d) :
    inner ℂ (hermiteGaussian d i b x) (hermiteGaussian d i c x) =
      (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d (star b+c) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteGaussian, RCLike.inner_apply', map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  change (x i : ℂ) * star (complexGaussian d b x) *
    ((x i : ℂ) * complexGaussian d c x) = _
  calc
    _ = (x i : ℂ)^2 * (star (complexGaussian d b x) * complexGaussian d c x) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      unfold complexGaussian
      simp only [Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_mul, map_neg, map_pow,
        Complex.conj_ofReal]
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_inner
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_inner (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc) =
      (1/(2*(star b+c))) * (π/(star b+c))^((d:ℂ)/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : 0 < (star b+c).re := by
    simpa only [Complex.add_re, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] using add_pos hb hc
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb x) (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc x)) =
        ∫ x : Space d, (x i : ℂ)^2 * complexGaussian d (star b+c) x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb, hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i c hc]
        with x hx hy
      rw [hx, hy, hermiteGaussian_inner_pointwise]
    _ = _ := integral_complexGaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d i (star b+c) hsum

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_norm_sq
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_norm_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    ‖hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb‖^2 =
      (1/(4*b.re)) * (π/(2*b.re))^((d:ℝ)/2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume]
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb x‖^2) =
        ∫ x : Space d, (x i)^2 * gaussian d (2*b.re) x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hermiteGaussianVector_coe d i b hb] with x hx
      rw [hx, hermiteGaussian_norm_sq]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_gaussian_coordinate_secondMoment d (2*b.re) (by positivity) i]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianGramScalar_sq
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianGramScalar_sq (d : ℕ) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ((1/(2*a)) * (π/a)^((d:ℂ)/2))^2 = (π:ℂ)^d / (4*a^(d+2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_pow, ← Complex.cpow_mul_nat]
  have hexp : (d:ℂ)/2 * (2:ℕ) = d := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hexp, Complex.cpow_natCast, div_pow, pow_add]
  field_simp
  have hp : a^d * a⁻¹^d = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, one_pow]
  linear_combination (4*(π:ℂ)^d)*hp

name: SVW.hermiteGaussianVector_inner_sq
statement:
theorem hermiteGaussianVector_inner_sq (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (b c : ℂ) (hb : 0 < b.re) (hc : 0 < c.re) :
    (inner ℂ (hermiteGaussianVector d i b hb) (hermiteGaussianVector d i c hc))^2 =
      (π:ℂ)^d / (4*(star b+c)^(d+2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteGaussianVector_inner]
  apply hermiteGaussianGramScalar_sq
  intro h
  have hpos : 0 < (star b+c).re := by
    simpa only [Complex.add_re, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] using add_pos hb hc
  exact hpos.ne' (congrArg Complex.re h)

name: SVW.upperShearZ_coe

name: SVW.integerShearRepresentation_coe
statement:
theorem integerShearRepresentation_coe (m : ℤ) :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).comp
      (integerShearRepresentation m) = shearRepresentation (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  cases i <;>
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, integerShearRepresentation, shearRepresentation,
      FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  · exact upperShearZ_coe m
  · simpa only [Int.cast_neg] using lowerShearZ_coe (-m)

statement:

    IsEmbedding (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ => A.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))

name: SVW.integralSL2_isDiscrete
statement: theorem integralSL2_isDiscrete : IsDiscrete (Set.range ((↑) : SL2Z → SL2))
proof:

    Real.isClosedEmbedding_intCast.isEmbedding.specialLinearGroup_map

name: SVW.shearRepresentation_isDiscrete

    IsDiscrete (Set.range (shearRepresentation (m : ℝ)))
proof:

  rintro A ⟨w, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨integerShearRepresentation m w, ?_⟩
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (integerShearRepresentation_coe m) w

name: SVW.MpRoot.fourierLift_base
statement:
theorem fourierLift_base : fourierLift.base =
    (⟨!![0,-1;1,0], by simp [Matrix.det_fin_two]⟩ : MpBase)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [fourierLift, mpRotation, rotation, MpRoot.base]

name: SVW.MpRoot.lowerShearLift_base
statement: theorem lowerShearLift_base (m : ℝ) : (lowerShearLift m).base = lowerShear (-m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lowerShearLift, base_mul, base_inv, base_shear, fourierLift_base]
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [lowerShear, upperShear, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_inv,
      Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: SVW.MpRoot.freeShearLift_projection
statement: theorem freeShearLift_projection (m : ℝ) : projection.comp (freeShearLift m) = shearRepresentation m
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro b
  cases b <;> simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, freeShearLift, shearRepresentation,
    FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

name: SVW.MpRoot.freeShearLift_base
statement:
theorem freeShearLift_base (m : ℝ) (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    (freeShearLift m g).base = shearRepresentation m g
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (freeShearLift_projection m) g

name: SVW.MpRoot.freeShearLift_injective
statement: theorem freeShearLift_injective (m : ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) : Function.Injective (freeShearLift m)
proof:
:= by
  intro g h he
  apply shearRepresentation_injective m hm
  have hbase := congrArg MpRoot.base he
  simpa only [freeShearLift_base] using hbase

name: SVW.MpRoot.freeShearLift_isDiscrete
statement:
theorem freeShearLift_isDiscrete (m : ℤ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    IsDiscrete (Set.range (freeShearLift (m:ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set MpRoot := Set.range (freeShearLift (m:ℝ))
  let T : Set MpBase := Set.range (shearRepresentation (m:ℝ))
  haveI : DiscreteTopology T := isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mp (shearRepresentation_isDiscrete m)
  let f : S → T := fun a => ⟨a.val.base, by
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := a.property
    exact ⟨g, by rw [← hg, freeShearLift_base]⟩⟩
  have hcont : Continuous f := (continuous_base.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b he
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := a.property
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := b.property
    have hbase : a.val.base = b.val.base := congrArg Subtype.val he
    rw [← hg, ← hh, freeShearLift_base, freeShearLift_base] at hbase
    have hgh : g = h := shearRepresentation_injective (m:ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hm) hbase
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hg, ← hh, hgh]
  haveI : DiscreteTopology S := DiscreteTopology.of_continuous_injective hcont hinj
  exact DiscreteTopology.isDiscrete

name: SVW.gaussianSector_polynomial_norm_le
statement:
theorem gaussianSector_polynomial_norm_le (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ) :
    ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i (m:ℝ) g)‖ ≤
      ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖
proof:
:= by
  have hdiscrete : IsDiscrete (Set.range (MpRoot.freeShearLift (m:ℝ))) := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using
      MpRoot.freeShearLift_isDiscrete (m:ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast hm)
  letI : DiscreteTopology (MpRoot.freeShearLift (m:ℝ)).range :=
    isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mp hdiscrete
  apply coefficient_embedding_polynomial_norm_le (GaussianSectorHilbert d i) MpRoot
    MpRoot.iwasawaMeasure (MpRoot.freeShearLift (m:ℝ))
    (MpRoot.freeShearLift_injective (m:ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hm))
    (gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i (m:ℝ)) (mpCoefficientEmbedding d i) ?_ c
  intro g x
  have hw : mpGaussianUnitary d i (MpRoot.freeShearLift (m:ℝ) g) =
      gaussianSectorWord d i (m:ℝ) g :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun (mpGaussianRepresentation_freeShearLift d i (m:ℝ)) g
  change mpCoefficientEmbedding d i (gaussianSectorWord d i (m:ℝ) g x) = _
  rw [← hw]
  exact mpCoefficientEmbedding_intertwines d i (MpRoot.freeShearLift (m:ℝ) g) x

name: SVW.exists_reducedRepresentation_generators
statement:
theorem exists_reducedRepresentation_generators (D : Type*) [CStarAlgebra D]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* D)
    (hstar : ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, star (ρ g) = ρ g⁻¹)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖) :
    ∃ π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D, ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool,
      π (reducedRegularElement g) = ρ g
proof:
:=
  ⟨reducedRepresentation D ρ hstar hρ, reducedRepresentation_generator D ρ hstar hρ⟩

name: SVW.exists_reducedRepresentation_on_hilbert
statement:
theorem exists_reducedRepresentation_on_hilbert (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (ρ : FreeGroup Bool →* (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hstar : ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, star (ρ g) = ρ g⁻¹)
    (hρ : ∀ c : FreeGroup Bool →₀ ℂ,
      ‖c.sum (fun g z => z • ρ g)‖ ≤ ‖finiteRegularOperator (FreeGroup Bool) c‖) :
    ∃ π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H), ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool,
      π (reducedRegularElement g) = ρ g
proof:
:=
  exists_reducedRepresentation_generators (H →L[ℂ] H) ρ hstar hρ

name: SVW.exists_oscillatorReducedModel
statement:
theorem exists_oscillatorReducedModel (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∃ π : reducedFreeCStar →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (GaussianSectorHilbert d i →L[ℂ] GaussianSectorHilbert d i),
      ∀ g : FreeGroup Bool, π (reducedRegularElement g) =
        gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i (m:ℝ) g
proof:
:=
  exists_reducedRepresentation_on_hilbert (GaussianSectorHilbert d i)
    (gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i (m:ℝ))
    (gaussianSectorOperator_star d i (m:ℝ)) (gaussianSector_polynomial_norm_le d i m hm)

name: SVW.oscillatorReducedModel_generator
statement:
theorem oscillatorReducedModel_generator (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (g : FreeGroup Bool) :
    oscillatorReducedModel d i m hm (reducedRegularElement g) =
      gaussianSectorOperatorRepresentation d i (m:ℝ) g
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_oscillatorReducedModel d i m hm) g

name: SVW.oscillatorReducedModel_coe
statement:
theorem oscillatorReducedModel_coe (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (g : FreeGroup Bool) (x : GaussianSectorHilbert d i) :
    (oscillatorReducedModel d i m hm (reducedRegularElement g) x : Hilbert d) =
      oscillatorWord d (m:ℝ) g (x : Hilbert d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oscillatorReducedModel_generator]
  exact gaussianSectorWord_coe d i (m:ℝ) g x

name: SVW.criticalDensity_bounds_of_saturation
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_bounds_of_saturation (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8)
    (hsat : theta d κ (1/2) (1/2) = 1) :
    1/2 - positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ criticalDensity d κ ∧
      criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2
proof:
:=
  ⟨criticalDensity_lower_bound d hd κ hκ hκsmall,
    criticalDensity_le_half_of_saturation d κ hsat⟩

name: SVW.criticalDensity_tendsto_half_of_saturation
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_tendsto_half_of_saturation (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hsat : ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → theta d κ (1/2) (1/2) = 1) :
    Tendsto (criticalDensity d) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (1/2))
proof:
:= by
  have hlo : Tendsto (fun κ : ℝ => 1/2 - positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (1/2)) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, sub_zero] using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1/2:ℝ))).sub (density_cube_root_tendsto_zero.const_mul (positiveDensityConstant d)))
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlo tendsto_const_nhds
  · have hsmall : ∀ᶠ κ : ℝ in nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0), κ < 1/8 :=
      (show ∀ᶠ κ : ℝ in nhds 0, κ < 1/8 from
        Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/8)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [eventually_mem_nhdsWithin, hsmall] with κ hκ hk
    exact criticalDensity_lower_bound d hd κ hκ hk.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_mem_nhdsWithin] with κ hκ
    exact criticalDensity_le_half_of_saturation d κ (hsat κ hκ)

name: SVW.projection_angle_forward
statement:
theorem projection_angle_forward
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (P Q : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection] [Q.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hPQ : ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ ≤ θ) (f : H) :
    ‖f‖ ≤ (1 / (1 - θ)) *
      (‖f - P.starProjection f‖ + ‖f - Q.starProjection f‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : P.starProjection f =
      P.starProjection (Q.starProjection f) +
        P.starProjection (f - Q.starProjection f) := by
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    abel
  have hP : ‖P.starProjection f‖ ≤ θ * ‖f‖ + ‖f - Q.starProjection f‖ := by
    rw [hsplit]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans <| add_le_add
      ((P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection).le_of_opNorm_le hPQ f)
      (P.norm_starProjection_apply_le _)
  have htriangle : ‖f‖ ≤ ‖f - P.starProjection f‖ + ‖P.starProjection f‖ := by
    simpa using norm_add_le (f - P.starProjection f) (P.starProjection f)
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - θ := sub_pos.mpr hθ
  rw [one_div, ← div_eq_inv_mul, le_div_iff₀ hpos]
  nlinarith

name: SVW.projection_angle_converse
statement:
theorem projection_angle_converse
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (P Q : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection] [Q.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C)
    (huncertainty : ∀ f : H, ‖f‖ ≤ C *
      (‖f - P.starProjection f‖ + ‖f - Q.starProjection f‖)) :
    ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - ((max 1 C)⁻¹) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ := max 1 C
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hMC : C ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hM : 0 < M := hC.trans_le hMC
  have hinv : 0 < M⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hM
  have hinv1 : M⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ hM).mpr hM1
  have hrad : 0 ≤ 1 - (M⁻¹) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  change ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - (M⁻¹) ^ 2)
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) fun f => ?_
  have hQ : Q.starProjection (Q.starProjection f) = Q.starProjection f :=
    Q.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr (Q.starProjection_apply_mem f)
  have hunc := huncertainty (Q.starProjection f)
  rw [hQ, sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] at hunc
  have hrem : ‖Q.starProjection f‖ / M ≤
      ‖Q.starProjection f - P.starProjection (Q.starProjection f)‖ := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hM).mpr
    calc
      ‖Q.starProjection f‖ ≤
          C * ‖Q.starProjection f - P.starProjection (Q.starProjection f)‖ := hunc
      _ ≤ M * ‖Q.starProjection f - P.starProjection (Q.starProjection f)‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMC (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have hremSq := (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ ‖Q.starProjection f‖ / M)
    (norm_nonneg _)).mpr hrem
  have hpyth := Submodule.norm_sq_eq_add_norm_sq_starProjection (Q.starProjection f) P
  rw [Submodule.starProjection_orthogonal_val] at hpyth
  have hbound : ‖P.starProjection (Q.starProjection f)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - (M⁻¹) ^ 2) * ‖Q.starProjection f‖ := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hrad]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow] at hremSq
    nlinarith
  exact hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Q.norm_starProjection_apply_le f) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))

name: SVW.projection_angle_converse_lt_one
statement:
theorem projection_angle_converse_lt_one (C : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - ((max 1 C)⁻¹) ^ 2) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < max 1 C := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  apply (Real.sqrt_lt' zero_lt_one).mpr
  have hinv : 0 < (max 1 C)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hM
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hinv]

name: SVW.projection_angle_iff
statement:
theorem projection_angle_iff
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (P Q : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection] [Q.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ < 1 ↔
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f : H, ‖f‖ ≤ C *
        (‖f - P.starProjection f‖ + ‖f - Q.starProjection f‖)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hgap
    refine ⟨1 / (1 - ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖),
      by positivity, ?_⟩
    exact projection_angle_forward H P Q _ hgap le_rfl
  · rintro ⟨C, hC, huncertainty⟩
    exact (projection_angle_converse H P Q C hC huncertainty).trans_lt
      (projection_angle_converse_lt_one C)

name: SVW.positive_operator_inner_cauchy
statement:
theorem positive_operator_inner_cauchy
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
