    (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : H) :
    ‖inner ℂ p (R q)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (inner ℂ p (R p)).re * Real.sqrt (inner ℂ q (R q)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hS := (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive (CFC.sqrt R)).mp
    (CFC.sqrt_nonneg R)
  have hinner (x y : H) : inner ℂ (CFC.sqrt R x) (CFC.sqrt R y) =
      inner ℂ x (R y) := by
    rw [hS.inner_left_eq_inner_right]
    change inner ℂ x ((CFC.sqrt R * CFC.sqrt R) y) = _
    rw [CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self R hR]
  have hnorm (x : H) : ‖CFC.sqrt R x‖ = Real.sqrt (inner ℂ x (R x)).re := by
    rw [← hinner]
    exact norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) _
  rw [← hinner, ← hnorm p, ← hnorm q]
  exact norm_inner_le_norm _ _

name: SVW.operator_re_inner_mono
statement:
theorem operator_re_inner_mono
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (R S : H →L[ℂ] H) (hRS : R ≤ S) (p : H) :
    (inner ℂ p (R p)).re ≤ (inner ℂ p (S p)).re
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((ContinuousLinearMap.le_def R S).mp hRS).re_inner_nonneg_right p
  simp only [sub_apply, inner_sub_right] at h
  change 0 ≤ (inner ℂ p (S p) - inner ℂ p (R p)).re at h
  rw [Complex.sub_re] at h
  linarith

name: SVW.compression_re_inner_bound
statement:
theorem compression_re_inner_bound
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (P : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (a : ℝ)
    (hPRP : P.starProjection * R * P.starProjection ≤ a • P.starProjection)
    (p : H) (hp : p ∈ P) (hp1 : ‖p‖ = 1) :
    (inner ℂ p (R p)).re ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  have hfix := P.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr hp
  have h := operator_re_inner_mono H
    (P.starProjection * R * P.starProjection) (a • P.starProjection) hPRP p
  simp only [mul_apply_eq_comp, hfix, smul_apply] at h
  rw [← P.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right, hfix] at h
  simpa [← Complex.coe_smul, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hp1] using h

name: SVW.positive_angle_unit_inner
statement:
theorem positive_angle_unit_inner
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection] [Q.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hR1 : R ≤ 1)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hab : a + b ≤ 1)
    (hPRP : P.starProjection * R * P.starProjection ≤ a • P.starProjection)
    (hQRQ : Q.starProjection * (1 - R) * Q.starProjection ≤ b • Q.starProjection)
    (p q : H) (hp : p ∈ P) (hq : q ∈ Q) (hp1 : ‖p‖ = 1) (hq1 : ‖q‖ = 1) :
    ‖inner ℂ p q‖ ≤ phiRadical a b
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℝ := (inner ℂ p (R p)).re
  let v : ℝ := (inner ℂ q ((1 - R) q)).re
  have hI : 0 ≤ (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) - R := sub_nonneg.mpr hR1
  have hu : 0 ≤ u :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive R).mp hR).re_inner_nonneg_right p
  have hv : 0 ≤ v :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive (1 - R)).mp hI).re_inner_nonneg_right q
  have hua : u ≤ a := compression_re_inner_bound H P R a hPRP p hp hp1
  have hvb : v ≤ b := compression_re_inner_bound H Q (1 - R) b hQRQ q hq hq1
  have huI : u ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := ⟨hu, hua.trans ha.2⟩
  have hvI : v ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := ⟨hv, hvb.trans hb.2⟩
  have hpp : (inner ℂ p ((1 - R) p)).re = 1 - u := by
    change (inner ℂ p (p - R p)).re = 1 - u
    rw [inner_sub_right]
    simp [u, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hp1]
  have hqq : (inner ℂ q (R q)).re = 1 - v := by
    change (inner ℂ q (R q)).re = 1 - (inner ℂ q (q - R q)).re
    rw [inner_sub_right]
    simp [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hq1]
  have hsplit : inner ℂ p q = inner ℂ p (R q) + inner ℂ p ((1 - R) q) := by
    rw [← inner_add_right]
    congr 1
    simp [sub_apply]
  have hcsR := positive_operator_inner_cauchy H R hR p q
  have hcsI := positive_operator_inner_cauchy H (1 - R) hI p q
  rw [hqq] at hcsR
  rw [hpp] at hcsI
  change ‖inner ℂ p (R q)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt u * Real.sqrt (1 - v) at hcsR
  change ‖inner ℂ p ((1 - R) q)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - u) * Real.sqrt v at hcsI
  have hbound : ‖inner ℂ p q‖ ≤ phiRadical u v := by
    calc
      ‖inner ℂ p q‖ ≤ ‖inner ℂ p (R q)‖ + ‖inner ℂ p ((1 - R) q)‖ := by
        rw [hsplit]
        exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt u * Real.sqrt (1 - v) + Real.sqrt (1 - u) * Real.sqrt v :=
        add_le_add hcsR hcsI
      _ = phiRadical u v := by
        rw [phiRadical, Real.sqrt_mul hu, Real.sqrt_mul hv]
        ring
  exact hbound.trans <|
    (phiRadical_mono_left u a v huI ha hvI hua (by linarith)).trans
      (phiRadical_mono_right a v b ha hvI hb hvb hab)

name: SVW.positive_contraction_angle
statement:
theorem positive_contraction_angle
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection] [Q.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hR1 : R ≤ 1)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hab : a + b ≤ 1)
    (hPRP : P.starProjection * R * P.starProjection ≤ a • P.starProjection)
    (hQRQ : Q.starProjection * (1 - R) * Q.starProjection ≤ b • Q.starProjection) :
    ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (a * (1 - b)) + Real.sqrt (b * (1 - a))
proof:
:= by
  let T : Q →L[ℂ] P := P.orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp Q.subtypeL
  have hT : ‖T‖ ≤ phiRadical a b := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_of_re_inner_le (phiRadical_nonneg a b)
      fun q p hq1 hp1 => ?_
    have hinner : inner ℂ (T q) p = inner ℂ (q : H) (p : H) := by
      change inner ℂ (P.starProjection (q : H)) (p : H) = _
      rw [P.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right, P.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr p.property]
    rw [hinner]
    exact (RCLike.re_le_norm _).trans <| by
      rw [norm_inner_symm]
      exact positive_angle_unit_inner H P Q R hR hR1 a b ha hb hab hPRP hQRQ
        p q p.property q.property hp1 hq1
  change ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ ≤ phiRadical a b
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (phiRadical_nonneg a b) fun f => ?_
  calc
    ‖(P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection) f‖ = ‖T (Q.orthogonalProjectionOnto f)‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ phiRadical a b * ‖Q.orthogonalProjectionOnto f‖ := T.le_of_opNorm_le hT _
    _ ≤ phiRadical a b * ‖f‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Q.norm_orthogonalProjectionOnto_apply_le f) (phiRadical_nonneg a b)

name: SVW.positive_contraction_angle_symmetric
statement:
theorem positive_contraction_angle_symmetric
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q : Submodule ℂ H) [P.HasOrthogonalProjection] [Q.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hR1 : R ≤ 1)
    (s : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s < 1 / 2)
    (hPRP : P.starProjection * R * P.starProjection ≤ s • P.starProjection)
    (hQRQ : Q.starProjection * (1 - R) * Q.starProjection ≤ s • Q.starProjection) :
    ‖P.starProjection.comp Q.starProjection‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (s * (1 - s)) ∧
      2 * Real.sqrt (s * (1 - s)) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsI : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := ⟨hs0, by linarith⟩
  have hss : s + s ≤ 1 := by linarith
  constructor
  · simpa only [two_mul] using
      positive_contraction_angle H P Q R hR hR1 s s hsI hsI hss hPRP hQRQ
  · have hstrict := phi_lt_one_of_add_lt_one s s hs0 hs0 (by linarith)
    simpa only [phi, if_pos hss, two_mul] using hstrict

name: SVW.concentration_angle_of_thin_sets
statement:
theorem concentration_angle_of_thin_sets (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (κ δ ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1/2)
    (hcube : δ^3 = κ) (hε₁ : 0 ≤ ε₁) (hε₂ : 0 ≤ ε₂)
    (hsum : (ε₁ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ) +
      (ε₂ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ) ≤ 1)
    (E F : Set (Space d)) (hE : WolffThin d κ ε₁ E) (hF : WolffThin d κ ε₂ F) :
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE.1 * frequencyProjection d F hF.1‖ ≤
      phiRadical (ε₁ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ)
        (ε₂ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ ε₁ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ :=
    add_nonneg hε₁ (mul_nonneg (positiveDensityConstant_pos d).le hδ.le)
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ ε₂ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ :=
    add_nonneg hε₂ (mul_nonneg (positiveDensityConstant_pos d).le hδ.le)
  apply concentration_angle_of_kernel_rows d hd E F hE.1 hF.1
    (ε₁ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ) (ε₂ + positiveDensityConstant d * δ)
    ⟨h₁, by linarith⟩ ⟨h₂, by linarith⟩ hsum
  · exact ae_of_all _ (positiveKernel_thin_row_bound d hd κ δ ε₁ hδ hδhalf hcube hε₁ E hE)
  · exact ae_of_all _ (positiveKernel_thin_row_bound d hd κ δ ε₂ hδ hδhalf hcube hε₂ F hF)

name: SVW.concentration_thin_gap
statement:
theorem concentration_thin_gap (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hs : ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) < 1/2)
    (E F : Set (Space d)) (hE : WolffThin d κ ε E) (hF : WolffThin d κ ε F) :
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE.1 * frequencyProjection d F hF.1‖ ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt ((ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) *
        (1 - (ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)))) ∧
    2 * Real.sqrt ((ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) *
        (1 - (ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)))) < 1
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := add_nonneg hε
    (mul_nonneg (positiveDensityConstant_pos d).le (density_cube_root κ hκ).1.le)
  have hsum : s + s ≤ 1 := by dsimp [s]; linarith
  constructor
  · simpa only [phiRadical, two_mul] using concentration_angle_of_thin_sets d hd
      κ (κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) ε ε (density_cube_root κ hκ).1
      (density_cube_root_le_half κ hκ hκsmall) (density_cube_root κ hκ).2
      hε hε hsum E F hE hF
  · have h := phi_lt_one_of_add_lt_one s s hs0 hs0 (by dsimp [s]; linarith)
    simpa only [phi, if_pos hsum, two_mul] using h

name: SVW.theta_thin_upper
statement:
theorem theta_thin_upper (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hs : ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) < 1/2) :
    theta d κ ε ε ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt ((ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) *
        (1 - (ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3))))
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le (concentrationValues_nonempty d κ ε ε hε hε)
  rintro t ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
  exact (concentration_thin_gap d hd κ ε hκ hκsmall hε hs E F hE hF).1

name: SVW.theta_thin_lt_one
statement:
theorem theta_thin_lt_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hs : ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) < 1/2) :
    theta d κ ε ε < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hstrict := (concentration_thin_gap d hd κ ε hκ hκsmall hε hs ∅ ∅
    (wolffThin_empty d κ ε hε) (wolffThin_empty d κ ε hε)).2
  exact (theta_thin_upper d hd κ ε hκ hκsmall hε hs).trans_lt hstrict

name: SVW.fourier_uncertainty_thin
statement:
theorem fourier_uncertainty_thin (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hs : ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) < 1/2)
    (E F : Set (Space d)) (hE : WolffThin d κ ε E) (hF : WolffThin d κ ε F)
    (f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖f‖ ≤ (1 / (1 - 2 * Real.sqrt
      ((ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) *
        (1 - (ε + positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)))))) *
      (‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.1.compl f‖ + ‖cut volume Fᶜ hF.1.compl (fourier d f)‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := concentration_thin_gap d hd κ ε hκ hκsmall hε hs E F hE hF
  exact fourier_uncertainty_of_gap d E F hE.1 hF.1 _ hg.2 hg.1 f

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_kernel_restriction
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_kernel_restriction (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (E : Set (Space d)) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (f : Hilbert d) :
    inner ℂ (cut volume E hE f) (gaussianSeparator d (cut volume E hE f)) =
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d, (positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2 : ℂ) *
        inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
        ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).restrict E).prod
          ((volume : Measure (Space d)).restrict E)
proof:
:= by
  have hsa : IsSelfAdjoint (gaussianSeparator d) :=
    IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (gaussianSeparator_nonneg d)
  have hsym : inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d (cut volume E hE f)) (cut volume E hE f) =
      inner ℂ (cut volume E hE f) (gaussianSeparator d (cut volume E hE f)) :=
    hsa.isSymmetric (cut volume E hE f) (cut volume E hE f)
  rw [← hsym, gaussianSeparator_kernel_quadratic d hd,
    Measure.prod_restrict, ← integral_indicator₀ (hE.prod hE)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  have hfst := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst
    (μ := (volume : Measure (Space d))) (ν := (volume : Measure (Space d)))).ae_eq_comp
      (cut_coe volume E hE f)
  have hsnd := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd
    (μ := (volume : Measure (Space d))) (ν := (volume : Measure (Space d)))).ae_eq_comp
      (cut_coe volume E hE f)
  filter_upwards [hfst, hsnd] with yz hy hz
  change cut volume E hE f yz.1 = E.indicator f yz.1 at hy
  change cut volume E hE f yz.2 = E.indicator f yz.2 at hz
  rw [hy, hz]
  by_cases hyE : yz.1 ∈ E <;> by_cases hzE : yz.2 ∈ E <;> simp [hyE, hzE]

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_compression_of_row_bound
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_compression_of_row_bound (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (E : Set (Space d)) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).restrict E,
      ∫ z in E, positiveKernel d y z ≤ s) :
    positionProjection volume E hE * gaussianSeparator d * positionProjection volume E hE ≤
      s • positionProjection volume E hE
proof:
:= by
  apply kernel_schur_compression (Space d) volume E hE
    (fun yz => positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2) (measurable_positiveKernel d)
    (ae_of_all _ fun yz => positiveKernel_nonneg d yz.1 yz.2)
    (ae_of_all _ fun yz => positiveKernel_symmetric d yz.1 yz.2)
    (gaussianSeparator d) (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (gaussianSeparator_nonneg d))
    (gaussianSeparator_kernel_restriction d hd E hE) s hs
  filter_upwards [hrow] with y hy
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
    (integrable_positiveKernel_row d hd y).restrict
    (ae_of_all _ fun z => positiveKernel_nonneg d y z)]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hy

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_frequency_compression
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_frequency_compression (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (F : Set (Space d)) (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume)
    (s : ℝ)
    (hbound : positionProjection volume F hF * gaussianSeparator d *
      positionProjection volume F hF ≤ s • positionProjection volume F hF) :
    frequencyProjection d F hF * (1 - gaussianSeparator d) * frequencyProjection d F hF ≤
      s • frequencyProjection d F hF
proof:
:= by
  have h := star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate hbound
    (fourier d : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, (fourier d).adjoint_eq_symm] at h
  have hl : (fourier d).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap *
      (positionProjection volume F hF * gaussianSeparator d * positionProjection volume F hF) *
      (fourier d : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d) =
      frequencyProjection d F hF * (1 - gaussianSeparator d) * frequencyProjection d F hF := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    change (fourier d).symm (cut volume F hF
      (gaussianSeparator d (cut volume F hF (fourier d f)))) =
      (fourier d).symm (cut volume F hF (fourier d
        (frequencyProjection d F hF f - gaussianSeparator d (frequencyProjection d F hF f))))
    rw [← gaussianSeparator_fourier_apply d hd]
    simp only [frequencyProjection_apply, (fourier d).apply_symm_apply]
  have hr : (fourier d).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap *
      (s • positionProjection volume F hF) *
      (fourier d : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d) = s • frequencyProjection d F hF := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    change (fourier d).symm (s • cut volume F hF (fourier d f)) =
      s • (fourier d).symm (cut volume F hF (fourier d f))
    exact (fourier d).symm.map_smul_of_tower s _
  rw [hl, hr] at h
  exact h

name: SVW.positive_contraction_angle_operators
statement:
theorem positive_contraction_angle_operators
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q)
    (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hR1 : R ≤ 1)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hab : a + b ≤ 1)
    (hPRP : P * R * P ≤ a • P) (hQRQ : Q * (1 - R) * Q ≤ b • Q) :
    ‖P * Q‖ ≤ phiRadical a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hPrange, hPeq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hP
  obtain ⟨hQrange, hQeq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hQ
  letI := hPrange
  letI := hQrange
  rw [hPeq] at hPRP
  rw [hQeq] at hQRQ
  rw [hPeq, hQeq]
  exact positive_contraction_angle H P.range Q.range R hR hR1 a b ha hb hab hPRP hQRQ

name: SVW.concentration_angle_of_kernel_rows
statement:
theorem concentration_angle_of_kernel_rows (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (E F : Set (Space d)) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume)
    (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hab : a + b ≤ 1)
    (hrowE : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).restrict E,
      ∫ z in E, positiveKernel d y z ≤ a)
    (hrowF : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).restrict F,
      ∫ z in F, positiveKernel d y z ≤ b) :
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE * frequencyProjection d F hF‖ ≤ phiRadical a b
proof:
:= by
  apply positive_contraction_angle_operators (Hilbert d)
    (positionProjection volume E hE) (frequencyProjection d F hF)
    (positionProjection_isStarProjection volume E hE) (frequencyProjection_isStarProjection d F hF)
    (gaussianSeparator d) (gaussianSeparator_nonneg d) (gaussianSeparator_le_one d)
    a b ha hb hab
  · exact gaussianSeparator_compression_of_row_bound d hd E hE a ha.1 hrowE
  · exact gaussianSeparator_frequency_compression d (by omega) F hF b
      (gaussianSeparator_compression_of_row_bound d hd F hF b hb.1 hrowF)

name: SVW.svw_half_density_limit
statement:
theorem svw_half_density_limit (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ 1/8 →
        1/2 - C*κ^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ criticalDensity d κ ∧ criticalDensity d κ ≤ 1/2) ∧
      Tendsto (criticalDensity d) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (1/2))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨positiveDensityConstant d, positiveDensityConstant_pos d, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro κ hκ hκsmall
    exact ⟨criticalDensity_lower_bound d hd κ hκ hκsmall, criticalDensity_le_half d hd κ hκ⟩
  · exact criticalDensity_tendsto_half_of_saturation d hd (fun κ hκ =>
      theta_eq_one_of_density_sum d hd κ (1/2) (1/2) hκ
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: SVW.criticalDensity_lower_bound
statement:
theorem criticalDensity_lower_bound
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1/8) :
    1/2 - positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ criticalDensity d κ
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3) :=
    mul_nonneg (positiveDensityConstant_pos d).le (density_cube_root κ hκ).1.le
  apply criticalDensity_lower_of_initial_gap d κ
    (1/2 - positiveDensityConstant d * κ^((1:ℝ)/3)) (by linarith)
  intro ε hε hεsmall
  exact theta_thin_lt_one d hd κ ε hκ hκsmall hε.le (by linarith)

name: SVW.star_projection_angle_forward
statement:
theorem star_projection_angle_forward
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 1) (hPQ : ‖P * Q‖ ≤ θ) (f : H) :
    ‖f‖ ≤ (1 / (1 - θ)) * (‖f - P f‖ + ‖f - Q f‖)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hPrange, hPeq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hP
  obtain ⟨hQrange, hQeq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hQ
  letI := hPrange
  letI := hQrange
  have hnorm : ‖P.range.starProjection.comp Q.range.starProjection‖ ≤ θ := by
    simpa only [← hPeq, ← hQeq, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] using hPQ
  simpa only [← hPeq, ← hQeq] using
    projection_angle_forward H P.range Q.range θ hθ hnorm f

name: SVW.star_projection_angle_iff
statement:
theorem star_projection_angle_iff
    (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (P Q : H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q) :
    ‖P * Q‖ < 1 ↔ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ f : H, ‖f‖ ≤ C * (‖f - P f‖ + ‖f - Q f‖)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hPrange, hPeq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hP
  obtain ⟨hQrange, hQeq⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hQ
  letI := hPrange
  letI := hQrange
  simpa only [← hPeq, ← hQeq, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] using
    projection_angle_iff H P.range Q.range

name: SVW.fourier_uncertainty_of_gap
statement:
theorem fourier_uncertainty_of_gap (d : ℕ) (E F : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hgap : ‖positionProjection volume E hE * frequencyProjection d F hF‖ ≤ θ)
    (f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖f‖ ≤ (1 / (1 - θ)) *
      (‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.compl f‖ + ‖cut volume Fᶜ hF.compl (fourier d f)‖)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cut_compl volume E hE f, ← frequency_residual_norm d F hF f]
  exact star_projection_angle_forward (Hilbert d) (positionProjection volume E hE)
    (frequencyProjection d F hF) (positionProjection_isStarProjection volume E hE)
    (frequencyProjection_isStarProjection d F hF) θ hθ hgap f

name: SVW.fourier_uncertainty_iff
statement:
theorem fourier_uncertainty_iff (d : ℕ) (E F : Set (Space d))
    (hE : NullMeasurableSet E volume) (hF : NullMeasurableSet F volume) :
    ‖positionProjection volume E hE * frequencyProjection d F hF‖ < 1 ↔
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f : Hilbert d, ‖f‖ ≤ C *
        (‖cut volume Eᶜ hE.compl f‖ + ‖cut volume Fᶜ hF.compl (fourier d f)‖)
proof:
:= by
  have h := star_projection_angle_iff (Hilbert d) (positionProjection volume E hE)
    (frequencyProjection d F hF) (positionProjection_isStarProjection volume E hE)
    (frequencyProjection_isStarProjection d F hF)
  constructor
  · intro hgap
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hf⟩ := h.mp hgap
    refine ⟨C, hC, fun f => ?_⟩
    rw [cut_compl volume E hE f, ← frequency_residual_norm d F hF f]
    exact hf f
  · rintro ⟨C, hC, hf⟩
    apply h.mpr
    refine ⟨C, hC, fun f => ?_⟩
    have hf' := hf f
    rw [cut_compl volume E hE f, ← frequency_residual_norm d F hF f] at hf'
    exact hf'

name: SVW.lipschitz_image_haar_null
statement:
theorem lipschitz_image_haar_null
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (f : E → E) (K : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith K f)
    (s : Set E) (hs : μ s = 0) : μ (f '' s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let ν : Measure E := Measure.hausdorffMeasure (Module.finrank ℝ E)
  have hνs : ν s = 0 :=
    (Measure.absolutelyContinuous_isAddHaarMeasure ν μ) hs
  have hνimage : ν (f '' s) = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    simpa only [ν, hνs, mul_zero, bot_eq_zero] using!
      hf.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (d := (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _) s
  exact (Measure.absolutelyContinuous_isAddHaarMeasure μ ν) hνimage

name: SVW.homeomorph_quasiMeasurePreserving_of_symm_lipschitz
statement:
theorem homeomorph_quasiMeasurePreserving_of_symm_lipschitz
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (H : E ≃ₜ E) (K : ℝ≥0) (hH : LipschitzWith K H.symm) :
    Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving H μ μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨H.continuous.measurable, Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk ?_⟩
  intro s hs hnull
  rw [Measure.map_apply H.continuous.measurable hs]
  have himage := lipschitz_image_haar_null E μ H.symm K hH s hnull
  simpa only [H.image_symm] using himage

name: SVW.homeomorph_integrable_jacobian_and_integral
statement:
theorem homeomorph_integrable_jacobian_and_integral
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (H : E ≃ₜ E) (K : ℝ≥0) (hH : LipschitzWith K H)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : Integrable h μ) :
    Integrable (fun x => jacobianAbs H x * h (H x)) μ ∧
      (∫ x, h x ∂μ) = ∫ x, jacobianAbs H x * h (H x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hsfull, hsm, hsdiff⟩ :=
    (hH.ae_differentiableAt (μ := μ)).exists_measurable_mem
  have hsnull : μ sᶜ = 0 := mem_ae_iff.mp hsfull
  have himagenull : μ (H '' s)ᶜ = 0 := by
    rw [← H.image_compl]
    exact lipschitz_image_haar_null E μ H K hH sᶜ hsnull
  have himagefull : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ H '' s := mem_ae_iff.mpr himagenull
  have hsrestrict : μ.restrict s = μ := Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hsfull
  have himagerestrict : μ.restrict (H '' s) = μ :=
    Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem himagefull
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivWithinAt H (fderiv ℝ H x) s x :=
    fun x hx => (hsdiff x hx).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hint := integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_det_fderiv_smul
    μ hsm hderiv H.injective.injOn h
  have heq := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul
    μ hsm hderiv H.injective.injOn h
  simp only [IntegrableOn, hsrestrict, himagerestrict, smul_eq_mul] at hint
  simp only [hsrestrict, himagerestrict, smul_eq_mul] at heq
  exact ⟨hint.mp hh, heq⟩

name: SVW.homeomorph_integrable_comp_of_jacobian_lower
statement:
theorem homeomorph_integrable_comp_of_jacobian_lower
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (H : E ≃ₜ E) (K K' : ℝ≥0)
    (hH : LipschitzWith K H) (hH' : LipschitzWith K' H.symm)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hcJ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, c ≤ jacobianAbs H x)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : Integrable h μ) (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ h x) :
    Integrable (fun x => h (H x)) μ ∧
      (∫ x, h (H x) ∂μ) ≤ c⁻¹ * ∫ x, h x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hq := homeomorph_quasiMeasurePreserving_of_symm_lipschitz E μ H K' hH'
  have hcomp0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ h (H x) := hq.ae hh0
  obtain ⟨hweighted, hcov⟩ := homeomorph_integrable_jacobian_and_integral E μ H K hH h hh
  have hcompmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => h (H x)) μ :=
    hh.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving hq
  have hdom : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, h (H x) ≤ c⁻¹ * (jacobianAbs H x * h (H x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hcJ, hcomp0] with x hx hx0
    have hcoef : 1 ≤ c⁻¹ * jacobianAbs H x := by
      rw [← div_eq_inv_mul]
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hc).mpr (by simpa only [one_mul] using hx)
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hx0
  have hcomp : Integrable (fun x => h (H x)) μ :=
    (hweighted.const_mul c⁻¹).mono_nonneg hcompmeas hcomp0 hdom
  refine ⟨hcomp, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ x, h (H x) ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, c⁻¹ * (jacobianAbs H x * h (H x)) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono_ae hcomp (hweighted.const_mul c⁻¹) hdom
    _ = c⁻¹ * ∫ x, h x ∂μ := by rw [integral_const_mul, ← hcov]

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_integrable_comp_and_integral_le
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_integrable_comp_and_integral_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : Integrable h μ) (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ h x) :
    Integrable (fun x => h (variableRadiusMap r u x)) μ ∧
      (∫ x, h (variableRadiusMap r u x) ∂μ) ≤
        (1 - (L : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∫ x, h x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let H := variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu
  have hJ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 1 - (L : ℝ) ≤ jacobianAbs H x := by
    filter_upwards [ae_abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
      E μ r L hr hL u hu] with x hx
    exact hx.1
  exact homeomorph_integrable_comp_of_jacobian_lower E μ H (1 + L) (1 - L)⁻¹
    (variableRadiusMap_lipschitz E r L hr u hu)
    (variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_lipschitz E r L hr hL u hu)
    (1 - (L : ℝ)) (sub_pos.mpr (NNReal.coe_lt_one.mpr hL)) hJ h hh hh0

name: SVW.homeomorph_setIntegral_jacobian
statement:
theorem homeomorph_setIntegral_jacobian
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (H : E ≃ₜ E) (K K' : ℝ≥0)
    (hH : LipschitzWith K H) (hH' : LipschitzWith K' H.symm)
    (A : Set E) (hA : NullMeasurableSet A μ)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : Integrable h μ) :
    (∫ x in A, h x ∂μ) =
      ∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, jacobianAbs H x * h (H x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hq := homeomorph_quasiMeasurePreserving_of_symm_lipschitz E μ H K' hH'
  have hpre : NullMeasurableSet (H ⁻¹' A) μ := hA.preimage hq
  have hcov := (homeomorph_integrable_jacobian_and_integral E μ H K hH
    (A.indicator h) (hh.indicator₀ hA)).2
  rw [integral_indicator₀ hA] at hcov
  calc
    (∫ x in A, h x ∂μ) =
        ∫ x, jacobianAbs H x * A.indicator h (H x) ∂μ := hcov
    _ = ∫ x, (H ⁻¹' A).indicator (fun y => jacobianAbs H y * h (H y)) x ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      by_cases hx : H x ∈ A <;> simp [Set.indicator, hx]
    _ = ∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, jacobianAbs H x * h (H x) ∂μ := integral_indicator₀ hpre

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_setIntegral_transport_bound
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_setIntegral_transport_bound
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (A : Set E) (hA : NullMeasurableSet A μ)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : Integrable h μ) (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ h x) :
    |(∫ x in (variableRadiusMap r u) ⁻¹' A, h x ∂μ) - ∫ x in A, h x ∂μ| ≤
      (∫ x, |h x - h (variableRadiusMap r u x)| ∂μ) +
        (L : ℝ) * ∫ x, h (variableRadiusMap r u x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let H := variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu
  have hH : LipschitzWith (1 + L) H := variableRadiusMap_lipschitz E r L hr u hu
  have hH' : LipschitzWith (1 - L)⁻¹ H.symm :=
    variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_lipschitz E r L hr hL u hu
  have hq := homeomorph_quasiMeasurePreserving_of_symm_lipschitz E μ H (1 - L)⁻¹ hH'
  have hcomp0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ h (H x) := hq.ae hh0
  have hcomp : Integrable (fun x => h (H x)) μ :=
    (variableRadiusMap_integrable_comp_and_integral_le E μ r L hr hL u hu h hh hh0).1
  have hweighted := (homeomorph_integrable_jacobian_and_integral E μ H (1 + L) hH h hh).1
  have hcov := homeomorph_setIntegral_jacobian E μ H (1 + L) (1 - L)⁻¹ hH hH' A hA h hh
  have hJerror : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |1 - jacobianAbs H x| ≤ (L : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
      E μ r L hr hL u hu] with x hx
    have hx' : 1 - (L : ℝ) ≤ jacobianAbs H x ∧ jacobianAbs H x ≤ 1 + (L : ℝ) := hx
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hx'.2], by linarith [hx'.1]⟩
  have herrorInt : Integrable (fun x => |h x - h (H x)| + (L : ℝ) * h (H x)) μ :=
    (hh.sub hcomp).abs.add (hcomp.const_mul (L : ℝ))
  have herror0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ |h x - h (H x)| + (L : ℝ) * h (H x) := by
    filter_upwards [hcomp0] with x hx
    exact add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg L.coe_nonneg hx)
  have hdom : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      |h x - jacobianAbs H x * h (H x)| ≤ |h x - h (H x)| + (L : ℝ) * h (H x) := by
    filter_upwards [hJerror, hcomp0] with x hx hx0
    have halg : h x - jacobianAbs H x * h (H x) =
        (h x - h (H x)) + (1 - jacobianAbs H x) * h (H x) := by ring
    rw [halg]
    calc
      |(h x - h (H x)) + (1 - jacobianAbs H x) * h (H x)| ≤
          |h x - h (H x)| + |(1 - jacobianAbs H x) * h (H x)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |h x - h (H x)| + |1 - jacobianAbs H x| * h (H x) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hx0]
      _ ≤ |h x - h (H x)| + (L : ℝ) * h (H x) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx hx0)
  change |(∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, h x ∂μ) - ∫ x in A, h x ∂μ| ≤
    (∫ x, |h x - h (H x)| ∂μ) + (L : ℝ) * ∫ x, h (H x) ∂μ
  calc
    |(∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, h x ∂μ) - ∫ x in A, h x ∂μ| =
        |∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, h x - jacobianAbs H x * h (H x) ∂μ| := by
      rw [hcov, integral_sub hh.integrableOn hweighted.integrableOn]
    _ ≤ ∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, |h x - jacobianAbs H x * h (H x)| ∂μ :=
      abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ x in H ⁻¹' A, |h x - h (H x)| + (L : ℝ) * h (H x) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono_ae (hh.sub hweighted).abs.integrableOn herrorInt.integrableOn
        (ae_restrict_of_ae hdom)
    _ ≤ ∫ x, |h x - h (H x)| + (L : ℝ) * h (H x) ∂μ :=
      setIntegral_le_integral herrorInt herror0
    _ = (∫ x, |h x - h (H x)| ∂μ) + (L : ℝ) * ∫ x, h (H x) ∂μ := by
      simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, integral_const_mul] using
        integral_add (hh.sub hcomp).abs (hcomp.const_mul (L : ℝ))

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_indicator_transport_bound
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_indicator_transport_bound
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (A : Set E) (hA : NullMeasurableSet A μ)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : Integrable h μ) (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ h x) :
proof:
|(∫ x, h x * A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (variableRadiusMap r u x) ∂μ) -
        ∫ x in A, h x ∂μ| ≤
      (∫ x, |h x - h (variableRadiusMap r u x)| ∂μ) +
        (L : ℝ) * ∫ x, h (variableRadiusMap r u x) ∂μ := by
  classical
  let H := variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu
  have hq := homeomorph_quasiMeasurePreserving_of_symm_lipschitz E μ H (1 - L)⁻¹
    (variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_lipschitz E r L hr hL u hu)
  have hpre : NullMeasurableSet ((variableRadiusMap r u) ⁻¹' A) μ := hA.preimage hq
  have hid : (fun x => h x * A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (variableRadiusMap r u x)) =
      ((variableRadiusMap r u) ⁻¹' A).indicator h := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : variableRadiusMap r u x ∈ A <;> simp [Set.indicator, hx]
  rw [hid, integral_indicator₀ hpre]
  exact variableRadiusMap_setIntegral_transport_bound E μ r L hr hL u hu A hA h hh hh0

name: SVW.weightedDerivativeNorm_const_mul
statement:
theorem weightedDerivativeNorm_const_mul
    (d : ℕ) (h : Space d → ℝ) (hh : Differentiable ℝ h)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (x : Space d) :
    weightedDerivativeNorm (fun z => c * h z) x = c * weightedDerivativeNorm h x
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedDerivativeNorm
  rw [fderiv_const_mul (hh x) c, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc]
  ring

name: SVW.smooth_master_averaging_homogeneous
statement:
theorem smooth_master_averaging_homogeneous
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (h : Space d → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hhi : Integrable h volume)
    (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ h x)
    (hGi : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm h) volume) :
    (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ (ε + 2 * δ) * (∫ x, h x) +
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, h x) +
      4 * δ * (∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x)
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x, h x
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := integral_nonneg_of_ae hh0
  by_cases hM : M = 0
  · have hz : h =ᵐ[volume] 0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hh0 hhi).mp hM
    have hzA : (∫ x in A, h x) = 0 := by
      rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hz)]
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply, integral_zero]
    rw [hzA]
    exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM0)
      (integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hh0)))
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg (weightedDerivativeNorm_nonneg _ h)))
  have hMp : 0 < M := lt_of_le_of_ne hM0 (Ne.symm hM)
  let f : Space d → ℝ := fun x => M⁻¹ * h x
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ 1 f := contDiff_const.mul hh
  have hfi : Integrable f volume := hhi.const_mul M⁻¹
  have hf0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ f x := hh0.mono fun x hx => mul_nonneg (by positivity) hx
  have hfM : (∫ x, f x) ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    change M⁻¹ * M ≤ 1
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hM]
  have hfG : weightedDerivativeNorm f = fun x => M⁻¹ * weightedDerivativeNorm h x := by
    funext x
    exact weightedDerivativeNorm_const_mul d h (hh.differentiable (by norm_num))
      M⁻¹ (by positivity) x
  let O : ℝ := ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, h x
  let G : ℝ := ∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x
  have hfO : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, f x) ≤ (M⁻¹ * O / δ) * δ := by
    dsimp [f, O]
    rw [integral_const_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hδ.ne']
  have hfiG : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm f) volume := by
    rw [hfG]
    exact hGi.const_mul M⁻¹
  have hfB : (∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm f x) ≤ M⁻¹ * G := by
    rw [hfG, integral_const_mul]
  have hb := smooth_master_averaging d κ δ ε (M⁻¹ * O / δ) (M⁻¹ * G)
    hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin f hfc hfi hf0 hfM hfO hfiG hfB
  dsimp only [f] at hb
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hb
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hMp.le
  have heL : M * (M⁻¹ * (∫ x in A, h x)) = ∫ x in A, h x := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM, one_mul]
  have heR : M * (ε + (M⁻¹ * O / δ + 2 + 4 * (M⁻¹ * G)) * δ) =
      (ε + 2 * δ) * M + O + 4 * δ * G := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rwa [heL, heR] at hmul

name: SVW.unitBall_affine_indicator_integral
statement:
theorem unitBall_affine_indicator_integral
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (A : Set E) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (x : E) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ u in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1,
      A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + R • u) ∂μ) =
      (R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹ * μ.real (A ∩ Metric.ball x R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hshift : (∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : E) R,
      A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + y) ∂μ) =
      μ.real (A ∩ Metric.ball x R) := by
    rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_ball]
    have hf : (Metric.ball (0 : E) R).indicator
        (fun y => A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + y)) =
        fun y => (A ∩ Metric.ball x R).indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + y) := by
      funext y
      have hy : x + y ∈ Metric.ball x R ↔ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) R := by
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, sub_zero]
      by_cases hya : x + y ∈ A <;> by_cases hyb : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) R <;>
        simp [Set.indicator, hya, hyb, hy]
    rw [hf, integral_add_left_eq_self, integral_indicator_const 1 (hA.inter measurableSet_ball)]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [Measure.setIntegral_comp_smul_of_pos μ
    (fun y => A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + y)) _ hR]
  rw [smul_ball hR.ne', smul_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR, mul_one, hshift,
    smul_eq_mul]

name: SVW.real_ball_scaling
statement:
theorem real_ball_scaling
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (x : E) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    μ.real (Metric.ball x R) = R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E * μ.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [measureReal_def, μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos x hR, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hR.le _)]

name: SVW.normalized_unitBall_affine_indicator_integral
statement:
theorem normalized_unitBall_affine_indicator_integral
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (A : Set E) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (x : E) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (μ.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))⁻¹ *
      (∫ u in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1,
        A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + R • u) ∂μ) =
      μ.real (A ∩ Metric.ball x R) / μ.real (Metric.ball x R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitBall_affine_indicator_integral E μ A hA x R hR,
    real_ball_scaling E μ x R hR]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  ring

name: SVW.unitBall_affine_indicator_le_of_thin
statement:
theorem unitBall_affine_indicator_le_of_thin
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (A : Set E) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (x : E) (R ε : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hthin : μ.real (A ∩ Metric.ball x R) ≤ ε * μ.real (Metric.ball x R)) :
    (∫ u in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1,
      A.indicator (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) (x + R • u) ∂μ) ≤
      ε * μ.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitBall_affine_indicator_integral E μ A hA x R hR]
  calc
    (R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹ * μ.real (A ∩ Metric.ball x R) ≤
        (R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹ * (ε * μ.real (Metric.ball x R)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hthin (by positivity)
    _ = ε * μ.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1) := by
      rw [real_ball_scaling E μ x R hR]
      field_simp

name: SVW.unitBall_weighted_average_integrable_and_bound
statement:
theorem unitBall_weighted_average_integrable_and_bound
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε D : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (h : Space d → ℝ) (hhc : Continuous h) (hhi : Integrable h volume)
    (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ h x) (hmass : (∫ x, h x) ≤ 1)
    (horigin : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, h x) ≤ D * δ) :
    Integrable (fun u => ∫ x, h x *
      A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ))
        (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x))
      (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) 1)) ∧
    (∫ u in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) 1, ∫ x, h x *
      A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ))
        (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x)) ≤
      volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) 1) * (ε + D * δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : Set (Space d) := Metric.ball 0 1
  let τ : Measure (Space d) := volume.restrict U
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure τ := ⟨by
    simp only [τ, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
    exact measure_ball_lt_top⟩
  let c : ℝ := volume.real U
  let r : Space d → ℝ := truncatedRadius κ δ
  let F : Space d × Space d → ℝ := fun p =>
    h p.2 * A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ)) (variableRadiusMap r p.1 p.2)
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := measureReal_nonneg
  have hr : Continuous r :=
    (truncatedRadius_lipschitz_of_cube (Space d) κ δ hδ hcube).continuous
  have hTc : Continuous (fun p : Space d × Space d => variableRadiusMap r p.1 p.2) :=
    continuous_snd.add ((hr.comp continuous_snd).smul continuous_fst)
  have hFm : AEStronglyMeasurable F (τ.prod volume) :=
    ((hhc.comp continuous_snd).measurable.mul
      ((measurable_const.indicator hA).comp hTc.measurable)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hFi : Integrable F (τ.prod volume) := by
    apply (hhi.abs.comp_snd τ).mono' hFm
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      by_cases hp : variableRadiusMap r p.1 p.2 ∈ A <;>
        simp [F, Set.indicator, hp, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  refine ⟨hFi.integral_prod_left, ?_⟩
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      (∫ u, F (u, x) ∂τ) ≤ (ε * c) * h x + c *
        (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ).indicator h x := by
    filter_upwards [hh0] with x hx0
    let m : ℝ := ∫ u, A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ))
      (variableRadiusMap r u x) ∂τ
    have hmi : Integrable (fun u => A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ))
        (variableRadiusMap r u x)) τ := by
      have huc : Continuous (fun u : Space d => variableRadiusMap r u x) := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] using!
          hTc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Space d => x)))
      have hum : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun u : Space d =>
          A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ)) (variableRadiusMap r u x)) τ :=
        ((measurable_const.indicator hA).comp huc.measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
      apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' hum
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => by
        by_cases hu : variableRadiusMap r u x ∈ A <;> simp [Set.indicator, hu]
    have hm : m ≤ c := by
      calc
        m ≤ ∫ _u, (1 : ℝ) ∂τ := by
          apply integral_mono_ae hmi (integrable_const _)
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => by
            by_cases hu : variableRadiusMap r u x ∈ A <;> simp [Set.indicator, hu]
        _ = c := by simp [τ, c]
    have hrewrite : (∫ u, F (u, x) ∂τ) = h x * m := by
      simpa only [F, m] using! (integral_const_mul (μ := τ) (h x)
        (fun u => A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ)) (variableRadiusMap r u x)))
    rw [hrewrite]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm hx0
      have hεterm : 0 ≤ (ε * c) * h x := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hε hc0) hx0
      nlinarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, mul_zero, add_zero]
      have hnorm : δ ≤ ‖x‖ := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, not_lt] using hx
      have heq := truncatedRadius_eq_reciprocalRadius_of_cube
        (Space d) κ δ hδ hδhalf hcube x hnorm
      have hκ : 0 < κ := by rw [← hcube]; positivity
      have hlocal : volume.real (A ∩ Metric.ball x (r x)) ≤
          ε * volume.real (Metric.ball x (r x)) := by
        simpa only [r, heq, testingBall] using hthin.2 x
      have hmthin : m ≤ ε * c := unitBall_affine_indicator_le_of_thin
        (Space d) volume A hA x (r x) ε
        (truncatedRadius_pos (Space d) κ δ hκ hδ x) hlocal
      simpa only [mul_comm (h x)] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmthin hx0
  calc
    (∫ u, ∫ x, F (u, x) ∂volume ∂τ) = ∫ x, ∫ u, F (u, x) ∂τ ∂volume :=
      integral_integral_swap hFi
    _ ≤ ∫ x, (ε * c) * h x + c * (Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ).indicator h x :=
      integral_mono_ae hFi.integral_prod_right
        ((hhi.const_mul (ε * c)).add ((hhi.indicator measurableSet_ball).const_mul c)) hpoint
    _ = (ε * c) * (∫ x, h x) + c * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, h x := by
      rw [integral_add (hhi.const_mul (ε * c))
        ((hhi.indicator measurableSet_ball).const_mul c), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul, integral_indicator measurableSet_ball]
    _ ≤ (ε * c) * 1 + c * (D * δ) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass (mul_nonneg hε hc0))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left horigin hc0)
    _ = c * (ε + D * δ) := by ring

name: SVW.smooth_master_averaging_measurable
statement:
theorem smooth_master_averaging_measurable
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε D B : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (h : Space d → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hhi : Integrable h volume)
    (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ h x) (hmass : (∫ x, h x) ≤ 1)
    (horigin : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, h x) ≤ D * δ)
    (hGi : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm h) volume)
    (hB : (∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x) ≤ B) :
    (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ ε + (D + 2 + 4 * B) * δ
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (Space d) := Metric.ball 0 1
  let τ : Measure (Space d) := volume.restrict U
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure τ := ⟨by
    simp only [τ, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
    exact measure_ball_lt_top⟩
  let c : ℝ := volume.real U
  let r : Space d → ℝ := truncatedRadius κ δ
  let L : ℝ≥0 := Real.toNNReal δ
  let e : ℝ := 8 * B * δ ^ 2 + 2 * δ
  let avg : Space d → ℝ := fun u => ∫ x, h x *
    A.indicator (fun _ : Space d => (1 : ℝ)) (variableRadiusMap r u x)
  have hc : 0 < c := ENNReal.toReal_pos
    (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume (0 : Space d) zero_lt_one).ne'
    measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have hr : LipschitzWith L r :=
    truncatedRadius_lipschitz_of_cube (Space d) κ δ hδ hcube
  have hLval : (L : ℝ) = δ := Real.coe_toNNReal _ hδ.le
  have hL : L < 1 := NNReal.coe_lt_one.mp (by rw [hLval]; linarith)
  have hgap : 0 < 1 - δ := by linarith
  have hinv : (1 - δ)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
    rw [inv_eq_one_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hgap).mpr
    linarith
  have hmass0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, h x := integral_nonneg_of_ae hh0
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (integral_nonneg (weightedDerivativeNorm_nonneg (Space d) h)).trans hB
  have hper (u : Space d) (hu : u ∈ U) : (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ avg u + e := by
    have hu' : ‖u‖ ≤ 1 := by
      exact (show ‖u‖ < 1 by simpa only [U, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu).le
    have htransport := variableRadiusMap_indicator_transport_bound
      (Space d) volume r L hr hL u hu' A hthin.1 h hhi hh0
    have hvar := smooth_row_variation_le (Space d) volume κ δ hδ hδhalf hcube
      u hu' h hh hGi B hB
    have hcomp := (variableRadiusMap_integrable_comp_and_integral_le
      (Space d) volume r L hr hL u hu' h hhi hh0).2
    rw [hLval] at hcomp htransport
    have hcomp2 : (∫ x, h (variableRadiusMap r u x)) ≤ 2 := by
      calc
        (∫ x, h (variableRadiusMap r u x)) ≤ (1 - δ)⁻¹ * ∫ x, h x := hcomp
        _ ≤ 2 * ∫ x, h x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hinv hmass0
        _ ≤ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass (by positivity)
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    have hb : |avg u - ∫ x in A, h x| ≤ e := by
      apply htransport.trans
      simpa only [mul_comm δ (2 : ℝ)] using
        add_le_add hvar (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcomp2 hδ.le)
    have := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp hb).2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨havgi, havgb⟩ := unitBall_weighted_average_integrable_and_bound
    d κ δ ε D hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hA hthin h hh.continuous hhi hh0 hmass horigin
  change Integrable avg τ at havgi
  change (∫ u, avg u ∂τ) ≤ c * (ε + D * δ) at havgb
  have hmain : c * (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ c * (ε + D * δ + e) := by
    calc
      c * (∫ x in A, h x) = ∫ _u, (∫ x in A, h x) ∂τ := by
        simp [τ, c, integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ∫ u, avg u + e ∂τ := by
        apply integral_mono_ae (integrable_const _) (havgi.add (integrable_const _))
        filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_ball] with u hu
        exact hper u hu
      _ = (∫ u, avg u ∂τ) + c * e := by
        rw [integral_add havgi (integrable_const _)]
        simp [τ, c, integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ c * (ε + D * δ) + c * e := add_le_add havgb le_rfl
      _ = c * (ε + D * δ + e) := by ring
  have hcancel : (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ ε + D * δ + e := (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hc).mp hmain
  have hsquare : 8 * B * δ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * B * δ := by
    have hsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ δ / 2 := by nlinarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (show 0 ≤ 8 * B by positivity)
    nlinarith
  dsimp only [e] at hcancel
  nlinarith

name: SVW.smooth_master_averaging
statement:
theorem smooth_master_averaging
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε D B : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (h : Space d → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hhi : Integrable h volume)
    (hh0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ h x) (hmass : (∫ x, h x) ≤ 1)
    (horigin : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, h x) ≤ D * δ)
    (hGi : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm h) volume)
    (hB : (∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x) ≤ B) :
    (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ ε + (D + 2 + 4 * B) * δ
proof:
:= by
  let A' : Set (Space d) := toMeasurable volume A
  have hA' : MeasurableSet A' := measurableSet_toMeasurable volume A
  have heq : A' =ᵐ[volume] A := hthin.1.toMeasurable_ae_eq
  have hthin' : WolffThin d κ ε A' := by
    refine ⟨hA'.nullMeasurableSet, fun x => ?_⟩
    have hmeasure : volume.real (A' ∩ testingBall d κ x) =
        volume.real (A ∩ testingBall d κ x) :=
      congrArg ENNReal.toReal (measure_congr (heq.inter (ae_eq_refl (testingBall d κ x))))
    rw [hmeasure]
    exact hthin.2 x
  have hb := smooth_master_averaging_measurable d κ δ ε D B hδ hδhalf hcube hε
    A' hA' hthin' h hh hhi hh0 hmass horigin hGi hB
  rwa [Measure.restrict_congr_set heq] at hb

name: SVW.master_averaging_of_smooth_monotone_limit
statement:
theorem master_averaging_of_smooth_monotone_limit
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε D B : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (h : Space d → ℝ) (hhi : Integrable h volume)
    (f : ℕ → Space d → ℝ) (hfc : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f n))
    (hfi : ∀ n : ℕ, Integrable (f n) volume)
    (hf0 : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ f n x)
    (hfmass : ∀ n : ℕ, (∫ x, f n x) ≤ 1)
    (hforigin : ∀ n : ℕ, (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, f n x) ≤ D * δ)
    (hfGi : ∀ n : ℕ, Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm (f n)) volume)
    (hfB : ∀ n : ℕ, (∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm (f n) x) ≤ B)
    (hfmono : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, Monotone (fun n : ℕ => f n x))
    (hflimit : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => f n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (h x))) :
    (∫ x in A, h x) ≤ ε + (D + 2 + 4 * B) * δ
proof:
:= by
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : (∫ x in A, f n x) ≤ ε + (D + 2 + 4 * B) * δ :=
    smooth_master_averaging d κ δ ε D B hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin
      (f n) (hfc n) (hfi n) (hf0 n) (hfmass n) (hforigin n) (hfGi n) (hfB n)
  have hconv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in A, f n x) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ x in A, h x)) :=
    integral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone (fun n => (hfi n).integrableOn)
      hhi.integrableOn (ae_restrict_of_ae hfmono) (ae_restrict_of_ae hflimit)
  exact le_of_tendsto hconv (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)

name: SVW.radiusDisplacement_lipschitz
statement:
theorem radiusDisplacement_lipschitz
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    LipschitzWith L (fun x : E => r x • u)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  calc
    dist (r x • u) (r y • u) = |r x - r y| * ‖u‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, ← sub_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ |r x - r y| := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (abs_nonneg (r x - r y))
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * dist x y := by
      simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hr.dist_le_mul x y

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_lipschitz
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_lipschitz
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    LipschitzWith (1 + L) (variableRadiusMap r u)
proof:
:=
  LipschitzWith.id.add (radiusDisplacement_lipschitz E r L hr u hu)

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_antilipschitz
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_antilipschitz
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    AntilipschitzWith (1 - L)⁻¹ (variableRadiusMap r u)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [inv_one, variableRadiusMap, id_eq] using!
    AntilipschitzWith.id.add_lipschitzWith
      (radiusDisplacement_lipschitz E r L hr u hu) (by simpa only [inv_one] using hL)

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_surjective
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_surjective
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    Function.Surjective (variableRadiusMap r u)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  let g : E → E := fun x => z - r x • u
  have hg : ContractingWith L g := by
    refine ⟨hL, ?_⟩
    simpa only [zero_add] using
      (LipschitzWith.const z).sub (radiusDisplacement_lipschitz E r L hr u hu)
  refine ⟨hg.fixedPoint g, ?_⟩
  have hfix : z - r (hg.fixedPoint g) • u = hg.fixedPoint g := hg.fixedPoint_isFixedPt
  exact eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp hfix.symm

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_bijective
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_bijective
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    Function.Bijective (variableRadiusMap r u)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(variableRadiusMap_antilipschitz E r L hr hL u hu).injective,
    variableRadiusMap_surjective E r L hr hL u hu⟩

name: SVW.variableRadiusHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem variableRadiusHomeomorph_apply
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (x : E) :
    variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu x = x + r x • u
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_lipschitz
statement:
theorem variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_lipschitz
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    LipschitzWith (1 - L)⁻¹ (variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu).symm
proof:
:=
  (variableRadiusMap_antilipschitz E r L hr hL u hu).to_rightInverse
    (variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu).apply_symm_apply

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_norm_sub_le
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_norm_sub_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (x y : E) :
    ‖variableRadiusMap r u x - variableRadiusMap r u y‖ ≤
      (1 + (L : ℝ)) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_one] using
    (variableRadiusMap_lipschitz E r L hr u hu).dist_le_mul x y

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_lower_norm_sub
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_lower_norm_sub
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (x y : E) :
    (1 - (L : ℝ)) * ‖x - y‖ ≤
      ‖variableRadiusMap r u x - variableRadiusMap r u y‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [inv_inv, NNReal.coe_sub hL.le, NNReal.coe_one, dist_eq_norm] using
    (variableRadiusMap_antilipschitz E r L hr hL u hu).mul_le_dist x y

name: SVW.variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_eq
statement:
theorem variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_eq
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (z : E) :
    (variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu).symm z =
      z - r ((variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu).symm z) • u
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
  exact (variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu).apply_symm_apply z

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_displacement_norm
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_displacement_norm
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (u x : E) :
    ‖variableRadiusMap r u x - x‖ = |r x| * ‖u‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [variableRadiusMap, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_displacement_le
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_displacement_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (x : E) (hrx : 0 ≤ r x) :
    ‖variableRadiusMap r u x - x‖ ≤ r x
proof:
:= by
  rw [variableRadiusMap_displacement_norm, abs_of_nonneg hrx]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hrx

name: SVW.variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_displacement_le
statement:
theorem variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_displacement_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (z : E) :
    ‖(variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu).symm z - z‖ ≤
      (1 - (L : ℝ))⁻¹ * |r z|
proof:
:= by
  let H := variableRadiusHomeomorph E r L hr hL u hu
  have hLip := (variableRadiusHomeomorph_symm_lipschitz E r L hr hL u hu).dist_le_mul
    z (H z)
  have hnorm : ‖H.symm z - z‖ ≤
      (1 - (L : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖z - H z‖ := by
    simpa only [H, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply, dist_eq_norm,
      NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_sub hL.le, NNReal.coe_one] using hLip
  have hdis : ‖z - H z‖ ≤ |r z| := by
    rw [norm_sub_rev]
    change ‖variableRadiusMap r u z - z‖ ≤ |r z|
    rw [variableRadiusMap_displacement_norm]
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (abs_nonneg (r z))
  exact hnorm.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdis
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (sub_nonneg.mpr (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr hL.le))))

name: SVW.det_id_add_smulRight
statement:
theorem det_id_add_smulRight
    (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (ℓ : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (u : E) :
    LinearMap.det (LinearMap.id + ℓ.smulRight u) = 1 + ℓ u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis ℝ E
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, map_add, LinearMap.toMatrix_id,
    LinearMap.toMatrix_smulRight, Matrix.vecMulVec_eq Unit,
    Matrix.det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow]
  congr 1
  change (∑ i, ℓ (b i) * b.repr u i) = ℓ u
  calc
    (∑ i, ℓ (b i) * b.repr u i) = ℓ (∑ i, b.repr u i • b i) := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _hi
      exact mul_comm _ _
    _ = ℓ u := congrArg ℓ (b.sum_repr u)

name: SVW.hasFDerivAt_variable_radius_translation
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_variable_radius_translation
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (ℓ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) (hr : HasFDerivAt r ℓ x)
    (u : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y : E => y + r y • u)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E + ℓ.smulRight u) x
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_id x).add (hr.smul_const u)

name: SVW.det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation
statement:
theorem det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (ℓ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) (hr : HasFDerivAt r ℓ x)
    (u : E) :
    LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap =
      1 + ℓ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_variable_radius_translation E r ℓ x hr u).fderiv]
  exact det_id_add_smulRight E ℓ.toLinearMap u

name: SVW.radius_derivative_norm_le
statement:
theorem radius_derivative_norm_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hrLip : LipschitzWith L r)
    (ℓ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) (hr : HasFDerivAt r ℓ x) :
    ‖ℓ‖ ≤ (L : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hr.fderiv]
  exact norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hrLip

name: SVW.det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
statement:
theorem det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hrLip : LipschitzWith L r)
    (ℓ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) (hr : HasFDerivAt r ℓ x)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    1 - (L : ℝ) ≤
        LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap ∧
      LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap ≤
        1 + (L : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation E r ℓ x hr u]
  have hnorm : ‖ℓ‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) := radius_derivative_norm_le E r L hrLip ℓ x hr
  have heval : |ℓ u| ≤ (L : ℝ) := by
    calc
      |ℓ u| = ‖ℓ u‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖ℓ‖ * ‖u‖ := ℓ.le_opNorm u
      _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * 1 := mul_le_mul hnorm hu (norm_nonneg u) L.coe_nonneg
      _ = (L : ℝ) := mul_one _
  constructor <;> linarith [(abs_le.mp heval).1, (abs_le.mp heval).2]

name: SVW.abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
statement:
theorem abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hrLip : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (ℓ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) (hr : HasFDerivAt r ℓ x)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    1 - (L : ℝ) ≤
proof:
|LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap| ∧
      |LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap| ≤
        1 + (L : ℝ) := by
  have hbounds := det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds E r L hrLip ℓ x hr u hu
  have hpos : 0 <
      LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap := by
    have hLreal : (L : ℝ) < 1 := NNReal.coe_lt_one.mpr hL
    linarith [hbounds.1]
  simpa only [abs_of_pos hpos] using hbounds

name: SVW.ae_abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
statement:
theorem ae_abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hrLip : LipschitzWith L r) (hL : L < 1)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      1 - (L : ℝ) ≤
proof:
|LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap| ∧
        |LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + r y • u) x).toLinearMap| ≤
          1 + (L : ℝ) := by
  filter_upwards [hrLip.ae_differentiableAt (μ := μ)] with x hx
  exact abs_det_fderiv_variable_radius_translation_bounds E r L hrLip hL
    (fderiv ℝ r x) x hx.hasFDerivAt u hu

name: SVW.heat_component_thin_integral_le
statement:
theorem heat_component_thin_integral_le
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1/2)
    (hcube : δ^3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y q : Space d) :
    (∫ z in A, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) ≤
      (ε+2*δ)*(∫ z : Space d, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) +
      (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) +
      4*δ*heatRowGradientUpper d t y q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hGi, hGb⟩ := heatRowIntegrand_gradient_integrable_and_mass d t ht y q
  have hh := smooth_master_averaging_homogeneous d κ δ ε hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin
    (heatRowIntegrand d t y q) (contDiff_heatRowIntegrand_row d t y q)
    (heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable d t ht y q)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q)) hGi
  exact hh.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGb (by positivity)))

name: SVW.heat_component_thin_lintegral_le
statement:
theorem heat_component_thin_lintegral_le
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1/2)
    (hcube : δ^3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y q : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ z in A, ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ε+2*δ)*(∫⁻ z : Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) +
      (∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) +
      ENNReal.ofReal (4*δ)*ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowGradientUpper d t y q)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable d t ht y q
  have h0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume] heatRowIntegrand d t y q :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q)
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi.integrableOn (ae_restrict_of_ae h0),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi h0,
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi.integrableOn (ae_restrict_of_ae h0)]
  have hh := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (heat_component_thin_integral_le d κ δ ε hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin t ht y q)
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg_of_ae h0))
    (integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae h0)))
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (heatRowGradientUpper_nonneg d t y q)),
    ENNReal.ofReal_add (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg_of_ae h0))
      (integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae h0)),
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε+2*δ),
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4*δ)] at hh
  exact hh

name: SVW.norm_segment_direction_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_segment_direction_le_one
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ‖t • u‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
  exact (mul_le_mul ht.2 hu (norm_nonneg u) zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul 1)

name: SVW.truncatedRadius_segment_weight_bound
statement:
theorem truncatedRadius_segment_weight_bound
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) (x : E)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    truncatedRadius κ δ x *
        (1 + ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖) ≤ 4 * κ / δ
proof:
:= by
  have hκ : 0 < κ := by rw [← hcube]; positivity
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ truncatedRadius κ δ x := (truncatedRadius_pos E κ δ hκ hδ x).le
  have hrbound := truncatedRadius_le_sq_of_cube E κ δ hδ hcube x
  have htu := norm_segment_direction_le_one E u hu t ht
  have hnorm : ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + δ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖ ≤
          ‖x‖ + ‖truncatedRadius κ δ x • (t • u)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ + truncatedRadius κ δ x := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
        exact add_le_add le_rfl (by simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htu hr0)
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ + δ ^ 2 := add_le_add le_rfl hrbound
  let a : ℝ := max ‖x‖ δ
  have ha0 : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (le_max_right _ _)
  have hδa : δ ≤ a := le_max_right _ _
  have hxa : ‖x‖ ≤ a := le_max_left _ _
  have hδone : δ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hδsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hprod0 : δ * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδone (norm_nonneg x)
  have hprod : δ * ‖x‖ ≤ a := hprod0.trans hxa
  have hcubea : δ ^ 3 ≤ a := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδsq hδ.le
    nlinarith
  have hden : δ * (1 + ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖) ≤ 4 * a := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hδ.le
    nlinarith
  have hdiv : (1 + ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖) / a ≤ 4 / δ := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ ha0 hδ).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv hκ.le
  change (κ / a) * (1 + ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖) ≤ 4 * κ / δ
  calc
    (κ / a) * (1 + ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖) =
        κ * ((1 + ‖variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x‖) / a) := by ring
    _ ≤ κ * (4 / δ) := hmul
    _ = 4 * κ / δ := by ring

name: SVW.variableRadiusMap_average_integrable_and_mass_le
statement:
theorem variableRadiusMap_average_integrable_and_mass_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (r : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hr : LipschitzWith L r) (hLhalf : (L : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (G : E → ℝ) (hGc : Continuous G) (hG0 : ∀ x : E, 0 ≤ G x) (hGi : Integrable G μ) :
    Integrable (fun x => ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, G (variableRadiusMap r (t • u) x)) μ ∧
      (∫ x, ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, G (variableRadiusMap r (t • u) x) ∂volume ∂μ) ≤
        2 * ∫ x, G x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let τ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  let F : ℝ × E → ℝ := fun p => G (variableRadiusMap r (p.1 • u) p.2)
  have hL : L < 1 := NNReal.coe_lt_one.mpr (by linarith)
  have hgap : 0 < 1 - (L : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hinv : (1 - (L : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
    rw [inv_eq_one_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hgap).mpr
    linarith
  have hIG0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, G x ∂μ := integral_nonneg hG0
  have hFc : Continuous F := hGc.comp
    (continuous_snd.add ((hr.continuous.comp continuous_snd).smul
      (continuous_fst.smul continuous_const)))
  have hFm : AEStronglyMeasurable F (τ.prod μ) := hFc.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hsection (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      Integrable (fun x => F (t, x)) μ ∧ (∫ x, F (t, x) ∂μ) ≤ 2 * ∫ x, G x ∂μ := by
    obtain ⟨hi, hb⟩ := variableRadiusMap_integrable_comp_and_integral_le
      E μ r L hr hL (t • u) (norm_segment_direction_le_one E u hu t ht)
      G hGi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hG0)
    exact ⟨hi, hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hinv hIG0)⟩
  have hFnorm (p : ℝ × E) : ‖F p‖ = F p := Real.norm_of_nonneg (hG0 _)
  have houter : Integrable (fun t => ∫ x, ‖F (t, x)‖ ∂μ) τ := by
    apply (integrable_const (2 * ∫ x, G x ∂μ)).mono'
      hFm.norm.integral_prod_right'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, F (t, x) ∂μ := integral_nonneg (fun x => hG0 _)
    simpa only [hFnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht0] using (hsection t ht).2
  have hFi : Integrable F (τ.prod μ) := (integrable_prod_iff hFm).mpr ⟨by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    exact (hsection t ht).1, houter⟩
  refine ⟨hFi.integral_prod_right, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ x, ∫ t, F (t, x) ∂τ ∂μ) = ∫ t, ∫ x, F (t, x) ∂μ ∂τ :=
      (integral_integral_swap hFi).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ _t, (2 * ∫ x, G x ∂μ) ∂τ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hFi.integral_prod_left (integrable_const _)
      filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
      exact (hsection t ht).2
    _ = 2 * ∫ x, G x ∂μ := by simp [τ]

name: SVW.smooth_row_pointwise_variation_bound
statement:
theorem smooth_row_pointwise_variation_bound
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (x : E) :
    |h x - h (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x)| ≤
      (4 * κ / δ) * ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        weightedDerivativeNorm h (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) (t • u) x)
proof:
:= by
  let r : E → ℝ := truncatedRadius κ δ
  let P : ℝ → E := fun t => variableRadiusMap r (t • u) x
  have hκ : 0 < κ := by rw [← hcube]; positivity
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r x := (truncatedRadius_pos E κ δ hκ hδ x).le
  have hv : ‖r x • u‖ ≤ r x := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hr0
  have hP (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt P (r x • u) t := by
    simpa only [P, variableRadiusMap, one_smul, Pi.smul_apply, id_eq] using
      (((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const u).const_smul (r x)).const_add x
  have hPc : Continuous P := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun t => (hP t).continuousAt
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => h (P t))
      (fderiv ℝ h (P t) (r x • u)) t :=
    ((hh.differentiable one_ne_zero) (P t)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hP t)
  have hspeed : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖deriv (fun t => h (P t)) t‖ ≤ (4 * κ / δ) * weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t) := by
    intro t ht
    have hw := truncatedRadius_segment_weight_bound E κ δ hδ hδhalf hcube u hu x t ht
    have hw' : r x * (1 + ‖P t‖) ≤ 4 * κ / δ := hw
    have hfactor : weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t) * (1 + ‖P t‖) = ‖fderiv ℝ h (P t)‖ := by
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
    rw [(hderiv t).deriv]
    calc
      ‖fderiv ℝ h (P t) (r x • u)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ h (P t)‖ * ‖r x • u‖ :=
        (fderiv ℝ h (P t)).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ h (P t)‖ * r x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t) * (r x * (1 + ‖P t‖)) := by rw [← hfactor]; ring
      _ ≤ weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t) * (4 * κ / δ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw' (weightedDerivativeNorm_nonneg E h (P t))
      _ = (4 * κ / δ) * weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t) := mul_comm _ _
  have hBcont : Continuous (fun t => (4 * κ / δ) * weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t)) :=
    continuous_const.mul ((continuous_weightedDerivativeNorm E h hh).comp hPc)
  have hFTC := norm_sub_le_integral_of_norm_deriv_le_of_le (f := fun t => h (P t))
    (B := fun t => (4 * κ / δ) * weightedDerivativeNorm h (P t)) zero_le_one
    (hh.continuous.comp hPc).continuousOn
    (fun t _ht => (hderiv t).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => hspeed t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩)
    (hBcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one, restrict_Ioc_eq_restrict_Icc,
    integral_const_mul] at hFTC
  rw [abs_sub_comm]
  simpa only [P, r, variableRadiusMap, zero_smul, smul_zero, add_zero, one_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs] using hFTC

name: SVW.smooth_row_variation_integrable_and_bound
statement:
theorem smooth_row_variation_integrable_and_bound
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hGi : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm h) μ) :
    Integrable (fun x => |h x - h (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x)|) μ ∧
      (∫ x, |h x - h (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x)| ∂μ) ≤
        8 * δ ^ 2 * ∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let r : E → ℝ := truncatedRadius κ δ
  let L : ℝ≥0 := Real.toNNReal δ
  let M : E → ℝ := fun x => ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
    weightedDerivativeNorm h (variableRadiusMap r (t • u) x)
  have hr : LipschitzWith L r := truncatedRadius_lipschitz_of_cube E κ δ hδ hcube
  have hLhalf : (L : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    simpa only [L, Real.coe_toNNReal _ hδ.le] using hδhalf
  obtain ⟨hMi, hMb⟩ := variableRadiusMap_average_integrable_and_mass_le E μ r L hr hLhalf u hu
    (weightedDerivativeNorm h) (continuous_weightedDerivativeNorm E h hh)
    (weightedDerivativeNorm_nonneg E h) hGi
  have hκ : 0 < κ := by rw [← hcube]; positivity
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ 4 * κ / δ := by positivity
  have hpoint (x : E) : |h x - h (variableRadiusMap r u x)| ≤ (4 * κ / δ) * M x :=
    smooth_row_pointwise_variation_bound E κ δ hδ hδhalf hcube u hu h hh x
  have hTcont : Continuous (variableRadiusMap r u) :=
    (variableRadiusMap_lipschitz E r L hr u hu).continuous
  have hvarmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => |h x - h (variableRadiusMap r u x)|) μ :=
    (hh.continuous.sub (hh.continuous.comp hTcont)).abs.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hvari : Integrable (fun x => |h x - h (variableRadiusMap r u x)|) μ :=
    (hMi.const_mul (4 * κ / δ)).mono_nonneg hvarmeas
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
  refine ⟨hvari, ?_⟩
  have hκdiv : κ / δ = δ ^ 2 := by rw [← hcube]; field_simp
  calc
    (∫ x, |h x - h (variableRadiusMap r u x)| ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, (4 * κ / δ) * M x ∂μ :=
      integral_mono_ae hvari (hMi.const_mul (4 * κ / δ)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    _ = (4 * κ / δ) * ∫ x, M x ∂μ := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ (4 * κ / δ) * (2 * ∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x ∂μ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMb hC0
    _ = 8 * δ ^ 2 * ∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x ∂μ := by rw [mul_div_assoc, hκdiv]; ring

name: SVW.smooth_row_variation_le
statement:
theorem smooth_row_variation_le
    (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (κ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) (hcube : δ ^ 3 = κ)
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (h : E → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hGi : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm h) μ)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : (∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x ∂μ) ≤ B) :
    (∫ x, |h x - h (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x)| ∂μ) ≤ 8 * B * δ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb := (smooth_row_variation_integrable_and_bound E μ κ δ hδ hδhalf hcube u hu h hh hGi).2
  calc
    (∫ x, |h x - h (variableRadiusMap (truncatedRadius κ δ) u x)| ∂μ) ≤
        8 * δ ^ 2 * ∫ x, weightedDerivativeNorm h x ∂μ := hb
    _ ≤ 8 * δ ^ 2 * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (by positivity)
    _ = 8 * B * δ ^ 2 := by ring

statement:
theorem positiveKernelENN_set_lintegral_eq_components
