name: SVW.positiveKernelENN_thin_lintegral_components
statement:
theorem positiveKernelENN_thin_lintegral_components
    (d : ℕ) (κ δ ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1/2)
    (hcube : δ^3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ z in A, positiveKernelENN d y z) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ε+2*δ) * (∫⁻ z : Space d, positiveKernelENN d y z) +
      (∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, positiveKernelENN d y z) +
      ENNReal.ofReal (4*δ) *
        (∫⁻ v : ℝ × Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowGradientUpper d v.1 y v.2)
          ∂((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume))
proof:
:= by
  let τ : Measure (ℝ × Space d) := (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume
  let a : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (ε+2*δ)
  let b : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (4*δ)
  let m : ℝ × Space d → ℝ≥0∞ := heatComponentMass d y univ
  let o : ℝ × Space d → ℝ≥0∞ := heatComponentMass d y (Metric.ball 0 δ)
  let G : ℝ × Space d → ℝ≥0∞ := fun v => ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowGradientUpper d v.1 y v.2)
  have hm : Measurable m := measurable_heatComponentMass d y univ
  have ho : Measurable o := measurable_heatComponentMass d y (Metric.ball 0 δ)
  have hG : Measurable G := (measurable_heatRowGradientUpper_pair d y).ennreal_ofReal
  have ham : Measurable (fun v => a*m v) := measurable_const.mul hm
  have hamo : Measurable (fun v => a*m v + o v) := ham.add ho
  have hsum : Measurable (fun v => a*m v + o v + b*G v) :=
    hamo.add (measurable_const.mul hG)
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ v ∂τ, heatComponentMass d y A v ≤ a*m v + o v + b*G v := by
    rw [Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_le (measurable_heatComponentMass d y A) hsum)]
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      simpa only [heatComponentMass, Measure.restrict_univ, a, b, m, o, G] using
        heat_component_thin_lintegral_le d κ δ ε hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin t ht y q
  have hint : (∫⁻ v, heatComponentMass d y A v ∂τ) ≤
      a*(∫⁻ v, m v ∂τ) + (∫⁻ v, o v ∂τ) + b*(∫⁻ v, G v ∂τ) := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ v, heatComponentMass d y A v ∂τ) ≤ ∫⁻ v, a*m v + o v + b*G v ∂τ :=
        lintegral_mono_ae hpoint
      _ = _ := by
        rw [lintegral_add_left hamo (fun v => b*G v),
          lintegral_add_left ham o,
          lintegral_const_mul _ hm, lintegral_const_mul _ hG]
  have hmass : (∫⁻ v, m v ∂τ) = ∫⁻ z : Space d, positiveKernelENN d y z := by
    simpa only [Measure.restrict_univ] using
      (positiveKernelENN_set_lintegral_eq_components d y univ).symm
  have horigin : (∫⁻ v, o v ∂τ) = ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
      positiveKernelENN d y z :=
    (positiveKernelENN_set_lintegral_eq_components d y (Metric.ball 0 δ)).symm
  rw [hmass, horigin] at hint
  rw [positiveKernelENN_set_lintegral_eq_components d y A]
  exact hint

name: SVW.positiveKernelENN_thin_row_bound
statement:
theorem positiveKernelENN_thin_row_bound
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ δ ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1/2)
    (hcube : δ^3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ z in A, positiveKernelENN d y z) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ε + positiveDensityConstant d * δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (∫⁻ v : ℝ × Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowGradientUpper d v.1 y v.2)
      ∂((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (rowGradientConstant d) := by
    rw [lintegral_prod _ (measurable_heatRowGradientUpper_pair d y).ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable]
    exact lintegral_heatRowGradientUpper_le d y
  have hh := positiveKernelENN_thin_lintegral_components d κ δ ε hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin y
  have hD : 0 ≤ kernelOriginConstant d := kernelOriginConstant_nonneg d
  calc
    (∫⁻ z in A, positiveKernelENN d y z) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ε+2*δ) * 1 + ENNReal.ofReal (kernelOriginConstant d * δ) +
        ENNReal.ofReal (4*δ) * ENNReal.ofReal (rowGradientConstant d) := by
      exact hh.trans (add_le_add
        (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_right (lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one d hd y) _)
          (lintegral_positiveKernelENN_origin_le d hd δ hδ (by linarith) y))
        (mul_le_mul_right hG _))
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (ε + positiveDensityConstant d * δ) := by
      rw [mul_one, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4*δ),
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε+2*δ)
          (mul_nonneg (kernelOriginConstant_nonneg d) hδ.le),
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε+2*δ+kernelOriginConstant d*δ)
          (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (rowGradientConstant_nonneg d))]
      congr 1
      unfold positiveDensityConstant
      ring

name: SVW.positiveKernel_thin_row_bound
statement:
theorem positiveKernel_thin_row_bound
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (κ δ ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1/2)
    (hcube : δ^3 = κ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (A : Set (Space d)) (hthin : WolffThin d κ ε A) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ z in A, positiveKernel d y z) ≤ ε + positiveDensityConstant d * δ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in A, positiveKernel d y z) =
      ∫⁻ z in A, positiveKernelENN d y z := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_positiveKernel_row d hd y).integrableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => positiveKernel_nonneg d y z)]
    exact lintegral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (positiveKernel_ofReal_ae d hd y))
  apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff
    (add_nonneg hε (mul_nonneg (positiveDensityConstant_pos d).le hδ.le))).mp
  rw [heq]
  exact positiveKernelENN_thin_row_bound d hd κ δ ε hδ hδhalf hcube hε A hthin y

name: SVW.heatDensity_split_expression_le
statement:
theorem heatDensity_split_expression_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (u : ℝ) (v : Space n) :
    (π / t) ^ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) *
      exp (-(π ^ 2 / t) * (u ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2)) ≤
      sqrt (π / t) * heatDensity n t v
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (π / t) ^ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) =
      sqrt (π / t) * (π / t) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) := by
    rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, ← rpow_add (div_pos pi_pos ht)]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have he : exp (-(π ^ 2 / t) * u ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    apply exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    have ha : 0 ≤ π ^ 2 / t := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]
  have hexp : exp (-(π ^ 2 / t) * (u ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2)) =
      exp (-(π ^ 2 / t) * u ^ 2) * gaussian n (π ^ 2 / t) v := by
    unfold gaussian
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hp, hexp]
  unfold heatDensity
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (gaussian_pos n (π ^ 2 / t) v).le
  have hc : 0 ≤ sqrt (π / t) * (π / t) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) := by positivity
  have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hc
  simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using hd

name: SVW.heatDensity_ball_integral_le_succ
statement:
theorem heatDensity_ball_integral_le_succ (n : ℕ) (t δ : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hδ : 0 < δ) (y : Space (n + 1)) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space (n + 1)) δ, heatDensity (n + 1) t (y - z)) ≤
      2 * δ * sqrt (π / t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := originSplitIsometry n
  let H : (ℝ × Space n) ≃ᵐ Space (n + 1) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (ℝ × Space n)).trans e.symm.toMeasurableEquiv
  have hH : MeasurePreserving H (volume.prod volume) volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (e.symm ∘ WithLp.toLp 2) (volume.prod volume) volume
    rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    exact e.symm.measurePreserving.comp (WithLp.volume_preserving_toLp ℝ (Space n))
  let φ : Space (n + 1) → ℝ := (Metric.ball 0 δ).indicator
    (fun z => heatDensity (n + 1) t (y - z))
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := (Ioo (-δ) δ).indicator (fun _ => sqrt (π / t))
  let g : Space n → ℝ := fun v => heatDensity n t ((e y).snd - v)
  have hφ : Integrable φ volume :=
    (integrable_heatDensity_sub_left (n + 1) t ht y).indicator measurableSet_ball
  have hφH : Integrable (fun p => φ (H p)) (volume.prod volume) :=
    (hH.integrable_comp_emb H.measurableEmbedding).mpr hφ
  have hf : Integrable f volume :=
    (integrableOn_const (show volume (Ioo (-δ) δ) ≠ ⊤ by
      rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ioo
  have hg : Integrable g volume := integrable_heatDensity_sub_left n t ht (e y).snd
  have hpoint (p : ℝ × Space n) : φ (H p) ≤ f p.1 * g p.2 := by
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g p.2 := (heatDensity_pos n t ht _).le
    by_cases hp : H p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Space (n + 1)) δ
    · have hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 p : SplitEuclideanSpace n)‖ < δ := by
        have hh : ‖H p‖ < δ := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp
        simpa only [H, MeasurableEquiv.trans_apply, MeasurableEquiv.toLp_apply,
          LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toMeasurableEquiv, e.symm.norm_map] using hh
      have hu : p.1 ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ := by
        have hh := (WithLp.norm_fst_le ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 p : SplitEuclideanSpace n)).trans_lt hnorm
        simpa only [WithLp.toLp_fst, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt, Set.mem_Ioo] using hh
      rw [show φ (H p) = heatDensity (n + 1) t (y - H p) from Set.indicator_of_mem hp _,
        show f p.1 = sqrt (π / t) from Set.indicator_of_mem hu _]
      have hnormdiff : ‖y - H p‖ ^ 2 = ((e y).fst - p.1) ^ 2 + ‖(e y).snd - p.2‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← e.norm_map (y - H p), e.map_sub]
        have heH : e (H p) = WithLp.toLp 2 p := e.apply_symm_apply _
        rw [heH, WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
        simp only [WithLp.sub_fst, WithLp.sub_snd, WithLp.toLp_fst, WithLp.toLp_snd,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      simpa only [heatDensity, gaussian, hnormdiff, g] using
        heatDensity_split_expression_le n t ht ((e y).fst - p.1) ((e y).snd - p.2)
    · rw [show φ (H p) = 0 from Set.indicator_of_notMem hp _]
      apply mul_nonneg _ hg0
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => sqrt_nonneg _) _
  calc
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space (n + 1)) δ, heatDensity (n + 1) t (y - z)) =
        ∫ z, φ z := (integral_indicator measurableSet_ball).symm
    _ = ∫ p, φ (H p) ∂volume.prod volume := (hH.integral_comp H.measurableEmbedding φ).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ p : ℝ × Space n, f p.1 * g p.2 ∂volume.prod volume :=
      integral_mono_ae hφH (hf.mul_prod hg) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    _ = (∫ u, f u) * ∫ v, g v := integral_prod_mul f g
    _ = 2 * δ * sqrt (π / t) := by
      rw [show (∫ v, g v) = 1 from integral_heatDensity_sub_left n t ht (e y).snd, mul_one]
      change (∫ u : ℝ, (Ioo (-δ) δ).indicator (fun _ => sqrt (π / t)) u) = _
      rw [integral_indicator_const _ measurableSet_Ioo,
        Real.volume_real_Ioo_of_le (by linarith : -δ ≤ δ), smul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: SVW.heatDensity_ball_integral_le
statement:
theorem heatDensity_ball_integral_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (t δ : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hδ : 0 < δ) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, heatDensity d t (y - z)) ≤
      2 * δ * sqrt (π / t)
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n => exact heatDensity_ball_integral_le_succ n t δ ht hδ y

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_product_origin_bound
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_product_origin_bound (d : ℕ) (y q z : Space d) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1) :
    gaussianWindow d (y - q) * gaussianWindow d (z - q) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 2 * exp π * gaussian d (π / 2) q
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : ‖q‖ ^ 2 / 2 - 1 ≤ ‖z - q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
    have hi := real_inner_le_norm z q
    have hsq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖q‖ - 2 * ‖z‖)]
  have hg : gaussian d π (z - q) ≤ exp π * gaussian d (π / 2) q := by
    unfold gaussian
    rw [← exp_add]
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have hbound := mul_le_mul (gaussian_le_one d π pi_pos.le (y - q)) hg
    (gaussian_pos d π (z - q)).le zero_le_one
  have hc : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound hc
  unfold gaussianWindow
  nlinarith

name: SVW.originWindowMajorant_nonneg
statement: theorem originWindowMajorant_nonneg (d : ℕ) (q : Space d) : 0 ≤ originWindowMajorant d q
proof:
:= by
  unfold originWindowMajorant
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (exp_pos _).le) (gaussian_pos d _ q).le

name: SVW.kernelOriginConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem kernelOriginConstant_nonneg (d : ℕ) : 0 ≤ kernelOriginConstant d
proof:
:= by
  unfold kernelOriginConstant
  apply mul_nonneg
  · positivity
  · exact integral_nonneg fun q => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (gaussian_pos d _ q).le

name: SVW.exponentialMix_heat_marginal_integrable_and_integral
statement:
theorem exponentialMix_heat_marginal_integrable_and_integral (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => exponentialMix b t * sqrt (π / t)) (Ioi 0) volume ∧
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix b t * sqrt (π / t)) = π * b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb0 : b = 0
  · subst b
    simp [exponentialMix]
  have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (Ne.symm hb0)
  have heq : (fun t => exponentialMix b t * sqrt (π / t)) =
      (fun t => sqrt π * (exponentialMix b t / sqrt t)) := by
    funext t
    rw [sqrt_div pi_pos.le]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  refine ⟨(integrable_exponentialMix_div_sqrt b hbpos).const_mul _, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exponentialMix_div_sqrt b hbpos]
  nlinarith [sq_sqrt pi_pos.le]

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_origin_integral_le
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_origin_integral_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (t δ : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (y q : Space d) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) ≤
      originWindowMajorant d q * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t * (2 * δ * sqrt (π / t))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : 0 ≤ originWindowMajorant d q := originWindowMajorant_nonneg d q
  have hm : 0 ≤ exponentialMix ‖q‖ t := exponentialMix_nonneg _ _
  calc
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) ≤
        ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
          (originWindowMajorant d q * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t) * heatDensity d t (y - z) := by
      apply setIntegral_mono_on (heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable d t ht y q).integrableOn
        ((integrable_heatDensity_sub_left d t ht y).const_mul _).integrableOn measurableSet_ball
      intro z hz
      have hz' : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 :=
        (show ‖z‖ < δ by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz).le.trans hδone
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussianWindow_product_origin_bound d y q z hz') hm)
        (heatDensity_pos d t ht _).le
    _ = (originWindowMajorant d q * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t) *
        ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, heatDensity d t (y - z) := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (heatDensity_ball_integral_le d hd t δ ht hδ y)
      (mul_nonneg hw hm)

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_origin_time_lintegral_le
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_origin_time_lintegral_le
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (y q : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * π * δ * originWindowMajorant d q * ‖q‖)
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := 2 * δ * originWindowMajorant d q
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (originWindowMajorant_nonneg d q)
  obtain ⟨hmi, hmv⟩ := exponentialMix_heat_marginal_integrable_and_integral ‖q‖ (norm_nonneg q)
  have hmajor : IntegrableOn (fun t => C * (exponentialMix ‖q‖ t * sqrt (π / t)))
      (Ioi 0) volume := hmi.const_mul C
  have hmajor0 : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioi 0),
      0 ≤ C * (exponentialMix ‖q‖ t * sqrt (π / t)) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => mul_nonneg hC
      (mul_nonneg (exponentialMix_nonneg _ _) (sqrt_nonneg _))
  calc
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) ≤
        ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (C * (exponentialMix ‖q‖ t * sqrt (π / t))) := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
        (heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable d t ht y q).integrableOn
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q z)]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      have hb := heatRowIntegrand_origin_integral_le d hd t δ ht hδ hδone y q
      simpa only [C, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hb
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (C * (π * ‖q‖)) := by
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hmajor hmajor0, integral_const_mul, hmv]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * π * δ * originWindowMajorant d q * ‖q‖) := by
      congr 1
      dsimp only [C]
      ring

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_origin_triple_lintegral_le
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_origin_triple_lintegral_le
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ q : Space d, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (kernelOriginConstant d * δ)
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := 2 * π * δ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4)) ^ 2 * exp π
  have hi : Integrable (fun q : Space d => 2 * π * δ * originWindowMajorant d q * ‖q‖) volume := by
    convert! (integrable_norm_mul_gaussian d (π / 2) (by positivity)).const_mul C using 1
    funext q
    dsimp only [C, originWindowMajorant]
    ring
  have h0 : ∀ᵐ q : Space d ∂volume, 0 ≤ 2 * π * δ * originWindowMajorant d q * ‖q‖ :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (originWindowMajorant_nonneg d q)) (norm_nonneg _)
  calc
    (∫⁻ q : Space d, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) ≤
        ∫⁻ q : Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * π * δ * originWindowMajorant d q * ‖q‖) :=
      lintegral_mono fun q => heatRowIntegrand_origin_time_lintegral_le d hd δ hδ hδone y q
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (kernelOriginConstant d * δ) := by
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi h0]
      congr 1
      have heq : (fun q : Space d => 2 * π * δ * originWindowMajorant d q * ‖q‖) =
          (fun q => C * (‖q‖ * gaussian d (π / 2) q)) := by
        funext q
        dsimp only [C, originWindowMajorant]
        ring
      rw [heq, integral_const_mul]
      unfold kernelOriginConstant
      dsimp only [C]
      ring

name: SVW.lintegral_positiveKernelENN_origin_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_positiveKernelENN_origin_le
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, positiveKernelENN d y z) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (kernelOriginConstant d * δ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveKernelENN
  calc
    (∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ q : Space d,
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z)) =
        ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, ∫⁻ q : Space d,
          ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) := by
      apply lintegral_lintegral_swap
      apply Measurable.aemeasurable
      apply Measurable.lintegral_prod_right
      unfold Function.uncurry heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
      fun_prop
    _ = ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ q : Space d, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
          ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro t
      apply lintegral_lintegral_swap
      apply Measurable.aemeasurable
      unfold Function.uncurry heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
      fun_prop
    _ = ∫⁻ q : Space d, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ,
          ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) := by
      apply lintegral_lintegral_swap
      apply Measurable.aemeasurable
      apply Measurable.lintegral_prod_right
      unfold Function.uncurry heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
      fun_prop
    _ ≤ _ := heatRowIntegrand_origin_triple_lintegral_le d hd δ hδ hδone y

name: SVW.positiveKernel_origin_integral_le
statement:
theorem positiveKernel_origin_integral_le
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, positiveKernel d y z) ≤ kernelOriginConstant d * δ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, positiveKernel d y z) =
      ∫⁻ z in Metric.ball (0 : Space d) δ, positiveKernelENN d y z := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_positiveKernel_row d hd y).integrableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => positiveKernel_nonneg d y z)]
    exact lintegral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (positiveKernel_ofReal_ae d hd y))
  apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (mul_nonneg (kernelOriginConstant_nonneg d) hδ.le)).mp
  rw [heq]
  exact lintegral_positiveKernelENN_origin_le d hd δ hδ hδone y

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_ext_ae
statement:
theorem operator_ext_ae (m n : BoundedSymbol α μ) (hmn : m =ᵐ[μ] n) :
    m.operator = n.operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [m.operator_coe f, n.operator_coe f, hmn] with x hm hn h
  rw [hm, hn, h]

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.realUnit_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem realUnit_selfAdjoint (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator
proof:
:= by
  change star (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator = (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator
  rw [← operator_conj]
  apply operator_ext_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp [conj, realUnit])

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.realUnit_inner
statement:
theorem realUnit_inner (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1)
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    (inner ℂ ((realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator f) f).re =
      ∫ x, a x * ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  change Complex.reCLM (∫ x, inner ℂ ((realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator f x) (f x) ∂μ) = _
  rw [← Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm (L2.integrable_inner
    ((realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator f) f)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator_coe f] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  change (inner ℂ ((a x : ℂ) * f x) (f x)).re = _
  rw [← smul_eq_mul, inner_smul_left, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
  simp [← Complex.ofReal_pow]

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.realUnit_nonneg
statement:
theorem realUnit_nonneg (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator
proof:
:= by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive,
    ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_def']
  refine ⟨realUnit_selfAdjoint a ha ha0 ha1, ?_⟩
  intro f
  change 0 ≤ (inner ℂ ((realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator f) f).re
  rw [realUnit_inner]
  apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
  filter_upwards [ha0] with x hx
  exact mul_nonneg hx (sq_nonneg _)

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.realUnit_complement
statement:
theorem realUnit_complement (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    (realUnit (fun x => 1 - a x) (aestronglyMeasurable_const.sub ha)
      (ha1.mono fun x hx => sub_nonneg.mpr hx)
      (ha0.mono fun x hx => by linarith)).operator =
    1 - (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(realUnit (fun x => 1 - a x) (aestronglyMeasurable_const.sub ha)
      (ha1.mono fun x hx => sub_nonneg.mpr hx)
      (ha0.mono fun x hx => by linarith)).operator_coe f,
    (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator_coe f,
    Lp.coeFn_sub f ((realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator f)] with x hc ha' hs
  change _ = (f - (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator f) x
  rw [hc, hs]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [ha']
  change ((1 - a x : ℝ) : ℂ) * f x = f x - (a x : ℂ) * f x
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.realUnit_le_one
statement:
theorem realUnit_le_one (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    (realUnit a ha ha0 ha1).operator ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_nonneg, ← realUnit_complement a ha ha0 ha1]
  exact realUnit_nonneg _ _ _ _

name: SVW.antiWickCompression_nonneg
statement:
theorem antiWickCompression_nonneg {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} (V : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ antiWickCompression V (BoundedSymbol.realUnit a ha ha0 ha1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive _ |>.mp
    (BoundedSymbol.realUnit_nonneg a ha ha0 ha1)).adjoint_conj V.toContinuousLinearMap

name: SVW.antiWickCompression_complement
statement:
theorem antiWickCompression_complement {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} (V : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    antiWickCompression V (BoundedSymbol.realUnit (fun x => 1-a x)
      (aestronglyMeasurable_const.sub ha) (ha1.mono fun x hx => sub_nonneg.mpr hx)
      (ha0.mono fun x hx => by linarith)) =
      1 - antiWickCompression V (BoundedSymbol.realUnit a ha ha0 ha1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold antiWickCompression
  rw [BoundedSymbol.realUnit_complement a ha ha0 ha1]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_sub]
  have hid : (1 : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ).comp V.toContinuousLinearMap =
      V.toContinuousLinearMap := by ext x; rfl
  rw [hid, V.adjoint_comp_self]

name: SVW.antiWickCompression_le_one
statement:
theorem antiWickCompression_le_one {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} (V : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
    (a : α → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ a x) (ha1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, a x ≤ 1) :
    antiWickCompression V (BoundedSymbol.realUnit a ha ha0 ha1) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_nonneg, ← antiWickCompression_complement V a ha ha0 ha1]
  exact antiWickCompression_nonneg _ _ _ _ _

name: SVW.exponentialMix_gradient_integrable_and_integral_le
statement:
theorem exponentialMix_gradient_integrable_and_integral_le
    (b A B H : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => exponentialMix b t * (A + (B / (1 + b)) * (H / sqrt t)))
      (Ioi 0) volume ∧
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix b t * (A + (B / (1 + b)) * (H / sqrt t))) ≤
      A + B * H * sqrt π
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb0 : b = 0
  · subst b
    constructor
    · simp [exponentialMix]
    · simp only [exponentialMix, zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), zero_mul, integral_zero]
      positivity
  have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (Ne.symm hb0)
  let C : ℝ := B * H / (1 + b)
  have heq : (fun t => exponentialMix b t * (A + (B / (1 + b)) * (H / sqrt t))) =
      (fun t => A * exponentialMix b t + C * (exponentialMix b t / sqrt t)) := by
    funext t
    dsimp only [C]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have hiA := (integrable_exponentialMix b hbpos).const_mul A
  have hiC := (integrable_exponentialMix_div_sqrt b hbpos).const_mul C
  refine ⟨hiA.add hiC, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_add hiA hiC, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_exponentialMix b hbpos, integral_exponentialMix_div_sqrt b hbpos, mul_one]
  have hfrac : b / (1 + b) ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one (by positivity : 0 < 1 + b)).mpr
    linarith
  calc
    A + C * (b * sqrt π) = A + (B * H * sqrt π) * (b / (1 + b)) := by
      dsimp only [C]
      ring
    _ ≤ A + (B * H * sqrt π) * 1 :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac (by positivity))
    _ = A + B * H * sqrt π := by rw [mul_one]

name: SVW.integrable_gaussianWindow_sub_left
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianWindow_sub_left (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun q => gaussianWindow d (y - q)) volume
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using ((integrable_gaussianWindow d).comp_add_left y).comp_neg

name: SVW.integral_gaussianWindow_sub_left
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianWindow_sub_left (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ q, gaussianWindow d (y - q)) = ∫ q, gaussianWindow d q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [integral_neg_eq_self (fun q => gaussianWindow d (y + q)) volume, integral_add_left_eq_self]

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_gradient_majorant_integrable_and_mass_le
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_gradient_majorant_integrable_and_mass_le
    (d : ℕ) (A B H : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun p : Space d × ℝ => gaussianWindow d (y - p.1) * exponentialMix ‖p.1‖ p.2 *
      (A + (B / (1 + ‖p.1‖)) * (H / sqrt p.2)))
      (volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))) ∧
    (∫ q : Space d, ∫ t in Ioi 0, gaussianWindow d (y - q) * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t *
      (A + (B / (1 + ‖q‖)) * (H / sqrt t))) ≤
      (∫ x : Space d, gaussianWindow d x) * (A + B * H * sqrt π)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Ioi 0)
  let F : Space d × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => gaussianWindow d (y - p.1) * exponentialMix ‖p.1‖ p.2 *
    (A + (B / (1 + ‖p.1‖)) * (H / sqrt p.2))
  have hF0 (p : Space d × ℝ) : 0 ≤ F p := by
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (gaussianWindow_pos d _).le (exponentialMix_nonneg _ _))
      (add_nonneg hA (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hB (by positivity)) (div_nonneg hH (sqrt_nonneg _))))
  have hFnorm (p : Space d × ℝ) : ‖F p‖ = F p := Real.norm_of_nonneg (hF0 p)
  have hFm : AEStronglyMeasurable F (volume.prod τ) := by
    apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold F gaussianWindow exponentialMix gaussian
    fun_prop
  have hsection (q : Space d) : Integrable (fun t => F (q, t)) τ ∧
      (∫ t, F (q, t) ∂τ) ≤ gaussianWindow d (y - q) * (A + B * H * sqrt π) := by
    obtain ⟨hi, hv⟩ := exponentialMix_gradient_integrable_and_integral_le
      ‖q‖ A B H (norm_nonneg _) hA hB hH
    constructor
    · simpa only [F, mul_assoc] using hi.const_mul (gaussianWindow d (y - q))
    · have heq : (∫ t, F (q, t) ∂τ) = gaussianWindow d (y - q) *
          ∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix ‖q‖ t * (A + (B / (1 + ‖q‖)) * (H / sqrt t)) := by
        simp only [F, τ, mul_assoc, integral_const_mul]
      rw [heq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (gaussianWindow_pos d _).le
  have hG : Integrable (fun q : Space d => gaussianWindow d (y - q) * (A + B * H * sqrt π)) volume :=
    (integrable_gaussianWindow_sub_left d y).mul_const _
  have houter : Integrable (fun q : Space d => ∫ t, ‖F (q, t)‖ ∂τ) volume := by
    apply hG.mono' hFm.norm.integral_prod_right'
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      have hI0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t, F (q, t) ∂τ := integral_nonneg (fun t => hF0 (q, t))
      simpa only [hFnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hI0] using (hsection q).2
  have hFi : Integrable F (volume.prod τ) :=
    (integrable_prod_iff hFm).mpr ⟨Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun q => (hsection q).1), houter⟩
  refine ⟨hFi, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ q : Space d, ∫ t, F (q, t) ∂τ) ≤
        ∫ q : Space d, gaussianWindow d (y - q) * (A + B * H * sqrt π) :=
      integral_mono_ae hFi.integral_prod_left hG (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => (hsection q).2)
    _ = (∫ x : Space d, gaussianWindow d x) * (A + B * H * sqrt π) := by
      rw [integral_mul_const, integral_gaussianWindow_sub_left d y]

name: SVW.integrable_heatRowGradientUpper
statement:
theorem integrable_heatRowGradientUpper (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun p : Space d × ℝ => heatRowGradientUpper d p.2 y p.1)
      (volume.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (gaussianWindow_gradient_majorant_integrable_and_mass_le d
    (windowDerivativeConstant d) (windowWeightConstant d) (heatGradientConstant d)
    (by unfold windowDerivativeConstant; positivity)
    (by unfold windowWeightConstant; positivity)
    (by unfold heatGradientConstant; positivity) y).1

name: SVW.integral_heatRowGradientUpper_le
statement:
theorem integral_heatRowGradientUpper_le (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ q : Space d, ∫ t in Ioi 0, heatRowGradientUpper d t y q) ≤
      rowGradientConstant d
proof:
:= by
  have h := (gaussianWindow_gradient_majorant_integrable_and_mass_le d
    (windowDerivativeConstant d) (windowWeightConstant d) (heatGradientConstant d)
    (by unfold windowDerivativeConstant; positivity)
    (by unfold windowWeightConstant; positivity)
    (by unfold heatGradientConstant; positivity) y).2
  simpa only [heatRowGradientUpper, rowGradientConstant, resolventGradientConstant, mul_assoc] using h

name: SVW.integral_heatRowGradientUpper_swap_le
statement:
theorem integral_heatRowGradientUpper_swap_le (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ q : Space d, heatRowGradientUpper d t y q) ≤
      rowGradientConstant d
proof:
:= by
  have hs := integral_integral_swap (f := fun q t => heatRowGradientUpper d t y q)
    (integrable_heatRowGradientUpper d y)
  rw [← hs]
  exact integral_heatRowGradientUpper_le d y

name: SVW.integrable_heatRowGradientUpper_swap
statement:
theorem integrable_heatRowGradientUpper_swap (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Space d => heatRowGradientUpper d p.1 y p.2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_heatRowGradientUpper d y).swap

name: SVW.lintegral_heatRowGradientUpper_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_heatRowGradientUpper_le (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ q : Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowGradientUpper d t y q)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (rowGradientConstant d)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_heatRowGradientUpper_swap d y
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Space d =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatRowGradientUpper d p.1 y p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod volume) := by
    exact hi.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal
  rw [← lintegral_prod _ hm, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => heatRowGradientUpper_nonneg d p.1 y p.2),
    integral_prod _ hi]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (integral_heatRowGradientUpper_swap_le d y)

name: SVW.fourier_modulation_function
statement:
theorem fourier_modulation_function (d : ℕ) (h : Space d → ℂ) (y z : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun p => Complex.exp ((2 * π * inner ℝ p y : ℝ) * Complex.I) * h p) z =
      𝓕 h (z - y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq', Real.fourier_eq']
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with p
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  simp only [inner_sub_right]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: SVW.fourier_gaussian_eq_heatDensity
statement:
theorem fourier_gaussian_eq_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (x : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ)) x = (heatDensity d t x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_real_gaussian d t ht]
  simp only [heatDensity, gaussian, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  congr 2
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_heatFrequencyTest
statement:
theorem integrable_heatFrequencyTest (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (heatFrequencyTest d t y) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Integrable (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ)) volume :=
    (integrable_gaussian d t ht).ofReal
  apply hg.mono
  · unfold heatFrequencyTest gaussian
    fun_prop
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => by simp [heatFrequencyTest, Complex.norm_exp]

name: SVW.fourier_heatFrequencyTest
statement:
theorem fourier_heatFrequencyTest (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y z : Space d) :
    𝓕 (heatFrequencyTest d t y) z = (heatDensity d t (y - z) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatFrequencyTest
  rw [fourier_modulation_function, fourier_gaussian_eq_heatDensity d t ht]
  simp only [heatDensity, gaussian, norm_sub_rev z y]

name: SVW.inverseFourier_gaussian_mul_fourier
statement:
theorem inverseFourier_gaussian_mul_fourier (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h : Space d → ℂ) (hh : Integrable h volume) (y : Space d) :
    𝓕⁻ (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p) y =
      ∫ z, (heatDensity d t (y - z) : ℂ) * h z
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (∫ z, 𝓕 (heatFrequencyTest d t y) z * h z) =
      ∫ p, heatFrequencyTest d t y p * 𝓕 h p := by
    simpa using!
      VectorFourier.integral_fourierIntegral_smul_eq_flip
        (L := innerₗ (Space d)) Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner
        (integrable_heatFrequencyTest d t ht y) hh
  rw [Real.fourierInv_eq']
  calc
    (∫ p, Complex.exp ((2 * π * inner ℝ p y : ℝ) * Complex.I) •
      ((gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p)) =
        ∫ p, heatFrequencyTest d t y p * 𝓕 h p := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with p
      simp only [heatFrequencyTest, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = ∫ z, 𝓕 (heatFrequencyTest d t y) z * h z := hs.symm
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [fourier_heatFrequencyTest d t ht]

name: SVW.continuous_fourier_of_integrable
statement:
theorem continuous_fourier_of_integrable (d : ℕ) (h : Space d → ℂ)
    (hh : Integrable h volume) : Continuous (𝓕 h)
proof:
:=
  VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner hh

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian_mul_fourier
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_mul_fourier (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h : Space d → ℂ) (hh : Integrable h volume) :
    Integrable (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖h x‖ := integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg (h x)
  have hi : Integrable (fun p => gaussian d t p * (∫ x, ‖h x‖)) volume :=
    (integrable_gaussian d t ht).mul_const _
  apply hi.mono
  · have hg : Continuous (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ)) := by unfold gaussian; fun_prop
    exact (hg.mul (continuous_fourier_of_integrable d h hh)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (gaussian_pos d t p).le,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (gaussian_pos d t p).le hC)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (VectorFourier.norm_fourierIntegral_le_integral_norm Real.fourierChar volume
          (innerₗ (Space d)) h p) (gaussian_pos d t p).le

name: SVW.heatDensity_le_prefactor
statement:
theorem heatDensity_le_prefactor (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (x : Space d) :
    heatDensity d t x ≤ (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : gaussian d (π ^ 2 / t) x ≤ 1 := by
    rw [gaussian, exp_le_one_iff]
    have hp : 0 ≤ π ^ 2 / t := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) ht.le
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hp) (sq_nonneg _)
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg pi_pos.le ht.le) _)).trans_eq (mul_one _)

name: SVW.integrable_heat_convolution_slice
statement:
theorem integrable_heat_convolution_slice (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h : Space d → ℂ) (hh : Integrable h volume) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun z => (heatDensity d t (y - z) : ℂ) * h z) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) := rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg pi_pos.le ht.le) _
  have hi : Integrable (fun z => (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * ‖h z‖) volume :=
    hh.norm.const_mul _
  apply hi.mono
  · have hk : Continuous (fun z => (heatDensity d t (y - z) : ℂ)) := by
      unfold heatDensity gaussian
      fun_prop
    exact hk.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hh.aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (heatDensity_pos d t ht (y-z)).le,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC (norm_nonneg _))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (heatDensity_le_prefactor d t ht (y-z)) (norm_nonneg _)

name: SVW.integrable_heat_kernel_pairing
statement:
theorem integrable_heat_kernel_pairing (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h : Space d → ℂ) (hh : Integrable h volume) :
    Integrable (fun yz : Space d × Space d =>
      (heatDensity d t (yz.1-yz.2) : ℂ) * inner ℂ (h yz.1) (h yz.2))
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 ≤ (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) := rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg pi_pos.le ht.le) _
  have hi : Integrable (fun yz : Space d × Space d =>
      (π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (‖h yz.1‖ * ‖h yz.2‖))
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))) :=
    (hh.norm.mul_prod hh.norm).const_mul _
  apply hi.mono
  · have hk : Continuous (fun yz : Space d × Space d =>
        (heatDensity d t (yz.1-yz.2) : ℂ)) := by unfold heatDensity gaussian; fun_prop
    exact hk.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      (hh.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_fst.inner (𝕜 := ℂ) hh.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_snd)
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun yz => by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (heatDensity_pos d t ht (yz.1-yz.2)).le,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))]
      exact mul_le_mul (heatDensity_le_prefactor d t ht (yz.1-yz.2))
        (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) _ _) (norm_nonneg _) hC

name: SVW.heat_kernel_quadratic_pairing
statement:
theorem heat_kernel_quadratic_pairing (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h : Space d → ℂ) (hh : Integrable h volume) :
    (∫ p, (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * (‖𝓕 h p‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) =
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d,
        (heatDensity d t (yz.1-yz.2) : ℂ) * inner ℂ (h yz.1) (h yz.2)
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (∫ p, inner ℂ (𝓕 h p) ((gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p)) =
      ∫ y, inner ℂ (h y) (𝓕⁻ (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p) y) := by
    simpa using! VectorFourier.integral_sesq_fourierIntegral_eq_neg_flip (innerSL ℂ)
      (L := innerₗ (Space d)) Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner hh
      (integrable_gaussian_mul_fourier d t ht h hh)
  have hleft : (∫ p, (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * (‖𝓕 h p‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) =
      ∫ p, inner ℂ (𝓕 h p) ((gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with p
    change (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * (‖𝓕 h p‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) =
      inner ℂ (𝓕 h p) ((gaussian d t p : ℂ) • 𝓕 h p)
    rw [inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
    norm_cast
    simp
  rw [hleft, hs]
  calc
    (∫ y, inner ℂ (h y) (𝓕⁻ (fun p => (gaussian d t p : ℂ) * 𝓕 h p) y)) =
        ∫ y, ∫ z, (heatDensity d t (y-z) : ℂ) * inner ℂ (h y) (h z) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with y
      rw [inverseFourier_gaussian_mul_fourier d t ht h hh]
      have hi : (∫ z, inner ℂ (h y) ((heatDensity d t (y-z) : ℂ) * h z)) =
          inner ℂ (h y) (∫ z, (heatDensity d t (y-z) : ℂ) * h z) :=
        (innerSL ℂ (h y)).integral_comp_comm (integrable_heat_convolution_slice d t ht h hh y)
      rw [← hi]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with z
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
        (inner_smul_right (𝕜 := ℂ) (h y) (h z) (r := (heatDensity d t (y-z) : ℂ)))
    _ = _ := integral_integral (integrable_heat_kernel_pairing d t ht h hh)

name: SVW.integrable_gaussianLocalized
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianLocalized (d : ℕ) (q : Space d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    Integrable (gaussianLocalized d q f) volume
proof:
:= by
  change Integrable (fun x => (gaussianWindow d (x-q) : ℂ) * f x) volume
  have hi := integrable_gaussianWavePacket_integrand d f q (0 : Space d)
  simpa only [inner_zero_right, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero,
    one_mul] using hi

name: SVW.gaussianCoefficient_integral
statement:
theorem gaussianCoefficient_integral (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) q p =
      ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * π * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        gaussianLocalized d q f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacketCoefficient_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_sub_right (volume : Measure (Space d)) q).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (gaussianL2Window_coe d)] with x hx
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hx
  rw [hx]
  simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, gaussianLocalized]

name: SVW.gaussianCoefficient_fourier
statement:
theorem gaussianCoefficient_fourier (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) q p =
      wavePacketPhase d q p * 𝓕 (gaussianLocalized d q f) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianCoefficient_integral, Real.fourier_eq', ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  simp only [wavePacketPhase, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  simp only [inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: SVW.gaussianCoefficient_norm_fourier
statement:
theorem gaussianCoefficient_norm_fourier (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    ‖wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) q p‖ =
      ‖𝓕 (gaussianLocalized d q f) p‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianCoefficient_fourier, norm_mul, norm_wavePacketPhase, one_mul]

name: SVW.gaussian_coefficient_heat_pairing
statement:
theorem gaussian_coefficient_heat_pairing (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (q : Space d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ p, (gaussian d t p : ℂ) *
      (‖wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) q p‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) =
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d,
        ((gaussianWindow d (yz.1-q) * gaussianWindow d (yz.2-q) *
          heatDensity d t (yz.1-yz.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [gaussianCoefficient_norm_fourier]
  rw [heat_kernel_quadratic_pairing d t ht (gaussianLocalized d q f)
    (integrable_gaussianLocalized d q f)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with yz
  simp only [gaussianLocalized, RCLike.inner_apply', map_mul,
    Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.translateSchwartz_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem translateSchwartz_apply (d : ℕ) (q x : Space d) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    translateSchwartz d q f x = f (x - q)
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.fourier_translateSchwartz
statement:
theorem fourier_translateSchwartz (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    𝓕 (translateSchwartz d q f) p =
      Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ q p : ℝ) * Complex.I) * 𝓕 f p
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_comp_add_right
    Real.fourierChar volume (innerₗ (Space d)) (f : Space d → ℂ) (-q)) p
  change (𝓕 (translateSchwartz d q f)) p =
    Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (-q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) * 𝓕 f p at h
  convert h using 2
  congr 1
  simp only [inner_neg_left]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.fourier_modulateSchwartz
statement:
@[simp] theorem fourier_modulateSchwartz (d : ℕ) (p : Space d) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    𝓕 (modulateSchwartz d p f) = translateSchwartz d p (𝓕 f)
proof:
:= by
  simp [modulateSchwartz]

name: SVW.modulateSchwartz_apply
statement:
theorem modulateSchwartz_apply (d : ℕ) (p x : Space d) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    modulateSchwartz d p f x =
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ p x : ℝ) * Complex.I) * f x
proof:
:= by
  change 𝓕 (translateSchwartz d p (𝓕 f)) (-x) = _
  rw [fourier_translateSchwartz]
  have h : 𝓕 (𝓕 f) (-x) = f x := by
    have hi : (𝓕⁻ (𝓕 f) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) = f := by simp
    simpa only [SchwartzMap.fourierInv_apply_eq,
      SchwartzMap.compCLMOfContinuousLinearEquiv_apply, Function.comp_apply,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_neg, LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv] using
      congrArg (fun k : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ) => k x) hi
  rw [h]
  congr 2
  simp only [inner_neg_right]
  ring_nf

name: SVW.weylSchwartz_apply
statement:
theorem weylSchwartz_apply (d : ℕ) (q p x : Space d) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    weylSchwartz d q p f x =
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        f (x - q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weylSchwartz, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, modulateSchwartz_apply,
    translateSchwartz_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  rw [real_inner_comm x p]
  simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.fourier_weylSchwartz
statement:
theorem fourier_weylSchwartz (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    𝓕 (weylSchwartz d q p f) = weylSchwartz d p (-q) (𝓕 f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [weylSchwartz, FourierTransform.fourier_smul, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    fourier_modulateSchwartz, translateSchwartz_apply, fourier_translateSchwartz,
    modulateSchwartz_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  simp only [inner_sub_right, inner_neg_right, inner_neg_left, real_inner_comm p q]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.wavePacket_eq_integral_inner_weyl
statement:
theorem wavePacket_eq_integral_inner_weyl (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ))
    (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d f g q p = ∫ x, inner ℂ (weylSchwartz d q p g x) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacket_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [weylSchwartz_apply, RCLike.inner_apply']
  simp only [map_mul, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    Complex.conj_I, ← mul_assoc]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: SVW.wavePacket_fourier_covariance
statement:
theorem wavePacket_fourier_covariance (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d (𝓕 f) (𝓕 g) q p = wavePacket d f g (-p) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacket_eq_integral_inner_weyl, wavePacket_eq_integral_inner_weyl]
  have h : weylSchwartz d q p (𝓕 g) = 𝓕 (weylSchwartz d (-p) q g) := by
    simp only [fourier_weylSchwartz, neg_neg]
  rw [h, SchwartzMap.integral_inner_fourier_fourier]

name: SVW.phaseRotation_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem phaseRotation_measurePreserving (d : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (phaseRotation d)
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  exact ((LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ (E := Space d)).measurePreserving.prod
    (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (Space d)))).comp Measure.measurePreserving_swap

name: SVW.phaseRotationIsometry_coe
statement:
theorem phaseRotationIsometry_coe (d : ℕ) (F : PhaseHilbert d) :
    phaseRotationIsometry d F =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod
      (volume : Measure (Space d))] fun z => F (phaseRotation d z)
proof:
:=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving F (phaseRotation_measurePreserving d)

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_fourier_covariance
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_fourier_covariance (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzLp d (𝓕 f) (𝓕 g) =
      phaseRotationIsometry d (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d (𝓕 f) (𝓕 g),
    phaseRotationIsometry_coe d (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g),
    (phaseRotation_measurePreserving d).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f g)] with z h₁ h₂ h₃
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  exact wavePacket_fourier_covariance d f g z.1 z.2

name: SVW.wavePacketL2_fourier_covariance
statement:
theorem wavePacketL2_fourier_covariance (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    wavePacketWindowCLM d (fourier d g) (fourier d f) =
      phaseRotationIsometry d (wavePacketWindowCLM d g f)
proof:
:= by
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on g
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro g₀
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on f
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro f₀
  change wavePacketWindowCLM d (𝓕 (g₀.toLp 2)) (𝓕 (f₀.toLp 2)) =
    phaseRotationIsometry d (wavePacketWindowCLM d (g₀.toLp 2) (f₀.toLp 2))
  rw [SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq, SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq]
  exact (wavePacketL2_apply_schwartz d (𝓕 f₀) (𝓕 g₀)).trans
    ((wavePacketSchwartzLp_fourier_covariance d f₀ g₀).trans
      (congrArg (phaseRotationIsometry d) (wavePacketL2_apply_schwartz d f₀ g₀).symm))

name: SVW.fourierL2_eq_of_integrable
statement:
theorem fourierL2_eq_of_integrable (d : ℕ) (f h : Hilbert d)
    (hf : Integrable (f : Space d → ℂ) volume)
    (hh : 𝓕 (f : Space d → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] (h : Space d → ℂ)) :
    fourier d f = h
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℂ
  intro v
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on v
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro v₀
  have hpl : inner ℂ (fourier d f) (v₀.toLp 2) =
      inner ℂ f ((𝓕⁻ v₀).toLp 2) := by
    have hi : fourier d ((𝓕⁻ v₀).toLp 2) = v₀.toLp 2 := by
      change (𝓕 ((𝓕⁻ v₀).toLp 2) : Hilbert d) = _
      rw [SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq]
      have hi₀ : (𝓕 (𝓕⁻ v₀) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) = v₀ := by simp
      rw [hi₀]
    rw [← hi]
    exact (fourier d).inner_map_map f ((𝓕⁻ v₀).toLp 2)
  have hs : (∫ x, inner ℂ (𝓕 (f : Space d → ℂ) x) (v₀ x)) =
      ∫ x, inner ℂ (f x) (𝓕⁻ v₀ x) := by
    simpa [SchwartzMap.fourierInv_coe] using!
      VectorFourier.integral_sesq_fourierIntegral_eq_neg_flip (innerSL ℂ)
        (L := innerₗ (Space d)) Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner hf v₀.integrable
  rw [schwartzToL2_apply, hpl, L2.inner_def, L2.inner_def]
  calc
    (∫ x, inner ℂ (f x) ((𝓕⁻ v₀).toLp 2 volume x)) =
        ∫ x, inner ℂ (f x) (𝓕⁻ v₀ x) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(𝓕⁻ v₀).coeFn_toLp 2 volume] with x hx
      rw [hx]
    _ = ∫ x, inner ℂ (𝓕 (f : Space d → ℂ) x) (v₀ x) := hs.symm
    _ = ∫ x, inner ℂ (h x) (v₀.toLp 2 volume x) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hh, v₀.coeFn_toLp 2 volume] with x hx hv
      rw [hx, hv]

name: SVW.fourier_function_const_mul
statement:
theorem fourier_function_const_mul (d : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (f : Space d → ℂ) (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun x => c * f x) p = c * 𝓕 f p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq', Real.fourier_eq', ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.fourier_gaussianWindow
statement:
theorem fourier_gaussianWindow (d : ℕ) (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun x => (gaussianWindow d x : ℂ)) p = (gaussianWindow d p : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianWindow, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rw [fourier_function_const_mul, fourier_real_gaussian d Real.pi Real.pi_pos]
  simp only [div_self Real.pi_ne_zero, Real.one_rpow, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
  congr 2
  change Real.exp (-Real.pi ^ 2 * ‖p‖ ^ 2 / Real.pi) =
    Real.exp (-Real.pi * ‖p‖ ^ 2)
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: SVW.fourier_gaussianL2Window
statement:
theorem fourier_gaussianL2Window (d : ℕ) :
    fourier d (gaussianL2Window d) = gaussianL2Window d
proof:
:= by
  apply fourierL2_eq_of_integrable
  · exact (integrable_gaussianWindow d).ofReal.congr (gaussianL2Window_coe d).symm
  · filter_upwards [gaussianL2Window_coe d] with p hp
    rw [Real.fourier_congr_ae (gaussianL2Window_coe d), fourier_gaussianWindow, hp]

name: SVW.gaussianWavePacket_fourier_covariance
statement:
theorem gaussianWavePacket_fourier_covariance (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    gaussianWavePacketIsometry d (fourier d f) =
      phaseRotationIsometry d (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := wavePacketL2_fourier_covariance d f (gaussianL2Window d)
  rw [fourier_gaussianL2Window] at h
  exact h

:=
  antiWickCompression_nonneg (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d) _ _ _ _

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_le_one

:=
  antiWickCompression_le_one (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d) _ _ _ _

name: SVW.separatorSymbol_rotation_ae
statement:
theorem separatorSymbol_rotation_ae (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      separatorSymbol d (phaseRotation d z).1 (phaseRotation d z).2 =
        1 - separatorSymbol d z.1 z.2
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero d := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hd⟩
  have hn : ∀ᵐ z ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      z ≠ 0 := by simp [ae_iff]
  filter_upwards [hn] with z hz
  have hz' : z.1 ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hz (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)
  have h := separatorSymbol_complement d z.1 z.2 hz'
  simpa only [phaseRotation, separatorSymbol, norm_neg] using h

name: SVW.separator_operator_rotation
statement:
theorem separator_operator_rotation (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (u : PhaseHilbert d) :
    (separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator (phaseRotationIsometry d u) =
      phaseRotationIsometry d (u - (separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator u)
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator_coe (phaseRotationIsometry d u),
    phaseRotationIsometry_coe d u,
    phaseRotationIsometry_coe d (u - (separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator u),
    (phaseRotation_measurePreserving d).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (Lp.coeFn_sub u ((separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator u)),
    (phaseRotation_measurePreserving d).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      ((separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator_coe u), separatorSymbol_rotation_ae d hd]
      with z h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅ h₆
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.sub_apply] at h₄ h₅
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅]
  change (separatorSymbol d z.1 z.2 : ℂ) * u (phaseRotation d z) =
    u (phaseRotation d z) -
      (separatorSymbol d (phaseRotation d z).1 (phaseRotation d z).2 : ℂ) *
        u (phaseRotation d z)
  rw [h₆]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_inner
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_inner (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) g =
      inner ℂ ((separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f))
        (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d g)
proof:
:= by
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left
    (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d).toContinuousLinearMap g
      ((separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f))

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_fourier_inner
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_fourier_inner (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d (fourier d f)) (fourier d g) =
      inner ℂ f g - inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianSeparator_inner, gaussianWavePacket_fourier_covariance,
    gaussianWavePacket_fourier_covariance, separator_operator_rotation d hd,
    (phaseRotationIsometry d).inner_map_map, inner_sub_left,
    (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d).inner_map_map, ← gaussianSeparator_inner]

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_fourier_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_fourier_apply (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    gaussianSeparator d (fourier d f) = fourier d (f - gaussianSeparator d f)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℂ
  intro v
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := (fourier d).surjective v
  rw [gaussianSeparator_fourier_inner d hd, (fourier d).inner_map_map, inner_sub_left]

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_fourier_complement
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_fourier_complement (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (fourier d : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d).comp
      ((gaussianSeparator d).comp ((fourier d).symm : Hilbert d →L[ℂ] Hilbert d)) =
        1 - gaussianSeparator d
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  have h := gaussianSeparator_fourier_apply d hd ((fourier d).symm f)
  rw [(fourier d).apply_symm_apply, map_sub, (fourier d).apply_symm_apply] at h
  change fourier d (gaussianSeparator d ((fourier d).symm f)) = f - gaussianSeparator d f
  rw [h]
  abel

proof:

name: SVW.positiveKernelENN_symmetric
statement:
theorem positiveKernelENN_symmetric (d : ℕ) (y z : Space d) :
    positiveKernelENN d y z = positiveKernelENN d z y
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveKernelENN
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro t
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro q

name: SVW.heatRowMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatRowMass_nonneg (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ heatRowMass d y t
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg (fun q => integral_nonneg (fun z => heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q z))

name: SVW.heatRowMass_rescale
statement:
theorem heatRowMass_rescale (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    heatRowMass d y (π*s) = (1/π)*rowHeatIntegrand d (π*‖y‖^2) s
proof:
:= by
  have h := heatRowIntegrand_rescaled_eq_rowHeatIntegrand d s hs y
  change π*heatRowMass d y (π*s) = _ at h
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ pi_pos.ne')
  calc
    π * heatRowMass d y (π*s) = rowHeatIntegrand d (π*‖y‖^2) s := h
    _ = π*((1/π)*rowHeatIntegrand d (π*‖y‖^2) s) := by field_simp

name: SVW.integrable_heatRowMass
statement:
theorem integrable_heatRowMass (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    IntegrableOn (heatRowMass d y) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IntegrableOn (fun s => heatRowMass d y (π*s)) (Ioi 0) volume := by
    apply ((integrable_rowHeatIntegrand d hd (π*‖y‖^2) (by positivity)).const_mul (1/π)).congr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
    exact (heatRowMass_rescale d y s hs).symm
  simpa only [mul_zero] using (integrableOn_Ioi_comp_mul_left_iff (heatRowMass d y) 0 pi_pos).mp hs

name: SVW.integral_heatRowMass_le_one
statement:
theorem integral_heatRowMass_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, heatRowMass d y t) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∫ s in Ioi 0, heatRowMass d y (π*s)) =
      (1/π)*(∫ s in Ioi 0, rowHeatIntegrand d (π*‖y‖^2) s) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
    exact heatRowMass_rescale d y s hs
  rw [integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (heatRowMass d y) 0 pi_pos] at he
  simp only [mul_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_div] at he
  have he' : (∫ t in Ioi 0, heatRowMass d y t) =
      ∫ s in Ioi 0, rowHeatIntegrand d (π*‖y‖^2) s :=
    (mul_left_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero pi_pos.ne')) he
  rw [he']
  exact integral_rowHeatIntegrand_le_one d hd _ (by positivity)

name: SVW.lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row
statement:
theorem lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ z : Space d, positiveKernelENN d y z) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in Ioi 0, heatRowMass d y t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveKernelENN
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
  · rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_heatRowMass d hd y)
      (by filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
          exact heatRowMass_nonneg d y t ht)]
    apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
    · unfold heatRowMass
      rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
        (heatRowIntegrand_iterated_integrable_and_integral d t ht y).1
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => integral_nonneg
          (fun z => heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q z))]
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro q
      exact (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
        (heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable d t ht y q)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q z)).symm
    · apply Measurable.aemeasurable
      unfold Function.uncurry heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
      fun_prop
  · apply Measurable.aemeasurable
    apply Measurable.lintegral_prod_right
    unfold Function.uncurry heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
    fun_prop

name: SVW.lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one
statement:
theorem lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ z : Space d, positiveKernelENN d y z) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row d hd y]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (integral_heatRowMass_le_one d hd y)).trans_eq
    ENNReal.ofReal_one

name: SVW.measurable_positiveKernelENN_row
statement:
theorem measurable_positiveKernelENN_row (d : ℕ) (y : Space d) :
    Measurable (positiveKernelENN d y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.lintegral_prod_right
  apply Measurable.lintegral_prod_right
  unfold heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
  fun_prop

name: SVW.positiveKernelENN_row_ae_finite
statement:
theorem positiveKernelENN_row_ae_finite (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)), positiveKernelENN d y z < ∞
proof:
:=
  ae_lt_top (measurable_positiveKernelENN_row d y)
    (ne_of_lt ((lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one d hd y).trans_lt ENNReal.one_lt_top))

name: SVW.integrable_positiveKernel_row
statement:
theorem integrable_positiveKernel_row (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (positiveKernel d y) volume
proof:
:=
  integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top (measurable_positiveKernelENN_row d y).aemeasurable
    (ne_of_lt ((lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one d hd y).trans_lt ENNReal.one_lt_top))

name: SVW.positiveKernel_ofReal_ae
statement:
theorem positiveKernel_ofReal_ae (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (positiveKernel d y z)) =ᵐ[volume] positiveKernelENN d y
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [positiveKernelENN_row_ae_finite d hd y] with z hz
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hz.ne

name: SVW.integral_positiveKernel_row_le_one
statement:
theorem integral_positiveKernel_row_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ z : Space d, positiveKernel d y z) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveKernel
  rw [integral_toReal (measurable_positiveKernelENN_row d y).aemeasurable
    (positiveKernelENN_row_ae_finite d hd y)]
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top
    (lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one d hd y)).trans_eq ENNReal.toReal_one

name: SVW.heatRowGradientUpper_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatRowGradientUpper_nonneg (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y q : Space d) :
    0 ≤ heatRowGradientUpper d t y q
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatRowGradientUpper windowDerivativeConstant windowWeightConstant heatGradientConstant
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (gaussianWindow_pos d (y-q)).le
    (exponentialMix_nonneg ‖q‖ t)) (by positivity)

name: SVW.contDiff_gaussian
statement: theorem contDiff_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (gaussian d b)
proof:
:= by
  exact (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).exp

name: SVW.contDiff_gaussianWindow
statement: theorem contDiff_gaussianWindow (d : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (gaussianWindow d)
proof:
:=
  contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_gaussian d π)

name: SVW.contDiff_heatDensity
statement: theorem contDiff_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (heatDensity d t)
proof:
:=
  contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_gaussian d (π^2/t))

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_reciprocal_weight
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_reciprocal_weight (d : ℕ) (q z : Space d) :
    gaussianWindow d (z-q) / (1+‖z‖) ≤ windowWeightConstant d / (1+‖q‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ‖q‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖z-q‖ := by
    calc
      ‖q‖ = ‖z - (z-q)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖z-q‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
  have hw : 1+‖q‖ ≤ (1+‖z‖)*(1+‖z-q‖) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) (norm_nonneg (z-q))]
  have hg := gaussianWindow_weighted_bound d (z-q)
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw (gaussianWindow_pos d (z-q)).le
  have hh' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+‖z‖)
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 1+‖z‖) (by positivity : 0 < 1+‖q‖)).mpr
  dsimp [windowWeightConstant]
  nlinarith

name: SVW.heatDensity_sub_symmetric
statement:
theorem heatDensity_sub_symmetric (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y z : Space d) :
    heatDensity d t (y-z) = heatDensity d t (z-y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatDensity gaussian
  rw [norm_sub_rev]

name: SVW.contDiff_heatRowIntegrand_row
statement:
theorem contDiff_heatRowIntegrand_row (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y q : Space d) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (heatRowIntegrand d t y q)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : Space d => gaussianWindow d (z-q)) :=
    (contDiff_gaussianWindow d).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : Space d => heatDensity d t (y-z)) :=
    (contDiff_heatDensity d t).comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
  convert! ((contDiff_const.mul hg).mul contDiff_const).mul hh using 1

name: SVW.norm_fderiv_real_mul_le
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_real_mul_le
    (d : ℕ) (f g : Space d → ℝ) (x : Space d)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => f z * g z) x‖ ≤
      ‖f x‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ + ‖g x‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖
proof:
:= by
  have he : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f z * g z) x =
      f x • fderiv ℝ g x + g x • fderiv ℝ f x := by
    convert! (hf.hasFDerivAt.mul hg.hasFDerivAt).fderiv using 1
  rw [he]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans_eq (by rw [norm_smul, norm_smul])

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_gradient_bound
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_gradient_bound
    (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y q z : Space d) :
    weightedDerivativeNorm (heatRowIntegrand d t y q) z ≤
      gaussianWindow d (y-q) * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t *
        (windowDerivativeConstant d * heatDensity d t (y-z) +
          (windowWeightConstant d / (1+‖q‖)) * ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Space d → ℝ := fun w => gaussianWindow d (w-q)
  let g : Space d → ℝ := fun w => heatDensity d t (w-y)
  let c : ℝ := gaussianWindow d (y-q) * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := mul_nonneg (gaussianWindow_pos d (y-q)).le (exponentialMix_nonneg ‖q‖ t)
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ 1 f :=
    (contDiff_gaussianWindow d).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hgc : ContDiff ℝ 1 g :=
    (contDiff_heatDensity d t).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hfd : Differentiable ℝ f := hfc.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hgd : Differentiable ℝ g := hgc.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have he : heatRowIntegrand d t y q = fun w => c * (f w * g w) := by
    funext w
    dsimp [heatRowIntegrand, c, f, g]
    rw [heatDensity_sub_symmetric d t y w]
    ring
  have hn := norm_fderiv_real_mul_le d f g z (hfd z) (hgd z)
  have hfn : ‖f z‖ = gaussianWindow d (z-q) := Real.norm_of_nonneg (gaussianWindow_pos d (z-q)).le
  have hgn : ‖g z‖ = heatDensity d t (y-z) := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (heatDensity_pos d t ht (z-y)).le]
    exact heatDensity_sub_symmetric d t z y
  have hdf : ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ windowDerivativeConstant d := by
    rw [show f = fun w => gaussianWindow d (w-q) from rfl, fderiv_comp_sub]
    exact gaussianWindow_derivative_bound d (z-q)
  have hdg : ‖fderiv ℝ g z‖ = ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖ := by
    rw [show g = fun w => heatDensity d t (w-y) from rfl, fderiv_comp_sub,
      norm_fderiv_heatDensity d t ht, norm_fderiv_heatDensity d t ht, norm_sub_rev z y]
    simp only [gaussian, norm_sub_rev z y]
  rw [hfn, hgn, hdg] at hn
  have hn' : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z‖ ≤
      gaussianWindow d (z-q) * ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖ +
        heatDensity d t (y-z) * windowDerivativeConstant d :=
    hn.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdf (heatDensity_pos d t ht (y-z)).le))
  have hden : 1 ≤ 1+‖z‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hgrad0 : 0 ≤ windowDerivativeConstant d := by unfold windowDerivativeConstant; positivity
  have hterm : heatDensity d t (y-z) * windowDerivativeConstant d / (1+‖z‖) ≤
      heatDensity d t (y-z) * windowDerivativeConstant d :=
    div_le_self (mul_nonneg (heatDensity_pos d t ht (y-z)).le hgrad0) hden
  have hweight := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussianWindow_reciprocal_weight d q z)
    (norm_nonneg (fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)))
  have hsum : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z‖ / (1+‖z‖) ≤
      windowDerivativeConstant d * heatDensity d t (y-z) +
        (windowWeightConstant d / (1+‖q‖)) * ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖ := by
    have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hn' (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+‖z‖)
    rw [add_div] at hh
    have hre : gaussianWindow d (z-q) * ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖ / (1+‖z‖) =
        gaussianWindow d (z-q) / (1+‖z‖) * ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖ := by ring
    rw [hre] at hh
    nlinarith
  rw [he]
  unfold weightedDerivativeNorm
  have hprod : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z := by
    convert! (hfd z).mul (hgd z) using 1
  rw [fderiv_const_mul hprod c, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc,
    mul_div_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hc

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_gradient_integrable_and_mass
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_gradient_integrable_and_mass
    (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y q : Space d) :
    Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm (heatRowIntegrand d t y q)) volume ∧
      (∫ z : Space d, weightedDerivativeNorm (heatRowIntegrand d t y q) z) ≤
        heatRowGradientUpper d t y q
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := gaussianWindow d (y-q) * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t
  let b : ℝ := windowWeightConstant d / (1+‖q‖)
  let major : Space d → ℝ := fun z => c *
    (windowDerivativeConstant d * heatDensity d t (y-z) +
      b * ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) (y-z)‖)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := mul_nonneg (gaussianWindow_pos d (y-q)).le
    (exponentialMix_nonneg ‖q‖ t)
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b, windowWeightConstant]; positivity
  have hhi := (integrable_heatDensity d t ht).comp_sub_left y
  have hgi := (integrable_norm_fderiv_heatDensity d t ht).comp_sub_left y
  have hmi : Integrable major volume :=
    ((hhi.const_mul (windowDerivativeConstant d)).add (hgi.const_mul b)).const_mul c
  have hbound (z : Space d) : weightedDerivativeNorm (heatRowIntegrand d t y q) z ≤ major z :=
    heatRowIntegrand_gradient_bound d t ht y q z
  have hdi : Integrable (weightedDerivativeNorm (heatRowIntegrand d t y q)) volume :=
    hmi.mono_nonneg
      (continuous_weightedDerivativeNorm (Space d) (heatRowIntegrand d t y q)
        (contDiff_heatRowIntegrand_row d t y q)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (weightedDerivativeNorm_nonneg _ _))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)
  refine ⟨hdi, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ z : Space d, weightedDerivativeNorm (heatRowIntegrand d t y q) z) ≤
        ∫ z : Space d, major z := integral_mono hdi hmi hbound
    _ = c * (windowDerivativeConstant d +
        b * (∫ z : Space d, ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) z‖)) := by
      dsimp [major]
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (hhi.const_mul _) (hgi.const_mul _),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_sub_left_eq_self,
        integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun z : Space d => ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) z‖)
          volume y, integral_heatDensity d t ht, mul_one]
    _ ≤ c * (windowDerivativeConstant d + b * (heatGradientConstant d / sqrt t)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (integral_norm_fderiv_heatDensity_le d t ht) hb)) hc
    _ = heatRowGradientUpper d t y q := rfl

name: SVW.gaussian_product_identity
statement:
theorem gaussian_product_identity (d : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (y x : Space d) :
    gaussian d a x * gaussian d b (y - x) =
      exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * shiftedGaussian d (a + b) ((2 * b) • y) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussian, shiftedGaussian, ← exp_add, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_gaussian_product
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_product (d : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun x => gaussian d a x * gaussian d b (y - x)) volume
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussian_product_identity]
  exact (integrable_shiftedGaussian d (a + b) (by positivity) ((2 * b) • y)).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_gaussian_product
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_product (d : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (y : Space d) :
    (∫ x, gaussian d a x * gaussian d b (y - x)) =
      (π / (a + b)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (-(a * b / (a + b)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussian_product_identity]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_shiftedGaussian d (a + b) (by positivity)]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * b)]
  rw [mul_left_comm, ← exp_add]
  congr 2
  field_simp
  ring

name: SVW.gaussian_product_translated_integrable_and_integral
statement:
theorem gaussian_product_translated_integrable_and_integral
    (d : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (q y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun z => gaussian d a (z - q) * gaussian d b (y - z)) volume ∧
    (∫ z, gaussian d a (z - q) * gaussian d b (y - z)) =
      (π / (a + b)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (-(a * b / (a + b)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Space d → ℝ := fun x => gaussian d a x * gaussian d b ((y - q) - x)
  have heq : (fun z => gaussian d a (z - q) * gaussian d b (y - z)) =
      (fun z => f (z + (-q))) := by
    funext z
    dsimp only [f]
    congr 2
    abel
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨(integrable_gaussian_product d a b ha hb (y - q)).comp_add_right (-q), by
    rw [integral_add_right_eq_self]
    exact integral_gaussian_product d a b ha hb (y - q)⟩

name: SVW.gaussian_product_secondMoment_integrable_and_integral
statement:
theorem gaussian_product_secondMoment_integrable_and_integral
    (d : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (gaussian d a x * gaussian d b (y - x))) volume ∧
    (∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (gaussian d a x * gaussian d b (y - x))) =
      (π / (a + b)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp (-(a * b / (a + b)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) *
        ((d : ℝ) / (2 * (a + b)) + b ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (a + b) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (gaussian d a x * gaussian d b (y - x))) =
      (fun x => exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2) *
        (‖x‖ ^ 2 * shiftedGaussian d (a + b) ((2 * b) • y) x)) := by
    funext x
    rw [gaussian_product_identity]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  refine ⟨(integrable_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment d (a + b) (by positivity)
    ((2 * b) • y)).const_mul _, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_shiftedGaussian_secondMoment d (a + b) (by positivity)]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * b)]
  have hcoef : (d : ℝ) / (2 * (a + b)) + (2 * b * ‖y‖) ^ 2 / (4 * (a + b) ^ 2) =
      (d : ℝ) / (2 * (a + b)) + b ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (a + b) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hcoef]
  have he : exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * exp ((2 * b * ‖y‖) ^ 2 / (4 * (a + b))) =
      exp (-(a * b / (a + b)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  calc
    exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2) *
        (((d : ℝ) / (2 * (a + b)) + b ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (a + b) ^ 2) *
          (π / (a + b)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * exp ((2 * b * ‖y‖) ^ 2 / (4 * (a + b)))) =
      (π / (a + b)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
        (exp (-b * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * exp ((2 * b * ‖y‖) ^ 2 / (4 * (a + b)))) *
        ((d : ℝ) / (2 * (a + b)) + b ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (a + b) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he]

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_heatDensity_convolution
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_heatDensity_convolution
    (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (q y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun z => gaussianWindow d (z - q) * heatDensity d t (y - z)) volume ∧
    (∫ z, gaussianWindow d (z - q) * heatDensity d t (y - z)) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * (π / (t + π)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
        exp (-(π ^ 2 / (t + π)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun z => gaussianWindow d (z - q) * heatDensity d t (y - z)) =
      (fun z => ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (gaussian d π (z - q) * gaussian d (π ^ 2 / t) (y - z))) := by
    funext z
    unfold gaussianWindow heatDensity
    ring
  obtain ⟨hi, hv⟩ := gaussian_product_translated_integrable_and_integral
    d π (π ^ 2 / t) pi_pos (by positivity) q y
  rw [heq]
  refine ⟨hi.const_mul _, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_const_mul, hv]
  have hp : (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
      (π / (π + π ^ 2 / t)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) =
      (π / (t + π)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) := by
    rw [← mul_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / t)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (π + π ^ 2 / t))]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have he : π * (π ^ 2 / t) / (π + π ^ 2 / t) = π ^ 2 / (t + π) := by
    field_simp
  rw [he]
  calc
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) *
        ((π / (π + π ^ 2 / t)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
          exp (-(π ^ 2 / (t + π)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2)) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) *
        ((π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) * (π / (π + π ^ 2 / t)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) *
          exp (-(π ^ 2 / (t + π)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hp]

name: SVW.heatRowPrecision_pos
statement: theorem heatRowPrecision_pos (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) : 0 < heatRowPrecision t
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatRowPrecision
  positivity

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_nonneg (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y q z : Space d) :
    0 ≤ heatRowIntegrand d t y q z
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatRowIntegrand
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (gaussianWindow_pos d _).le (gaussianWindow_pos d _).le)
      (exponentialMix_nonneg _ _)) (heatDensity_pos d t ht _).le

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
