    (y q : Space d) : Integrable (heatRowIntegrand d t y q) volume
proof:
:= by
  have heq : heatRowIntegrand d t y q = fun z =>
      (gaussianWindow d (y - q) * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t) *
        (gaussianWindow d (z - q) * heatDensity d t (y - z)) := by
    funext z
    unfold heatRowIntegrand
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact (gaussianWindow_heatDensity_convolution d t ht q y).1.const_mul _

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_inner_integral
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_inner_integral (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (y q : Space d) :
    (∫ z, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) = heatRowCoefficient d t *
      (‖q‖ ^ 2 * (gaussian d t q * gaussian d (heatRowPrecision t) (y - q)))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : heatRowIntegrand d t y q = fun z =>
      (gaussianWindow d (y - q) * exponentialMix ‖q‖ t) *
        (gaussianWindow d (z - q) * heatDensity d t (y - z)) := by
    funext z
    unfold heatRowIntegrand
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_const_mul, (gaussianWindow_heatDensity_convolution d t ht q y).2]
  have hmix : exponentialMix ‖q‖ t = ‖q‖ ^ 2 * gaussian d t q := by
    unfold exponentialMix gaussian
    congr 1
    congr 1
    ring
  have hpref : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) *
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * (π / (t + π)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) =
      heatRowCoefficient d t := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have hd : (d : ℝ) / 4 + (d : ℝ) / 4 = (d : ℝ) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hd, ← mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (t + π))]
    unfold heatRowCoefficient
    congr 1
    ring
  have hgprod : gaussian d π (y - q) *
      exp (-(π ^ 2 / (t + π)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2) =
      gaussian d (heatRowPrecision t) (y - q) := by
    unfold gaussian
    rw [← exp_add]
    congr 1
    unfold heatRowPrecision
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hmix]
  simp only [gaussianWindow]
  calc
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * gaussian d π (y - q) *
        (‖q‖ ^ 2 * gaussian d t q)) *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * (π / (t + π)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
          exp (-(π ^ 2 / (t + π)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2)) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 4) * (π / (t + π)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2))) *
        (‖q‖ ^ 2 * (gaussian d t q * (gaussian d π (y - q) *
          exp (-(π ^ 2 / (t + π)) * ‖y - q‖ ^ 2)))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hpref, hgprod]

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_iterated_integrable_and_integral
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_iterated_integrable_and_integral
    (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun q => ∫ z, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) volume ∧
    (∫ q, ∫ z, heatRowIntegrand d t y q z) =
      heatRowCoefficient d t *
        ((π / (t + heatRowPrecision t)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
          exp (-(t * heatRowPrecision t / (t + heatRowPrecision t)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) *
          ((d : ℝ) / (2 * (t + heatRowPrecision t)) +
            (heatRowPrecision t) ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (t + heatRowPrecision t) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [heatRowIntegrand_inner_integral d t ht y]
  obtain ⟨hi, hv⟩ := gaussian_product_secondMoment_integrable_and_integral
    d t (heatRowPrecision t) ht (heatRowPrecision_pos t ht) y
  exact ⟨hi.const_mul _, by rw [integral_const_mul, hv]⟩

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_integrable
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_integrable (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (y : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun p : Space d × Space d => heatRowIntegrand d t y p.1 p.2)
      (volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : Space d × Space d => heatRowIntegrand d t y p.1 p.2) (volume.prod volume) := by
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
    fun_prop
  apply (integrable_prod_iff hmeas).mpr
  constructor
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => heatRowIntegrand_inner_integrable d t ht y q
  · have hn (q z : Space d) : ‖heatRowIntegrand d t y q z‖ = heatRowIntegrand d t y q z :=
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d t ht y q z)
    simpa only [hn] using (heatRowIntegrand_iterated_integrable_and_integral d t ht y).1

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_rescaled_integral
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_rescaled_integral
    (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (y : Space d) :
    π * (∫ q, ∫ z, heatRowIntegrand d (π * s) y q z) =
      (2 / rowDenom s) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
        exp (-(π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * s * (s + 2) / rowDenom s) *
        ((d : ℝ) * (s + 1) / (2 * rowDenom s) +
          (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (s + 2) ^ 2 / rowDenom s ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 0 < π * s := mul_pos pi_pos hs
  have hCpos : 0 < heatRowPrecision (π * s) := heatRowPrecision_pos (π * s) ht
  have hsp : 0 < s + 1 := by linarith
  have hD : 0 < rowDenom s := rowDenom_pos s
  have hC : heatRowPrecision (π * s) = π * (s + 2) / (s + 1) := by
    unfold heatRowPrecision
    field_simp
  have hA : π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s) = π * rowDenom s / (s + 1) := by
    rw [hC]
    unfold rowDenom
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpref : heatRowCoefficient d (π * s) *
      (π / (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) =
      (2 / rowDenom s) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) := by
    unfold heatRowCoefficient
    rw [← mul_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * π / (π * s + π))
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s)))]
    rw [hA]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  have hexp : exp (-(π * s * heatRowPrecision (π * s) /
      (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) =
      exp (-(π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * s * (s + 2) / rowDenom s) := by
    congr 1
    rw [hA, hC]
    field_simp
  have hcoef : π * ((d : ℝ) / (2 * (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) +
      heatRowPrecision (π * s) ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 / (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s)) ^ 2) =
      (d : ℝ) * (s + 1) / (2 * rowDenom s) +
        (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (s + 2) ^ 2 / rowDenom s ^ 2 := by
    rw [hA, hC]
    field_simp
  rw [(heatRowIntegrand_iterated_integrable_and_integral d (π * s) ht y).2]
  calc
    π * (heatRowCoefficient d (π * s) *
      ((π / (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
        exp (-(π * s * heatRowPrecision (π * s) /
          (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) *
        ((d : ℝ) / (2 * (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) +
          heatRowPrecision (π * s) ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 /
            (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s)) ^ 2))) =
      (heatRowCoefficient d (π * s) *
        (π / (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) *
        exp (-(π * s * heatRowPrecision (π * s) /
          (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) *
        (π * ((d : ℝ) / (2 * (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s))) +
          heatRowPrecision (π * s) ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 /
            (π * s + heatRowPrecision (π * s)) ^ 2)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hpref, hexp, hcoef]

name: SVW.heatRowIntegrand_rescaled_eq_rowHeatIntegrand
statement:
theorem heatRowIntegrand_rescaled_eq_rowHeatIntegrand
    (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (y : Space d) :
    π * (∫ q, ∫ z, heatRowIntegrand d (π * s) y q z) =
      rowHeatIntegrand d (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatRowIntegrand_rescaled_integral d s hs y]
  have hphase : rowPhase s = s * (s + 2) / rowDenom s := by
    unfold rowPhase rowScale rowDenom
    field_simp
    ring
  have hU : rowU d (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) s =
      (2 / rowDenom s) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
        exp (-(π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * s * (s + 2) / rowDenom s) := by
    unfold rowU rowScale
    rw [hphase]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hcoef : (d : ℝ) * (s + 1) / (2 * rowDenom s) +
      (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (s + 2) ^ 2 / rowDenom s ^ 2 =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) * (s + 1) / rowDenom s +
        4 * (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (s + 1) / rowDenom s ^ 2) +
        (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) / rowDenom s := by
    unfold rowDenom
    field_simp
    ring
  unfold rowHeatIntegrand
  rw [(rowU_hasDerivAt d (π * ‖y‖ ^ 2) s).deriv, hU, hcoef]
  ring

name: SVW.conjugateTranslate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateTranslate_apply
    (d : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q x : Space d) :
    conjugateTranslate d g q x = star (g (x - q))
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjugateTranslate]

name: SVW.localizedSchwartz_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedSchwartz_apply
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q x : Space d) :
    localizedSchwartz d f g q x = star (g (x - q)) * f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localizedSchwartz, SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply
    (conjugateTranslate d g q).hasTemperateGrowth, conjugateTranslate_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: SVW.unphasedWavePacket_integral
statement:
theorem unphasedWavePacket_integral
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    unphasedWavePacket d f g q p =
      ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ x p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        (star (g (x - q)) * f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unphasedWavePacket, SchwartzMap.fourier_coe, Real.fourier_eq']
  simp only [localizedSchwartz_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: SVW.wavePacket_slice_energy
statement:
theorem wavePacket_slice_energy
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q : Space d) :
    (∫ p, ‖unphasedWavePacket d f g q p‖ ^ 2) =
      ∫ x, ‖g (x - q)‖ ^ 2 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ p, ‖𝓕 (localizedSchwartz d f g q) p‖ ^ 2) = _
  rw [SchwartzMap.integral_norm_sq_fourier]
  simp only [localizedSchwartz_apply, norm_mul, norm_star, mul_pow]

name: SVW.wavePacket_slice_lintegral
statement:
theorem wavePacket_slice_lintegral
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q : Space d) :
    (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (‖unphasedWavePacket d f g q p‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖g (x - q)‖ ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let h : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ) := localizedSchwartz d f g q
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => ‖h x‖ ^ 2) (volume : Measure (Space d)) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable).mp (h.memLp 2)
  have hfi : Integrable (fun p => ‖𝓕 h p‖ ^ 2) (volume : Measure (Space d)) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (𝓕 h).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable).mp ((𝓕 h).memLp 2)
  change (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (‖𝓕 h p‖ ^ 2)) = _
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => sq_nonneg _)),
    SchwartzMap.integral_norm_sq_fourier,
    ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _))]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp only [h, localizedSchwartz_apply, norm_mul, norm_star, mul_pow,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)]

name: SVW.unphasedWavePacket_stronglyMeasurable
statement:
theorem unphasedWavePacket_stronglyMeasurable
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (fun w : Space d × Space d => unphasedWavePacket d f g w.1 w.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [unphasedWavePacket_integral]
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : (Space d × Space d) × Space d =>
      Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ z.2 z.1.2 : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        (star (g (z.2 - z.1.1)) * f z.2)) := by fun_prop
  exact hc.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'

name: SVW.wavePacket_moyal_lintegral
statement:
theorem wavePacket_moyal_lintegral
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    (∫⁻ w : Space d × Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (‖unphasedWavePacket d f g w.1 w.2‖ ^ 2)
      ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume) =
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2)) * (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖g x‖ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas := (unphasedWavePacket_stronglyMeasurable d f g).measurable
  rw [lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [wavePacket_slice_lintegral]
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by fun_prop)]
  calc
    (∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ q, ENNReal.ofReal (‖g (x - q)‖ ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2)) =
        ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ q, ENNReal.ofReal (‖g (x - q)‖ ^ 2)) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2) := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact lintegral_mul_const _ (by fun_prop)
    _ = ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ q, ENNReal.ofReal (‖g q‖ ^ 2)) * ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2) := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [lintegral_sub_left_eq_self (fun q : Space d => ENNReal.ofReal (‖g q‖ ^ 2)) x]
    _ = (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2)) * (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖g x‖ ^ 2)) := by
      rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (by fun_prop), mul_comm]

name: SVW.norm_wavePacketPhase
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_wavePacketPhase (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    ‖wavePacketPhase d q p‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [wavePacketPhase, Complex.norm_exp]

name: SVW.norm_wavePacket
statement:
@[simp] theorem norm_wavePacket (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    ‖wavePacket d f g q p‖ = ‖unphasedWavePacket d f g q p‖
proof:
:= by
  simp [wavePacket]

name: SVW.wavePacket_integral
statement:
theorem wavePacket_integral
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d f g q p =
      ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        (star (g (x - q)) * f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacket, unphasedWavePacket_integral, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro x
  dsimp only
  rw [wavePacketPhase, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  simp only [inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, Complex.ofReal_sub,
    Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SVW.wavePacket_stronglyMeasurable
statement:
theorem wavePacket_stronglyMeasurable
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (fun w : Space d × Space d => wavePacket d f g w.1 w.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hphase : Continuous (fun w : Space d × Space d => wavePacketPhase d w.1 w.2) := by
    unfold wavePacketPhase
    fun_prop
  exact hphase.stronglyMeasurable.mul (unphasedWavePacket_stronglyMeasurable d f g)

name: SVW.schwartz_lintegral_energy
statement:
theorem schwartz_lintegral_energy (d : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2)) = ENNReal.ofReal (‖f.toLp 2‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) (volume : Measure (Space d)) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable).mp (f.memLp 2)
  have hcongr : (∫ x : Space d, ‖(f.toLp 2 volume) x‖ ^ 2) = ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [f.coeFn_toLp 2 volume] with x hx
    rw [hx]
  have hreal : (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = ‖f.toLp 2 volume‖ ^ 2 :=
    hcongr.symm.trans (lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume (f.toLp 2 volume))
  exact (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _))).symm.trans
      (congrArg ENNReal.ofReal hreal)

name: SVW.wavePacket_moyal_lintegral_norm
statement:
theorem wavePacket_moyal_lintegral_norm
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    (∫⁻ w : Space d × Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (‖wavePacket d f g w.1 w.2‖ ^ 2)
      ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖f.toLp 2‖ ^ 2 * ‖g.toLp 2‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_wavePacket]
  rw [wavePacket_moyal_lintegral, schwartz_lintegral_energy, schwartz_lintegral_energy,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)]

name: SVW.wavePacket_memLp
statement:
theorem wavePacket_memLp (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    MemLp (fun w : Space d × Space d => wavePacket d f g w.1 w.2) 2
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := wavePacket_stronglyMeasurable d f g
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  refine ⟨(hm.norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable,
    (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun w => sq_nonneg _))).mpr ?_⟩
  rw [wavePacket_moyal_lintegral_norm]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume]
      (fun w => wavePacket d f g w.1 w.2)
proof: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_norm
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_norm (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    ‖wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g‖ = ‖f.toLp 2‖ * ‖g.toLp 2‖
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr : (∫ w : Space d × Space d, ‖wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g w‖ ^ 2
      ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume) =
        ∫ w, ‖wavePacket d f g w.1 w.2‖ ^ 2
          ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f g] with w hw
    rw [hw]
  have hreal : (∫ w : Space d × Space d, ‖wavePacket d f g w.1 w.2‖ ^ 2
      ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume) =
        ‖f.toLp 2 volume‖ ^ 2 * ‖g.toLp 2 volume‖ ^ 2 :=
    (integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun w => sq_nonneg _))
      ((wavePacket_stronglyMeasurable d f g).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable).trans
        ((congrArg ENNReal.toReal (wavePacket_moyal_lintegral_norm d f g)).trans
          (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)))
  have henergy := (lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d × Space d)
    ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod volume) (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g)).symm.trans
      (hcongr.trans hreal)
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  simpa only [mul_pow] using henergy

name: SVW.wavePacket_add_signal
statement:
theorem wavePacket_add_signal (d : ℕ) (f₁ f₂ g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d (f₁ + f₂) g q p = wavePacket d f₁ g q p + wavePacket d f₂ g q p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wavePacket, unphasedWavePacket, localizedSchwartz, map_add,
    FourierTransform.fourier_add, add_apply, mul_add]

name: SVW.wavePacket_smul_signal
statement:
theorem wavePacket_smul_signal
    (d : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d (c • f) g q p = c • wavePacket d f g q p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wavePacket, unphasedWavePacket, localizedSchwartz, map_smul,
    FourierTransform.fourier_smul, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_add_signal
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_add_signal (d : ℕ) (f₁ f₂ g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzLp d (f₁ + f₂) g =
      wavePacketSchwartzLp d f₁ g + wavePacketSchwartzLp d f₂ g
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d (f₁ + f₂) g,
    wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f₁ g, wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f₂ g,
    Lp.coeFn_add (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f₁ g) (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f₂ g)] with w h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  rw [h₁, h₄]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [h₂, h₃]
  exact wavePacket_add_signal d f₁ f₂ g w.1 w.2

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_smul_signal
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_smul_signal (d : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzLp d (c • f) g = c • wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d (c • f) g, wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f g,
    Lp.coeFn_smul c (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g)] with w h₁ h₂ h₃
  rw [h₁, h₃]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [h₂]
  exact wavePacket_smul_signal d c f g w.1 w.2

name: SVW.schwartzToL2_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem schwartzToL2_apply (d : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    schwartzToL2 d f = f.toLp 2 volume
proof: := rfl

name: SVW.schwartzToL2_dense
statement: theorem schwartzToL2_dense (d : ℕ) : DenseRange (schwartzToL2 d)
proof:
:=
  SchwartzMap.denseRange_toLpCLM ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_apply
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_apply
    (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g (f.toLp 2 volume) = wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (schwartzToL2_dense d)
  refine ⟨‖g.toLp 2 volume‖, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖wavePacketSchwartzLp d h g‖ ≤ ‖g.toLp 2 volume‖ * ‖h.toLp 2 volume‖
  rw [wavePacketSchwartzLp_norm, mul_comm]

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_norm
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_norm
    (d : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g f‖ = ‖f‖ * ‖g.toLp 2 volume‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on f (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro h
  change ‖wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g (h.toLp 2 volume)‖ = _
  rw [wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_apply]
  exact wavePacketSchwartzLp_norm d h g

name: SVW.wavePacket_add_window
statement:
theorem wavePacket_add_window
    (d : ℕ) (f g₁ g₂ : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d f (g₁ + g₂) q p = wavePacket d f g₁ q p + wavePacket d f g₂ q p
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : localizedSchwartz d f (g₁ + g₂) q =
      localizedSchwartz d f g₁ q + localizedSchwartz d f g₂ q := by
    ext x
    simp only [localizedSchwartz_apply, add_apply, star_add, add_mul]
  simp only [wavePacket, unphasedWavePacket, hlocal, FourierTransform.fourier_add,
    add_apply, mul_add]

name: SVW.wavePacket_real_smul_window
statement:
theorem wavePacket_real_smul_window
    (d : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacket d f (r • g) q p = r • wavePacket d f g q p
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : localizedSchwartz d f (r • g) q = r • localizedSchwartz d f g q := by
    ext x
    simp [localizedSchwartz_apply, mul_assoc]
  simp only [wavePacket, unphasedWavePacket, hlocal, FourierTransform.fourier_smul,
    smul_apply, mul_smul_comm]

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_add_window
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_add_window (d : ℕ) (f g₁ g₂ : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzLp d f (g₁ + g₂) =
      wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g₁ + wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g₂
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f (g₁ + g₂),
    wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f g₁, wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f g₂,
    Lp.coeFn_add (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g₁) (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g₂)] with w h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  rw [h₁, h₄]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [h₂, h₃]
  exact wavePacket_add_window d f g₁ g₂ w.1 w.2

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzLp_real_smul_window
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzLp_real_smul_window (d : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzLp d f (r • g) = r • wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f (r • g), wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f g,
    Lp.coeFn_smul r (wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g)] with w h₁ h₂ h₃
  rw [h₁, h₃]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [h₂]
  exact wavePacket_real_smul_window d r f g w.1 w.2

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_add
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_add
    (d : ℕ) (g₁ g₂ : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d (g₁ + g₂) =
      wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g₁ + wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g₂
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  change wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d (g₁ + g₂) f =
    wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g₁ f + wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g₂ f
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on f (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro h
  simp only [schwartzToL2_apply, wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_apply,
    wavePacketSchwartzLp_add_window]

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_real_smul
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_real_smul
    (d : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d (r • g) = r • wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  change wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d (r • g) f = r • wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g f
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on f (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro h
  simp only [schwartzToL2_apply, wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_apply,
    wavePacketSchwartzLp_real_smul_window]

name: SVW.wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_opNorm
statement:
theorem wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_opNorm
    (d : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    ‖wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g‖ ≤ ‖g.toLp 2 volume‖
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
  intro f
  rw [wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_norm, mul_comm]

name: SVW.wavePacketWindowCLM_apply_schwartz
statement:
theorem wavePacketWindowCLM_apply_schwartz
    (d : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketWindowCLM d (g.toLp 2 volume) = wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d g
proof:
:= by
  have hd : DenseRange ((schwartzToL2 d).restrictScalars ℝ) := schwartzToL2_dense d
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq hd
  refine ⟨1, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM d h‖ ≤ 1 * ‖h.toLp 2 volume‖
  simpa only [one_mul] using wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_opNorm d h

name: SVW.wavePacketL2_norm
statement:
theorem wavePacketL2_norm (d : ℕ) (g f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖wavePacketWindowCLM d g f‖ = ‖f‖ * ‖g‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (schwartzToL2_dense d).induction_on g (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) ?_
  intro h
  simp only [schwartzToL2_apply, wavePacketWindowCLM_apply_schwartz,
    wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_norm]

name: SVW.continuous_wavePacketL2
statement:
theorem continuous_wavePacketL2 (d : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun gf : Hilbert d × Hilbert d => wavePacketWindowCLM d gf.1 gf.2)
proof: := by fun_prop

name: SVW.wavePacketL2_apply_schwartz
statement:
theorem wavePacketL2_apply_schwartz (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    wavePacketWindowCLM d (g.toLp 2 volume) (f.toLp 2 volume) = wavePacketSchwartzLp d f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacketWindowCLM_apply_schwartz, wavePacketSchwartzWindowCLM_apply]

name: SVW.gaussianWindow_memLp_complex
statement:
theorem gaussianWindow_memLp_complex (d : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun x : Space d => (gaussianWindow d x : ℂ)) 2
      (volume : Measure (Space d))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : Space d => (gaussianWindow d x : ℂ)) volume :=
    (integrable_gaussianWindow d).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.complex_ofReal.aestronglyMeasurable
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm).mpr
  simpa only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using integrable_gaussianWindow_sq d

name: SVW.gaussianL2Window_coe
statement:
theorem gaussianL2Window_coe (d : ℕ) :
    gaussianL2Window d =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d))]
      (fun x => (gaussianWindow d x : ℂ))
proof: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: SVW.gaussianL2Window_norm
statement: theorem gaussianL2Window_norm (d : ℕ) : ‖gaussianL2Window d‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr : (∫ x : Space d, ‖gaussianL2Window d x‖ ^ 2) =
      ∫ x : Space d, gaussianWindow d x ^ 2 := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [gaussianL2Window_coe d] with x hx
    rw [hx]
    simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hsquare : ‖gaussianL2Window d‖ ^ 2 = 1 :=
    (lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume (gaussianL2Window d)).symm.trans
      (hcongr.trans (integral_gaussianWindow_sq d))
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (gaussianL2Window d)]

name: SVW.gaussianWavePacketIsometry_norm
statement:
@[simp] theorem gaussianWavePacketIsometry_norm (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ‖gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f‖ = ‖f‖
proof:
:=
  (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d).norm_map f

name: SVW.rowDenom_pos
statement: theorem rowDenom_pos (s : ℝ) : 0 < rowDenom s
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowDenom
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s+1)]

name: SVW.rowScale_pos
statement: theorem rowScale_pos (s : ℝ) : 0 < rowScale s
proof: := div_pos (by norm_num) (rowDenom_pos s)

name: SVW.rowScale_le_one
statement: theorem rowScale_le_one (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) : rowScale s ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowScale
  apply (div_le_one (rowDenom_pos s)).mpr
  unfold rowDenom
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]

name: SVW.rowPhase_bounds
statement: theorem rowPhase_bounds (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) : 0 ≤ rowPhase s ∧ rowPhase s < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowPhase
  constructor
  · linarith [rowScale_le_one s hs]
  · linarith [rowScale_pos s]

name: SVW.rowDenom_hasDerivAt
statement: theorem rowDenom_hasDerivAt (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt rowDenom (2*(s+1)) s
proof:
:= by
  convert! (((hasDerivAt_id s).pow 2).add ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul 2)).add_const 2 using 1
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, id_eq, mul_one]
  ring

name: SVW.rowScale_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem rowScale_hasDerivAt (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt rowScale (-4*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2) s
proof:
:= by
  convert! (hasDerivAt_const s (2:ℝ)).div (rowDenom_hasDerivAt s) (ne_of_gt (rowDenom_pos s)) using 1
  ring

name: SVW.rowPhase_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem rowPhase_hasDerivAt (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt rowPhase (4*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2) s
proof:
:= by
  convert! (rowScale_hasDerivAt s).const_sub 1 using 1
  ring

name: SVW.rowU_pos
statement: theorem rowU_pos (d : ℕ) (T s : ℝ) : 0 < rowU d T s
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos (rowScale_pos s) _) (exp_pos _)

name: SVW.rowU_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem rowU_hasDerivAt (d : ℕ) (T s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (rowU d T)
      (-((d:ℝ)*(s+1)/rowDenom s + 4*T*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2) * rowU d T s) s
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (rowScale_hasDerivAt s).rpow_const
    (p := (d:ℝ)/2) (Or.inl (ne_of_gt (rowScale_pos s)))
  have he := ((rowPhase_hasDerivAt s).const_mul (-T)).exp
  convert! hp.mul he using 1
  unfold rowU
  rw [rpow_sub (rowScale_pos s), rpow_one]
  unfold rowScale
  field_simp
  ring

name: SVW.rowScale_weight_le
statement:
theorem rowScale_weight_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    rowScale s ^ ((d:ℝ)/2) / rowDenom s ≤ 2*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hp : rowScale s ^ ((d:ℝ)/2) ≤ sqrt (rowScale s) := by
    rw [sqrt_eq_rpow]
    exact rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (rowScale_pos s) (rowScale_le_one s hs) (by linarith)
  have hD := rowDenom_pos s
  have hsqrt : sqrt (rowScale s) ≤ 2*(s+1)/rowDenom s := by
    apply (sqrt_le_iff).mpr
    constructor
    · positivity
    · unfold rowScale rowDenom
      field_simp
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]
  calc
    rowScale s ^ ((d:ℝ)/2) / rowDenom s ≤ (2*(s+1)/rowDenom s) / rowDenom s :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.trans hsqrt) hD.le
    _ = 2*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2 := by ring

name: SVW.rowDenom_tendsto_atTop
statement: theorem rowDenom_tendsto_atTop : Tendsto rowDenom atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (1:ℝ)
    ((tendsto_pow_atTop (α := ℝ) (n := 2) (by omega)).comp
      (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (1:ℝ) tendsto_id))
  convert! h using 1
  ext s
  simp only [rowDenom, Function.comp_apply, id_eq]
  ring

name: SVW.rowScale_tendsto_zero
statement: theorem rowScale_tendsto_zero : Tendsto rowScale atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rowScale, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_zero, Pi.inv_apply] using!
    rowDenom_tendsto_atTop.inv_tendsto_atTop.const_mul 2

name: SVW.rowPhase_tendsto_one
statement: theorem rowPhase_tendsto_one : Tendsto rowPhase atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun s => 1-rowScale s) atTop (𝓝 1)
  simpa only [sub_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub rowScale_tendsto_zero

name: SVW.rowU_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem rowU_tendsto_zero (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (rowU d T) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hd)
  have hp := rowScale_tendsto_zero.rpow_const_nhds_zero (show 0 < (d:ℝ)/2 by positivity)
  have he := Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (rowPhase_tendsto_one.const_mul (-T))
  change Tendsto (fun s => rowScale s ^ ((d:ℝ)/2) * exp (-T*rowPhase s)) atTop (𝓝 0)
  simpa only [zero_mul, Function.comp_apply] using hp.mul he

name: SVW.rowMassPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem rowMassPrimitive_hasDerivAt (d : ℕ) (T s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (rowMassPrimitive d T) (rowMassMajorant d T s) s
proof:
:= by
  have hu := (rowU_hasDerivAt d T s).const_mul (-(1/2:ℝ))
  have he := (((rowPhase_hasDerivAt s).const_mul (-T)).exp).const_mul (1/2:ℝ)
  convert! hu.sub he using 1
  unfold rowMassMajorant
  rw [(rowU_hasDerivAt d T s).deriv]
  ring

name: SVW.rowU_deriv_nonpos
statement:
theorem rowU_deriv_nonpos (d : ℕ) (T s : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    deriv (rowU d T) s ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(rowU_hasDerivAt d T s).deriv]
  have hc : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ)*(s+1)/rowDenom s + 4*T*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2 := by
    have hD := rowDenom_pos s
    positivity
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hc) (rowU_pos d T s).le

name: SVW.rowMassMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowMassMajorant_nonneg (d : ℕ) (T s : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    0 ≤ rowMassMajorant d T s
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowMassMajorant
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (rowU_deriv_nonpos d T s hT hs)
  · positivity

name: SVW.rowHeatIntegrand_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowHeatIntegrand_nonneg (d : ℕ) (T s : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    0 ≤ rowHeatIntegrand d T s
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowHeatIntegrand
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (rowU_deriv_nonpos d T s hT hs)
  · exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hT (rowDenom_pos s).le) (rowU_pos d T s).le

name: SVW.rowHeatIntegrand_le_majorant
statement:
theorem rowHeatIntegrand_le_majorant (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T s : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hs : 0 ≤ s) : rowHeatIntegrand d T s ≤ rowMassMajorant d T s
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowHeatIntegrand rowMassMajorant
  apply add_le_add_right
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (rowScale_weight_le d hd s hs)
    (mul_nonneg hT (exp_pos (-T*rowPhase s)).le)
  unfold rowU
  convert! h using 1 <;> ring

name: SVW.rowMassPrimitive_tendsto
statement:
theorem rowMassPrimitive_tendsto (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (rowMassPrimitive d T) atTop (𝓝 (-(1/2:ℝ)*exp (-T)))
proof:
:= by
  have hu := (rowU_tendsto_zero d hd T).const_mul (-(1/2:ℝ))
  have he := (Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (rowPhase_tendsto_one.const_mul (-T))).const_mul (1/2:ℝ)
  change Tendsto (fun s => -(1/2:ℝ)*rowU d T s - (1/2:ℝ)*exp (-T*rowPhase s)) atTop _
  simpa only [mul_zero, mul_one, zero_sub, neg_mul, Function.comp_apply] using hu.sub he

name: SVW.integral_rowMassMajorant
statement:
theorem integral_rowMassMajorant (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∫ s in Ioi 0, rowMassMajorant d T s = 1-exp (-T)/2
proof:
:= by
  have he := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg'
    (fun s (_ : s ∈ Ici (0:ℝ)) => rowMassPrimitive_hasDerivAt d T s)
    (fun s hs => rowMassMajorant_nonneg d T s hT hs.le)
    (rowMassPrimitive_tendsto d hd T)
  convert! he using 1
  simp [rowMassPrimitive, rowU, rowPhase, rowScale, rowDenom]
  ring

name: SVW.integrable_rowMassMajorant
statement:
theorem integrable_rowMassMajorant (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    IntegrableOn (rowMassMajorant d T) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:=
  integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg'
    (fun s (_ : s ∈ Ici (0:ℝ)) => rowMassPrimitive_hasDerivAt d T s)
    (fun s hs => rowMassMajorant_nonneg d T s hT hs.le)
    (rowMassPrimitive_tendsto d hd T)

name: SVW.measurable_rowHeatIntegrand
statement:
theorem measurable_rowHeatIntegrand (d : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    Measurable (rowHeatIntegrand d T)
proof:
:= by
  have he : deriv (rowU d T) = fun s =>
      -((d:ℝ)*(s+1)/rowDenom s + 4*T*(s+1)/rowDenom s^2) * rowU d T s :=
    funext (fun s => (rowU_hasDerivAt d T s).deriv)
  unfold rowHeatIntegrand
  rw [he]
  unfold rowU rowPhase rowScale rowDenom
  fun_prop

name: SVW.integrable_rowHeatIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrable_rowHeatIntegrand (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    IntegrableOn (rowHeatIntegrand d T) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_rowMassMajorant d hd T hT).mono'
    (measurable_rowHeatIntegrand d T).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (rowHeatIntegrand_nonneg d T s hT hs.le)]
  exact rowHeatIntegrand_le_majorant d hd T s hT hs.le

name: SVW.integral_rowHeatIntegrand_le
statement:
theorem integral_rowHeatIntegrand_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (∫ s in Ioi 0, rowHeatIntegrand d T s) ≤ 1-exp (-T)/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_rowMassMajorant d hd T hT]
  apply integral_mono_ae (integrable_rowHeatIntegrand d hd T hT)
    (integrable_rowMassMajorant d hd T hT)
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
  exact rowHeatIntegrand_le_majorant d hd T s hT hs.le

name: SVW.integral_rowHeatIntegrand_le_one
statement:
theorem integral_rowHeatIntegrand_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (∫ s in Ioi 0, rowHeatIntegrand d T s) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have he := integral_rowHeatIntegrand_le d hd T hT
  linarith [exp_pos (-T)]

name: SVW.heatTruncationInterval_subset
statement: theorem heatTruncationInterval_subset (n : ℕ) : heatTruncationInterval n ⊆ Ioi 0
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ht.1

name: SVW.heatTruncationInterval_mono
statement: theorem heatTruncationInterval_mono : Monotone heatTruncationInterval
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm t ht
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hnm' : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m + 1 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hnm 1
  exact ⟨(inv_anti₀ hn hnm').trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hnm'⟩

name: SVW.iUnion_heatTruncationInterval
statement: theorem iUnion_heatTruncationInterval : (⋃ n : ℕ, heatTruncationInterval n) = Ioi 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · exact iUnion_subset heatTruncationInterval_subset
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max t t⁻¹)
    have hmax : max t t⁻¹ ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := hn.le.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)
    apply mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have htn : t⁻¹ ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hmax
      have h := inv_anti₀ (inv_pos.mpr ht) htn
      simpa only [inv_inv] using h
    · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hmax

name: SVW.heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ heatSymbolIntegrand d q p t
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (exponentialMix_nonneg ‖q‖ t) (exp_pos _).le

name: SVW.heatSymbolIntegrand_eq
statement:
theorem heatSymbolIntegrand_eq (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (t : ℝ) :
    heatSymbolIntegrand d q p t = ‖q‖ ^ 2 * exp (-(‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) * t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatSymbolIntegrand exponentialMix
  rw [mul_assoc, ← exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring_nf

name: SVW.integrable_heatSymbolIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrable_heatSymbolIntegrand (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    IntegrableOn (heatSymbolIntegrand d q p) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · have hzero : heatSymbolIntegrand d q p = 0 := by
      funext t
      simp [heatSymbolIntegrand, hq, exponentialMix]
    rw [hzero]
    exact integrableOn_zero
  · have hqpos : 0 < ‖q‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hq
    have hneg : -(‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) < 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖p‖]
    have heq : heatSymbolIntegrand d q p =
        (fun t => ‖q‖ ^ 2 * exp (-(‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) * t)) :=
      funext (heatSymbolIntegrand_eq d q p)
    rw [heq]
    exact (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi hneg 0).const_mul (‖q‖ ^ 2)

name: SVW.integral_heatSymbolIntegrand
statement:
theorem integral_heatSymbolIntegrand (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, heatSymbolIntegrand d q p t) = separatorSymbol d q p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [heatSymbolIntegrand, hq, exponentialMix, separatorSymbol]
  · exact integral_resolvent_symbol ‖q‖ ‖p‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hq)

name: SVW.truncatedSeparatorSymbol_nonneg
statement:
theorem truncatedSeparatorSymbol_nonneg (d n : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    0 ≤ truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n q p
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg (heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg d q p)

name: SVW.truncatedSeparatorSymbol_le_separator
statement:
theorem truncatedSeparatorSymbol_le_separator (d n : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n q p ≤ separatorSymbol d q p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_heatSymbolIntegrand]
  exact setIntegral_mono_set (integrable_heatSymbolIntegrand d q p)
    (Eventually.of_forall (heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg d q p))
    (Eventually.of_forall (heatTruncationInterval_subset n))

name: SVW.truncatedSeparatorSymbol_le_one
statement:
theorem truncatedSeparatorSymbol_le_one (d n : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n q p ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (truncatedSeparatorSymbol_le_separator d n q p).trans (separatorSymbol_le_one d q p)

name: SVW.truncatedSeparatorSymbol_mono
statement:
theorem truncatedSeparatorSymbol_mono (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    Monotone (fun n => truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n q p)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  exact setIntegral_mono_set
    ((integrable_heatSymbolIntegrand d q p).mono_set (heatTruncationInterval_subset m))
    (Eventually.of_forall (heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg d q p))
    (Eventually.of_forall (heatTruncationInterval_mono hnm))

name: SVW.truncatedSeparatorSymbol_tendsto
statement:
theorem truncatedSeparatorSymbol_tendsto (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    Tendsto (fun n => truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n q p) atTop (𝓝 (separatorSymbol d q p))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntegrableOn (heatSymbolIntegrand d q p) (⋃ n, heatTruncationInterval n) volume := by
    rw [iUnion_heatTruncationInterval]
    exact integrable_heatSymbolIntegrand d q p
  have hm : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (heatTruncationInterval n) := fun _ => measurableSet_Icc
  have h := tendsto_setIntegral_of_monotone hm heatTruncationInterval_mono hi
  rw [iUnion_heatTruncationInterval, integral_heatSymbolIntegrand] at h
  exact h

name: SVW.measurable_truncatedSeparatorSymbol
statement:
theorem measurable_truncatedSeparatorSymbol (d n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun z : Space d × Space d => truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : (Space d × Space d) × ℝ =>
      heatSymbolIntegrand d z.1.1 z.1.2 z.2) := by
    unfold heatSymbolIntegrand exponentialMix
    fun_prop
  exact hc.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'.measurable

name: SVW.truncatedGaussianSeparator_nonneg
statement: theorem truncatedGaussianSeparator_nonneg (d n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ truncatedGaussianSeparator d n
proof:
:=
  antiWickCompression_nonneg (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d) _ _ _ _

name: SVW.truncatedGaussianSeparator_le_one
statement: theorem truncatedGaussianSeparator_le_one (d n : ℕ) : truncatedGaussianSeparator d n ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  antiWickCompression_le_one (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d) _ _ _ _

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_sub_norm_sq_integral
statement:
theorem operator_sub_norm_sq_integral (m n : BoundedSymbol α μ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ‖m.operator f - n.operator f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x, ‖(m x - n x) * f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (m.operator f) (n.operator f), m.operator_coe f,
    n.operator_coe f] with x h₁ h₂ h₃
  simp only [h₁, Pi.sub_apply, h₂, h₃, sub_mul]

name: SVW.BoundedSymbol.operator_tendsto_of_ae
statement:
theorem operator_tendsto_of_ae (m : ℕ → BoundedSymbol α μ) (a : BoundedSymbol α μ)
    (C : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖m n x - a x‖ ≤ C)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => m n x) atTop (𝓝 (a x)))
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : Tendsto (fun n => (m n).operator f) atTop (𝓝 (a.operator f))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => C ^ 2 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).mp (Lp.memLp f)).const_mul _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖(m n x - a x) * f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (0 : ℝ) ∂μ)) := by
    apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => C ^ 2 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2)
    · intro n
      exact (((m n).measurable.sub a.measurable).mul (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).norm.pow 2
    · exact hi
    · intro n
      filter_upwards [hbound n] with x hx
      simp only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), norm_mul, mul_pow]
      gcongr
    · filter_upwards [hlim] with x hx
      simpa only [sub_self, zero_mul, norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0)] using
        (((hx.sub (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => a x) atTop (𝓝 (a x)))).mul
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => f x) atTop (𝓝 (f x)))).norm.pow 2)
  have hs : Tendsto (fun n => ‖(m n).operator f - a.operator f‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [operator_sub_norm_sq_integral, integral_zero] using ht
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  have hr := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hs
  have heq : ((fun x : ℝ => sqrt x) ∘
      (fun n => ‖(m n).operator f - a.operator f‖ ^ 2)) =
      (fun n => ‖(m n).operator f - a.operator f‖) := by
    funext n
    exact sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [heq] at hr
  simpa only [sqrt_zero] using hr

name: SVW.truncatedSeparator_operator_tendsto
statement:
theorem truncatedSeparator_operator_tendsto (d : ℕ) (f : PhaseHilbert d) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (truncatedSeparatorBoundedSymbol d n).operator f) atTop
      (𝓝 ((separatorBoundedSymbol d).operator f))
proof:
:= by
  apply BoundedSymbol.operator_tendsto_of_ae _ _ 1
  · intro n
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      change ‖(truncatedSeparatorSymbol d n z.1 z.2 : ℂ) -
        (separatorSymbol d z.1 z.2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos
        (sub_nonpos.mpr (truncatedSeparatorSymbol_le_separator d n z.1 z.2))]
      have h₀ := truncatedSeparatorSymbol_nonneg d n z.1 z.2
      have h₁ := separatorSymbol_le_one d z.1 z.2
      linarith
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z =>
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (truncatedSeparatorSymbol_tendsto d z.1 z.2)

name: SVW.truncatedGaussianSeparator_tendsto
statement:
theorem truncatedGaussianSeparator_tendsto (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    Tendsto (fun n => truncatedGaussianSeparator d n f) atTop (𝓝 (gaussianSeparator d f))
proof:
:=
  (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (truncatedSeparator_operator_tendsto d (gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f))

name: SVW.heatSymbolIntegrand_gaussian
statement:
theorem heatSymbolIntegrand_gaussian (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (t : ℝ) :
    heatSymbolIntegrand d q p t = exponentialMix ‖q‖ t * gaussian d t p
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatSymbolIntegrand gaussian
  congr 2
  ring

name: SVW.heatEnergy_spatial_slice
statement:
theorem heatEnergy_spatial_slice (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (q : Space d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ yz : Space d × Space d, heatPairingIntegrand d f ((t,q),yz)
      ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      ((∫ p : Space d, heatEnergyIntegrand d f (t,(q,p)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∫ yz : Space d × Space d, heatPairingIntegrand d f ((t,q),yz)
      ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
        (exponentialMix ‖q‖ t : ℂ) *
          ∫ yz : Space d × Space d,
            ((gaussianWindow d (yz.1-q) * gaussianWindow d (yz.2-q) *
              heatDensity d t (yz.1-yz.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
            ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with yz
      simp only [heatPairingIntegrand, heatSpatialKernel, heatRowIntegrand, Complex.ofReal_mul]
      ring
    _ = (exponentialMix ‖q‖ t : ℂ) * ∫ p : Space d,
        (gaussian d t p : ℂ) *
          (‖wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) q p‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) := by
      rw [gaussian_coefficient_heat_pairing d t ht q f]
    _ = ∫ p : Space d, (heatEnergyIntegrand d f (t,(q,p)) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with p
      simp only [heatEnergyIntegrand, heatSymbolIntegrand_gaussian, Complex.ofReal_mul,
        Complex.ofReal_pow]
      ring
    _ = _ := integral_complex_ofReal

name: SVW.integral_heatEnergy_iterated
statement:
theorem integral_heatEnergy_iterated (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ w, heatEnergyIntegrand d f w
      ∂((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioi 0)).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      ∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ q : Space d, ∫ p : Space d, heatEnergyIntegrand d f (t,(q,p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_prod _ (integrable_heatEnergyIntegrand d f)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(integrable_heatEnergyIntegrand d f).prod_right_ae] with t ht
  exact integral_prod _ ht

name: SVW.positiveKernel_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem positiveKernel_quadratic_energy (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ yz : Space d × Space d, (positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2 : ℂ) *
      inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
        ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      (((inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) f).re : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_heatPairing_iterated d hd f]
  have hi : Integrable (fun tq : ℝ × Space d =>
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d, heatPairingIntegrand d f (tq,yz)
        ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))))
      (heatParameterMeasure d) := (integrable_heatPairingIntegrand d hd f).integral_prod_left
  rw [integral_prod _ hi]
  calc
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ q : Space d, ∫ yz : Space d × Space d,
      heatPairingIntegrand d f ((t,q),yz)
        ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
        ∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ q : Space d,
          ((∫ p : Space d, heatEnergyIntegrand d f (t,(q,p)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with q
      exact heatEnergy_spatial_slice d t ht q f
    _ = ((∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ q : Space d, ∫ p : Space d,
        heatEnergyIntegrand d f (t,(q,p)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp_rw [integral_complex_ofReal]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← integral_heatEnergy_iterated, integral_heatEnergyIntegrand]

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_quadratic_real
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_quadratic_real (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (((inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) f).re : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) f
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp
  rw [inner_conj_symm]
  have hsa := (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_def'.mp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive (gaussianSeparator d)).mp
      (gaussianSeparator_nonneg d))).1
  exact (hsa.isSymmetric f f).symm

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_kernel_quadratic
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_kernel_quadratic (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) f =
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d, (positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2 : ℂ) *
        inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveKernel_quadratic_energy d hd f, gaussianSeparator_quadratic_real]

name: SVW.exponentialMix_nonneg
statement: theorem exponentialMix_nonneg (b t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ exponentialMix b t
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (exp_pos _).le

name: SVW.integrable_exponentialMix
statement:
theorem integrable_exponentialMix (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    IntegrableOn (exponentialMix b) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:=
  (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (a := -(b ^ 2)) (by nlinarith) 0).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_exponentialMix
statement:
theorem integral_exponentialMix (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix b t = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold exponentialMix
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (a := -(b ^ 2)) (by nlinarith) 0]
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  simp [hb0]

name: SVW.lintegral_exponentialMix
statement:
theorem lintegral_exponentialMix (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialMix b t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_exponentialMix b hb)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (exponentialMix_nonneg b)), integral_exponentialMix b hb]
  simp

name: SVW.measurable_heatDensity
statement:
theorem measurable_heatDensity (d : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun z : ℝ × Space d => heatDensity d z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatDensity gaussian
  fun_prop

name: SVW.lintegral_heatDensity
statement:
theorem lintegral_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫⁻ x : Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (heatDensity d t x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_heatDensity d t ht)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (heatDensity_pos d t ht x).le)),
    integral_heatDensity d t ht]
  simp

name: SVW.measurable_heatResolventENN
statement:
theorem measurable_heatResolventENN (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) :
    Measurable (heatResolventENN d b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.lintegral_prod_right
  have hh := (measurable_heatDensity d).comp measurable_swap
  exact (by unfold exponentialMix; fun_prop : Measurable (fun z : Space d × ℝ =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialMix b z.2))).mul hh.ennreal_ofReal

name: SVW.lintegral_heatResolventENN
statement:
theorem lintegral_heatResolventENN (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫⁻ x : Space d, heatResolventENN d b x = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatResolventENN
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap]
  · calc
      (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ x : Space d,
        ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialMix b t) * ENNReal.ofReal (heatDensity d t x)) =
          ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialMix b t) := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
        have hh : Measurable (fun x : Space d => ENNReal.ofReal (heatDensity d t x)) := by
          unfold heatDensity gaussian
          fun_prop
        rw [lintegral_const_mul _ hh, lintegral_heatDensity d t ht, mul_one]
      _ = 1 := lintegral_exponentialMix b hb
  · have hh := (measurable_heatDensity d).comp measurable_swap
    exact ((by unfold exponentialMix; fun_prop : Measurable (fun z : Space d × ℝ =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialMix b z.2))).mul hh.ennreal_ofReal).aemeasurable

name: SVW.heatResolventENN_ae_finite
statement:
theorem heatResolventENN_ae_finite (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)), heatResolventENN d b x < ∞
proof:
:= by
  apply ae_lt_top (measurable_heatResolventENN d b)
  rw [lintegral_heatResolventENN d b hb]
  exact ENNReal.one_ne_top

name: SVW.heatResolvent_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatResolvent_nonneg (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    0 ≤ heatResolvent d b x
proof: := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: SVW.measurable_heatResolvent
statement:
theorem measurable_heatResolvent (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) :
    Measurable (heatResolvent d b)
proof: := (measurable_heatResolventENN d b).ennreal_toReal

name: SVW.integrable_heatResolvent
statement:
theorem integrable_heatResolvent (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (heatResolvent d b) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top (measurable_heatResolventENN d b).aemeasurable
  rw [lintegral_heatResolventENN d b hb]
  exact ENNReal.one_ne_top

name: SVW.integral_heatResolvent
statement:
theorem integral_heatResolvent (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ x : Space d, heatResolvent d b x = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatResolvent
  rw [integral_toReal (measurable_heatResolventENN d b).aemeasurable
    (heatResolventENN_ae_finite d b hb), lintegral_heatResolventENN d b hb,
    ENNReal.toReal_one]

name: SVW.heatResolvent_even
statement:
theorem heatResolvent_even (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    heatResolvent d b (-x) = heatResolvent d b x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [heatResolvent, heatResolventENN, heatDensity, gaussian, norm_neg]

name: SVW.heatResolvent_zero_parameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem heatResolvent_zero_parameter (d : ℕ) (x : Space d) :
    heatResolvent d 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [heatResolvent, heatResolventENN, exponentialMix]

name: SVW.translationL2_coe
statement:
theorem translationL2_coe (d : ℕ) (q : Space d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    translationL2 d q f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => f (x - q)
proof:
:=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (measurePreserving_sub_right volume q)

name: SVW.weylPhaseSymbol_unimodular
statement:
theorem weylPhaseSymbol_unimodular (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ‖weylPhaseSymbol d q p x‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simp [weylPhaseSymbol, Complex.norm_exp]

name: SVW.weylL2_coe
statement:
theorem weylL2_coe (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (g : Hilbert d) :
    weylL2 d q p g =ᵐ[volume] fun x =>
      Complex.exp ((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        g (x - q)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(weylPhaseSymbol d q p).operator_coe (translationL2 d q g),
    translationL2_coe d q g] with x h₁ h₂
  change (weylPhaseSymbol d q p).operator (translationL2 d q g) x = _
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  rfl

name: SVW.weylL2_apply_schwartz
statement:
theorem weylL2_apply_schwartz (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) (g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    weylL2 d q p (g.toLp 2) = (weylSchwartz d q p g).toLp 2
proof:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [weylL2_coe d q p (g.toLp 2),
    (weylSchwartz d q p g).coeFn_toLp 2 volume,
    (measurePreserving_sub_right (volume : Measure (Space d)) q).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (g.coeFn_toLp 2 volume)] with x h₁ h₂ h₃
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, weylSchwartz_apply]

name: SVW.continuous_wavePacketCoefficient
statement:
theorem continuous_wavePacketCoefficient (d : ℕ) (q p : Space d) :
    Continuous (fun gf : Hilbert d × Hilbert d => wavePacketCoefficient d gf.2 gf.1 q p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wavePacketCoefficient
  fun_prop

name: SVW.wavePacketCoefficient_norm_le
statement:
theorem wavePacketCoefficient_norm_le (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    ‖wavePacketCoefficient d f g q p‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [wavePacketCoefficient, (weylL2 d q p).norm_map]
    using norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) (weylL2 d q p g) f

name: SVW.wavePacketCoefficient_schwartz
statement:
theorem wavePacketCoefficient_schwartz (d : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacketCoefficient d (f.toLp 2) (g.toLp 2) q p = wavePacket d f g q p
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacketCoefficient, weylL2_apply_schwartz, L2.inner_def,
    wavePacket_eq_integral_inner_weyl]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(weylSchwartz d q p g).coeFn_toLp 2 volume, f.coeFn_toLp 2 volume]
    with x h₁ h₂
  rw [h₁, h₂]

name: SVW.exists_schwartz_sequence
statement:
theorem exists_schwartz_sequence (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → 𝓢(Space d, ℂ), Tendsto (fun n => (u n).toLp 2) atTop (𝓝 f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp ((schwartzToL2_dense d) f)
  choose u hu using hv
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  have huv : (fun n => (u n).toLp 2) = v := by
    funext n
    exact hu n
  rw [huv]
  exact hvlim

name: SVW.lp_coefficient_ae_of_schwartz
statement:
theorem lp_coefficient_ae_of_schwartz (d : ℕ)
    (V : Hilbert d × Hilbert d → PhaseHilbert d)
    (K : Hilbert d × Hilbert d → Space d × Space d → ℂ)
    (hV : Continuous V) (hK : ∀ z : Space d × Space d, Continuous (fun x => K x z))
    (hS : ∀ f g : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ),
      V (g.toLp 2, f.toLp 2) =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod
        (volume : Measure (Space d))] K (g.toLp 2, f.toLp 2))
    (f g : Hilbert d) :
    V (g, f) =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))] K (g, f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_schwartz_sequence d f
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_schwartz_sequence d g
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => V ((v n).toLp 2, (u n).toLp 2))
      atTop (𝓝 (V (g, f))) := (hV.tendsto (g, f)).comp (hv.prodMk_nhds hu)
  obtain ⟨ns, hns, hlim⟩ := (tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_Lp ht).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  have heq : ∀ᵐ z ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      ∀ n : ℕ, V ((v n).toLp 2, (u n).toLp 2) z = K ((v n).toLp 2, (u n).toLp 2) z := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    exact fun n => hS (u n) (v n)
  refine (heq.and hlim).mono ?_
  intro z hzh
  obtain ⟨hz, hlimz⟩ := hzh
  have hfull : Tendsto (fun i => K ((v i).toLp 2, (u i).toLp 2) z)
      atTop (𝓝 (K (g, f) z)) :=
    ((hK z).tendsto (g, f)).comp (hv.prodMk_nhds hu)
  have hc : Tendsto (fun i => K ((v (ns i)).toLp 2, (u (ns i)).toLp 2) z)
      atTop (𝓝 (K (g, f) z)) := hfull.comp hns.tendsto_atTop
  have hc' : Tendsto (fun i => V ((v (ns i)).toLp 2, (u (ns i)).toLp 2) z)
      atTop (𝓝 (K (g, f) z)) := by
    simpa only [hz] using hc
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlimz hc'

name: SVW.wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae
statement:
theorem wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    wavePacketWindowCLM d g f =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod
      (volume : Measure (Space d))] fun z => wavePacketCoefficient d f g z.1 z.2
proof:
:= by
  apply lp_coefficient_ae_of_schwartz d
    (fun x => wavePacketWindowCLM d x.1 x.2)
    (fun x z => wavePacketCoefficient d x.2 x.1 z.1 z.2)
    (continuous_wavePacketL2 d) (fun z => continuous_wavePacketCoefficient d z.1 z.2) _ f g
  intro f₀ g₀
  rw [wavePacketL2_apply_schwartz]
  filter_upwards [wavePacketSchwartzLp_coe d f₀ g₀] with z hz
  rw [hz, wavePacketCoefficient_schwartz]

name: SVW.wavePacketCoefficient_integral
statement:
theorem wavePacketCoefficient_integral (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    wavePacketCoefficient d f g q p =
      ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        (star (g (x - q)) * f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wavePacketCoefficient, L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [weylL2_coe d q p g] with x hx
  rw [hx, RCLike.inner_apply']
  simp only [map_mul, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    Complex.conj_I, ← mul_assoc]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: SVW.integrable_wavePacketCoefficient
statement:
theorem integrable_wavePacketCoefficient (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun x =>
      Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        (star (g (x - q)) * f x)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (weylL2 d q p g) f).congr
  filter_upwards [weylL2_coe d q p g] with x hx
  rw [hx, RCLike.inner_apply']
  simp only [map_mul, Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    Complex.conj_I, ← mul_assoc]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: SVW.wavePacketL2_integral_ae
statement:
theorem wavePacketL2_integral_ae (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    wavePacketWindowCLM d g f =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod
      (volume : Measure (Space d))] fun z =>
        ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • z.1) z.2 : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
          (star (g (x - z.1)) * f x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae d f g] with z hz
  rw [hz, wavePacketCoefficient_integral]

name: SVW.gaussianWavePacket_integral_ae
statement:
theorem gaussianWavePacket_integral_ae (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f =ᵐ[(volume : Measure (Space d)).prod
      (volume : Measure (Space d))] fun z =>
        ∫ x, Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • z.1) z.2 : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
          ((gaussianWindow d (x - z.1) : ℂ) * f x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [wavePacketL2_integral_ae d f (gaussianL2Window d)] with z hz
  change wavePacketWindowCLM d (gaussianL2Window d) f z = _
  rw [hz]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_sub_right (volume : Measure (Space d)) z.1).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (gaussianL2Window_coe d)] with x hx
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hx
  rw [hx]
  simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]

name: SVW.integrable_gaussianWavePacket_integrand
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianWavePacket_integrand (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (q p : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun x =>
      Complex.exp ((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ (x - (1/2 : ℝ) • q) p : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        ((gaussianWindow d (x - q) : ℂ) * f x)) volume
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) q p).congr
  filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_sub_right (volume : Measure (Space d)) q).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (gaussianL2Window_coe d)] with x hx
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hx
  rw [hx]
  simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]

name: SVW.gaussianWavePacket_norm_le_ae
statement:
theorem gaussianWavePacket_norm_le_ae (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      ‖gaussianWavePacketIsometry d f z‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae d f (gaussianL2Window d)] with z hz
  change ‖wavePacketWindowCLM d (gaussianL2Window d) f z‖ ≤ _
  rw [hz]
  simpa only [gaussianL2Window_norm, one_mul] using
    wavePacketCoefficient_norm_le d f (gaussianL2Window d) z.1 z.2

name: SVW.wavePacketCoefficient_moyal
statement:
theorem wavePacketCoefficient_moyal (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ z : Space d × Space d, ‖wavePacketCoefficient d f g z.1 z.2‖ ^ 2
      ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
        ‖f‖ ^ 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (∫ z : Space d × Space d, ‖wavePacketWindowCLM d g f z‖ ^ 2
      ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      ∫ z : Space d × Space d, ‖wavePacketCoefficient d f g z.1 z.2‖ ^ 2
        ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae d f g] with z hz
    rw [hz]
  rw [← hc, lp_integral_norm_sq, wavePacketL2_norm, mul_pow]

name: SVW.wavePacketCoefficient_memLp
statement:
theorem wavePacketCoefficient_memLp (d : ℕ) (f g : Hilbert d) :
    MemLp (fun z : Space d × Space d => wavePacketCoefficient d f g z.1 z.2) 2
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:=
  (memLp_congr_ae (wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae d f g)).mp
    (Lp.memLp (wavePacketWindowCLM d g f))

name: SVW.gaussianSeparator_quadratic_integral
statement:
theorem gaussianSeparator_quadratic_integral (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) f).re =
      ∫ z : Space d × Space d, separatorSymbol d z.1 z.2 *
        ‖wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) z.1 z.2‖ ^ 2
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianSeparator_inner]
  unfold separatorBoundedSymbol
  rw [BoundedSymbol.realUnit_inner]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [wavePacketL2_coefficient_ae d f (gaussianL2Window d)] with z hz
  change separatorSymbol d z.1 z.2 * ‖wavePacketWindowCLM d (gaussianL2Window d) f z‖ ^ 2 = _
  rw [hz]

name: SVW.rowMassWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowMassWeight_nonneg (d : ℕ) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    0 ≤ rowMassWeight d h
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hh.2]) _) (rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hh.1]) _)

name: SVW.rowMassWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem rowMassWeight_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    rowMassWeight d h ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hleft := rpow_le_one (x := 1-h) (z := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2)
    (by linarith [hh.2]) (by linarith [hh.1]) (by linarith)
  have hright := rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (x := 1+h) (z := -(1:ℝ)/2)
    (by linarith [hh.1]) (by norm_num)
  exact (mul_le_mul hleft hright (rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hh.1]) _) zero_le_one).trans_eq (mul_one 1)

name: SVW.rowMassWeight_continuousOn
statement:
theorem rowMassWeight_continuousOn (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ContinuousOn (rowMassWeight d) (Icc 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  apply ContinuousOn.mul
  · exact (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn.rpow_const
      (fun h hh => Or.inr (by linarith))
  · exact (continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousOn.rpow_const
      (fun h hh => Or.inl (by change 1+h ≠ 0; linarith [hh.1]))

name: SVW.rowMassExpression_integrable
statement:
theorem rowMassExpression_integrable (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun h => rowMassWeight d h * exp (-T*h)) volume 0 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
  rw [uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  exact (rowMassWeight_continuousOn d hd).mul
    (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun h : ℝ => exp (-T*h))).continuousOn

name: SVW.integral_exp_decay_unit_interval
statement:
theorem integral_exp_decay_unit_interval (T : ℝ) :
    T * (∫ h in (0:ℝ)..1, exp (-T*h)) = 1 - exp (-T)
proof:
:= by
  have hd (h : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -exp (-T*x)) (T * exp (-T*h)) h := by
    have he := ((((hasDerivAt_id h).const_mul (-T)).exp).neg)
    have hc : -(exp (-T*h) * (-T*1)) = T * exp (-T*h) := by ring
    simpa only [id_eq, Pi.neg_apply, hc] using! he
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun h : ℝ => T * exp (-T*h)) volume 0 1 := by
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun h : ℝ => T * exp (-T*h))).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hf := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun h (_ : h ∈ uIcc (0:ℝ) 1) => hd h) hi
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, exp_zero, neg_sub_neg]
    using hf

name: SVW.rowMassExpression_le
statement:
theorem rowMassExpression_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    rowMassExpression d T ≤ 1 - exp (-T)/2
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : (∫ h in (0:ℝ)..1, rowMassWeight d h * exp (-T*h)) ≤
      ∫ h in (0:ℝ)..1, exp (-T*h) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)
      (rowMassExpression_integrable d hd T)
      ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun h : ℝ => exp (-T*h))).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    intro h hh
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (rowMassWeight_le_one d hd h hh) (exp_pos _).le).trans_eq (one_mul _)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hT
  have he := integral_exp_decay_unit_interval T
  unfold rowMassExpression
  linarith

name: SVW.rowMassExpression_le_one
statement:
theorem rowMassExpression_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    rowMassExpression d T ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have he := rowMassExpression_le d hd T hT
  linarith [exp_pos (-T)]

name: SVW.measurable_mixedHeat
statement: theorem measurable_mixedHeat (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) : Measurable (mixedHeat d b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mixedHeat exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
  fun_prop

name: SVW.mixedHeat_nonneg
statement:
theorem mixedHeat_nonneg (d : ℕ) (b t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (x : Space d) :
    0 ≤ mixedHeat d b (t,x)
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (exponentialMix_nonneg b t) (heatDensity_pos d t ht x).le

name: SVW.integral_norm_mixedHeat
statement:
theorem integral_norm_mixedHeat (d : ℕ) (b t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫ x : Space d, ‖mixedHeat d b (t,x)‖ = exponentialMix b t
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun x : Space d => ‖mixedHeat d b (t,x)‖) =
      (fun x => exponentialMix b t * heatDensity d t x) := by
    funext x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mixedHeat_nonneg d b t ht x)]
    rfl
  rw [he, integral_const_mul, integral_heatDensity d t ht, mul_one]

name: SVW.integrable_mixedHeat
statement:
theorem integrable_mixedHeat (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (mixedHeat d b)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integrable_prod_iff (measurable_mixedHeat d b).aestronglyMeasurable]
  constructor
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact (integrable_heatDensity d t ht).const_mul (exponentialMix b t)
  · refine (integrable_exponentialMix b hb).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact (integral_norm_mixedHeat d b t ht).symm

name: SVW.heatResolvent_eq_heatIntegral
statement:
theorem heatResolvent_eq_heatIntegral (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    heatResolvent d b x = ∫ t in Ioi 0, mixedHeat d b (t,x)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae]
  · unfold heatResolvent heatResolventENN
    congr 1
    apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_mul (exponentialMix_nonneg b t)
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact mixedHeat_nonneg d b t ht x
  · exact ((measurable_mixedHeat d b).comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable

name: SVW.mixedHeat_section_integrable
statement:
theorem mixedHeat_section_integrable (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Space d)),
      IntegrableOn (fun t => mixedHeat d b (t,x)) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:=
  (integrable_mixedHeat d b hb).prod_left_ae

name: SVW.gaussian_scaled_first_moment_bound
statement:
theorem gaussian_scaled_first_moment_bound (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (x : Space d) :
    ‖x‖ * gaussian d b x ≤ (3 / sqrt b) * gaussian d (b/2) x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sqrt b := sqrt_pos.mpr hb
  have he : (sqrt b * ‖x‖)^2 = b * ‖x‖^2 := by rw [mul_pow, sq_sqrt hb.le]
  have h := radial_gaussian_first_moment_bound 1 (sqrt b * ‖x‖) (by norm_num)
  norm_num only [div_one, one_mul, he] at h
  unfold gaussian
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hs).mpr
  have hexp : -(1/2:ℝ)*(b*‖x‖^2) = -(b/2)*‖x‖^2 := by ring
  rw [hexp] at h
  simp only [neg_mul, one_mul] at h ⊢
  convert! h using 1
  ring

name: SVW.hasFDerivAt_heatDensity
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (x : Space d) :
    HasFDerivAt (heatDensity d t)
      (((π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2)) • ((gaussian d (π^2/t) x * (-2*(π^2/t))) • innerSL ℝ x)) x
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_gaussian d (π^2/t) x).const_mul _

name: SVW.norm_fderiv_heatDensity
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (x : Space d) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) x‖ =
      (π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*(π^2/t)*‖x‖*gaussian d (π^2/t) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_heatDensity d t x).fderiv, norm_smul,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _),
    ← (hasFDerivAt_gaussian d (π^2/t) x).fderiv,
    norm_fderiv_gaussian d (π^2/t) (by positivity)]

name: SVW.integrable_norm_fderiv_heatDensity
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_fderiv_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) x‖) volume
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun x : Space d => ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) x‖) =
      (fun x => ((π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*(π^2/t))) * (‖x‖*gaussian d (π^2/t) x)) := by
    funext x
    rw [norm_fderiv_heatDensity d t ht]
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact (integrable_norm_mul_gaussian d (π^2/t) (by positivity)).const_mul _

name: SVW.integral_norm_fderiv_heatDensity_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_fderiv_heatDensity_le (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ x : Space d, ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) x‖) ≤
      (6*π*(2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2)) / sqrt t
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ := π^2/t
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hc : 0 ≤ (π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*b) := by positivity
  have hi := ((integrable_gaussian d (b/2) (by positivity)).const_mul
    (((π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*b)) * (3/sqrt b)))
  have hm : (∫ x : Space d, ‖fderiv ℝ (heatDensity d t) x‖) ≤
      ∫ x : Space d, (((π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*b)) * (3/sqrt b)) *
        gaussian d (b/2) x := by
    apply integral_mono (integrable_norm_fderiv_heatDensity d t ht) hi
    intro x
    dsimp only
    rw [norm_fderiv_heatDensity d t ht]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussian_scaled_first_moment_bound d b hb x) hc
    change (π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*b*‖x‖*gaussian d b x) ≤ _
    convert! hh using 1 <;> ring
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussian d (b/2) (by positivity)] at hm
  have hp : (π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (π/(b/2))^((d:ℝ)/2) = (2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2) := by
    rw [← mul_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ π/t) (by positivity : 0 ≤ π/(b/2))]
    congr 1
    dsimp [b]
    field_simp
  have hs : sqrt b = π / sqrt t := by
    dsimp [b]
    rw [sqrt_div (sq_nonneg π), sqrt_sq pi_pos.le]
  have hbroot : sqrt b * sqrt b = b := mul_self_sqrt hb.le
  have hroot : sqrt b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sqrt_pos.mpr hb)
  have hbdiv : b/sqrt b = sqrt b := (div_eq_iff hroot).mpr hbroot.symm
  have he : (((π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (2*b)) * (3/sqrt b)) * (π/(b/2))^((d:ℝ)/2) =
      (6*π*(2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2)) / sqrt t := by
    calc
      _ = 6*(b/sqrt b) * ((π/t)^((d:ℝ)/2) * (π/(b/2))^((d:ℝ)/2)) := by ring
      _ = 6*sqrt b*(2:ℝ)^((d:ℝ)/2) := by
        rw [hp, hbdiv]
      _ = _ := by rw [hs]; ring
  rwa [he] at hm

name: SVW.measurable_heatSpatialKernel
statement: theorem measurable_heatSpatialKernel (d : ℕ) : Measurable (heatSpatialKernel d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold heatSpatialKernel heatRowIntegrand gaussianWindow exponentialMix heatDensity gaussian
  fun_prop

name: SVW.heatParameter_positive_ae
statement:
theorem heatParameter_positive_ae (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ tq ∂heatParameterMeasure d, 0 < tq.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi)

name: SVW.heatSpatialKernel_nonneg_ae
statement:
theorem heatSpatialKernel_nonneg_ae (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ w ∂(heatParameterMeasure d).prod
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      0 ≤ heatSpatialKernel d w
proof:
:= by
  have ht : ∀ᵐ w ∂(heatParameterMeasure d).prod
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))), 0 < w.1.1 :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae (heatParameter_positive_ae d)
  filter_upwards [ht] with w hw
  exact heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d w.1.1 hw w.2.1 w.1.2 w.2.2

name: SVW.lintegral_heatSpatialKernel
statement:
theorem lintegral_heatSpatialKernel (d : ℕ) (yz : Space d × Space d) :
    (∫⁻ tq, ENNReal.ofReal (heatSpatialKernel d (tq,yz)) ∂heatParameterMeasure d) =
      positiveKernelENN d yz.1 yz.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_prod]
  · rfl
  · exact ((measurable_heatSpatialKernel d).comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable

name: SVW.integral_heatSpatialKernel
statement:
theorem integral_heatSpatialKernel (d : ℕ) (yz : Space d × Space d) :
    (∫ tq, heatSpatialKernel d (tq,yz) ∂heatParameterMeasure d) =
      positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae, lintegral_heatSpatialKernel]
  · rfl
  · filter_upwards [heatParameter_positive_ae d] with tq ht
    exact heatRowIntegrand_nonneg d tq.1 ht yz.1 tq.2 yz.2
  · exact ((measurable_heatSpatialKernel d).comp
      (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable

name: SVW.heatPairingMajorant_measurable
statement:
theorem heatPairingMajorant_measurable (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (heatPairingMajorant d f)
      ((heatParameterMeasure d).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))))
proof:
