    (((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).comp_fst.norm.mul
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).comp_snd.norm).comp_snd)

name: SVW.heatPairingMajorant_nonneg_ae
statement:
theorem heatPairingMajorant_nonneg_ae (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    ∀ᵐ w ∂(heatParameterMeasure d).prod
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      0 ≤ heatPairingMajorant d f w
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [heatSpatialKernel_nonneg_ae d] with w hw
  exact mul_nonneg hw (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))

name: SVW.lintegral_heatPairingMajorant
statement:
theorem lintegral_heatPairingMajorant (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (heatPairingMajorant d f w)
      ∂(heatParameterMeasure d).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      ∫⁻ yz : Space d × Space d, positiveKernelENN d yz.1 yz.2 *
        (ENNReal.ofReal ‖f yz.1‖ * ENNReal.ofReal ‖f yz.2‖)
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (heatPairingMajorant d f w)) =ᵐ[
      (heatParameterMeasure d).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))]
      fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (heatSpatialKernel d w) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal ‖f w.2.1‖ * ENNReal.ofReal ‖f w.2.2‖) := by
    filter_upwards [heatSpatialKernel_nonneg_ae d] with w hw
    rw [heatPairingMajorant, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hw, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
  rw [lintegral_congr_ae heq]
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (heatSpatialKernel d w) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal ‖f w.2.1‖ * ENNReal.ofReal ‖f w.2.2‖))
      ((heatParameterMeasure d).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) := by
    exact (heatPairingMajorant_measurable d f).aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal.congr heq
  rw [lintegral_prod_symm _ hm]
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with yz
  have hslice : Measurable (fun tq : ℝ × Space d =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (heatSpatialKernel d (tq,yz))) :=
    ((measurable_heatSpatialKernel d).comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).ennreal_ofReal
  rw [lintegral_mul_const _ hslice, lintegral_heatSpatialKernel]

name: SVW.integrable_heatPairingMajorant
statement:
theorem integrable_heatPairingMajorant (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    Integrable (heatPairingMajorant d f)
      ((heatParameterMeasure d).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))))
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : ∀ᵐ yz ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))),
      positiveKernelENN d yz.1 yz.2 = positiveKernelENN d yz.2 yz.1 :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun yz => positiveKernelENN_symmetric d yz.1 yz.2
  have hu : AEMeasurable (fun x : Space d => ENNReal.ofReal ‖f x‖) volume :=
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).norm.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal
  have hb := kernel_schur_lintegral_ae (Space d) volume
    (fun yz => positiveKernelENN d yz.1 yz.2) (measurable_positiveKernelENN d) hsym
    (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ‖f x‖) hu 1
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => lintegral_positiveKernelENN_row_le_one d hd y)
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : Space d => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).mp (Lp.memLp f)
  have hsq : (∫⁻ x : Space d, ENNReal.ofReal ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = ENNReal.ofReal (‖f‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [← lp_integral_norm_sq (Space d) volume f,
      ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => sq_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg (f x)) 2).symm
  refine ⟨heatPairingMajorant_measurable d f,
    (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (heatPairingMajorant_nonneg_ae d f)).mpr ?_⟩
  rw [lintegral_heatPairingMajorant]
  exact hb.trans_lt (by rw [hsq, one_mul]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)

name: SVW.integrable_heatPairingIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrable_heatPairingIntegrand (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    Integrable (heatPairingIntegrand d f)
      ((heatParameterMeasure d).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))))
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_heatPairingMajorant d hd f).mono
  · exact (measurable_heatSpatialKernel d).complex_ofReal.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      (((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).comp_fst.inner
        (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).comp_snd).comp_snd)
  · filter_upwards [heatSpatialKernel_nonneg_ae d, heatPairingMajorant_nonneg_ae d f]
      with w hw hmajor
    rw [heatPairingIntegrand, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hw,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg hmajor]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) _ _) hw

name: SVW.integral_heatPairingIntegrand
statement:
theorem integral_heatPairingIntegrand (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ w, heatPairingIntegrand d f w ∂(heatParameterMeasure d).prod
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d, (positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2 : ℂ) *
        inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ (integrable_heatPairingIntegrand d hd f)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with yz
  change (∫ tq, (heatSpatialKernel d (tq,yz) : ℂ) * inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
    ∂heatParameterMeasure d) = _
  rw [integral_mul_const, integral_complex_ofReal, integral_heatSpatialKernel]

name: SVW.integral_heatPairing_iterated
statement:
theorem integral_heatPairing_iterated (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ tq, ∫ yz : Space d × Space d, heatPairingIntegrand d f (tq,yz)
      ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
        ∂heatParameterMeasure d) =
      ∫ yz : Space d × Space d, (positiveKernel d yz.1 yz.2 : ℂ) *
        inner ℂ (f yz.1) (f yz.2)
          ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:=
  (integral_integral (f := fun tq yz => heatPairingIntegrand d f (tq,yz))
    (integrable_heatPairingIntegrand d hd f)).trans
    (integral_heatPairingIntegrand d hd f)

name: SVW.fourier_real_gaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_real_gaussian (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun x : Space d => (gaussian d b x : ℂ)) p =
      (((π / b) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (exp (-π ^ 2 * ‖p‖ ^ 2 / b) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (fun x : Space d => (gaussian d b x : ℂ)) =
      (fun x : Space d => Complex.exp (-(b : ℂ) * (‖x‖ : ℂ) ^ 2)) := by
    funext x
    simp [gaussian, Complex.ofReal_exp]
  rw [hf, fourier_gaussian_innerProductSpace (by simpa using hb)]
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (Space d) = d := by simp [Space]
  rw [hdim]
  congr 1
  · rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow (div_nonneg pi_pos.le hb.le)]
    push_cast
    rfl
  · simp [Complex.ofReal_exp]

name: SVW.fourier_heatDensity
statement:
theorem fourier_heatDensity (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun x : Space d => (heatDensity d t x : ℂ)) p =
      (exp (-t * ‖p‖ ^ 2) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (fun x : Space d => (heatDensity d t x : ℂ)) =
      (((π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (fun x : Space d => (gaussian d (π ^ 2 / t) x : ℂ)) := by
    funext x
    simp [heatDensity]
  have hs (a : ℂ) (f : Space d → ℂ) : 𝓕 (a • f) p = a * 𝓕 f p := by
    simp only [Real.fourier_eq', Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by ring)
  rw [hf, hs, fourier_real_gaussian d (π ^ 2 / t) (by positivity)]
  have hc : (π / t) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) *
      (π / (π ^ 2 / t)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_rpow (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / t)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ π / (π ^ 2 / t))]
    have he : π / t * (π / (π ^ 2 / t)) = 1 := by field_simp
    rw [he, one_rpow]
  have he : -π ^ 2 * ‖p‖ ^ 2 / (π ^ 2 / t) = -t * ‖p‖ ^ 2 := by field_simp
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, hc, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul, he]

name: SVW.integral_resolvent_symbol
statement:
theorem integral_resolvent_symbol (b s : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix b t * exp (-s ^ 2 * t) =
      b ^ 2 / (b ^ 2 + s ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < b ^ 2 + s ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]
  have hf : (fun t => exponentialMix b t * exp (-s ^ 2 * t)) =
      (fun t => b ^ 2 * exp (-(b ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * t)) := by
    funext t
    unfold exponentialMix
    rw [mul_assoc, ← exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring_nf
  rw [hf, integral_const_mul,
    integral_exp_mul_Ioi (a := -(b ^ 2+s ^ 2)) (by linarith) 0]
  simp only [mul_zero, exp_zero, div_neg, neg_div, neg_neg]
  ring

name: SVW.norm_fourierPhase
statement: theorem norm_fourierPhase (d : ℕ) (p x : Space d) : ‖fourierPhase d p x‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _

name: SVW.measurable_fourierPhase
statement:
theorem measurable_fourierPhase (d : ℕ) (p : Space d) :
    Measurable (fourierPhase d p)
proof:
:= by

name: SVW.integrable_mixedHeat_fourierPhase
statement:
theorem integrable_mixedHeat_fourierPhase (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b)
    (p : Space d) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ × Space d => fourierPhase d p z.2 * (mixedHeat d b z : ℂ))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun z : ℝ × Space d => (mixedHeat d b z : ℂ))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioi 0)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))) :=
    (integrable_mixedHeat d b hb).ofReal
  apply hi.mono
  · exact (((measurable_fourierPhase d p).comp measurable_snd).mul
      ((measurable_mixedHeat d b).complex_ofReal)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by rw [norm_mul, norm_fourierPhase, one_mul])

name: SVW.fourierPhase_mixedHeat_integral
statement:
theorem fourierPhase_mixedHeat_integral (d : ℕ) (b t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (p : Space d) :
    (∫ x : Space d, fourierPhase d p x * (mixedHeat d b (t,x) : ℂ)) =
      ((exponentialMix b t * exp (-t * ‖p‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun x : Space d => fourierPhase d p x * (mixedHeat d b (t,x) : ℂ)) =
      (fun x => (exponentialMix b t : ℂ) *
        (fourierPhase d p x * (heatDensity d t x : ℂ))) := by
    funext x
    simp only [mixedHeat, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring
  rw [he, integral_const_mul]
  have hf : (∫ x : Space d, fourierPhase d p x * (heatDensity d t x : ℂ)) =
      𝓕 (fun x : Space d => (heatDensity d t x : ℂ)) p := by
    simp only [Real.fourier_eq', smul_eq_mul, fourierPhase]
  rw [hf, fourier_heatDensity d t ht, Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: SVW.fourier_heatResolvent
statement:
theorem fourier_heatResolvent (d : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (p : Space d) :
    𝓕 (fun x : Space d => (heatResolvent d b x : ℂ)) p =
      ((b ^ 2 / (b ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq']
  change (∫ x : Space d, fourierPhase d p x * (heatResolvent d b x : ℂ)) = _
  calc
    (∫ x : Space d, fourierPhase d p x * (heatResolvent d b x : ℂ)) =
        ∫ x : Space d, ∫ t in Ioi 0,
          fourierPhase d p x * (mixedHeat d b (t,x) : ℂ) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal, heatResolvent_eq_heatIntegral]
    _ = ∫ t in Ioi 0, ∫ x : Space d,
        fourierPhase d p x * (mixedHeat d b (t,x) : ℂ) :=
      integral_integral_swap (integrable_mixedHeat_fourierPhase d b hb p).swap
    _ = ∫ t in Ioi 0,
        ((exponentialMix b t * exp (-t * ‖p‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      exact fourierPhase_mixedHeat_integral d b t ht p
    _ = ((b ^ 2 / (b ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [integral_complex_ofReal]
      congr 1
      have he : (fun t : ℝ => exponentialMix b t * exp (-t * ‖p‖ ^ 2)) =
          (fun t => exponentialMix b t * exp (-‖p‖ ^ 2 * t)) := by
        funext t
        congr 2
        ring
      rw [he, integral_resolvent_symbol b ‖p‖ hb]

name: SVW.expMix_div_sqrt_eq
statement:
theorem expMix_div_sqrt_eq (b t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    exponentialMix b t / sqrt t = b^2 * (t^(-(1:ℝ)/2) * exp (-(b^2)*t))
proof:
:= by
  unfold exponentialMix
  rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv, ← rpow_neg ht.le]
  ring_nf

name: SVW.integrable_exponentialMix_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem integrable_exponentialMix_div_sqrt (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => exponentialMix b t / sqrt t) (Ioi 0) volume
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
    (p := (1:ℝ)) (s := -(1:ℝ)/2) (b := b^2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have he : (fun t => t^(-(1:ℝ)/2) * exp (-(b^2)*t^(1:ℝ))) =
      (fun t => t^(-(1:ℝ)/2) * exp (-(b^2)*t)) := by simp only [rpow_one]
  rw [he] at hi
  apply (hi.const_mul (b^2)).congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
  exact (expMix_div_sqrt_eq b t ht).symm

name: SVW.integral_exponentialMix_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem integral_exponentialMix_div_sqrt (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix b t / sqrt t) = b * sqrt π
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∫ t in Ioi 0, exponentialMix b t / sqrt t) =
      ∫ t in Ioi 0, b^2 * (t^(-(1:ℝ)/2) * exp (-(b^2)*t)) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
    exact expMix_div_sqrt_eq b t ht
  rw [he, integral_const_mul]
  have hi := integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
    (p := (1:ℝ)) (q := -(1:ℝ)/2) (b := b^2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  simp only [rpow_one] at hi
  rw [hi]
  have he1 : -(-(1:ℝ)/2+1)/1 = -(1:ℝ)/2 := by norm_num
  have he2 : (-(1:ℝ)/2+1)/1 = (1:ℝ)/2 := by norm_num
  rw [he1, he2, Gamma_one_half_eq]
  norm_num only [one_div_one, mul_one]
  have hr : (b^2)^(-((1:ℝ)/2)) = 1/b := by
    rw [rpow_neg (sq_nonneg _),
      ← sqrt_eq_rpow, sqrt_sq hb.le]
    simp only [one_div]
  rw [hr]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hb]

name: SVW.heatEnergyIntegrand_nonneg
statement:
theorem heatEnergyIntegrand_nonneg (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (w : ℝ × (Space d × Space d)) :

name: SVW.separatorEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem separatorEnergy_nonneg (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) (z : Space d × Space d) :

proof: := mul_nonneg (separatorSymbol_nonneg d z.1 z.2) (sq_nonneg _)

name: SVW.heatEnergyIntegrand_measurable
statement:
theorem heatEnergyIntegrand_measurable (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (heatEnergyIntegrand d f)
      (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioi 0)).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous (fun w : ℝ × (Space d × Space d) =>
      heatSymbolIntegrand d w.2.1 w.2.2 w.1) := by
    unfold heatSymbolIntegrand exponentialMix
    fun_prop
  exact hs.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
    ((wavePacketCoefficient_memLp d f (gaussianL2Window d)).aestronglyMeasurable.norm.pow 2).comp_snd

name: SVW.integrable_separatorEnergy
statement:
theorem integrable_separatorEnergy (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    Integrable (separatorEnergy d f)
      ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := wavePacketCoefficient_memLp d f (gaussianL2Window d)
  have hi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hc.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hc
  apply hi.mono
  · exact (measurable_separatorSymbol d).aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hc.aestronglyMeasurable.norm.pow 2)
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (separatorEnergy_nonneg d f z),
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (separatorSymbol_le_one d z.1 z.2)

name: SVW.lintegral_heatEnergyIntegrand
statement:
theorem lintegral_heatEnergyIntegrand (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (heatEnergyIntegrand d f w)
      ∂((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioi 0)).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      ∫⁻ z : Space d × Space d, ENNReal.ofReal (separatorEnergy d f z)
        ∂((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_prod_symm _ (heatEnergyIntegrand_measurable d f).aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal]
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with z
  have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (heatEnergyIntegrand d f (t,z))) =
      fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (heatSymbolIntegrand d z.1 z.2 t) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (‖wavePacketCoefficient d f (gaussianL2Window d) z.1 z.2‖ ^ 2) := by
    funext t
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_mul (heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg d z.1 z.2 t)
  rw [hfun]
  have hm : Measurable (fun t : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (heatSymbolIntegrand d z.1 z.2 t)) := by
    unfold heatSymbolIntegrand exponentialMix
    fun_prop
  rw [lintegral_mul_const _ hm,
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (integrable_heatSymbolIntegrand d z.1 z.2)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (heatSymbolIntegrand_nonneg d z.1 z.2)),
    integral_heatSymbolIntegrand, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (separatorSymbol_nonneg d z.1 z.2)]
  rfl

name: SVW.integrable_heatEnergyIntegrand
statement:
theorem integrable_heatEnergyIntegrand (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    Integrable (heatEnergyIntegrand d f)
      (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioi 0)).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d))))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨heatEnergyIntegrand_measurable d f,
    (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (heatEnergyIntegrand_nonneg d f))).mpr ?_⟩
  rw [lintegral_heatEnergyIntegrand]
  exact (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (separatorEnergy_nonneg d f))).mp (integrable_separatorEnergy d f).2

name: SVW.integral_heatEnergyIntegrand
statement:
theorem integral_heatEnergyIntegrand (d : ℕ) (f : Hilbert d) :
    (∫ w, heatEnergyIntegrand d f w
      ∂((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioi 0)).prod
        ((volume : Measure (Space d)).prod (volume : Measure (Space d)))) =
      (inner ℂ (gaussianSeparator d f) f).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (heatEnergyIntegrand_nonneg d f))
